blocks.text: This module defines RPC wire data and provides construction, validation, normalization, and framing. It opens no connection, executes no remote method, owns no Endpoint, and binds to neither Node nor DOM/Worker APIs. Stateful framers own bounded assembly buffers and expiry timers only. Runtime dependencies are `@migaia/serialize` and `@migaia/utils`, without peer dependencies.

Ordinary TypeScript callers usually use it through rpc-core, where this module is a peer dependency. Independent-language peers, carrier adapters, and cross-boundary error handling are its direct consumers. rpc-process reuses Content-Length framing and error conversion; serialize owns the underlying portable traversal and error-chain implementation.

V1 uses named rpcProtocol and normalizeRpcEnvelope exports without a default aggregate; the root calls its protocol object rpcProtocolV1. createReassembler and IRpcReassembler were removed: use the original framer.accept/close or Pick their method types. Complete-string carriers use remoteProcessStringFramer. The bare processStringFramer is internal, without a compatibility alias.

RpcProtocol supplies the identity migaia.rpc and current major/minor 1.1. RpcCodecId maintains codec labels such as json. RpcCapability maintains versioned names such as ping@1, batch@1, stream@1, runtime-api@1, group@1, and transfer@1. Independent implementations must use the same wire values.

RpcPeerRuntime has keys such as node, bun, deno, electron, python, rust, go, and java. A valid runtime string such as browser does not imply a browser constant key exists. RpcEnvelopeKind, RpcRouteField/Key/Profile/Type, RpcWireLimit, RpcStreamLimit, and RpcWireErrorLimit own envelope, route, and budget vocabulary. Route fields include timeoutMs, idempotencyKey, and trace. RpcRuntime* defines runtime-call data. Import RpcBinaryTag from wire; binary entries expose profile/storage/native-kind domains.

createDescriptor(id, version) returns a frozen exact identity. Both arguments are required without defaults; version must be a positive safe integer. Invalid descriptors retain TypeError with INVALID_DESCRIPTOR. A descriptor does not establish a connection or register a service.

Ordinary normalizePortable(value, depth?, active?) uses the wire domain. Value is required, depth defaults to 0, and an omitted active set is created for ancestors rather than global deduplication. RPC_PORTABLE_MAX_DEPTH is 64. Repeated objects in separate branches receive separate copies; only an ancestor back-edge is a cycle.

blocks.text: Undefined property values also fail. The reserved $rpc marker is accepted only for a complete valid bytes tag. Invalid alphabets, padding, or noncanonical trailing bits are not valid tags. Byte admission checks genuine internal slots, allowing other realms and legitimate Uint8Array subclasses without trusting forged toStringTag values or DataViews.

Ordinary wire traversal can execute record getters, capturing them once. This differs from strict runtime own-data validation below. Reflection/getter failures preserve their cause. The advanced native-guard overload invokes its guard without a receiver at native binary admission and preserves the thrown object; application callers rarely need to manage active or this guard.

A separate overload serves negotiated runtime native-binary data. It can retain ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array identities and uses strict own-data descriptors. This does not widen the default wire normalizer's return domain. ArrayBuffer transmission belongs to the binary profile, not ordinary portable input.

createRpcHello(offer) returns JSON text to send. acceptRpcHandshake(localOffer, hello) negotiates and returns an accepted agreement or a rejected reply/error. completeRpcHandshake(localOffer, reply) confirms the result. normalizeRpcHandshake(text) validates received handshake text. None of these functions sends data or authenticates a peer.

An offer requires peer, versions, codecs, and capabilities. peer.id/runtime describes the local participant; each version has major/minor. Codecs must include json and preserve preference order. Capabilities are unique versioned names; an empty list proposes no optional capabilities. Optional auth carries portable credentials for upper-layer validation, not proof that authentication succeeded. Agreement.peer always describes the other side.

Negotiation selects the highest shared major, the lower shared minor, the first common codec in initiator order, and the capability intersection in initiator order. An incompatible version or codec yields ok false and a reject reply from the responder. The initiator receives HANDSHAKE_REJECTED, potentially with HANDSHAKE_INCOMPATIBLE on cause. Invalid UTF-8, JSON, fields, or selections produce HANDSHAKE_INVALID rather than an automatic downgrade.

Public handshake causes may be bounded frozen redaction summaries. Credential-bearing raw text, objects, and engine JSON excerpts are not unconditionally retained. A verified clean native decoder/getter failure can still retain its exact identity. Classify by source/code rather than depending on raw input echoes.
The native prefix and JSON-RPC Content-Length formats are different and cannot be mixed.

rows: encodeRpcStreamFrame; createRpcStreamFrameDecoder delivers onFrame and reports its first protocol failure through onError before termination
encodeJsonRpcFrame; createJsonRpcFrameDecoder.push returns complete values, while invalid push/finish operations throw bridge errors

blocks.text: The native encoder requires a nonempty Uint8Array payload. RPC_STREAM_MAX_FRAME_BYTES is 16 MiB. Empty or invalid payloads produce INVALID_FRAME; oversize produces FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. Decoder options require both onFrame(frame) and onError(error), without defaults. push accepts arbitrary splits and copies input into its owned frame storage, allowing the caller to reuse chunks. finish checks partial EOF and terminates this decoder; close discards state. Calling close/finish from onFrame stops remaining delivery from the current chunk.

createRpcStreamFrameDecoderWithLimit(options, maxFrameBytes) reads the current limit before each allocation, supporting smaller handshake budgets. Both callbacks and the limit function are caller-supplied. Bootstrap and handshake receivers process the first frame and queue later data before activation, without owning a connection.

Content-Length uses actual UTF-8 byte length rather than JavaScript string length. Its decoder has no constructor arguments; push may return no messages or several, and bufferedBytes reports retained bytes. JsonRpcLimit has headerBytes 1024, bodyBytes 16 MiB, and handshakeMs 10000. Malformed/duplicate/missing headers, invalid UTF-8/JSON, or partial EOF produce JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID. Here finish only checks leftovers and does not close the decoder. close clears it and makes later push calls return an empty array. Do not apply native-prefix onError/termination semantics to this decoder.

createStringFramer(options?) and createBinaryFramer(options?) provide a descriptor, encoded-type labels, frame(value, context), accept(frame, context), and close(reason?). Context requires source and messageId. The carrier supplies source to separate equal message identifiers from different origins. frame returns physical frames. accept returns pending, complete/value, or rejected/error; categorized rejection results are not all thrown exceptions.
Options default to an empty object. Numeric fields must be positive safe integers.

chunkBytes cannot exceed maxMessageBytes, which cannot exceed maxBufferedBytes. Callers can supply schedule(callback, delayMs) and cancel(handle); otherwise available host setTimeout/clearTimeout are used. The module does not invent timer support when the host lacks it.

The now field is retained but does not drive assembly expiry; changing a fake now alone does not advance the timer. The framer owns its timers and should be closed by its owner. Complete messages and fragments both enforce maxMessageBytes. String limits use UTF-16 code units despite byte-oriented option names; binary limits use byteLength. Inspect encoded physical UTF-8 size separately with inspectRpcPhysicalFrame(value, limit).

Fragments must satisfy first-chunk, order, count, and total-length rules. Late, duplicate, expired, or oversized input is rejected. Assemblies use the source/messageId pair rather than ambiguous delimiter concatenation. The caller handles result dispatch; the framer sends no network data and does not authenticate source.

Timers are detached before cancellation, so reentrant close does not cancel twice. Unclassified schedule/warn failures receive CALLBACK_FAILED. Cancel failures reach available host reportError or utils' host exception queue, preserving the cleanup primary and reporter secondary without replacing a completed frame result. Physical inspection measures actual encoded frames; splitBatch divides splittable batches in half, while an oversized single message fails with RangeError.
remoteProcessStringFramer preserves existing complete-string carrier boundaries without fragmentation. Nonstring input retains TypeError with INVALID_FRAME.

normalizeRuntimeEnvelope validates live received runtime records through own data properties, rejecting accessors without invoking them. Runtime request/notify/stream/group vocabulary belongs to runtime. createRuntimeCallEnvelope in runtime/metadata constructs outbound call headers; normalizeRuntimeGeneration and normalizeRuntimeSteps validate generations and group steps. Steps must form a nonempty dense own-data array; there is no separate fixed step-count limit, and physical byte budgets remain independent.

normalizeRuntimeEnvelopeDecoded and restoreRpcBinaryDecoded are for fresh output of this module's codec that no other code has touched. They preserve data grammar, first-error behavior, and frozen metadata while omitting full descriptor checks, so hand-built getters can execute. Ordinary prototype checks still apply: structuredClone preserving Date/Map does not make them records. Use strict variants for uncertain input. Decoded is not a public trust flag. In runtime/lazy, scalar paths may return synchronously and stream paths may return a Promise; callers support both.

normalizeStreamPayload validates payloads. checkRpcStreamSequence/Progress/ConsumerCredit/ProducerCredit check consecutive sequence, progress, consumer credit, and producer busy state. Success returns undefined; protocol failure returns a coded Error for the caller to report, terminate, or cancel. Do not assume it was thrown. checkRpcRuntimeStreamTransition/Intent compares termination or early control against start options. These helpers do not schedule producers, transmit data, or replay delivered items.

sections.heading: Binary capture, manifests, restoration, and budgets

blocks.text: prepareRpcBinary(envelope, storage, limit?, digest?, codec?) creates manifests, native sidecars, and totals. restoreRpcBinary validates manifests/integrity before restoring data. Its Decoded variant has the preceding trust restriction. captureRpcBinaryData captures synchronously for later prepare. The lazy entry captures data before loading the full codec and computes its first digest when the native branch requires one.

Native storage charges the complete backing ArrayBuffer. Inline storage charges offset + visibleLength, copies visible bytes only, and preserves a zero prefix. Limit does not unconditionally cover every manifest metadata field. The native + encode-only codec prehash branch separately checks the full physical frame. Inline and other codec paths leave physical frame limits to that codec or the caller.

The digest parameter is optional, but native storage requires a caller-supplied real SHA-256 over each complete backing; inline storage needs no digest. An omitted limit defaults to 16 MiB, and restoration sidecars default to an empty array []. The optional final codec handles metadata. binary/inspect helpers such as assertRpcNativeBinaryFrameSize charge complete backings, read native binary, and classify integrity failures. They do not choose a transport or release remote resources.

sections.heading: Error trees, native classes, and JSON-RPC mapping

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) requires value and options.report. The callback receives { pointer, field, error } for omitted property-read or normalization failures; its count is not a complete truncation count. The bounded tree has source/code/name/message/stack and optional cause/errors/data/route/truncated. Unclassified thrown values use unknown/UNKNOWN. Cross-realm native names and sender stacks survive projection. deserializeRpcError validates before restoring Error, RangeError, TypeError, and other supported classes, retaining sender stack text.

RpcWireErrorLimit is maxNesting 48, maxEmbeddingDepth 16, maxNodes 1024, maxStringBytes 65536, and maxBytes 1048576. Budget/text truncation can cut content and mark truncated without reporting every cut. Cyclic edges are removed. reachRpcError(value, { report }) walks cause, errors, and cleanup failures with reference deduplication; RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects is 4096.

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) defaults options to an empty object. unknownFields is reject by default or ignore; onUnknownField is optional without a callback default. deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) uses those rules; routes can expose a caller-owned WeakMap set capability to retain admitted route diagnostics. Serialization reads its fixed fields rather than arbitrary own properties. An unreadable field can be reported while preserving the root and marking truncation.

Optional metadata.summaries and metadata.routes are WeakMap get capabilities keyed by Error references. Summaries supply an outward code/message while hiding internal causes; preserveSerializedError: true retains existing descendants. Routes are bounded diagnostics without control authority.

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) stores the tree in error.data.migaiaWireError. The caller selects the integer JSON-RPC code; it is not automatically the wire string code. fromJsonRpcError also accepts ordinary errors without that extension, using foreignSource jsonrpc-2.0 and the integer code as a string. RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey owns the extension name. Independent adapters use their own source/code. They can install utils directly and use attachErrorIdentity to retain native errors rather than impersonating official RPC sources.

classifyRpcContractError recognizes only exact local references issued by this module and returns their outward code/message. Copies or deserialized remote errors return undefined. Remote source/code is diagnostic identity, not proof of local origin or authority to retry/control an operation.

schema/wire-error is a structural starting point, not the complete bounded normalizer. Independent implementations also enforce x-migaia-limits, canonical base64url, and surrogate rules. Schema additionalProperties does not match default normalizer rejection. A native peer in another language also needs prefix framing, handshake, and runtime envelopes. The JSON-RPC bridge needs its four extension methods, owned by the rpc-process protocol layer rather than a connection implementation here.
Contract errors retain the semantic source `@migaia/rpc/contract`, exported as `RPC_CONTRACT_SOURCE`, and use RpcContractErrorCode for the code.

blocks.text: Shape errors retain native classes. Mutable callback errors are tagged in place without stack rewriting; immutable/non-Error values stay on cause. Complete upstream source/code identities retain their owner. Fatal UTF-8 decoder errors remain on HANDSHAKE_INVALID/INVALID_FRAME causes.

The bridge source is `@migaia/rpc/bridge/jsonrpc`, exported as JSONRPC_BRIDGE_ERROR_SOURCE. JsonRpcBridgeErrorCode contains JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID, JSONRPC_EXTENSION_MISSING, JSONRPC_PROFILE_INVALID, JSONRPC_UNSUPPORTED_MODE, and JSONRPC_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT for framing, extensions, profile, mode, and handshake timing. Do not classify bridge errors as the contract source.

Other layers use `@migaia/rpc/core` (RPC_CORE_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcCoreErrorCode), `@migaia/rpc/remote` (RPC_REMOTE_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcRemoteLayerErrorCode), `@migaia/rpc/process` (RPC_PROCESS_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcProcessErrorCode), and `@migaia/rpc/threads` (RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcThreadErrorCode). Branch on source/code; message is presentation text rather than retry policy.

blocks.text: Each independent example matches its website case and opens no connection. Install the module first:

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/rpc-contract

sections.heading: Capture data before the caller changes it

blocks.text: An adapter validates a payload, then the caller changes its nested object or byte array before encoding. The message should keep the values admitted at the validation boundary.
Keeping the original object lets later mutations change what is sent. A shallow spread still shares nested records and bytes, so it does not establish a stable payload snapshot.
normalizePortable creates a frozen portable snapshot. The default wire profile copies records and converts Uint8Array bytes into a canonical unpadded Base64URL tag; it does not send a request.

normalizePortable requires value. Here profile/name and bytes are business data rather than RPC endpoint fields. Omitting depth/active starts at depth 0 with this traversal’s ancestor set. The Uint8Array’s visible bytes become an unpadded base64url tag instead of retaining the original array identity.

blocks.code:
import { normalizePortable } from '@migaia/rpc-contract/portable'

const source = { profile: { name: 'Ada' }, bytes: new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]) }
const snapshot = normalizePortable(source)
source.profile.name = 'Grace'
source.bytes[0] = 99
console.log(JSON.stringify(snapshot))
console.log(Object.isFrozen(snapshot))

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
{"profile":{"name":"Ada"},"bytes":{"$rpc":"bytes","base64url":"AQID"}}
true

blocks.text: Prints `{"profile":{"name":"Ada"},"bytes":{"$rpc":"bytes","base64url":"AQID"}}` and `true`. Later source mutations do not change the captured name or the encoded bytes.

Ordinary records become frozen null-prototype snapshots. This default profile produces a bytes tag, not a restored Uint8Array; negotiated native-binary paths have a separate contract. Getters on ordinary wire records are read once and can execute user code.

sections.heading: Reject values that cannot preserve their meaning on the wire

blocks.text: A nonfinite measurement can be silently saved as null, while a cyclic payload cannot form a finite wire tree. Both should be rejected before an adapter commits to sending the message.
JSON.stringify changes NaN to null inside a record. Checking only the top-level object misses invalid descendants and cycles that appear deeper in the payload.

normalizePortable walks the supported value tree and rejects invalid descendants. Compare the JSON result with the categorized TypeError, then submit a separate cyclic object through the same public entry.

Both calls require value: a record containing NaN, then a self-reference. No advanced options are passed. The default domain accepts only finite numbers, with root depth 0 and maximum depth 64. Invalid data throws TypeError with INVALID_ENVELOPE.
Output:
Prints `{"total":null}`, `nonfinite: true INVALID_ENVELOPE`, then `cycle: true INVALID_ENVELOPE`. Validation neither substitutes a finite value nor accepts a recursive reference.

The default domain includes null, booleans, finite numbers, strings, arrays, plain records and portable bytes. Its maximum depth is 64 with root depth 0; Date, Map, Set, functions and unsupported primitive values are not admitted.

sections.heading: Preserve native error classes and remote cause stacks

blocks.text: A remote operation fails with a TypeError caused by a RangeError. The receiver needs both semantic codes and the original stacks to understand which operation failed and why.
Sending only error.message drops the cause tree, native classes and stacks. Creating a fresh local error from that text assigns a receiving-side stack that hides the original failure location.

serializeRpcError projects a bounded coded tree, and deserializeRpcError validates it before restoring native classes. Supply the required report callback to retain any fields that cannot be read or normalized.

serializeRpcError requires value and options. options.report is a required synchronous callback; here it collects failure records without an implicit reporter. source/code supplies semantic identity and cause carries the original reason. deserializeRpcError options may be omitted; unknown fields default to reject.
Output:

blocks.code:
true true
true true
REQUEST LIMIT 0

blocks.text: Prints `true true`, `true true`, then `REQUEST LIMIT 0`. Both native classes and stack strings survive the round trip, both semantic codes remain present, and no field failures are reported.

Restoration creates new Error objects, so cross-boundary object identity is not preserved. The tree is bounded and can carry cause, AggregateError errors and a truncation marker; no connection or request is executed by these functions.

sections.heading: Report unreadable error fields without losing the wire error

blocks.text: A diagnostic serializer encounters an Error whose message getter throws. Losing the whole diagnostic would hide both the original operation and the new field-read failure.
Direct property reads while building a JSON object let the getter exception escape the logging path. Ignoring that exception instead removes evidence that a field was omitted.

serializeRpcError captures supported fields and routes omitted read failures to report. Save the fixture stack before installing its hostile message getter, then collect each report record for inspection.

Each report entry contains pointer, field, and error. The error here is the original message-getter failure. No metadata argument supplies custom summaries or routes. Object.defineProperty builds a local failure fixture rather than configuring the normalizer.
Output:

blocks.code:
Error UNKNOWN
1 message true

blocks.text: Prints `Error UNKNOWN` and `1 message true`. A wire error is still returned, and the report identifies the unreadable message field with the exact original TypeError.

report is required and receives pointer, field and the original failure synchronously. These records are local diagnostic evidence, not extra wire fields. Untagged errors use the unknown source/code fallback; unreadable fields follow the bounded serializer policy.

sections.heading: Keep equal message identifiers from different peers separate

blocks.text: Two peers each send a fragmented message named job. Their chunks can interleave, but completing one message must not concatenate bytes from the other peer.
A buffer map keyed only by messageId merges unrelated senders. Even ordered chunks then produce a plausible but incorrect combined value, or consume another sender assembly state.
createStringFramer retains assemblies by source and messageId together. Set chunkBytes to 2, interleave the two first fragments, then finish each source separately and close the framer.

Options are optional and default to empty. Here chunkBytes changes from 16384 to 2; string units are UTF-16 code units. context.source and context.messageId are required without defaults. Both origins reuse job. frame/accept require a value and context; close has an optional reason.
Output:

blocks.code:
pending pending
abcd
wxyz

blocks.text: Prints `pending pending`, `abcd`, then `wxyz`. Both partial assemblies coexist despite sharing job as messageId, and each complete result contains only its own source data.

The caller owns trusted source attribution and message correlation; frame data does not authenticate a peer. This string profile counts UTF-16 code units despite the chunkBytes option name, requires ordered delivery, and releases retained timers through close().

sections.heading: Reject out-of-order chunks and close partial assemblies

blocks.text: A receiver sees the second fragment before the first, then shuts down after receiving only a prefix. It needs an explicit rejection result and a way to release the unfinished assembly.
Joining whichever fragments arrive produces reordered payloads. Keeping the prefix after shutdown leaves assembly buffers and timeout ownership alive beyond the receiver lifetime.

createStringFramer.accept returns pending, complete or rejected. Submit the out-of-order fragment, start a valid prefix, then call close() before another accept to observe the terminal ingress boundary.

The example uses chunkBytes: 2 and required source/messageId. accept returns pending, complete/value, or rejected/error without reordering fragments. close(reason?) defaults reason to undefined, releases retained state, and rejects further ingress. Other limits retain the defaults below.
Output:

blocks.code:
rejected INVALID_FRAME
pending
rejected INVALID_FRAME

blocks.text: Prints `rejected INVALID_FRAME`, `pending`, then `rejected INVALID_FRAME`. The early second fragment is refused; after a valid prefix, close() prevents further acceptance.

Invalid incoming fragments return categorized rejections, while invalid construction limits throw. close() clears assemblies and timers; this framer does not reorder or retry delivery, and frame-size, chunk-count and concurrency limits still apply.

Negotiation selects the highest shared major, the lower shared minor, the first common codec in initiator order, and the capability intersection in initiator order. An incompatible version or codec yields ok false and a reject reply from the responder. The initiator receives HANDSHAKE_REJECTED, potentially with HANDSHAKE_INCOMPATIBLE on cause. Invalid UTF-8, JSON, fields, or selections produce HANDSHAKE_INVALID rather than an automatic downgrade.

Public handshake causes may be bounded frozen redaction summaries. Credential-bearing raw text, objects, and engine JSON excerpts are not unconditionally retained. A verified clean native decoder/getter failure can still retain its exact identity. Classify by source/code rather than depending on raw input echoes.
The native prefix and JSON-RPC Content-Length formats are different and cannot be mixed.

rows: encodeRpcStreamFrame; createRpcStreamFrameDecoder delivers onFrame and reports its first protocol failure through onError before termination
encodeJsonRpcFrame; createJsonRpcFrameDecoder.push returns complete values, while invalid push/finish operations throw bridge errors

blocks.text: The native encoder requires a nonempty Uint8Array payload. RPC_STREAM_MAX_FRAME_BYTES is 16 MiB. Empty or invalid payloads produce INVALID_FRAME; oversize produces FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. Decoder options require both onFrame(frame) and onError(error), without defaults. push accepts arbitrary splits and copies input into its owned frame storage, allowing the caller to reuse chunks. finish checks partial EOF and terminates this decoder; close discards state. Calling close/finish from onFrame stops remaining delivery from the current chunk.

createRpcStreamFrameDecoderWithLimit(options, maxFrameBytes) reads the current limit before each allocation, supporting smaller handshake budgets. Both callbacks and the limit function are caller-supplied. Bootstrap and handshake receivers process the first frame and queue later data before activation, without owning a connection.

Content-Length uses actual UTF-8 byte length rather than JavaScript string length. Its decoder has no constructor arguments; push may return no messages or several, and bufferedBytes reports retained bytes. JsonRpcLimit has headerBytes 1024, bodyBytes 16 MiB, and handshakeMs 10000. Malformed/duplicate/missing headers, invalid UTF-8/JSON, or partial EOF produce JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID. Here finish only checks leftovers and does not close the decoder. close clears it and makes later push calls return an empty array. Do not apply native-prefix onError/termination semantics to this decoder.

createStringFramer(options?) and createBinaryFramer(options?) provide a descriptor, encoded-type labels, frame(value, context), accept(frame, context), and close(reason?). Context requires source and messageId. The carrier supplies source to separate equal message identifiers from different origins. frame returns physical frames. accept returns pending, complete/value, or rejected/error; categorized rejection results are not all thrown exceptions.
Options default to an empty object. Numeric fields must be positive safe integers.

chunkBytes cannot exceed maxMessageBytes, which cannot exceed maxBufferedBytes. Callers can supply schedule(callback, delayMs) and cancel(handle); otherwise available host setTimeout/clearTimeout are used. The module does not invent timer support when the host lacks it.

The now field is retained but does not drive assembly expiry; changing a fake now alone does not advance the timer. The framer owns its timers and should be closed by its owner. Complete messages and fragments both enforce maxMessageBytes. String limits use UTF-16 code units despite byte-oriented option names; binary limits use byteLength. Inspect encoded physical UTF-8 size separately with inspectRpcPhysicalFrame(value, limit).

Fragments must satisfy first-chunk, order, count, and total-length rules. Late, duplicate, expired, or oversized input is rejected. Assemblies use the source/messageId pair rather than ambiguous delimiter concatenation. The caller handles result dispatch; the framer sends no network data and does not authenticate source.

Timers are detached before cancellation, so reentrant close does not cancel twice. Unclassified schedule/warn failures receive CALLBACK_FAILED. Cancel failures reach available host reportError or utils' host exception queue, preserving the cleanup primary and reporter secondary without replacing a completed frame result. Physical inspection measures actual encoded frames; splitBatch divides splittable batches in half, while an oversized single message fails with RangeError.
remoteProcessStringFramer preserves existing complete-string carrier boundaries without fragmentation. Nonstring input retains TypeError with INVALID_FRAME.

normalizeRuntimeEnvelope validates live received runtime records through own data properties, rejecting accessors without invoking them. Runtime request/notify/stream/group vocabulary belongs to runtime. createRuntimeCallEnvelope in runtime/metadata constructs outbound call headers; normalizeRuntimeGeneration and normalizeRuntimeSteps validate generations and group steps. Steps must form a nonempty dense own-data array; there is no separate fixed step-count limit, and physical byte budgets remain independent.

normalizeRuntimeEnvelopeDecoded and restoreRpcBinaryDecoded are for fresh output of this module's codec that no other code has touched. They preserve data grammar, first-error behavior, and frozen metadata while omitting full descriptor checks, so hand-built getters can execute. Ordinary prototype checks still apply: structuredClone preserving Date/Map does not make them records. Use strict variants for uncertain input. Decoded is not a public trust flag. In runtime/lazy, scalar paths may return synchronously and stream paths may return a Promise; callers support both.

normalizeStreamPayload validates payloads. checkRpcStreamSequence/Progress/ConsumerCredit/ProducerCredit check consecutive sequence, progress, consumer credit, and producer busy state. Success returns undefined; protocol failure returns a coded Error for the caller to report, terminate, or cancel. Do not assume it was thrown. checkRpcRuntimeStreamTransition/Intent compares termination or early control against start options. These helpers do not schedule producers, transmit data, or replay delivered items.

sections.heading: Binary capture, manifests, restoration, and budgets

blocks.text: prepareRpcBinary(envelope, storage, limit?, digest?, codec?) creates manifests, native sidecars, and totals. restoreRpcBinary validates manifests/integrity before restoring data. Its Decoded variant has the preceding trust restriction. captureRpcBinaryData captures synchronously for later prepare. The lazy entry captures data before loading the full codec and computes its first digest when the native branch requires one.

Native storage charges the complete backing ArrayBuffer. Inline storage charges offset + visibleLength, copies visible bytes only, and preserves a zero prefix. Limit does not unconditionally cover every manifest metadata field. The native + encode-only codec prehash branch separately checks the full physical frame. Inline and other codec paths leave physical frame limits to that codec or the caller.

The digest parameter is optional, but native storage requires a caller-supplied real SHA-256 over each complete backing; inline storage needs no digest. An omitted limit defaults to 16 MiB, and restoration sidecars default to an empty array []. The optional final codec handles metadata. binary/inspect helpers such as assertRpcNativeBinaryFrameSize charge complete backings, read native binary, and classify integrity failures. They do not choose a transport or release remote resources.

sections.heading: Error trees, native classes, and JSON-RPC mapping

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) requires value and options.report. The callback receives { pointer, field, error } for omitted property-read or normalization failures; its count is not a complete truncation count. The bounded tree has source/code/name/message/stack and optional cause/errors/data/route/truncated. Unclassified thrown values use unknown/UNKNOWN. Cross-realm native names and sender stacks survive projection. deserializeRpcError validates before restoring Error, RangeError, TypeError, and other supported classes, retaining sender stack text.

RpcWireErrorLimit is maxNesting 48, maxEmbeddingDepth 16, maxNodes 1024, maxStringBytes 65536, and maxBytes 1048576. Budget/text truncation can cut content and mark truncated without reporting every cut. Cyclic edges are removed. reachRpcError(value, { report }) walks cause, errors, and cleanup failures with reference deduplication; RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects is 4096.

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) defaults options to an empty object. unknownFields is reject by default or ignore; onUnknownField is optional without a callback default. deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) uses those rules; routes can expose a caller-owned WeakMap set capability to retain admitted route diagnostics. Serialization reads its fixed fields rather than arbitrary own properties. An unreadable field can be reported while preserving the root and marking truncation.

Optional metadata.summaries and metadata.routes are WeakMap get capabilities keyed by Error references. Summaries supply an outward code/message while hiding internal causes; preserveSerializedError: true retains existing descendants. Routes are bounded diagnostics without control authority.

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) stores the tree in error.data.migaiaWireError. The caller selects the integer JSON-RPC code; it is not automatically the wire string code. fromJsonRpcError also accepts ordinary errors without that extension, using foreignSource jsonrpc-2.0 and the integer code as a string. RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey owns the extension name. Independent adapters use their own source/code. They can install utils directly and use attachErrorIdentity to retain native errors rather than impersonating official RPC sources.

classifyRpcContractError recognizes only exact local references issued by this module and returns their outward code/message. Copies or deserialized remote errors return undefined. Remote source/code is diagnostic identity, not proof of local origin or authority to retry/control an operation.

schema/wire-error is a structural starting point, not the complete bounded normalizer. Independent implementations also enforce x-migaia-limits, canonical base64url, and surrogate rules. Schema additionalProperties does not match default normalizer rejection. A native peer in another language also needs prefix framing, handshake, and runtime envelopes. The JSON-RPC bridge needs its four extension methods, owned by the rpc-process protocol layer rather than a connection implementation here.
Contract errors use source @migaia/rpc/contract, exported as RPC_CONTRACT_SOURCE, and RpcContractErrorCode.

blocks.text: Shape errors retain native classes. Mutable callback errors are tagged in place without stack rewriting; immutable/non-Error values stay on cause. Complete upstream source/code identities retain their owner. Fatal UTF-8 decoder errors remain on HANDSHAKE_INVALID/INVALID_FRAME causes.

The bridge source is @migaia/rpc/bridge/jsonrpc, exported as JSONRPC_BRIDGE_ERROR_SOURCE. JsonRpcBridgeErrorCode contains JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID, JSONRPC_EXTENSION_MISSING, JSONRPC_PROFILE_INVALID, JSONRPC_UNSUPPORTED_MODE, and JSONRPC_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT for framing, extensions, profile, mode, and handshake timing. Do not classify bridge errors as the contract source.

Other layers use @migaia/rpc/core (RPC_CORE_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcCoreErrorCode), @migaia/rpc/remote (RPC_REMOTE_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcRemoteLayerErrorCode), @migaia/rpc/process (RPC_PROCESS_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcProcessErrorCode), and @migaia/rpc/threads (RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcThreadErrorCode). Branch on source/code; message is presentation text rather than retry policy.

blocks.code:
import { connect, createEndpoint } from '@migaia/rpc-core'
import { createMemoryTransportPair } from '@migaia/rpc-core/adapters/memory'

const [left, right] = createMemoryTransportPair()
const server = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'server',
  transport: right,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: right })]
})
server.provide('double', (context) => context.success((context.data as number) * 2))
const client = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'client',
  targetIds: ['server'],
  transport: left,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: left })]
})
console.log(await client.send<number>('server', 'double', 21))
await client.dispose()
await server.dispose()
left.close()

blocks.text: 完整工厂提供 send、provide、discovery、control 等默认根，ping/pingAll 的公开类型仍由选中的 ping 中间件决定。createClientEndpoint 只发起调用；createProviderEndpoint 提供方法并保留出站调用；createFullEndpoint 双向；createComposedEndpoint(config, roots) 显式选择 Feature 根。createFullOneWayEndpoint 等 one-way 预设增加 sendOneWay，其 Promise 只表示物理发送，不表示业务完成。

provide(method, handler) 返回 Endpoint，可链式注册；重复方法拒绝，不覆盖旧 handler。handler 通过 context.data 读取输入，通过 context.success(value) 或 context.failed(message, code) 结算；不完成会得到 PROVIDER_NOT_SETTLED，过期 context 的 success/failed 返回 ok:false 与 PROVIDER_CONTEXT_EXPIRED，应检查该返回值。

`send<T>`(target, method, data, options?) 等待结果，前三参数必填，无载荷时传 null。sendAll(method, data, options?) 对已知目标汇总 fulfilled/rejected；dispatch(target, method, data) 与 dispatchAll(method, data) 同步返回 void，不等待结果。根 Endpoint 没有 Runtime Peer 的 notify 方法。group/outcome 需要实际组合的能力；ping 需要中间件；on 和 hooks.on 订阅相应事件，返回的释放句柄不代替整个 Endpoint 的 dispose。

send 的 options 可含 signal、timeoutMs、idempotencyKey、trace、transfer。未装 timeout 中间件时，Endpoint 使用 1000 毫秒 fallback；安装 timeout({}) 时未配置值为 undefined，反而不设期限，显式 timeoutMs: false 同样不计时。单次 timeoutMs: 0 在发送前拒绝，false 关闭默认；Runtime Peer 的 30000 毫秒是另一层默认，不能混用。abort() 接入远端取消通知，本地预先取消的 signal 即使没有该中间件也会拒绝。取消或超时不能证明对端没有执行。dispose 注销监听并拒绝在途等待；借用载体不会因此自动关闭，已产生的业务副作用也不回滚。

createRuntimeApiEndpoint(config, channel) 是高级 Runtime 组装入口，同步返回后先 await endpoint.ready。单参数形式限于 { binding }，必须提供完整、真实的 owned binding operations，不能交入假 Endpoint。其 facade 重复及同步重入 dispose 共用首次结算 Promise，底层只调用一次。

该高级配置还支持 protocol、codec、framer、provider、idempotency、providerLimits、replay、middlewares、features 与 construction；transport 接收 framer 的输出，codec 输出必须匹配 framer 输入。provider 在构造完成前登记，idempotency 只用于带键的调用，不自动把所有方法变成幂等操作。

blocks.text: defineMiddleware / defineFeature 使用原 owner 扩展日志、诊断或策略；公开扩展不能自行引入新的协议级根能力。功能与中间件声明的字段不能冲突；两端编码、分帧和能力组合必须兼容。connect 的 discoveryMode 默认 automatic，可选 manual；useBaseIdVerifyOnly 仅显式 false 时才调用自定义 identifier，此时缺 identifier 拒绝 INVALID_CONFIG，uniqueTargetId 也只在该组合生效。construction.timeoutMs 省略或 false 均不设期限，内部 Host 的 mutation/drain 沿 construction.timeoutMs ?? false。构造失败会回滚已接纳资源，不留下可用的半安装 Endpoint。

IRpcTransport 提供 send(message, options?)、subscribe(listener) 与可选 close，并声明 platform、可选 topology/ownership/encodedType/sourceProof/onTransportError/onListenerError。sourceProof 为多路载体提供来源证明；普通地址字符串不构成认证。ownership 省略按 owned 处理，表示关闭时释放底层；borrowed 只撤销自己的监听，物理资源由原 owner 关闭。

createMemoryTransportPair(options?) 默认 {}，返回两端而非单个 transport。双方都是 borrowed、exclusive 的同进程载体；关闭任一端会关闭整个 pair，之后 send 抛错。默认异步交付沿原生微任务顺序；传入 scheduler 只控制 pair delivery，不替代 Endpoint 自己的期限时钟。先 dispose 两 Endpoint，再由创建方 close pair。

createBrowserMessagePortTransport 的 ownership 默认 owned，可选 borrowed；后者只撤监听，端口由调用者关闭。createNodeMessagePortTransport 使用真实 Node 风格端口。createWebWorkerTransport 接收实际 Worker 或 self，capabilities 是静态约定列表，双方须一致；peerId 标识对端，这个低层载体不做握手。更具体的 window、广播、SharedWorker、ServiceWorker、WebRTC、WebTransport 场景由 rpc-browser 的载体或 Peer 负责。

transport-kit 复用监听器集合、失败收集/报告和安全属性读取，不应在各适配器中另造同一套 listener owner。手动时钟必须推进零时间工作，以执行 deferred reconciliation、departure 通知与策略关闭；旧的两方法时钟通过 schedule(callback, 0) 接收延后工作。默认 deadline 的 schedule(0) 语义不变，迟到回调仍检查关闭与报告边界。
Runtime Peer 位于 Endpoint 之上，用 request/notify/stream/group/outcome 按点分方法路径调用，并在握手交换能力与方法目录。createRuntimePeer(options) 的 spawn/connect/listen 必须且只能有一个，Core 层均为回调；平台包才可提供对象式来源。

blocks.text: provide 只读自身可枚举数据属性，嵌套普通对象生成 math.double 等点分路径。getter、循环、非法名字、重复路径在打开来源前拒绝。对端只能调用已协商目录。输入/返回值遵循可移植值域：JSON 值与协商后二进制，Date/Map/类实例等拒绝。没有 API 泛型时无静态可调用的方法；IRuntimeDynamicSurface 只放宽编译检查，运行时仍校验目录。流方法返回 IterableIterator 或 AsyncIterableIterator，类型才会被 stream 识别；IRuntimeSurface 从 Host/插件提取纯类型，不生成运行时代码。

rows: 仅确认发出，不确认业务成功
惰性，首次 next 才发送，提前 return 通知提供方停止
steps 按序执行，首错后余项 not-executed，不回滚
本地身份、连接与目录查询
拒绝新调用并关闭原 owner，重复返回同一 Promise
返回幂等取消订阅，不重放首次 ready
原 close 函数本身，支持 await using

blocks.text: 调用选项含 timeoutMs、signal、idempotencyKey、orderKey、cancel、transfer。request/stream 默认 30000 毫秒，单次 false 关闭默认、0 立即到期，并受来源单次上限约束；重试和等待下一代沿用同一个绝对期限，不在新代次重置。signal 为协作取消；cancel: 'before-start' 只撤销尚未开始的调用，已开始则保留真实结果。同 orderKey 在提供方串行。transfer 仅支持已协商的线程能力，不适用于普通内存 pair。

非法方法名、参数或选项可能在 Promise 返回前同步抛错，把整个调用表达式放进 try，而非只接 .catch。Peer 已经关闭、或它的代次已被停止和替换时，新调用会同步抛出 REMOTE_CLOSED；监督器正在启动下一代（例如 Worker 崩溃后正在重启）时，调用返回以 REMOTE_CLOSED 拒绝的 Promise，不会同步抛错。close 与事件不提供业务回滚，也不能把断线解释为调用未执行。

createRuntimePlugin、createCoroutinePlugin 及平台插件安装到原 Plugin Host；同族连接共享 host.process/thread/coroutine，RuntimePluginKey 给出名称。request/notify/stream/group/outcome 先传连接名或 { name, instanceId } 精确目标，同名多实例不能唯一确定时拒绝。

list/get/describe 默认对象，查询可选文本格式；不可知事实用 unavailable，不伪造为 0。on 支持 ready/exit/degraded/restart/terminal/liquidated；watch 是有界异步迭代器，超过 100 个事件积压以 RUNTIME_EVENT_OVERFLOW 报告并结束，先用当前查询重新对账。broadcast 汇总各目标结果，不保证全部成功。

stop/kill/restart/replace 仅适用于真正由 spawn 或 coroutine task 创建的单元；对 connect/listen 借入连接拒绝 CAPABILITY_CONFLICT。expose 默认不公开本端 Host 方法，必须显式列出。本地 Feature expose 在安装未提交期间的调用等候原 Host batch commit；回滚以 TARGET_UNKNOWN 拒绝，不能把此保证扩展到 forward/catalog。ready 只代表目录可达，不是任意远端安装事务已完成的确认。

首次 ready 已包含 factory await，不向后来订阅重放。受监督 Peer 的后续 exit/restart/degraded 来自真实 supervisor，listener ready 来自实际接纳 session；raw Peer 不伪造原生 exit 或后续 ready。unsubscribe 不关闭执行单元；释放必须 close / await using，开始关闭时撤销事件订阅。

Coroutine 父模式 createCoroutinePlugin({ name, task, supervisor? }) 在同一事件循环监督 task，每代拥有 MessageChannel；子模式 { name, connect } 只接入该 task 收到的 opaque connect，不能传任意 MessagePort。task/connect 必须二选一，都可 provide/expose，expose 的本端 provider 须先安装。

task 收到 signal、heartbeat()、connect，自行在 finally 释放所创建子 Host。resolve 表示 exited，reject 表示 crashed，重启按 supervisor 策略。默认每插件占一个 coroutine 单元；replace(name, { task }) 更换下一代，非函数以 INVALID_CONFIG 拒绝而旧单元保留。取消靠 task 合作；忽略 signal 可延迟结束、预算租约保持到 settlement，阻塞事件循环的 task 无法强制终止。terminal 事件保留终止重启链的 source/code 与连接名，不用逻辑关闭伪装原生退出。

request/notify/stream 都占入站额度，默认每对端 64、全局 256。超限时业务函数不被调用；调用方只见 OVERLOADED，要区分并发或其它准入原因，用提供方 providerLimits.onRejected 的 RpcProviderRejectionReason。createProviderAdmissionScope 可让多个 Endpoint 共享原额度 owner，不以客户端在途数冒充提供方并发。

原生 Process/Threads launcher 证明的独占通道只记录在途调用，不套用普通载体的结果保留窗口。其它载体使用有界账本：出站每 Endpoint 默认 maxEntries 4096、ttlMs 310000；入站每对端 maxReplayEntriesPerPeer 1024、全局 4096，同样保留 310000 毫秒。它们限制保留窗口内的接纳总量，不能把 burst 能力或容量/TTL 推导当作实测吞吐量。

createRpcIdempotencyStore 默认 retentionMs 300000、maxEntries 1024、maxEntriesPerScope 256、maxBytes 8 MiB、maxOutcomeBytes 1 MiB，均为正安全整数。pending 不按 retention 自动过期；容量可保留结果不可用的 tombstone，outcome 因而可能 unavailable，而非重新执行。内存 owner 重启会丢状态，不保证跨重启连续性或无限期至多一次。

sections.id: 二进制-转发与重试边界
sections.heading: 二进制、转发与重试边界

blocks.text: ArrayBuffer / Uint8Array 需要双方协商二进制；视图 offset/length 保留。inline 只携带可见字节，native 线程清单保留全 backing 并验证摘要；SharedArrayBuffer、Atomics 与其它 TypedArray 不属于支持路径。transfer 在真实提交后分离 buffer，失败也不能恢复，不保留输入副本且不自动重试；签名认证/能力不满足以 CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED 拒绝，不降级成复制。
expose 可让第三方经插件转发已接纳连接的方法前缀；每跳绑定当时目标代次，最多三跳，环路/超限拒绝，中继不缓存业务结果。最终提供方认证的是直接上一跳，而不是最初调用者。
超时、取消、断线、连接恢复、unknown 都不能证明业务未执行。仅有独立未执行证据时（如明确并发拒绝或成功的 before-start 撤销）才可直接重试；其余通过同 idempotencyKey 查 outcome 或业务对账。不要通过换键重发逃避未知结果，总预算与退避由调用者控制。

sections.id: 为真实物理-i-o-定义适配器
sections.heading: 为真实物理 I/O 定义适配器

blocks.text: defineMessageAdapter({ open, launch? }) 的 open 取得真实端口，可选 launch 执行原启动操作；结果创建独立 peer 或 host.thread 插件。defineByteAdapter({ open, listen?, dial? }) 接入有序字节 I/O，生成 Peer 或 host.process 插件。它们不接受成品 Peer、channel、已协商能力、可信身份或自称 ownership 的替身。

消息 Peer 创建方保有借入端口的物理关闭责任；字节 I/O 提供真实 write/onData/onClose/close，Core 沿同一握手、分帧、能力与目录 owner 完成连接。launch 返回原生端口、exited、terminate；冷启动取消、握手失败或关闭由原 termination-once owner 释放，不重造 supervisor。平台 managed 来源仍使用既有监督/代次 owner。

governor 沿原 rate/payload/连续超时/idle 策略，disposer 归实际连接 close。adapter.scope(store?) 创建 provider scope，共享者须等所有 Peer 关闭后 scope.close。会话幂等范围依赖从实际认证连接捕获的 principal，普通地址字符串无此权限；字节 responder 须由实际 auth.verify 建立认证身份。
字节 auth.verify 失败原对象通过本地 cause 和 report 保留，对端只收到净化拒绝摘要，不泄露验证器原链。第三方适配器使用 utils attachErrorIdentity 附自己的 source/code，保留原错在 cause，不冒充 Core/Contract 身份。
错误保留原生类型、message、stack 与 cause；错误形状用 IRpcError，平台/拓扑值域用 IRpcPlatformValue / IRpcTransportTopologyValue。按稳定 source/code 而非 message 分支，远端身份只作诊断，不授予本地控制权。
下表的 `source` 是错误的身份值，不是导入路径。Core API 从 `@migaia/rpc-core` 导入，Remote API 从 `@migaia/rpc-core/remote` 导入。

isRpcErrorInstance / isRpcRemoteError / isRpcTimeoutError 按稳定字段跨 realm/副本判断，不能依赖 instanceof；isRpcError 只检查字符串 code，不能替代错误族守卫。RpcError、RpcRemoteError、RpcTimeoutError 等仅类型导出，唯一公开可构造类为 RpcLifecycleError，供持有自身释放状态的消费方使用。

blocks.text: owned supervisor 即使 Endpoint 释放失败，仍尝试关闭 channel 与原生资源；primary 沿 cause/errors 可达。迟到物理发送拒绝仍被观察；用户 reporter 自身 throw 经既有宿主异常队列可见，不制造未处理 reaction Promise。

Probe 从 ./probe 导入，不改变请求/结果的业务路径。导出阶段、方向、kind、outcome 的数值常量与同序名称表，以及 defineProbe、snapshotProbeEvent、rpcProbeSampleKey、probePlugin、readProbeStages、subscribeProbeStages、既有 hostRethrowReporter / IpcReporterContext。Peer 传 probe，Endpoint 激活前安装 probePlugin，两者使用同一 emitter。

defineProbe(definition, host?) 定义时验证 stages 非空且为已知名称；capture 默认关闭且须为 stages 子集；sample 默认全采样，范围 (0, 1]；methods 只过滤 message/envelope 中的方法，没有 method 的 variation 通过该过滤，其它阶段只受采样。redact 处理显式捕获，不打开未选择 capture；describe/emit/onError 分别负责描述、同步消费与错误报告。定义错误保留 TypeError / INVALID_CONFIG。

省略 host 返回独立冻结 handle；提供 host 则直接添加 stageMask/captureMask/methods/sampleThreshold/setStages 五字段，以原对象身份登记并冻结，返回 THost & IRpcProbe，不复制。host 必须可扩展、未冻结、非 null，不能已有这些字段或已注册为 Probe；验证先于修改，失败保持原样。已有 host.emit 不被替换，definition.emit 由私有状态持有。

每 emitter 复用事件 view，只能在同步 emit 中读取。snapshotProbeEvent 显式复制并冻结顶层，detail/error/content 仍保留原引用与所有权，不是深快照。未知 sizeBytes/chunk/members/durationMs 使用 -1；字符串和 opaque 容器的 sizeBytes 恒为 -1，不为观察而额外编码/扫描。已有字节 backing/view 长度直接读取；nested transferable 不遍历 getter、不深扫描/复制，可能在真实 transfer 后分离，直接捕获且将分离的 backing/view 才保存字节。

protected 只在真实认证路径存在且显式 capture 时出现，不伪造事件。setStages([]) 暂停，设置已知阶段可恢复，captureMask 保持定义值；host.stageMask 是初始值，独立 handle getter 反映私有当前值。readProbeStages 读有效 mask，subscribeProbeStages 只在实际改变后通知，返回幂等释放；无效阶段以 INVALID_CONFIG 保持旧值。冷 listener 抛错时先通知其余监听、使 emitter 采用新 mask，再传播 CALLBACK_FAILED。

emit、redact、describe 的 throw/reject 通过 onError 报 PROBE_FAILED，cause 保留原错，无回调则用宿主 reporter，不进入业务管线。激活后交付一次 descriptor，只有载体实际提供 observe 才调用，disposer 归原资源 scope；关闭后停止事件。managed spawn 与 Process/Thread/Browser/pool 均沿原 Probe 引用，不以观察重造生命周期。

variation 字段保留原 route.variation，含 ping/pong/close/abort 和已登记 subtype；abort kind 为 cancel，其余为 control，request/response 等无 variation。rpcProbeSampleKey 对 senderId/messageId 拼接的 UTF-8 计算 FNV-1a 32 位键，是采样关联，不是认证或唯一身份。

carrierSeq 是同一 emitter 的 inbound carrier 序号，无关联时 -1；Core receive 捕获它并随原物理记录经过异步 unprotect/decode。collector 按原 Endpoint/source 序号转为全局 wire 序号；已淘汰的未解析 origin 不能恢复，已读链接在 dependent 行保留时仍有效，source 序号重置为旧 origin 留 cutoff，防止误连新行，不在摄取时新增代次历史。

outbound carrier 借用本次 send 的 envelope（messageId/senderId/targetId/trace），同步返回后清空；仓库载体同步 emit，第三方跨异步间隙 emit 没有该 context。physical batch 只取首个实际成员代表，不展开业务内容。Byte carrier 在实际交付前发出，启动排队帧以交付时间各发一次，关闭/溢出前未交付帧不发业务事件；复用 detail 的 frameBytes 表示跨度，drainMs 初值 -1，真实 writer false/drain 后更新，不改变原 write 结算，也不补异步事件。

观察保留 fast/native/batch/chunk 选择：descriptor 可含 frame，fast send 不伪造 frame；认证 descriptor 读取 sign 或 encrypt-sign。解密前缺 sender/message 身份，无法保证与后续阶段同采样键；多块匿名记录不猜测身份，仅最后解码块可经 carrierSeq 关联。Native Peer 调用选项不带 trace，应用在自己的 Endpoint.send 显式传已有 trace。
按问题选择完整场景；这里直接运行真实 Endpoint 和内存 transport，Remote Peer、Host、适配器与 Probe 的契约放在后面的详细参考中。

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/rpc-core @migaia/rpc-contract

sections.id: 通过一对内存端点调用实际处理函数
sections.heading: 通过一对内存端点调用实际处理函数

blocks.text: 两个模块需要请求与对应答复，又不想打开线程或网络连接；调用者应直接等待处理结果，而非自行维护消息监听。
手写发送与订阅代码，需要自行关联答复、区分方法名并在关闭时移除监听，物理通道本身不提供这些请求语义。
为每个 `createEndpoint` 提供内存通道的一侧和配套 `connect` 插件，用 `provide` 登记 `double` 并返回 `context.success`，再等待 `client.send`，最后释放两端。

id 是本端标识，客户端 targetIds 列出 server；transport 是各自的内存侧，middlewares 使用同侧 connect({ transport })，discoveryMode 默认 automatic；provide 的方法名为 double，context.data 是发送的 21，context.success 返回成功结果；send 的 target/method/data 都必填。

blocks.code:
import { connect, createEndpoint } from '@migaia/rpc-core'
import { createMemoryTransportPair } from '@migaia/rpc-core/adapters/memory'

const [left, right] = createMemoryTransportPair()
const server = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'server',
  transport: right,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: right })]
})
server.provide('double', (context) => context.success((context.data as number) * 2))
const client = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'client',
  targetIds: ['server'],
  transport: left,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: left })]
})
console.log(await client.send<number>('server', 'double', 21))
await client.dispose()
await server.dispose()
left.close()

blocks.text: 输出 `42`；处理函数从 `context.data` 取得 `21`，成功结果经过真实端点与内存传输，兑现调用方的发送 Promise。
该预设包含发送、处理函数登记、发现与控制；`connect` 绑定传输对象，内存消息异步交付且值仍共享引用。端点释放后借入的通道对仍打开，调用者须显式关闭。

sections.id: 让并发答复回到各自的请求
sections.heading: 让并发答复回到各自的请求

blocks.text: 较慢请求先启动，后来的请求却先完成；若只维护一个“当前请求”槽，后一个结果可能交给错误的等待者。
只按方法名匹配，无法区分同时调用的两个 `double`；假定答复顺序等于发送顺序，也会在处理任务乱序完成时失效。
每次调用分别保留 `send` 的 Promise；处理函数用明确的完成门控制首个调用，客户端先取得第二个结果，再放行并等待第一个。
构造与上例相同；两个 send 分别传入 2 和 5，每个 Promise 独立；started/release 只控制示例完成顺序，不增加计时器；本例未安装 timeout，中间件缺省时 Endpoint 使用 1000 毫秒 fallback。
逐行输出 `10`、`4`；参数为 `5` 的调用先于被暂挂的 `2` 完成，每个 Promise 仍取得各自输入的二倍值。
答复按操作身份关联，而非按完成先后分配；完成门只让顺序可观察，不添加计时器或自制传输实现。处理任务可能并发执行，业务状态仍需自行确定并发策略。

sections.id: 拒绝重复登记-并保留原处理函数
sections.heading: 拒绝重复登记，并保留原处理函数

blocks.text: 两条初始化路径登记了同一方法名；直接覆盖映射表，会悄悄替换第一个处理函数，改变后续调用执行的业务操作。
没有登记准入检查时，第二个所有者无法得知自己接管了别人的方法，另建一份名称列表又可能与实际分派表脱节。
直接在端点登记处理函数；同名的第二次 `provide` 抛出 `PROVIDER_DUPLICATED`，捕获这一配置失败后，再通过真实客户端调用原方法。
provide 的方法名在同一端点必须唯一；第二次同步拒绝；send 无业务输入仍传必填 data: null；重复登记不覆盖原处理函数。

blocks.code:
PROVIDER_DUPLICATED
原处理函数

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `PROVIDER_DUPLICATED`、`原处理函数`；重复登记被同步拒绝，没有覆盖第一个处理函数。
方法名由应用约定，在同一端点内必须唯一；这不提供热替换，也不会自动重试失败初始化。释放端点以清理登记，再单独关闭调用者拥有的通道对。

sections.id: 释放端点-同时保留借入的传输通道
sections.heading: 释放端点，同时保留借入的传输通道

blocks.text: 组件结束 RPC 工作时，另一个所有者仍在管理物理通道；若把端点清理等同于无条件关闭传输资源，就可能过早拆掉共享资源。
包装器拥有调用 `close` 的能力，并不代表它拥有底层资源；资源创建与端点订阅可能属于不同所有者，生命周期也不同。
内存通道对声明借用关系；先释放端点并检查两侧 `closed`，再由创建通道对的调用者显式执行最终关闭。
createMemoryTransportPair() 无选项，默认原生微任务交付；它声明 ownership: borrowed、topology: exclusive；endpoint.dispose 不关闭 pair，left.close 无参数且会关闭双方。

blocks.code:
import { connect, createEndpoint } from '@migaia/rpc-core'
import { createMemoryTransportPair } from '@migaia/rpc-core/adapters/memory'

const [left, right] = createMemoryTransportPair()
const endpoint = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'local',
  transport: left,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: left })]
})
await endpoint.dispose()
console.log(left.closed, right.closed)
left.close()
console.log(left.closed, right.closed)

false false
true true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `false false`、`true true`；端点释放后两侧借入通道仍打开，随后显式关闭一侧会关闭整个内存通道对。
这是当前适配器的所有权规则，不能推广到所有传输对象；端点订阅与在途操作仍会清理。拥有型传输对象可在释放时关闭，应按实际适配器契约确定关闭责任。

sections.id: 只覆盖某次请求的继承期限
sections.heading: 只覆盖某次请求的继承期限

blocks.text: 多数调用共用等待预算，但已过期请求应立即失败，明确的长任务又需要取消期限；修改共享超时配置会影响无关工作。
在 `send` 外另做计时竞速，会让请求登记与远端等待不知道该期限；把 `false` 与省略选项当成同一值，也会丢失调用者明确取消期限的选择。
安装 `timeout({ timeoutMs: 5000 })`，再逐次为 `send` 覆盖 `timeoutMs`；零预算在提交请求前拒绝，`false` 取消当前调用期限，不改变已安装默认值。
timeout 配置默认 {}，本例 timeoutMs: 5000；单次 timeoutMs: 0 发送前到期，false 取消当前期限，省略则继承；有限非负数（含小数）或 false 合法；timeout({}) 无期限，完全未装中间件时 fallback 为 1000 毫秒。

blocks.code:
DEADLINE_EXCEEDED
42

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`、`42`；首个调用已无剩余预算，第二个明确取消本地期限并取得处理结果。
`timeout({})` 的期限配置为 `undefined`，完全不安装插件时 Core 则回退到 `1000` 毫秒；取值须为有限非负毫秒或 `false`。期限限制等待，不能抢占同步业务代码。

sections.id: 让已经运行的处理函数协作停止
sections.heading: 让已经运行的处理函数协作停止

blocks.text: 调用者离开页面时，处理任务已经启动；若只拒绝本地 Promise，远端操作没有收到取消信号，仍会继续消耗资源。
外部 Promise 竞速无法通知处理方停止哪项在途操作；反过来，若认为取消能打断任意用户代码，又超出了信号本身的能力。
在两端安装 `abort()`，向 `send` 传入 `AbortController` 信号；等处理函数已启动后取消调用方，处理函数收到 `context.signal` 取消通知后自行结束。
abort() 无参数，两端安装；send 的 signal 默认 undefined，本例使用真实 AbortController；context.signal 属于该次提供方调用，处理函数收到取消后自行结束，controller.abort 不抢占同步代码。

blocks.code:
CANCELLED
true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `CANCELLED`、`true`；调用方以取消码拒绝，独立的处理完成门确认正在运行的处理函数已观察到取消信号。
`abort()` 没有选项，启用远端协作取消；处理函数须观察信号并自行释放资源，同步工作不会被抢占。预先取消时的本地准入拒绝属于 Core 行为，不能单独证明远端取消。
本包拥有运行时中立的 RPC 调用、路由、取消、期限、准入、错误还原与生命周期语义，不创建操作系统进程或 Worker，也没有 node: 导入。Coroutine 使用受支持宿主的全局 MessageChannel，在当前事件循环运行。Process、Threads、Browser 等平台包依赖这一内层，线上格式归 rpc-contract。
安装时显式添加 @migaia/rpc-core 与其 peer 依赖 @migaia/rpc-contract；不要把工作区当前同版本误读为运行时的版本相等校验。其余直接依赖为 event-subscriber、lifecycle、plugin-host、serialize、supervision、utils。Node 引擎要求 >=18。运行时/平台工厂的具体可用性仍取决于宿主能力。

blocks.text: 发布保留 dist 与 schema，以及以上 24 个实际导出路径；根入口源码归 core/index，而不是顶层 index。按需工厂限制所装能力，实际产物由构建器决定，不写未经测量的体积或速度承诺。
Endpoint 适合已有 transport 的调用方；它用目标 id 和方法名路由，不自动交换 Runtime 方法目录。createEndpoint(config) 异步完成中间件安装后返回实际 Endpoint，调用方负责 dispose。

blocks.text: 完整工厂提供 send、provide、discovery、control 等默认根，ping/pingAll 的公开类型仍由选中的 ping 中间件决定。createClientEndpoint 只发起调用；createProviderEndpoint 提供方法并保留出站调用；createFullEndpoint 双向；createComposedEndpoint(config, roots) 显式选择 Feature 根。createFullOneWayEndpoint 等 one-way 预设增加 sendOneWay，其 Promise 只表示物理发送，不表示业务完成。

provide(method, handler) 返回 Endpoint，可链式注册；重复方法拒绝，不覆盖旧 handler。handler 通过 context.data 读取输入，通过 context.success(value) 或 context.failed(message, code) 结算；不完成会得到 PROVIDER_NOT_SETTLED，过期 context 的 success/failed 返回 ok:false 与 PROVIDER_CONTEXT_EXPIRED，应检查该返回值。

`send<T>`(target, method, data, options?) 等待结果，前三参数必填，无载荷时传 null。sendAll(method, data, options?) 对已知目标汇总 fulfilled/rejected；dispatch(target, method, data) 与 dispatchAll(method, data) 同步返回 void，不等待结果。根 Endpoint 没有 Runtime Peer 的 notify 方法。group/outcome 需要实际组合的能力；ping 需要中间件；on 和 hooks.on 订阅相应事件，返回的释放句柄不代替整个 Endpoint 的 dispose。

send 的 options 可含 signal、timeoutMs、idempotencyKey、trace、transfer。未装 timeout 中间件时，Endpoint 使用 1000 毫秒 fallback；安装 timeout({}) 时未配置值为 undefined，反而不设期限，显式 timeoutMs: false 同样不计时。单次 timeoutMs: 0 在发送前拒绝，false 关闭默认；Runtime Peer 的 30000 毫秒是另一层默认，不能混用。abort() 接入远端取消通知，本地预先取消的 signal 即使没有该中间件也会拒绝。取消或超时不能证明对端没有执行。dispose 注销监听并拒绝在途等待；借用载体不会因此自动关闭，已产生的业务副作用也不回滚。

createRuntimeApiEndpoint(config, channel) 是高级 Runtime 组装入口，同步返回后先 await endpoint.ready。单参数形式限于 { binding }，必须提供完整、真实的 owned binding operations，不能交入假 Endpoint。其 facade 重复及同步重入 dispose 共用首次结算 Promise，底层只调用一次。

该高级配置还支持 protocol、codec、framer、provider、idempotency、providerLimits、replay、middlewares、features 与 construction；transport 接收 framer 的输出，codec 输出必须匹配 framer 输入。provider 在构造完成前登记，idempotency 只用于带键的调用，不自动把所有方法变成幂等操作。

业务版本与 schema；标识长度限制 discovery 的 targetId/receiverId/uniqueTargetId/variation id，不限制方法名

blocks.text: defineMiddleware / defineFeature 使用原 owner 扩展日志、诊断或策略；公开扩展不能自行引入新的协议级根能力。功能与中间件声明的字段不能冲突；两端编码、分帧和能力组合必须兼容。connect 的 discoveryMode 默认 automatic，可选 manual；useBaseIdVerifyOnly 仅显式 false 时才调用自定义 identifier，此时缺 identifier 拒绝 INVALID_CONFIG，uniqueTargetId 也只在该组合生效。construction.timeoutMs 省略或 false 均不设期限，内部 Host 的 mutation/drain 沿 construction.timeoutMs ?? false。构造失败会回滚已接纳资源，不留下可用的半安装 Endpoint。

IRpcTransport 提供 send(message, options?)、subscribe(listener) 与可选 close，并声明 platform、可选 topology/ownership/encodedType/sourceProof/onTransportError/onListenerError。sourceProof 为多路载体提供来源证明；普通地址字符串不构成认证。ownership 省略按 owned 处理，表示关闭时释放底层；borrowed 只撤销自己的监听，物理资源由原 owner 关闭。

createMemoryTransportPair(options?) 默认 {}，返回两端而非单个 transport。双方都是 borrowed、exclusive 的同进程载体；关闭任一端会关闭整个 pair，之后 send 抛错。默认异步交付沿原生微任务顺序；传入 scheduler 只控制 pair delivery，不替代 Endpoint 自己的期限时钟。先 dispose 两 Endpoint，再由创建方 close pair。

createBrowserMessagePortTransport 的 ownership 默认 owned，可选 borrowed；后者只撤监听，端口由调用者关闭。createNodeMessagePortTransport 使用真实 Node 风格端口。createWebWorkerTransport 接收实际 Worker 或 self，capabilities 是静态约定列表，双方须一致；peerId 标识对端，这个低层载体不做握手。更具体的 window、广播、SharedWorker、ServiceWorker、WebRTC、WebTransport 场景由 rpc-browser 的载体或 Peer 负责。

transport-kit 复用监听器集合、失败收集/报告和安全属性读取，不应在各适配器中另造同一套 listener owner。手动时钟必须推进零时间工作，以执行 deferred reconciliation、departure 通知与策略关闭；旧的两方法时钟通过 schedule(callback, 0) 接收延后工作。默认 deadline 的 schedule(0) 语义不变，迟到回调仍检查关闭与报告边界。
Runtime Peer 位于 Endpoint 之上，用 request/notify/stream/group/outcome 按点分方法路径调用，并在握手交换能力与方法目录。createRuntimePeer(options) 的 spawn/connect/listen 必须且只能有一个，Core 层均为回调；平台包才可提供对象式来源。

blocks.text: provide 只读自身可枚举数据属性，嵌套普通对象生成 math.double 等点分路径。getter、循环、非法名字、重复路径在打开来源前拒绝。对端只能调用已协商目录。输入/返回值遵循可移植值域：JSON 值与协商后二进制，Date/Map/类实例等拒绝。没有 API 泛型时无静态可调用的方法；IRuntimeDynamicSurface 只放宽编译检查，运行时仍校验目录。流方法返回 IterableIterator 或 AsyncIterableIterator，类型才会被 stream 识别；IRuntimeSurface 从 Host/插件提取纯类型，不生成运行时代码。

rows: 仅确认发出，不确认业务成功
惰性，首次 next 才发送，提前 return 通知提供方停止
steps 按序执行，首错后余项 not-executed，不回滚
本地身份、连接与目录查询
拒绝新调用并关闭原 owner，重复返回同一 Promise
返回幂等取消订阅，不重放首次 ready
原 close 函数本身，支持 await using

blocks.text: 调用选项含 timeoutMs、signal、idempotencyKey、orderKey、cancel、transfer。request/stream 默认 30000 毫秒，单次 false 关闭默认、0 立即到期，并受来源单次上限约束；重试和等待下一代沿用同一个绝对期限，不在新代次重置。signal 为协作取消；cancel: 'before-start' 只撤销尚未开始的调用，已开始则保留真实结果。同 orderKey 在提供方串行。transfer 仅支持已协商的线程能力，不适用于普通内存 pair。

非法方法名、参数或选项可能在 Promise 返回前同步抛错，把整个调用表达式放进 try，而非只接 .catch。Peer 已经关闭、或它的代次已被停止和替换时，新调用会同步抛出 REMOTE_CLOSED；监督器正在启动下一代（例如 Worker 崩溃后正在重启）时，调用返回以 REMOTE_CLOSED 拒绝的 Promise，不会同步抛错。close 与事件不提供业务回滚，也不能把断线解释为调用未执行。

createRuntimePlugin、createCoroutinePlugin 及平台插件安装到原 Plugin Host；同族连接共享 host.process/thread/coroutine，RuntimePluginKey 给出名称。request/notify/stream/group/outcome 先传连接名或 { name, instanceId } 精确目标，同名多实例不能唯一确定时拒绝。

list/get/describe 默认对象，查询可选文本格式；不可知事实用 unavailable，不伪造为 0。on 支持 ready/exit/degraded/restart/terminal/liquidated；watch 是有界异步迭代器，超过 100 个事件积压以 RUNTIME_EVENT_OVERFLOW 报告并结束，先用当前查询重新对账。broadcast 汇总各目标结果，不保证全部成功。

stop/kill/restart/replace 仅适用于真正由 spawn 或 coroutine task 创建的单元；对 connect/listen 借入连接拒绝 CAPABILITY_CONFLICT。expose 默认不公开本端 Host 方法，必须显式列出。本地 Feature expose 在安装未提交期间的调用等候原 Host batch commit；回滚以 TARGET_UNKNOWN 拒绝，不能把此保证扩展到 forward/catalog。ready 只代表目录可达，不是任意远端安装事务已完成的确认。

首次 ready 已包含 factory await，不向后来订阅重放。受监督 Peer 的后续 exit/restart/degraded 来自真实 supervisor，listener ready 来自实际接纳 session；raw Peer 不伪造原生 exit 或后续 ready。unsubscribe 不关闭执行单元；释放必须 close / await using，开始关闭时撤销事件订阅。

Coroutine 父模式 createCoroutinePlugin({ name, task, supervisor? }) 在同一事件循环监督 task，每代拥有 MessageChannel；子模式 { name, connect } 只接入该 task 收到的 opaque connect，不能传任意 MessagePort。task/connect 必须二选一，都可 provide/expose，expose 的本端 provider 须先安装。

task 收到 signal、heartbeat()、connect，自行在 finally 释放所创建子 Host。resolve 表示 exited，reject 表示 crashed，重启按 supervisor 策略。默认每插件占一个 coroutine 单元；replace(name, { task }) 更换下一代，非函数以 INVALID_CONFIG 拒绝而旧单元保留。取消靠 task 合作；忽略 signal 可延迟结束、预算租约保持到 settlement，阻塞事件循环的 task 无法强制终止。terminal 事件保留终止重启链的 source/code 与连接名，不用逻辑关闭伪装原生退出。

request/notify/stream 都占入站额度，默认每对端 64、全局 256。超限时业务函数不被调用；调用方只见 OVERLOADED，要区分并发或其它准入原因，用提供方 providerLimits.onRejected 的 RpcProviderRejectionReason。createProviderAdmissionScope 可让多个 Endpoint 共享原额度 owner，不以客户端在途数冒充提供方并发。

原生 Process/Threads launcher 证明的独占通道只记录在途调用，不套用普通载体的结果保留窗口。其它载体使用有界账本：出站每 Endpoint 默认 maxEntries 4096、ttlMs 310000；入站每对端 maxReplayEntriesPerPeer 1024、全局 4096，同样保留 310000 毫秒。它们限制保留窗口内的接纳总量，不能把 burst 能力或容量/TTL 推导当作实测吞吐量。

createRpcIdempotencyStore 默认 retentionMs 300000、maxEntries 1024、maxEntriesPerScope 256、maxBytes 8 MiB、maxOutcomeBytes 1 MiB，均为正安全整数。pending 不按 retention 自动过期；容量可保留结果不可用的 tombstone，outcome 因而可能 unavailable，而非重新执行。内存 owner 重启会丢状态，不保证跨重启连续性或无限期至多一次。

sections.id: 二进制-转发与重试边界
sections.heading: 二进制、转发与重试边界

blocks.text: ArrayBuffer / Uint8Array 需要双方协商二进制；视图 offset/length 保留。inline 只携带可见字节，native 线程清单保留全 backing 并验证摘要；SharedArrayBuffer、Atomics 与其它 TypedArray 不属于支持路径。transfer 在真实提交后分离 buffer，失败也不能恢复，不保留输入副本且不自动重试；签名认证/能力不满足以 CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED 拒绝，不降级成复制。
expose 可让第三方经插件转发已接纳连接的方法前缀；每跳绑定当时目标代次，最多三跳，环路/超限拒绝，中继不缓存业务结果。最终提供方认证的是直接上一跳，而不是最初调用者。
超时、取消、断线、连接恢复、unknown 都不能证明业务未执行。仅有独立未执行证据时（如明确并发拒绝或成功的 before-start 撤销）才可直接重试；其余通过同 idempotencyKey 查 outcome 或业务对账。不要通过换键重发逃避未知结果，总预算与退避由调用者控制。

sections.id: 为真实物理-i-o-定义适配器
sections.heading: 为真实物理 I/O 定义适配器

blocks.text: defineMessageAdapter({ open, launch? }) 的 open 取得真实端口，可选 launch 执行原启动操作；结果创建独立 peer 或 host.thread 插件。defineByteAdapter({ open, listen?, dial? }) 接入有序字节 I/O，生成 Peer 或 host.process 插件。它们不接受成品 Peer、channel、已协商能力、可信身份或自称 ownership 的替身。

消息 Peer 创建方保有借入端口的物理关闭责任；字节 I/O 提供真实 write/onData/onClose/close，Core 沿同一握手、分帧、能力与目录 owner 完成连接。launch 返回原生端口、exited、terminate；冷启动取消、握手失败或关闭由原 termination-once owner 释放，不重造 supervisor。平台 managed 来源仍使用既有监督/代次 owner。

governor 沿原 rate/payload/连续超时/idle 策略，disposer 归实际连接 close。adapter.scope(store?) 创建 provider scope，共享者须等所有 Peer 关闭后 scope.close。会话幂等范围依赖从实际认证连接捕获的 principal，普通地址字符串无此权限；字节 responder 须由实际 auth.verify 建立认证身份。
字节 auth.verify 失败原对象通过本地 cause 和 report 保留，对端只收到净化拒绝摘要，不泄露验证器原链。第三方适配器使用 utils attachErrorIdentity 附自己的 source/code，保留原错在 cause，不冒充 Core/Contract 身份。
错误保留原生类型、message、stack 与 cause；错误形状用 IRpcError，平台/拓扑值域用 IRpcPlatformValue / IRpcTransportTopologyValue。按稳定 source/code 而非 message 分支，远端身份只作诊断，不授予本地控制权。

isRpcErrorInstance / isRpcRemoteError / isRpcTimeoutError 按稳定字段跨 realm/副本判断，不能依赖 instanceof；isRpcError 只检查字符串 code，不能替代错误族守卫。RpcError、RpcRemoteError、RpcTimeoutError 等仅类型导出，唯一公开可构造类为 RpcLifecycleError，供持有自身释放状态的消费方使用。

blocks.text: owned supervisor 即使 Endpoint 释放失败，仍尝试关闭 channel 与原生资源；primary 沿 cause/errors 可达。迟到物理发送拒绝仍被观察；用户 reporter 自身 throw 经既有宿主异常队列可见，不制造未处理 reaction Promise。

Probe 从 ./probe 导入，不改变请求/结果的业务路径。导出阶段、方向、kind、outcome 的数值常量与同序名称表，以及 defineProbe、snapshotProbeEvent、rpcProbeSampleKey、probePlugin、readProbeStages、subscribeProbeStages、既有 hostRethrowReporter / IpcReporterContext。Peer 传 probe，Endpoint 激活前安装 probePlugin，两者使用同一 emitter。

defineProbe(definition, host?) 定义时验证 stages 非空且为已知名称；capture 默认关闭且须为 stages 子集；sample 默认全采样，范围 (0, 1]；methods 只过滤 message/envelope 中的方法，没有 method 的 variation 通过该过滤，其它阶段只受采样。redact 处理显式捕获，不打开未选择 capture；describe/emit/onError 分别负责描述、同步消费与错误报告。定义错误保留 TypeError / INVALID_CONFIG。

省略 host 返回独立冻结 handle；提供 host 则直接添加 stageMask/captureMask/methods/sampleThreshold/setStages 五字段，以原对象身份登记并冻结，返回 THost & IRpcProbe，不复制。host 必须可扩展、未冻结、非 null，不能已有这些字段或已注册为 Probe；验证先于修改，失败保持原样。已有 host.emit 不被替换，definition.emit 由私有状态持有。

每 emitter 复用事件 view，只能在同步 emit 中读取。snapshotProbeEvent 显式复制并冻结顶层，detail/error/content 仍保留原引用与所有权，不是深快照。未知 sizeBytes/chunk/members/durationMs 使用 -1；字符串和 opaque 容器的 sizeBytes 恒为 -1，不为观察而额外编码/扫描。已有字节 backing/view 长度直接读取；nested transferable 不遍历 getter、不深扫描/复制，可能在真实 transfer 后分离，直接捕获且将分离的 backing/view 才保存字节。

protected 只在真实认证路径存在且显式 capture 时出现，不伪造事件。setStages([]) 暂停，设置已知阶段可恢复，captureMask 保持定义值；host.stageMask 是初始值，独立 handle getter 反映私有当前值。readProbeStages 读有效 mask，subscribeProbeStages 只在实际改变后通知，返回幂等释放；无效阶段以 INVALID_CONFIG 保持旧值。冷 listener 抛错时先通知其余监听、使 emitter 采用新 mask，再传播 CALLBACK_FAILED。

emit、redact、describe 的 throw/reject 通过 onError 报 PROBE_FAILED，cause 保留原错，无回调则用宿主 reporter，不进入业务管线。激活后交付一次 descriptor，只有载体实际提供 observe 才调用，disposer 归原资源 scope；关闭后停止事件。managed spawn 与 Process/Thread/Browser/pool 均沿原 Probe 引用，不以观察重造生命周期。

variation 字段保留原 route.variation，含 ping/pong/close/abort 和已登记 subtype；abort kind 为 cancel，其余为 control，request/response 等无 variation。rpcProbeSampleKey 对 senderId/messageId 拼接的 UTF-8 计算 FNV-1a 32 位键，是采样关联，不是认证或唯一身份。

carrierSeq 是同一 emitter 的 inbound carrier 序号，无关联时 -1；Core receive 捕获它并随原物理记录经过异步 unprotect/decode。collector 按原 Endpoint/source 序号转为全局 wire 序号；已淘汰的未解析 origin 不能恢复，已读链接在 dependent 行保留时仍有效，source 序号重置为旧 origin 留 cutoff，防止误连新行，不在摄取时新增代次历史。

outbound carrier 借用本次 send 的 envelope（messageId/senderId/targetId/trace），同步返回后清空；仓库载体同步 emit，第三方跨异步间隙 emit 没有该 context。physical batch 只取首个实际成员代表，不展开业务内容。Byte carrier 在实际交付前发出，启动排队帧以交付时间各发一次，关闭/溢出前未交付帧不发业务事件；复用 detail 的 frameBytes 表示跨度，drainMs 初值 -1，真实 writer false/drain 后更新，不改变原 write 结算，也不补异步事件。

观察保留 fast/native/batch/chunk 选择：descriptor 可含 frame，fast send 不伪造 frame；认证 descriptor 读取 sign 或 encrypt-sign。解密前缺 sender/message 身份，无法保证与后续阶段同采样键；多块匿名记录不猜测身份，仅最后解码块可经 carrierSeq 关联。Native Peer 调用选项不带 trace，应用在自己的 Endpoint.send 显式传已有 trace。
Turn asynchronous messages into calls with correlated replies, per-call deadlines, and cooperative cancellation while keeping transport closure with its owner.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: A later request replies first and wakes the wrong caller: replies are matched by method name or one shared pending slot.
Another initialization path silently replaces a method: registration overwrites a map without conflict admission.
Unmounting a component closes a shared channel: subscription lifetime and physical ownership have been conflated.
Changing one request’s deadline affects other calls: only shared timeout configuration is available.
Remote work continues after the page leaves: only the local wait rejects, without notifying the running provider.
Keep concurrent replies attached to the correct request. Each send correlates its result by operation identity, as shown in Keep concurrent replies attached to their own requests.

Detect duplicate method registration where it happens. provide rejects a second handler while preserving the original registration, as shown in Reject a duplicate provider without replacing the active handler.

Separate Endpoint release from physical channel closure. Endpoints honor the actual transport’s owned/borrowed declaration, as shown in Release an endpoint without closing its borrowed transport pair.
Override the waiting budget for one selected call. Per-call timeoutMs overrides the installed timeout default, as shown in Override one request’s inherited deadline without changing other calls.
Notify an already-running provider of cancellation. abort routes caller cancellation to that operation’s context.signal, as shown in Ask an already-running provider to stop cooperatively.

blocks.code:
import { connect, createEndpoint } from '@migaia/rpc-core'
import { createMemoryTransportPair } from '@migaia/rpc-core/adapters/memory'

const [left, right] = createMemoryTransportPair()
const server = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'server',
  transport: right,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: right })]
})
server.provide('double', (context) => context.success((context.data as number) * 2))
const client = await createEndpoint({
  id: 'client',
  targetIds: ['server'],
  transport: left,
  middlewares: [connect({ transport: left })]
})
console.log(await client.send<number>('server', 'double', 21))
await client.dispose()
await server.dispose()
left.close()

blocks.text: This module owns runtime-neutral RPC routing, cancellation, deadlines, admission, error restoration, and lifecycle semantics. It does not launch operating-system processes or Workers and contains no node: imports. Coroutines use a supported host's global MessageChannel in the current event loop. Platform module depend inward on this core; rpc-contract owns wire formats.

Install @migaia/rpc-core together with its peer dependency @migaia/rpc-contract. Matching workspace versions are not a runtime version-equality mechanism. Other direct dependencies are event-subscriber, lifecycle, plugin-host, serialize, supervision, and utils. Node requires >=18, while selected platform factories still need their actual host capabilities.

blocks.text: Publication retains dist, schema, and all 24 export paths. The root owner is core/index rather than a top-level index. Selective factories restrict installed capabilities; actual bundle output depends on the bundler, without an unmeasured size or speed claim.

sections.heading: Endpoints route by target and method

blocks.text: An Endpoint fits a caller with an existing transport. It routes by target id and method rather than automatically exchanging a Runtime method catalog. createEndpoint(config) resolves after middleware installation; its caller owns dispose.

rows: Required without a default; nonempty stable local identifier
Defaults to []; deduplicated with the local id removed; automatic discovery can resolve more targets
The same real carrier supplied by the factory or connect; no default physical resource
Required middleware tuple, installed atomically during construction
Optional finite tuple of synchronous Features
Defaults to systemScheduler; monotonic clock shared by Endpoint and internal Host deadlines
Host wall clock by default; wire sentAt/hook at diagnostics only
Cancel or bound installation; false disables its deadline

blocks.text: The full factory includes outbound, provider, discovery, and control roots; ping/pingAll typing still depends on the selected ping middleware. createClientEndpoint sends calls; createProviderEndpoint provides methods while retaining outbound calls; createFullEndpoint is bidirectional; createComposedEndpoint(config, roots) explicitly selects Feature roots. One-way presets such as createFullOneWayEndpoint add sendOneWay, whose Promise confirms physical sending rather than business completion.

provide(method, handler) returns the Endpoint for chaining. Duplicate names reject without replacing the original handler. Read input from context.data and settle using context.success(value) or context.failed(message, code). An unsettled handler produces PROVIDER_NOT_SETTLED; an expired context's success/failed returns ok:false with PROVIDER_CONTEXT_EXPIRED, so inspect the returned result.

send(target, method, data, options?) waits for a result. The first three arguments are required; pass null when there is no payload. sendAll(method, data, options?) groups fulfilled/rejected results by known target. dispatch(target, method, data) and dispatchAll(method, data) return void synchronously without awaiting results. A root Endpoint has no Runtime Peer notify method. group/outcome need the selected capabilities, ping needs its middleware, and on/hooks.on subscriptions do not replace Endpoint disposal.

Send options include signal, timeoutMs, idempotencyKey, trace, and transfer. Without timeout middleware, Endpoint uses a 1000 ms fallback. Installing timeout({}) supplies undefined and leaves calls unbounded; explicit timeoutMs:false likewise disables timing. A per-call zero deadline rejects before send and false overrides the default. Runtime Peer's 30000 ms is a different layer's default. abort() enables remote abort notifications, while an already-aborted local signal is refused even without that middleware.

Neither cancellation nor timeout proves that the provider did not execute. dispose removes subscriptions and rejects in-flight waits without automatically closing borrowed carriers or undoing business side effects.

createRuntimeApiEndpoint(config, channel) is an advanced Runtime assembly that returns synchronously; await endpoint.ready before use. The single-argument form is restricted to { binding } with complete, genuine owned operations. Its facade reuses its first disposal Promise, including synchronous reentry, and invokes the underlying dispose once.

That advanced configuration also supports protocol, codec, framer, provider, idempotency, providerLimits, replay, middlewares, features, and construction. The transport receives framer output, and codec output must match framer input. Providers are registered before construction finishes. Idempotency applies to keyed calls rather than making every method idempotent.

blocks.text: defineMiddleware/defineFeature extend logging, diagnostics, or policy through existing owners. Public extensions cannot invent new protocol-level root capabilities. Feature/middleware claims must not conflict, and both sides need compatible encoding, framing, and capabilities.

connect defaults discoveryMode to automatic, with manual as the other value. Only explicit useBaseIdVerifyOnly:false invokes a custom identifier; missing identifier then rejects INVALID_CONFIG, and uniqueTargetId only applies in that combination. An omitted construction.timeoutMs or false leaves construction unbounded; internal Host mutation/drain use construction.timeoutMs ?? false. Failed construction rolls back accepted resources instead of returning a partly installed Endpoint.

IRpcTransport supplies send(message, options?), subscribe(listener), optional close, and platform plus optional topology/ownership/encodedType/sourceProof/onTransportError/onListenerError. sourceProof establishes origin on multiplexed carriers; an address string alone is not authentication. Omitted ownership is treated as owned, releasing the physical resource on close. Borrowed resources only lose this Endpoint's subscriptions and remain with their original owner.

createMemoryTransportPair(options?) defaults to {} and returns both sides. They are borrowed, exclusive, same-process carriers. Closing either side closes the whole pair and later send throws. Default delivery follows the native microtask order. An injected scheduler controls only pair delivery rather than the Endpoint deadline clock. Dispose both Endpoints, then let the creator close the pair.

createBrowserMessagePortTransport defaults ownership to owned, with borrowed leaving physical port closure to its caller. createNodeMessagePortTransport accepts a real Node-style port. createWebWorkerTransport receives a real Worker/self; capabilities are a static agreement that must match both sides, and peerId identifies the other side. This low-level carrier does not handshake. Window, broadcast, SharedWorker, ServiceWorker, WebRTC, and WebTransport scenarios belong to rpc-browser adapters/Peers.

transport-kit reuses listener management, failure reporting, and safe property reads rather than requiring duplicate listener owners. Manual clocks must run zero-time deferred reconciliation, departure notifications, and policy closure. Older two-method clocks receive this work through schedule(callback,0). Deadline schedule(0) semantics stay unchanged, and late jobs retain close checks and callback reporting.

Runtime Peers build on Endpoint and call dotted method paths using request/notify/stream/group/outcome after exchanging capabilities and catalogs. createRuntimePeer requires exactly one of spawn/connect/listen. At Core level these are source callbacks; platform module can offer object-style sources.

blocks.text: provide reads only own enumerable data properties and builds dotted paths from nested plain objects. Getters, cycles, invalid names, and duplicate paths fail before opening the source. Remote calls are limited to the negotiated catalog. Values must be portable JSON or negotiated binary; Date/Map/class instances are refused. Without an API generic there are no statically callable methods. IRuntimeDynamicSurface relaxes only type checking, not catalog admission. IterableIterator/AsyncIterableIterator return types identify stream methods; IRuntimeSurface extracts Host/plugin types without runtime code.

pending/done/unknown; unknown is not evidence of non-execution
