blocks.text: defaultTimeoutMs is 30000 ms and must be a positive finite number; only request/stream inherit it. A call's timeoutMs may be a nonnegative number or false: 0 expires immediately and false disables the default deadline, while a process callWallTimeMs cap may still apply. signal cancellation is cooperative and does not prove business nonexecution. idempotencyKey reuses outcomes only when the provider declared and retained them. orderKey serializes a key at the provider. cancel:'before-start' cancels unstarted work but waits for the real outcome once it has started.

Process calls reject the transfer property even when []. Ordinary ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array payloads are copied. Timeout, cancellation, disconnection, and unknown outcome do not prove that execution never happened. Reconcile non-idempotent writes through outcome or business state before retrying. Distinguish admission failures such as OVERLOADED/PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT and successful before-start cancellation from sent calls whose outcome is unknown.

Short connect/listen strings may be plain service names or explicit addresses. Names contain no slash/protocol and derive one endpoint from OS user and name. POSIX uses a private 0700 user directory and 0600 socket, rejecting wrong owners/permissions, symlinks, and other services' paths. Node-compatible APIs expose no peer-credential reader here; OS permissions isolate users, not applications within one user. Supply a token to distinguish those applications.

Loopback TCP, explicit Unix paths, and Windows named pipes without an adapter ACL require tokens. The same-user hello marker is public protocol data, not a secret. Supported addresses are tcp://127.0.0.1:port, tcp://[::1]:port, absolute Unix paths, and Windows named pipes, never remote-machine addresses. Port 0 lets the OS choose a port returned through listener.address.

connectTimeoutMs defaults to 5000 ms and accepts a finite nonnegative number. Only named-local rendezvous retries ENOENT/ECONNREFUSED at up-to-25-ms intervals; explicit-address dialing does not. signal cancels a pending retry with its original reason. A second same-name listener still fails PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED. Existing owner records reclaim only abandoned same-service paths.

Full connect contains kind:'connect', address/token, dial(address,signal), establish, optional offer, and native wire by default. Optional local-session supervision can set restart/startupTimeoutMs/health/stop/terminalPolicy/scheduler; it rebuilds the connection without owning or restarting the external process. Full listen contains kind:'listener', listen/address/offer/verify/createConnectionContext and optional scheduler. Each accepted session has its own labels and channel. verify returns the principal rather than trusting self-reported client identity. Invalid credentials can produce outer REMOTE_START_FAILED on the client and original PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED in the server reporter; do not blindly repeat them.

A socket listener owns listening and unhanded candidates, not sessions already transferred. close shares one Promise. Unix owner records do not guarantee native path deletion safety after external replacement: Node/libuv may unlink a successor inode installed at the old path when the original listener closes. The current path reports PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED/cause once, without repeating on later closes. Do not replace an active listener's path with another owner. The existing Darwin path budget is 104 bytes without a shorter hidden staging address.

The runtime createProcessPlugin form adds name/expose to Peer sources/provide, producing a plugin for Host.use. Host owns that installed process connection; another owner should not independently terminate it. expose defaults to no Host methods. Explicit Feature method paths are whitelisted individually: exposing math.add does not expose math.sub.

host.process request/notify/stream/group/outcome take a connection name or {name,instanceId} when exact instance selection is required. list/get expose identity, generation, health, and exit information, returning unavailable rather than invented zeros. on returns an idempotent disposer; watch is bounded async iteration. broadcast aggregates individual results without all-success guarantees. stop/kill/restart/replace require spawn ownership; connect/listen reject with CAPABILITY_CONFLICT.

Replacement uses existing supervision/Host strategies without moving calls already executing. IProcessPlugin.replace defaults options to {} and strategy to stop-then-start, accepting optional spec and stop-then-start/start-then-switch strategies; results carry the underlying supervisor outcome or successor plugin. Original owners retain preparation, switching, and retirement. Both Host execution budgets must be explicit under PluginHost's contract; false means unlimited rather than a default.

Root also exports parseProcessPluginDescriptor and ProcessPluginWire. A descriptor is persistent configuration data without live channels, bootstrap credentials, or authenticated state. Executable ports come from actual factories. Low-level IProcessPluginOptions deployment/host/endpointFactory/registrationOwner and convenient runtime-source options are distinct public shapes.

createProcessResilience requires scheduler/report and does not create another process supervisor. Its default idempotency store uses an owner-specific namespace. Different connections/sessions of one principal share a deduplication scope; separate owners remain isolated. identity requires a nonempty principalId, with connectionId/sessionId labels and optional processId.

Capacity, timeout, and drain options are positive safe integers; 0 does not disable them. Report times are relative to terminal entry, with the original supervisor retaining its zero-minute report. Liquidation follows the unhandled threshold rather than treating the first diagnostic as removal.

sessionOptions(identity) supplies Endpoint idempotency/limits. listenRegistrations accepts wire:'native', a real listen/address/offer, verifyToken, createConnectionContext, onCandidate, and optional serviceId/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs/signal. onCandidate returns adopt/reject. The listener owns pending candidates, while an adopted lease passes to its adopter. lease.channel/identity/close form one session. Principals come from authentication; declaring fields cannot skip a handshake.

attachRegistration(name,binding,owner) connects a real supervisor. binding.ownership is spawn-owned/connection-borrowed and health is ping/custom/none. The owner is either proxy-plugin name/Host.unUse or standalone-host release. callGuard rejects terminal/liquidated work before provider execution. inspect returns state/health/unhandled/liquidated/reason or undefined for unknown names. Any fulfilled onTerminal handler counts as handled, resets unhandled accounting, and stops later diagnostics; only all-rejected outcomes remain unhandled, with rejection causes reported.

Explicit shared-instance health failure closes shared sessions before creating/replacing the target; failure keeps it fenced and reports the original reason. Per-connection mode closes only the affected session rather than replacing the shared process. Connection/rate/payload admission fails PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT before business execution. Consecutive timeouts and idle expiry close that connection without proving whole-instance failure.

Liquidation uses only the Host's committed affected plan, never a dry run as proof of mutation. Post-removal cleanup errors still count as committed and retain terminal/cleanup causes. Precommit rejection or standalone release failure creates no liquidated tombstone and does not retry the Host mutation automatically. Default suspend starts diagnostics for actually affected dependants; cascade releases actual dependants without starting diagnostics for already-released ones. Only the newest 100 committed tombstones remain. An old registration.close cannot remove a replacement generation.

registration.close stops its diagnostics/subscription without disposing an external supervisor. resilience.close releases listeners/registrations it owns, shares one allSettled cleanup Promise, and rejects cleanup failure as PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError. Not every read method becomes a closed-state exception; sessionOptions/inspect retain their original behavior. The actual supervisor/Host owner still disposes those resources.

sections.heading: Channels, negotiation, diagnostics, and platform capability

blocks.text: IProcessByteChannel is an ordered kind:'byte' write/onData/onClose/close port whose write Promise retains backpressure. IProcessMessageChannel supplies kind:'message' send/onMessage/onClose/close. Byte createProcessTransport requires initiator+offer or responder+offer+auth; responder auth is required/verify or explicit none. Common options include peerId/report/ipc and optional signal/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs. ipc requires connectionId/sessionId/log and optionally processId, stderr, maxPendingData/maxPendingControl.

createNativeProcessOffer requires peer and optionally auth/stream/capabilities. Its direct baseline is ping/close/batch, adding stream only for stream:true. Omitted capabilities lets Runtime complete defaults from actually installed Core capabilities. Explicit lists, including [], are not widened automatically; stream:false prevents automatic stream expansion. Offer/version/codec/peer data is frozen, and Contract owns the json codec and current RpcProtocol version.

Message staticAgreement.local/peer must both use codec:'identity' with identical ordered capability lists. This validates input declarations rather than minting negotiated trust. Existing base abort/ping/close/deadline/idempotency/trace/stream/batch capabilities are directly usable; Runtime/binary extensions still require Core ACK. Missing ACK or timeout leaves actual base capabilities, visible through agreement.capabilities.

Default inbound providerLimits are maxPerPeer=64/maxGlobal=256, with rejection reasons available through onRejected. Exceeding limits produces Core OVERLOADED before execution. These differ from resilience's 32-per-session concurrency defaults. PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_MAX_FRAME_BYTES=65536 bounds the initial handshake frame; native business frames are limited to 16 MiB. Handshake and message-extension ACK deadlines default to 10000 ms. Core pending-send data/control limits default to 256/8. Manual receiveAdapterBootstrap/openProcessStdioChannel has no timer when bootstrapTimeout is omitted; automatic child discovery explicitly supplies 10000 ms. Use stream or application chunking for large values.

stderr drains from launch. Each session produces at most 32 ipc.stderr records per 1000 ms, merging excess chunks into a redacted droppedChunks summary. stdout is never a log channel. Native ping defaults to 5000-ms intervals, 2000-ms checks, and three failures before unhealthy; explicit custom health wins. JSON-RPC disables native ping by default. PROCESS_HEALTH_PING_FAILED feeds the original supervision policy rather than a new restart loop.

Node/Bun/Deno stdio/socket paths reuse Core byte framing. transport.observe is available; the old not-implemented description is obsolete. Byte observation emits once synchronously with complete frame.byteLength and borrowed detail containing frameBytes/drainMs. Inbound drainMs is 0; outbound starts at -1 and physical onWrite completion updates that same detail without a second asynchronous carrier event. Capture supplies the original frame reference; copy numeric metadata when retaining it. Whole-message content retains the original value, detail is undefined, and native-byte size is known while opaque size remains -1 without serialization. Observer failures report through Core TRANSPORT. Logical send duration is not drainMs, and Node results prove neither native Electron behavior nor a speed claim.

Web Streams byte close publishes its shared Promise before callbacks, then attempts all observers, reader.cancel, writer.abort, and physical cleanup despite failures. Cleanup rejects PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError with first cause and all errors. Writer acquisition failure releases an acquired reader lock and retains native TypeError with PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED. Node/Deno/Web byte constructors require actual resources, not authenticated-state claims.

Adapter authors can use createAdapterSocketByteIO, createAdapterChildStdio, createAdapterProcessStdio, createAdapterWebByteIO, and createAdapterProcessLaunch/Peer/Plugin. Prefer Core defineByteAdapter/defineMessageAdapter, using the original advanced SDK for complex assembly rather than duplicating framing, handshake, correlation, or lifetime state.

For ordinary foreign children use spawn:{command,args,wire:'jsonrpc',contract}, retaining normal spawn supervision. createProcessJsonRpcChannel supports an application-owned ordered byte connection. Former bridge factories converge on this entry and IProcessJsonRpcChannelOptions; bridge error constants come from rpc-contract/framing/jsonrpc. Process retains byte-close/stderr/diagnostic ownership while Core owns protocol negotiation, correlation, and cleanup.

Advanced options explicitly provide byte/peerId/target/offer/token/scheduler/wallClock/ipc/report, with optional signal/handshakeTimeoutMs. JSON-RPC handshake defaults to 10000 ms without native length-prefix framing or default ping. target is {kind:'plugin',contract} or {kind:'host',catalog}. Local contract prechecks unsupported streams; the actual callable catalog comes from remote migaia.describe, never caller-declared authority. The bridge fills codecs/auth. Optional capabilities are deadline@1, trace@1, idempotency@1 plus automatically required jsonrpc-bridge@1/runtime-api@1/batch@1/abort@1/wire-error@1.

Node launches without a shell or implicit environment inheritance, drains stderr before writing bootstrap, and never also consumes channel stdout as ordinary output. Its restart object has flat fields mode:'on-failure', maxRestarts:5, windowMs:60000, initialDelayMs:250, factor:2, maxDelayMs:30000. stop.drainTimeoutMs/stop.reapTimeoutMs both default to 5000. restart.mode is never/on-failure/always: no restart, restart on failure, or restart after every exit. A wrapper must preserve stdin/stdout: stdin first carries bootstrap and then RPC, stdout contains only protocol frames, and logs use stderr. Preserve env.inherit/env.set. A call's timeoutMs may be a nonnegative number or false: 0 expires immediately and false disables the default deadline, while a process callWallTimeMs cap may still apply. signal cancellation is cooperative and does not prove business nonexecution. idempotencyKey reuses outcomes only when the provider declared and retained them. orderKey serializes a key at the provider. cancel:'before-start' cancels unstarted work but waits for the real outcome once it has started.

Timeout, cancellation, disconnection, and unknown outcome do not prove that execution never happened. Reconcile non-idempotent writes through outcome or business state before retrying. Distinguish admission failures such as OVERLOADED/PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT and successful before-start cancellation from sent calls whose outcome is unknown.

Short connect/listen strings may be plain service names or explicit addresses. Names contain no slash/protocol and derive one endpoint from OS user and name. POSIX uses a private 0700 user directory and 0600 socket, rejecting wrong owners/permissions, symlinks, and other services' paths. Node-compatible APIs expose no peer-credential reader here; OS permissions isolate users, not applications within one user. Supply a token to distinguish those applications.

Loopback TCP, explicit Unix paths, and Windows named pipes without an adapter ACL require tokens. The same-user hello marker is public protocol data, not a secret. Supported addresses are tcp://127.0.0.1:port, tcp://[::1]:port, absolute Unix paths, and Windows named pipes, never remote-machine addresses. Port 0 lets the OS choose a port returned through listener.address.

connectTimeoutMs defaults to 5000 ms and accepts a finite nonnegative number. Only named-local rendezvous retries ENOENT/ECONNREFUSED at up-to-25-ms intervals; explicit-address dialing does not. signal cancels a pending retry with its original reason. A second same-name listener still fails PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED. Existing owner records reclaim only abandoned same-service paths.

Full connect contains kind:'connect', address/token, dial(address,signal), establish, optional offer, and native wire by default. Optional local-session supervision can set restart/startupTimeoutMs/health/stop/terminalPolicy/scheduler; it rebuilds the connection without owning or restarting the external process. Full listen contains kind:'listener', listen/address/offer/verify/createConnectionContext and optional scheduler. Each accepted session has its own labels and channel. verify returns the principal rather than trusting self-reported client identity. Invalid credentials can produce outer REMOTE_START_FAILED on the client and original PROCESS_CHANNEL_AUTH_REJECTED in the server reporter; do not blindly repeat them.

A socket listener owns listening and unhanded candidates, not sessions already transferred. close shares one Promise. Unix owner records do not guarantee native path deletion safety after external replacement: Node/libuv may unlink a successor inode installed at the old path when the original listener closes. The current path reports PROCESS_CHANNEL_LISTEN_FAILED/cause once, without repeating on later closes. Do not replace an active listener's path with another owner. The existing Darwin path budget is 104 bytes without a shorter hidden staging address.

The runtime createProcessPlugin form adds name/expose to Peer sources/provide, producing a plugin for Host.use. Host owns that installed process connection; another owner should not independently terminate it. expose defaults to no Host methods. Explicit Feature method paths are whitelisted individually: exposing math.add does not expose math.sub.

host.process request/notify/stream/group/outcome take a connection name or {name,instanceId} when exact instance selection is required. list/get expose identity, generation, health, and exit information, returning unavailable rather than invented zeros. on returns an idempotent disposer; watch is bounded async iteration. broadcast aggregates individual results without all-success guarantees. stop/kill/restart/replace require spawn ownership; connect/listen reject with CAPABILITY_CONFLICT.

IProcessPlugin.replace defaults options to {} and strategy to stop-then-start, accepting optional spec and stop-then-start/start-then-switch strategies; results carry the underlying supervisor outcome or successor plugin. Original owners retain preparation, switching, and retirement. Both Host execution budgets must be explicit under PluginHost's contract; false means unlimited rather than a default.

Root also exports parseProcessPluginDescriptor and ProcessPluginWire. A descriptor is persistent configuration data without live channels, bootstrap credentials, or authenticated state. Executable ports come from actual factories. Low-level IProcessPluginOptions deployment/host/endpointFactory/registrationOwner and convenient runtime-source options are distinct public shapes.

createProcessResilience requires scheduler/report and does not create another process supervisor. Its default idempotency store uses an owner-specific namespace. Different connections/sessions of one principal share a deduplication scope; separate owners remain isolated. identity requires a nonempty principalId, with connectionId/sessionId labels and optional processId.

Capacity, timeout, and drain options are positive safe integers; 0 does not disable them. Report times are relative to terminal entry, with the original supervisor retaining its zero-minute report. Liquidation follows the unhandled threshold rather than treating the first diagnostic as removal.

sessionOptions(identity) supplies Endpoint idempotency/limits. listenRegistrations accepts wire:'native', a real listen/address/offer, verifyToken, createConnectionContext, onCandidate, and optional serviceId/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs/signal. onCandidate returns adopt/reject. Explicit shared-instance health failure closes shared sessions before creating/replacing the target; failure keeps it fenced and reports the original reason. Per-connection mode closes only the affected session rather than replacing the shared process. Connection/rate/payload admission fails PROCESS_CONNECTION_LIMIT before business execution. Consecutive timeouts and idle expiry close that connection without proving whole-instance failure.

Only the newest 100 committed tombstones remain. An old registration.close cannot remove a replacement generation.

registration.close stops its diagnostics/subscription without disposing an external supervisor. resilience.close releases listeners/registrations it owns, shares one allSettled cleanup Promise, and rejects cleanup failure as PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError. sections.heading: Channels, negotiation, diagnostics, and platform capability

blocks.text: IProcessByteChannel is an ordered kind:'byte' write/onData/onClose/close port whose write Promise retains backpressure. IProcessMessageChannel supplies kind:'message' send/onMessage/onClose/close. Byte createProcessTransport requires initiator+offer or responder+offer+auth; responder auth is required/verify or explicit none. Common options include peerId/report/ipc and optional signal/scheduler/handshakeTimeoutMs. ipc requires connectionId/sessionId/log and optionally processId, stderr, maxPendingData/maxPendingControl.

createNativeProcessOffer requires peer and optionally auth/stream/capabilities. Its direct baseline is ping/close/batch, adding stream only for stream:true. Omitted capabilities lets Runtime complete defaults from actually installed Core capabilities. Explicit lists, including [], are not widened automatically; stream:false prevents automatic stream expansion. Offer/version/codec/peer data is frozen, and Contract owns the json codec and current RpcProtocol version.

Message staticAgreement.local/peer must both use codec:'identity' with identical ordered capability lists. This validates input declarations rather than minting negotiated trust. Existing base abort/ping/close/deadline/idempotency/trace/stream/batch capabilities are directly usable; Runtime/binary extensions still require Core ACK. Missing ACK or timeout leaves actual base capabilities, visible through agreement.capabilities.

Default inbound providerLimits are maxPerPeer=64/maxGlobal=256, with rejection reasons available through onRejected. Exceeding limits produces Core OVERLOADED before execution. These differ from resilience's 32-per-session concurrency defaults. PROCESS_HANDSHAKE_MAX_FRAME_BYTES=65536 bounds the initial handshake frame; native business frames are limited to 16 MiB. Handshake and message-extension ACK deadlines default to 10000 ms. Core pending-send data/control limits default to 256/8. Manual receiveAdapterBootstrap/openProcessStdioChannel has no timer when bootstrapTimeout is omitted; automatic child discovery explicitly supplies 10000 ms. Use stream or application chunking for large values.

stderr drains from launch. Each session produces at most 32 ipc.stderr records per 1000 ms, merging excess chunks into a redacted droppedChunks summary. stdout is never a log channel. Native ping defaults to 5000-ms intervals, 2000-ms checks, and three failures before unhealthy; explicit custom health wins. JSON-RPC disables native ping by default. PROCESS_HEALTH_PING_FAILED feeds the original supervision policy rather than a new restart loop.

Node/Bun/Deno stdio/socket paths reuse Core byte framing. transport.observe is available; the old not-implemented description is obsolete. Byte observation emits once synchronously with complete frame.byteLength and borrowed detail containing frameBytes/drainMs. Inbound drainMs is 0; outbound starts at -1 and physical onWrite completion updates that same detail without a second asynchronous carrier event. Capture supplies the original frame reference; copy numeric metadata when retaining it. Whole-message content retains the original value, detail is undefined, and native-byte size is known while opaque size remains -1 without serialization. Observer failures report through Core TRANSPORT. Logical send duration is not drainMs, and Node results prove neither native Electron behavior nor a speed claim.

Web Streams byte close publishes its shared Promise before callbacks, then attempts all observers, reader.cancel, writer.abort, and physical cleanup despite failures. Cleanup rejects PROCESS_CHANNEL_CLOSED AggregateError with first cause and all errors. Writer acquisition failure releases an acquired reader lock and retains native TypeError with PROCESS_CHANNEL_CONNECT_FAILED. Node/Deno/Web byte constructors require actual resources, not authenticated-state claims.

Adapter authors can use createAdapterSocketByteIO, createAdapterChildStdio, createAdapterProcessStdio, createAdapterWebByteIO, and createAdapterProcessLaunch/Peer/Plugin. Prefer Core defineByteAdapter/defineMessageAdapter, using the original advanced SDK for complex assembly rather than duplicating framing, handshake, correlation, or lifetime state.

For ordinary foreign children use spawn:{command,args,wire:'jsonrpc',contract}, retaining normal spawn supervision. createProcessJsonRpcChannel supports an application-owned ordered byte connection. Former bridge factories converge on this entry and IProcessJsonRpcChannelOptions; bridge error constants come from rpc-contract/framing/jsonrpc. Process retains byte-close/stderr/diagnostic ownership while Core owns protocol negotiation, correlation, and cleanup.

Advanced options explicitly provide byte/peerId/target/offer/token/scheduler/wallClock/ipc/report, with optional signal/handshakeTimeoutMs. JSON-RPC handshake defaults to 10000 ms without native length-prefix framing or default ping. target is {kind:'plugin',contract} or {kind:'host',catalog}. Local contract prechecks unsupported streams; the actual callable catalog comes from remote migaia.describe, never caller-declared authority. The bridge fills codecs/auth. Optional capabilities are deadline@1, trace@1, idempotency@1 plus automatically required jsonrpc-bridge@1/runtime-api@1/batch@1/abort@1/wire-error@1.

Content-Length counts UTF-8 bytes, followed by CRLF CRLF and JSON; header≤1024 bytes, frame≤16 MiB
JSON-RPC 2.0 with id; params.hello is a JSON-stringified handshake hello containing migaia.rpc, versions, json codec, capabilities, peer, auth
reply is a JSON accept/reject string and methods lists migaia.hello/migaia.describe/migaia.invoke/migaia.cancel; accept selects shared version, currently 1.1, json codec, and shared capabilities
params.args=[]; result schemaVersion:2, self{name,instanceId}, methods; instanceId matches handshake peer.id
name, supportedModes containing only request/notify, modeSource:'declared', optional idempotent; stream is rejected
params.method and positional args array; omitted payload becomes []; id requests a result, absence means notify without a reply
Optional timeoutMs/idempotencyKey/trace, including only actually supplied values
Notification with params.id and optional reason, no acknowledgement or rollback; late results are discarded
Arrays after handshake, processed in order; replies include only id-bearing requests, with independent member failures and no reply for all-notify batches

blocks.text: Reject non-hello traffic before authentication. Invalid credentials produce reject plus wire error. stdout contains protocol only; logs use stderr. Any language can implement the peer. The former minimal Python pattern reads exact bootstrap bytes, loops over Content-Length messages, verifies hello, describes methods, dispatches invoke, and handles cancel notifications; it does not automatically implement business idempotency or cancellation. Reverse migaia.invoke is supported by the protocol but must be verified in the application's language implementation.

Payloads must be arrays, otherwise JSONRPC_PROFILE_INVALID. Represent integers outside ±(2^53-1) as strings. JSON encoding supports neither native streams nor transfer. Invalid framing/UTF-8/JSON or partial-frame closure terminates with JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID. Unknown/late ids are reported and discarded without disrupting other calls.

Business failures use JSON-RPC error.code/message/data.migaiaWireError, with source/code/name/message/stack and optional cause/errors. Never replace the recorded stack at the receiver. Integer JSON-RPC codes include -32700 parse, -32600 request, -32601 method, -32602 parameters, -32603 internal, and -32000 business. Semantic diagnostics still use wire source/code. Reuse Contract toJsonRpcError/fromJsonRpcError and encodeJsonRpcFrame/createJsonRpcFrameDecoder rather than another protocol implementation.

rows: Invalid header/encoding/JSON or partial closure; terminal connection
Hello omits required capabilities or extension methods
Unsupported local profile, payload, or capabilities
Stream in the local contract or remote catalog

blocks.text: Remote wire source/code is diagnostic data, not local cancellation/retry/authentication authority. Business Errors without semantic identity can restore their native type with unknown/UNKNOWN rather than invented Process codes. Non-idempotent retry still requires reconciliation or real provider-side meta.idempotencyKey deduplication.

RPC_PROCESS_ERROR_SOURCE is @migaia/rpc/process. Native synchronous spawn and Unix listener preparation/bind errors receive semantic identity on the original object, retaining native type, stack, and other OS fields while replacing errno code with the semantic code. Wrappers retain originals through cause. Do not control behavior by matching messages.

rows: Closed-channel work or resource/close-observer cleanup failure; inspect cause/errors
Facade release has begun; create another owner
Invalid governance or connection/rate/payload admission refusal
Explicit shared-instance health isolation or failed native ping
Terminal work refusal or liquidation forbidding restart
Native CPU/memory sample failure; show unavailable without altering process lifetime

blocks.text: Core call errors include DEADLINE_EXCEEDED/TimeoutError, CANCELLED/AbortError, OVERLOADED, PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND, and TRANSPORT. Remote/PluginHost/Supervision wrappers keep their own sources. Native business errors such as RangeError retain type/message/stack/cause through wire rather than becoming Process host errors.

For automatic-source failure, confirm the library launcher actually started the child. For handshake timeout, confirm bootstrap consumption, stdin reading, and protocol-only stdout. Check loopback/permissions/token for sockets. notify confirms sending only. Send large files in chunks/streams or pass an agreed path for the remote application to read. Validate descendant termination and permissions against the actual host.

items: Worker 卡住了，调用一直等不到结果。 输入太大、算法陷入死循环，或者用户已经取消，主线程的 Promise 却一直 pending，只能自己拼超时和取消消息。示例
Worker 崩溃后，等待中的调用永远等不到回复。 线程已经退出，没人去拒绝那些还在等的 Promise。示例

Worker 要回调主线程、或要逐项返回结果。 只好另建一套消息类型和路由，再维护一遍请求和回复的对应关系。示例

blocks.text: 常见做法是给 `postMessage` 加一层请求编号，或者用把 Worker 包装成代理对象的轻量封装，把调用写成 `await api.method()`。它们让调用看起来像本地函数，却不管调用出了问题之后怎么办。本包补上的正是这一段：

items: 卡住的调用会到期，也能随时取消。 常见封装只在 Worker 回复时 resolve，超时和取消都要自己拼。这里每次调用默认有 30 秒期限，可以用 `timeoutMs` 单独设置，也可以传入 `AbortSignal`；到期或取消时分别以带 `code` 的 `TimeoutError`、`AbortError` 拒绝。示例
Worker 崩溃，进行中的调用立刻失败。 常见封装要你自己监听 `exit`，再逐个拒绝还在等的调用。这里连接一断，未完成的调用就以 `REMOTE_RESULT_UNKNOWN` 拒绝，明确告诉你“结果未知，先对账再重试”；默认还会按递增的间隔自动重启 Worker。示例
错误原样回到主线程。 结构化克隆会把自定义错误变成普通 `Error`，并丢掉 `code` 这类自定义字段。这里类名、`code` 和 `cause` 链都会还原，主线程可以继续按 `code` 分支。示例
忙不过来时直接拒绝，不无限排队。 常见封装把消息全部塞进 Worker 的队列。这里同时执行的调用数有上限，超出的调用立即以 `OVERLOADED` 拒绝，提供方函数不会执行，调用方可以马上限流或降级。示例
双向调用和流共用一条连接。 两端都能提供方法、发起调用；返回异步生成器的方法用 `stream()` 逐项读取，不用另建消息路由。示例

blocks.text: 本包创建 Worker、接入消息端口，并把 Worker 的预算、启动、重启和释放交给监督器。调用关联、目录、超时、取消、错误还原和重试归 Core；协议与便携值归 Contract。它适合把解析、压缩、图像处理等计算移出主线程，以及让 Host 统一管理多条 Worker 连接。

线程共享进程，不能代替独立进程的权限或故障隔离。需要独立进程时使用 rpc-process；跨窗口、iframe、SharedWorker、可靠有序 RTCDataChannel 的 Peer 使用 rpc-browser，Service Worker 和 BroadcastChannel 使用该包的 Endpoint transport。SharedArrayBuffer / Atomics 共享内存不在本包支持范围内。

rows: Peer、Plugin、child guard、错误码、高级通道与 Web launcher，以及公开配置和 handle 类型。

blocks.text: 直接安装 Core 与 Contract 两个 peer 依赖；不以硬编码版本相等作为运行时规则。lifecycle、supervision、utils 是运行时依赖。Electron-main 入口另需可选 peer `electron: ^44.0.0`。示例直接导入 PluginHost 或 utils 时，也应直接安装相应包。

Web、Bun、Deno 和 Electron renderer 使用根入口的 `createWebThreadLauncher`、`createWebThreadChannelFactory`。`INodeThreadHandle`、`IWebThreadHandle`、`IWebThreadLauncherOptions` 和高级原生运行时类型从根入口导入。根入口还重新导出 Core 的 typed surface、查询、详情、列表、事件与 thread stop 类型；这些不是另一套调用协议。

`createThreadPeer<TRemote>(options, runtime?)` 返回 typed Peer。`TRemote` 默认 `Record<never, never>`，只约束调用端类型，不注册 Worker 方法。`IRuntimeDynamicSurface` 可以放宽静态路径检查，运行时仍以对端真实目录为准。默认本地身份为 `{ name: 'thread', instanceId: 自动生成值 }`；需要稳定地址时显式传 `self.name`、`self.instanceId`。

主线程可以指定短 `spawn`、完整 `spawn` 或 Core 的 `connect` / `listen` 来源；来源不能混用。库 launcher 创建的 Worker 内省略来源，由真实 Node parentPort / workerData 或 Web Worker bootstrap 自动连接父线程。单独执行普通 Worker 文件不会获得这种连接。`isThreadChild()` 只读取库的启动标记以区分父子分支，不为外部 Worker 授权，也不替代能力确认。
`provide` 缺省不暴露应用方法；自身可枚举数据属性中的函数形成方法，嵌套对象形成点分路径，不接受 accessor 作为方法声明。返回 iterable / async iterable 的方法通过 `stream` 调用。Worker 端也是 Peer，可反向调用父线程的 `provide`。

blocks.text: `defaultTimeoutMs` 缺省 30000，必须是正有限值，只用于 request / stream。单次 `timeoutMs` 可为非负有限值或 `false`；0 表示立即到期，false 关闭该次期限。全局并发默认 256，每个对端 64，通过 `providerLimits.maxGlobal`、`providerLimits.maxPerPeer` 调整；超额以 `OVERLOADED` 拒绝，不执行该次 provider。设置 `spec.limits.callWallTimeMs` 会进一步压低调用期限。

`signal` 是协作取消，超时、取消或断线都不能证明 Worker 尚未执行。非幂等写入先用业务标识对账；已声明幂等且仍保留结果的调用可结合 `idempotencyKey` / `outcome(key)`，不能把任意重试当作只执行一次。`report` 缺省 Core 的默认诊断输出（通常为 console.error）；它接收后台失败。`probe`、`contract`、`authentication`、`endpointFactory`、`keyFactory`、`retryPort` 延续 Core 各自 owner 的契约。

blocks.text: 默认 RPC health 使用 5000 ms 间隔、2000 ms 单次上限、连续 3 次失败策略。Endpoint 尚未绑定时由原准备期限管理，绑定后只探测该 handle 的真实 Endpoint。显式去掉 ping 却未提供自定义 health 会以 INVALID_CONFIG 拒绝；健康检查不会把 unsupported 原生退出能力变成 enforced。
Node / Bun self spawn 保留运行时 flags；显式不同入口会过滤父进程的 eval、print、测试控制参数，保留 loader 等运行时 flags。REPL、eval、单文件二进制、Electron 和测试运行器等没有可复用主入口时，self spawn 以 INVALID_CONFIG 拒绝，不猜入口；显式可用入口不受“不能 self spawn”的推断限制。

Node 24 可剥离 .ts 类型，但不把相对 `./x.js` 重定向为 `./x.ts`；Bun 支持此映射。含这种 specifier 的工程在 Node / Deno 下使用构建输出或合适 loader，解析错误保留原 cause。浏览器只接受明确 URL，不接受 true / 裸字符串；动态 Worker 构造也不能替代 bundler 的字面量源码发现。应提供预构建模块 URL，或在自定义构造器内保留字面量 Worker 构造。Deno Worker 仍需相应宿主权限。
`createThreadPlugin(options, runtime?)` 复用 Peer 来源、provide 与认证配置，另需 `name`，`expose` 缺省为空数组：不向 Worker 暴露 Host 应用方法。只有明确选中的 Host 路径可见。安装后由 Host 持有连接和 Worker，经 `host.thread` 操作；直接 Peer 则由创建者关闭。

`host.thread.request` / notify / stream / group / outcome 的第一参数是连接名或 `{ name, instanceId }`。list / get 查询连接及当前代次，broadcast 返回每个目标的独立结果，on / watch 复用 Core 事件目录。stop / kill / restart / replace 仅用于 spawn 来源；连接来源不能据此终止外部 Worker。线程 stop 只接受 `{ graceMs }`，出现 signal 字段（即便 undefined）也拒绝。
restart 返回 ready、replace 返回 replaced 时，新代次已经发布进调用目录，可以立即调用，不需额外等待事件或自行退避。替换不会把已发往旧代次的业务自动迁移到新代次。Host 的 execution.mutationTimeoutMs 和 pipelineDrainTimeoutMs 必须显式配置，false 表示不设该预算。

sections.id: 二进制复制-签名与转移
sections.heading: 二进制复制、签名与转移

rows: 默认按值复制，原 buffer 仍可用；Uint8Array 的 offset / length 得到保留。
必须实际协商原生二进制与 transfer 能力，并建立签名认证；不满足时 CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED。
不支持，调用准入时拒绝。

blocks.text: 要使用普通 factory 的签名原生二进制，在双方 `createThreadPeer` 配置 `authentication: { sign, verify }`；无需另建 Endpoint。`sign` 保护完整语义输入及 Core 为原生 backing 计算的摘要，`verify` 必须拒绝伪造签名。该 profile 签名但不加密，encodedType 使用默认 any。能力提案经实际端口双边确认，配置里的字符串不构成信任证据。
使用 HMAC 时，双方从各自部署配置读取同一个密钥；密钥不经 RPC 发送，也不进入日志。可由应用用 createHmac 对完整输入生成签名，verify 先检查签名长度再用 timingSafeEqual 校验，失败抛出认证错误。旧示例中的 RPC_SIGNING_KEY 是应用环境变量名，不是库自动提供的凭据。Node Worker 继承环境，应用应在加载读取密钥的模块前设置部署配置。
buffer 在消息真正提交到原生端口时失效，byteLength 变为 0，共享 backing 的所有 view 同时失效。之后即使对端拒绝签名或调用失败，也不能恢复原 buffer。带 transfer 的调用不自动重试，库不保留输入副本；确认业务结果后按需重新构造数据。这里描述原生转移机制，没有未经测量的速度保证。

`createNodeThreadChannel(port, peerId, options)` 借用 EventEmitter 端口，`createWebThreadChannel` 借用 EventTarget 端口；options.scheduler 必填。未传 capabilities 时使用固定基础 profile，同步返回且不做运行时 hello。固定子集只含 stream / batch 时也走同步固定路径；扩展能力提案返回 Promise，Core 在实际端口等待双边 ACK，缺失或错误 ACK 会拒绝，不能把单方声明当作完成协商。

在 Peer 的 connect callback 中把 `context.capabilities` 交给 channel，并让两端同时开始。context.self 是 Core 为本地准备的真实地址；peerId 表示对端连接。显式 capabilities 可缩小提案，不可扩大实际 launch offer、伪造协商或信任。逻辑 channel.close / Peer.close 解除自己的监听和 observer，不物理关闭借入端口；调用方最后关闭原生端口。固定 raw channel 不等于完整 runtime Peer。

完整 `IRuntimeThreadSpawn` 必填 spec、launcher、budget、scheduler、channelFactory、report；health、supervisor、keyFactory、retryPort 可省略。完整 source 不继承短形式的 isolation 覆盖：省略 supervisor.isolation 时由 supervision 默认 required 处理。spec.entry 是 Node 绝对路径 / file URL，Web 是绝对模块 URL；spec.name / data / limits 可省略。heapBytes 和 callWallTimeMs 是正限制：前者映射为 Node Worker 的 maxOldGenerationSizeMb，后者限制调用期限；不是进程总内存 / 总 CPU 限额。

electron-main 子入口的两个工厂
复用 worker_threads，但明确三项 unsupported，不把 Node 验证外推到 Electron。

blocks.text: Web launcher 必填 report，可选 Worker 构造器（默认全局 Worker）和 runtimeApi；构造器接收 entry 与 `{ type: 'module', name }`。Node launcher options 默认空对象，可显式 execArgv / runtimeApi；高级 createAdapterNodeThreadLauncher 另接真实 runtime resource。工厂只在实际启动时获取宿主能力。Node 的 sampleUsage 为冷查询：可用时报告该 isolate 的 heap、CPU 微秒和 ELU，sharedPid 只是共享进程身份；缺少原生方法时字段缺席，退出后返回空对象，不拿整个父进程用量冒充线程用量。

handle.identity 含稳定 fingerprint，Node 另含创建时 threadId；handle.port 为实际消息资源，terminate 只请求停止，exited 表示退出，Web 还提供 prepared。Node 由原生 exit、Bun 由原生 Worker close 结算 exited；Deno、浏览器和 Electron renderer 的退出观察为 unsupported，强制回收立即报告 supervision EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE 并保留 abandoned budget lease，不等待 reapTimeoutMs，也不能提前把槽位当空闲。可观察退出超时仍报告 REAP_TIMEOUT；best-effort 准入诊断 CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED 不变。自定义 Node / Web handle 的 open(signal, { scheduler, capabilities? }) 打开对应代次；channel factory 与它使用同一 scheduler。

构造或打开失败时，launcher / 监督 owner 释放已取得监听和候选 Worker；主错误保持原对象或在 cause 链中，清理错误保留在 errors。Node Endpoint 构造失败会回收真实 Worker 和预算；Web 请求 terminate 仍不能补出退出证明。高级调用方若直接 launch，须负责逻辑 channel 关闭、terminate 请求和等待真实 exited 的边界，不能在缺少原生回执的 Web 路径无限 await exited。

AdapterNodeThreadParentChannel 在构造时只保留真实 parentPort，open 才建立固定 profile，不先添加 listener。createAdapterNodeThreadPeer 接收已持有 parentPort 和原始 workerData；runtime resource 的 load 获取真实 Worker 模块，pid 表示共享进程。receiveThreadData 只消费匹配的初始 bootstrap，移除自己的 listener，await prepare(data, peerId) 后发送 ready；返回便携业务 data。readThreadBootstrap 校验并拆出 peerId / data；这些工具不给任意外部 Worker 授权。
新适配器复用 Core adapter SDK 的 defineMessageAdapter；复杂原生组装可使用它的 internal-advanced 入口，不复制能力协商、重试或生命周期 owner。Node Worker 与 Bun 1.4.3 原生 Worker 已有业务与关闭运行证据；这些结果不证明浏览器、Deno 或 Electron 的权限与退出能力。

最终 channel 的 `transport.observe(probe)` 安装物理消息观察；发送、接收各报告一次。发送 detail.transfers 为原生 transfer 列表长度，接收为 -1，因为 structured clone 不能说明收到的 buffer 是复制还是转移。直接 ArrayBuffer / view 的 sizeBytes 是字节长度，其它原生消息为 -1，不通过额外序列化估算对象大小。
仅 probe.capturing 开启时读取内容；未转移内容借用原引用，实际转移的 buffer 在发送前复制以保留观察字节。Core 对 own-data 原生容器的选择性捕获保留 Array、Record、Map、Set 中的环、共享 backing 和未转移对象引用；只经 accessor 返回转移 buffer 的情形不提供额外读取保证，不能为捕获再执行 getter。
probe 失败经 onListenerError 报 Core TRANSPORT，原异常保留在 cause，消息仍继续发送和接收。重复 observe 替换旧代，旧 disposer 不会移除新代；当前 disposer、逻辑 close 和既有原生 terminal 路径退休观察。借用端口 close 不改变物理端口所有权，也不改变既有监听与错误 cause 次序。
下表区分线程采样、监督、Core 与 Remote 的错误来源。线程 API 从 `@migaia/rpc-threads` 导入；Core 与 Remote API 分别从 `@migaia/rpc-core` 和 `@migaia/rpc-core/remote` 导入，`source` 值保留各自的错误身份。

rows: 线程 CPU / 内存采样失败，原因为 cause；显示不可用，不据此改变 Worker 生命周期。
退出观察明确不支持；立即 abandoned，不等回收窗口，租约仍保留。
入口、来源、bootstrap、能力 ACK、portable data 或配置不合法；检查字段与 cause。
原生消息 I/O / 启动资源边界失败，保留原生错误类型和原因。
TimeoutError；Worker 可能已执行，先对账。
AbortError；协作取消，不能证明业务未执行。
并发额度满，provider 未调用，降低并发后重试。
需要未协商能力，例如未签名的 transfer。
当前目录没有该目标，检查名字和当前代次。
连接或代次已关闭，重新选择目标，并对已发调用对账。

blocks.text: Node launcher 的原生 Worker 构造参数被拒绝时，使用 Core INVALID_CONFIG 标识；若已有原生 code，则以包装错误保留原 Error、name、message、stack 和原生 code 于 cause，不覆盖它们。此分类只描述 Node 构造边界，不泛化为所有 Web 构造器异常。

本包本地错误码对象 RpcThreadErrorCode 只有 usageSampleFailed，值为 THREAD_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED，RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE 为 `@migaia/rpc/threads`。调用、监督和 Host 边界各使用自己的 source，不把所有失败改成本包采样码。按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message 文本；业务异常跨 Worker 后保留原生类型、message、stack、source/code 与 cause / errors 链，不能承诺接收端对象与发送端同一 identity。
Worker 单独运行配置失败通常是没有库 launcher bootstrap；默认 buffer 未失效是复制语义；Worker 是否重启取决于 restart 策略。需人工恢复时用 Host 的 restart / replace，并查看 list / get 的当前代次与退出信息。
用真实 Worker 执行函数，并明确区分拥有 Worker 与借入消息端口。最短入口见 README。

blocks.text: 下面十个示例各自保存为一个 .ts 文件，用 Node 24 直接运行；self spawn 会再次执行该文件，必须保留 child guard。它们不依赖浏览器授权，也不证明 Electron 或 Web Worker 的退出能力。

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/rpc-threads @migaia/rpc-core @migaia/rpc-contract @migaia/plugin-host @migaia/utils

blocks.text: PluginHost 只用于 Host 场景；utils 的 scheduler 用于两个底层通道场景。各例最后释放自己拥有的资源，借入端口由调用方另行关闭。

sections.id: 在真实-worker-上执行任务并区分线程与进程
sections.heading: 在真实 Worker 上执行任务并区分线程与进程

blocks.text: 计算需要移出主线程，但单看返回的数字，还不知道它在哪里执行。
同一入口重新执行时，若不先区分子线程，就会继续创建更多 Worker；只比较进程 id，也无法区分同一 Node 进程里的线程。
先等待 `isThreadChild()`，子端提供方法，父端从当前真实文件启动 Worker，并同时比较原生进程和线程标识。
本例的 spawn: true 重用当前入口；省略 self 使用自动生成的 thread 身份，省略 provide 时不暴露应用方法。provide.double 的 value 是数值参数，identity 返回真实 process.pid / threadId；TRemote 只描述对端方法。默认调用期限为 30000 ms，report 使用默认诊断输出。
输出：

blocks.code:
42
true
true

blocks.text: 输出为 `42`、`true`、`true`：结果正确，进程 id 相同，而原生线程 id 不同。
这证明任务运行在同一进程的真实 Node Worker 中，不代表进程级隔离；持有它的 Peer 仍要显式关闭 Worker。

sections.id: 通过同一连接反向调用父端并消费-worker-结果
sections.heading: 通过同一连接反向调用父端并消费 Worker 结果

blocks.text: Worker 既需要父端持有的操作，也要提供一串任务结果。
拆成多套 `postMessage` 路由，就得分别维护结果对应和清理；先收集整个序列，又会推迟读取其中的值。
父端提供方法，Worker 等待反向请求结果；序列方法返回异步生成器，由父端通过 `stream()` 消费，最后统一关闭所有者。
父端 provide.prefix 接收字符串，子端 label 等待反向 request，count 接收 limit 并返回异步生成器。stream 在消费时发送，3 是本例序列上界；未设置的来源、超时和关闭规则与上一例相同。
输出：

blocks.code:
主端:任务
1,2,3

blocks.text: 输出为 `主端:任务`、`1,2,3`：一个请求反向调用父端，流则提供三个值。
这是同一连接上的两个独立方法；流开始迭代时才执行发送，`notify` 完成也不表示提供方已经执行完成。

sections.id: 调用卡住时按期限失败-或中途取消
sections.heading: 调用卡住时按期限失败，或中途取消

blocks.text: 主线程把报表渲染交给 Worker。某次输入太大，Worker 一直算不完；或者用户已经点了“取消”，结果不再需要。
常见的 `postMessage` 封装只在结果回来时 resolve。Worker 卡住，这个 Promise 就永远 pending。想要超时，只能自己用 `Promise.race` 再包一层，到期后还得记得删掉回调表里的那一项；想要取消，还得另外设计一种“取消”消息，并让 Worker 认得它。
这里每次 `request` 默认有 30 秒期限，也可以用 `timeoutMs` 单独设置；传入 `AbortSignal` 就能取消。到期和取消都会让调用以带 `code` 的原生错误拒绝。
`render` 每页约 20 ms，500 页需要约 10 秒。第一次调用只渲染 2 页，正常返回；第二次设置 `timeoutMs: 100`；第三次在 50 ms 后调用 `controller.abort()`。
输出：

blocks.code:
2 pages
TimeoutError DEADLINE_EXCEEDED
AbortError CANCELLED

blocks.text: 正常的调用照常返回；超时的调用以 `TimeoutError` 拒绝，取消的调用以 `AbortError` 拒绝，两者都带有可以用来分支的 `code`。
期限和取消只结束调用方的等待，不会强行中断 Worker 里已经开始执行的函数，函数会继续运行到结束，并一直占用并发名额。所以超时或取消都不能证明 Worker 没有执行；非幂等操作重试前要先对账。需要立刻停下计算时，关闭或重启 Worker。

sections.id: worker-崩溃时-进行中的调用立即失败
sections.heading: Worker 崩溃时，进行中的调用立即失败

blocks.text: Worker 正在转换文件时崩溃了，例如原生模块出错，线程直接退出。
常见封装把每个调用的 resolve 和 reject 存在一张表里，等 Worker 回消息时按编号取出。Worker 一旦退出，就再也不会有回复，表里所有调用都永远 pending。除非你另外监听 `exit` 事件，自己遍历这张表逐个拒绝，否则调用方会一直等下去。
这里连接断开时，所有还没完成的调用立即以 `REMOTE_RESULT_UNKNOWN` 拒绝。这个 code 的意思是“结果未知”：Worker 可能已经执行了一部分，调用方据此决定是先对账还是重试。
`convert` 要 5 秒后才返回；`crash` 用 `process.exit(1)` 让 Worker 线程直接退出，父端用不等待回复的 `notify` 触发它。`spawn` 对象把 `supervisor.restart.mode` 设为 `'never'`，崩溃后不重启，本例只观察进行中的调用。默认 `report` 会把“监督已停止”的诊断写到 stderr。
输出：

blocks.code:
REMOTE_RESULT_UNKNOWN
true

blocks.text: 转换调用在 Worker 退出后不到 1 秒就以 `REMOTE_RESULT_UNKNOWN` 拒绝，既没有等满 5 秒，也没有永远等下去。
这个拒绝只说明结果未知，不说明 Worker 没有执行；非幂等操作重试前要先对账。崩溃后是否重启由 `supervisor.restart` 决定，本例关闭了重启；默认的 `on-failure` 会按递增的间隔自动重启 Worker。重启完成前发出的调用会以 `REMOTE_CLOSED` 拒绝，重启完成后的调用由新 Worker 处理。

sections.id: 错误类名-code-和-cause-跨-worker-原样返回
sections.heading: 错误类名、code 和 cause 跨 Worker 原样返回

blocks.text: Worker 里的下单校验失败，抛出自定义的 `OrderError`。它带有 `code`，`cause` 上是导致失败的原始 `RangeError`。
`postMessage` 靠结构化克隆传递数据。错误经过克隆后，内置错误类型和 `message` 能保留，但自定义错误类会变成普通的 `Error`，类名丢失，`code` 这类自定义字段会被直接丢掉。主线程想按 `code` 分支处理时，就拿不到依据。
这里错误跨 Worker 返回时，保留类名、`message`、`code` 和 `cause` 链。调用方可以像处理本地错误一样按 `code` 分支，并沿着 `cause` 找到原因。
`OrderError` 设置自己的 `name` 和 `code`，`cause` 是一个 `RangeError`。Worker 一侧的默认 `report` 也会把这次失败写到 stderr，方便在 Worker 端排查。
输出：

blocks.code:
OrderError ORDER_INVALID order rejected
true quantity must be positive

blocks.text: 类名、`code` 和 `message` 都还原了，`cause` 仍是一个 `RangeError`，消息也没变。
还原的是错误的类名和字段，不是同一个对象：主线程拿到的错误不是 `OrderError` 的实例。请按 `code` 分支，不要依赖 `instanceof` 自定义类，也不要匹配 `message` 文本。

sections.id: worker-忙不过来时直接拒绝超额调用
sections.heading: Worker 忙不过来时直接拒绝超额调用

blocks.text: 图片上传高峰时，主线程在很短时间内向 Worker 发出大量缩放请求。
常见封装把每个请求都直接 `postMessage` 给 Worker，消息在 Worker 的队列里排队，没有上限。Worker 处理不过来时，请求越积越多，每个调用等得越来越久，内存也跟着上涨，调用方却看不出 Worker 已经过载。
这里提供方同时执行的调用数有上限，默认每个对端 64 个、全局 256 个，可以用 `providerLimits` 调整。超出上限的调用立即以 `OVERLOADED` 拒绝，提供方函数不会执行，调用方可以马上降级、限流或稍后重试。
Worker 用 `providerLimits.maxPerPeer: 2` 规定同时最多执行父端的两个调用；每次缩放需要 100 ms。父端同时发出三次调用，`started` 统计提供方真正开始执行的次数。
输出：

blocks.code:
1 2 OVERLOADED
2

blocks.text: 前两个调用正常完成，第三个立即被拒绝，提供方只执行了两次。
上限限制的是同时执行的数量，不是排队长度。已经超时或取消、但仍在 Worker 里运行的函数也占用名额。`OVERLOADED` 保证提供方没有执行，可以放心重试。

sections.id: 未签名的-rpc-转移被拒绝后仍可使用原字节
sections.heading: 未签名的 RPC 转移被拒绝后仍可使用原字节

blocks.text: Worker 会修改收到的输入，但调用方后续还要使用自己的原始字节。
把所有原生端口发送都当成转移所有权，会意外让原存储失效；未配置签名的 RPC 转移也不能悄悄绕过信任边界。
先用默认复制方式请求，再尝试未配置认证的转移，并检查错误、原始存储和提供方调用次数。
inspect 接收 ArrayBuffer，修改自己的副本；calls 返回实际执行次数。request 最后的 transfer 数组请求转移该 backing；默认没有 authentication，因此拒绝前不 detach，不会调用第二次 inspect。默认复制不需要签名；已签名转移的部署规则见后文。
输出：

blocks.code:
3 7
3 7
CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED
3 1

blocks.text: 输出依次为 `3 7`、`3 7`、`CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`、`3 1`：Worker 只修改了副本，被拒绝的转移既未让原存储失效，也未再次调用提供方。
已签名的 RPC 转移需要双方真实认证配置及协商后的原生能力；此例有意保留默认禁用状态。

sections.id: host-报告重启就绪后立即调用新-worker
sections.heading: Host 报告重启就绪后立即调用新 Worker

blocks.text: Host 重启 Worker 后，下一次请求需要到达新代次，而不是已经退役的实例。
只收到原生重启结果，并不一定说明应用目录已更新；随意增加延时，又会掩盖真正的就绪边界。
把带名称的线程插件安装到真实 Host，等待出口的重启结果后立刻再次读取计数器，不插入固定等待。

插件 name 必填，这里为 worker；spawn: true 使用当前入口。Host execution.mutationTimeoutMs 与 pipelineDrainTimeoutMs 均必填，false 表示不设预算，不是省略默认值。expose 缺省为空数组；restart 的 ready 是应用目录已更新后的结果，dispose 返回包含 cleanupComplete 的清理结果。
输出：

blocks.code:
1
ready
1
true

blocks.text: 输出为 `1`、`ready`、`1`、`true`：新 Worker 的计数器重新开始，能够立即接收调用，Host 清理也已完成。
Host 拥有安装后的 Worker；两个必填执行预算显式设为 `false`，表示不设期限；重启不会迁移旧 Worker 的内存状态。

sections.id: 关闭借用通道后继续使用原生端口
sections.heading: 关闭借用通道后继续使用原生端口

blocks.text: 组件停止使用已有 MessagePort 时，调用方仍可能拥有这个物理端口。
适配器清理时直接关闭原生端口，会破坏调用方剩余的协议或其他显式管理的用途。
创建固定基础配置的 Node 通道，释放订阅并等待共享关闭结果，再用同一个原生端口发送消息。
createNodeThreadChannel 的 port 是借入的原生 MessagePort，peerId 是对端标签，options.scheduler 必填，本例直接使用 systemScheduler。capabilities 缺省走同步 static profile；subscribe 的返回值只退订该监听，close 复用关闭 Promise，不接管原生 port。
输出：

blocks.code:
static true
true
端口仍可用

blocks.text: 输出为 `static true`、`true`、`端口仍可用`：固定配置保留调度器，关闭复用同一个 Promise，原生端口之后仍能交付消息。
这是借用的底层通道，并非拥有 Worker 的启动所有者；最后仍由调用方关闭两个端口，省略 capabilities 不执行运行时扩展能力的双边确认。

sections.id: 真实原生转移后保留捕获字节并替换观察回调
sections.heading: 真实原生转移后保留捕获字节并替换观察回调

blocks.text: 诊断工具需要保留转移的字节，即使原生发送已经让调用方的原始 buffer 失效。
只保留失效后的引用，就会丢掉字节；若不区分代次，旧退订函数还可能错误移除新的观察回调。
观察真实 Node 载体，替换回调后执行旧 disposer，再通过两个真实 MessagePort 转移字节，最后停止当前观察回调。

observe 的 capturing 默认不要求内容；本例显式 false / true 切换。emit 按 direction、sizeBytes、carrier、detail、content 接收事件；send 的 transfer 是底层原生端口转移列表。subscribe 收到的 message.data 是载体值；这不是 RPC request，也不建立认证信任。utils 是此例直接导入的依赖，需直接安装。
输出：
输出依次为 `0`、`7,9`、`7,9`、`0 1`、`42 1`：原存储失效，实际接收与捕获字节一致，旧 disposer 不移除新观察回调，停止后不再捕获下一条消息。
这证明物理载体转移，不代表已签名的 RPC 准入；捕获已转移字节需要复制，不能据此声称全链路没有分配或速度更快。
本包创建 Worker、接入消息端口，并把 Worker 的预算、启动、重启和释放交给监督器。调用关联、目录、超时、取消、错误还原和重试归 Core；协议与便携值归 Contract。它适合把解析、压缩、图像处理等计算移出主线程，以及让 Host 统一管理多条 Worker 连接。

线程共享进程，不能代替独立进程的权限或故障隔离。需要独立进程时使用 rpc-process；跨窗口、iframe、SharedWorker、可靠有序 RTCDataChannel 的 Peer 使用 rpc-browser，Service Worker 和 BroadcastChannel 使用该包的 Endpoint transport。SharedArrayBuffer / Atomics 共享内存不在本包支持范围内。

rows: Peer、Plugin、child guard、错误码、高级通道与 Web launcher，以及公开配置和 handle 类型。

blocks.text: 直接安装 Core 与 Contract 两个 peer 依赖；不以硬编码版本相等作为运行时规则。lifecycle、supervision、utils 是运行时依赖。Electron-main 入口另需可选 peer `electron: ^44.0.0`。示例直接导入 PluginHost 或 utils 时，也应直接安装相应包。

Web、Bun、Deno 和 Electron renderer 使用根入口的 `createWebThreadLauncher`、`createWebThreadChannelFactory`。`INodeThreadHandle`、`IWebThreadHandle`、`IWebThreadLauncherOptions` 和高级原生运行时类型从根入口导入。根入口还重新导出 Core 的 typed surface、查询、详情、列表、事件与 thread stop 类型；这些不是另一套调用协议。

`createThreadPeer<TRemote>(options, runtime?)` 返回 typed Peer。`TRemote` 默认 `Record<never, never>`，只约束调用端类型，不注册 Worker 方法。`IRuntimeDynamicSurface` 可以放宽静态路径检查，运行时仍以对端真实目录为准。默认本地身份为 `{ name: 'thread', instanceId: 自动生成值 }`；需要稳定地址时显式传 `self.name`、`self.instanceId`。

主线程可以指定短 `spawn`、完整 `spawn` 或 Core 的 `connect` / `listen` 来源；来源不能混用。库 launcher 创建的 Worker 内省略来源，由真实 Node parentPort / workerData 或 Web Worker bootstrap 自动连接父线程。单独执行普通 Worker 文件不会获得这种连接。`isThreadChild()` 只读取库的启动标记以区分父子分支，不为外部 Worker 授权，也不替代能力确认。
`provide` 缺省不暴露应用方法；自身可枚举数据属性中的函数形成方法，嵌套对象形成点分路径，不接受 accessor 作为方法声明。返回 iterable / async iterable 的方法通过 `stream` 调用。Worker 端也是 Peer，可反向调用父线程的 `provide`。

单向调用，不提供业务执行完成回执。
逐项消费远端 iterable / async iterable；取消仍依赖远端配合。

blocks.text: `defaultTimeoutMs` 缺省 30000，必须是正有限值，只用于 request / stream。单次 `timeoutMs` 可为非负有限值或 `false`；0 表示立即到期，false 关闭该次期限。全局并发默认 256，每个对端 64，通过 `providerLimits.maxGlobal`、`providerLimits.maxPerPeer` 调整；超额以 `OVERLOADED` 拒绝，不执行该次 provider。设置 `spec.limits.callWallTimeMs` 会进一步压低调用期限。

`signal` 是协作取消，超时、取消或断线都不能证明 Worker 尚未执行。非幂等写入先用业务标识对账；已声明幂等且仍保留结果的调用可结合 `idempotencyKey` / `outcome(key)`，不能把任意重试当作只执行一次。`report` 缺省 Core 的默认诊断输出（通常为 console.error）；它接收后台失败。`probe`、`contract`、`authentication`、`endpointFactory`、`keyFactory`、`retryPort` 延续 Core 各自 owner 的契约。

Node / Bun self spawn 保留运行时 flags；显式不同入口会过滤父进程的 eval、print、测试控制参数，保留 loader 等运行时 flags。REPL、eval、单文件二进制、Electron 和测试运行器等没有可复用主入口时，self spawn 以 INVALID_CONFIG 拒绝，不猜入口；显式可用入口不受“不能 self spawn”的推断限制。

Node 24 可剥离 .ts 类型，但不把相对 `./x.js` 重定向为 `./x.ts`；Bun 支持此映射。含这种 specifier 的工程在 Node / Deno 下使用构建输出或合适 loader，解析错误保留原 cause。浏览器只接受明确 URL，不接受 true / 裸字符串；动态 Worker 构造也不能替代 bundler 的字面量源码发现。应提供预构建模块 URL，或在自定义构造器内保留字面量 Worker 构造。Deno Worker 仍需相应宿主权限。
`createThreadPlugin(options, runtime?)` 复用 Peer 来源、provide 与认证配置，另需 `name`，`expose` 缺省为空数组：不向 Worker 暴露 Host 应用方法。只有明确选中的 Host 路径可见。安装后由 Host 持有连接和 Worker，经 `host.thread` 操作；直接 Peer 则由创建者关闭。

`host.thread.request` / notify / stream / group / outcome 的第一参数是连接名或 `{ name, instanceId }`。list / get 查询连接及当前代次，broadcast 返回每个目标的独立结果，on / watch 复用 Core 事件目录。stop / kill / restart / replace 仅用于 spawn 来源；连接来源不能据此终止外部 Worker。线程 stop 只接受 `{ graceMs }`，出现 signal 字段（即便 undefined）也拒绝。
restart 返回 ready、replace 返回 replaced 时，新代次已经发布进调用目录，可以立即调用，不需额外等待事件或自行退避。替换不会把已发往旧代次的业务自动迁移到新代次。Host 的 execution.mutationTimeoutMs 和 pipelineDrainTimeoutMs 必须显式配置，false 表示不设该预算。

sections.heading: 二进制复制、签名与转移

rows: 默认按值复制，原 buffer 仍可用；Uint8Array 的 offset / length 得到保留。
必须实际协商原生二进制与 transfer 能力，并建立签名认证；不满足时 CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED。
不支持，调用准入时拒绝。

blocks.text: 要使用普通 factory 的签名原生二进制，在双方 `createThreadPeer` 配置 `authentication: { sign, verify }`；无需另建 Endpoint。`sign` 保护完整语义输入及 Core 为原生 backing 计算的摘要，`verify` 必须拒绝伪造签名。该 profile 签名但不加密，encodedType 使用默认 any。能力提案经实际端口双边确认，配置里的字符串不构成信任证据。
使用 HMAC 时，双方从各自部署配置读取同一个密钥；密钥不经 RPC 发送，也不进入日志。可由应用用 createHmac 对完整输入生成签名，verify 先检查签名长度再用 timingSafeEqual 校验，失败抛出认证错误。旧示例中的 RPC_SIGNING_KEY 是应用环境变量名，不是库自动提供的凭据。Node Worker 继承环境，应用应在加载读取密钥的模块前设置部署配置。
buffer 在消息真正提交到原生端口时失效，byteLength 变为 0，共享 backing 的所有 view 同时失效。之后即使对端拒绝签名或调用失败，也不能恢复原 buffer。带 transfer 的调用不自动重试，库不保留输入副本；确认业务结果后按需重新构造数据。这里描述原生转移机制，没有未经测量的速度保证。

`createNodeThreadChannel(port, peerId, options)` 借用 EventEmitter 端口，`createWebThreadChannel` 借用 EventTarget 端口；options.scheduler 必填。未传 capabilities 时使用固定基础 profile，同步返回且不做运行时 hello。固定子集只含 stream / batch 时也走同步固定路径；扩展能力提案返回 Promise，Core 在实际端口等待双边 ACK，缺失或错误 ACK 会拒绝，不能把单方声明当作完成协商。

在 Peer 的 connect callback 中把 `context.capabilities` 交给 channel，并让两端同时开始。context.self 是 Core 为本地准备的真实地址；peerId 表示对端连接。显式 capabilities 可缩小提案，不可扩大实际 launch offer、伪造协商或信任。逻辑 channel.close / Peer.close 解除自己的监听和 observer，不物理关闭借入端口；调用方最后关闭原生端口。固定 raw channel 不等于完整 runtime Peer。

完整 `IRuntimeThreadSpawn` 必填 spec、launcher、budget、scheduler、channelFactory、report；health、supervisor、keyFactory、retryPort 可省略。完整 source 不继承短形式的 isolation 覆盖：省略 supervisor.isolation 时由 supervision 默认 required 处理。spec.entry 是 Node 绝对路径 / file URL，Web 是绝对模块 URL；spec.name / data / limits 可省略。heapBytes 和 callWallTimeMs 是正限制：前者映射为 Node Worker 的 maxOldGenerationSizeMb，后者限制调用期限；不是进程总内存 / 总 CPU 限额。

termination / exit-observation / heap-limit 均 enforced，真实 exit 才结算 exited。

blocks.text: Web launcher 必填 report，可选 Worker 构造器（默认全局 Worker）和 runtimeApi；构造器接收 entry 与 `{ type: 'module', name }`。Node launcher options 默认空对象，可显式 execArgv / runtimeApi；高级 createAdapterNodeThreadLauncher 另接真实 runtime resource。工厂只在实际启动时获取宿主能力。Node 的 sampleUsage 为冷查询：可用时报告该 isolate 的 heap、CPU 微秒和 ELU，sharedPid 只是共享进程身份；缺少原生方法时字段缺席，退出后返回空对象，不拿整个父进程用量冒充线程用量。

handle.identity 含稳定 fingerprint，Node 另含创建时 threadId；handle.port 为实际消息资源，terminate 只请求停止，exited 表示退出，Web 还提供 prepared。Node 由原生 exit、Bun 由原生 Worker close 结算 exited；Deno、浏览器和 Electron renderer 的退出观察为 unsupported，强制回收立即报告 supervision EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE 并保留 abandoned budget lease，不等待 reapTimeoutMs，也不能提前把槽位当空闲。可观察退出超时仍报告 REAP_TIMEOUT；best-effort 准入诊断 CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED 不变。自定义 Node / Web handle 的 open(signal, { scheduler, capabilities? }) 打开对应代次；channel factory 与它使用同一 scheduler。

构造或打开失败时，launcher / 监督 owner 释放已取得监听和候选 Worker；主错误保持原对象或在 cause 链中，清理错误保留在 errors。Node Endpoint 构造失败会回收真实 Worker 和预算；Web 请求 terminate 仍不能补出退出证明。高级调用方若直接 launch，须负责逻辑 channel 关闭、terminate 请求和等待真实 exited 的边界，不能在缺少原生回执的 Web 路径无限 await exited。

AdapterNodeThreadParentChannel 在构造时只保留真实 parentPort，open 才建立固定 profile，不先添加 listener。createAdapterNodeThreadPeer 接收已持有 parentPort 和原始 workerData；runtime resource 的 load 获取真实 Worker 模块，pid 表示共享进程。receiveThreadData 只消费匹配的初始 bootstrap，移除自己的 listener，await prepare(data, peerId) 后发送 ready；返回便携业务 data。readThreadBootstrap 校验并拆出 peerId / data；这些工具不给任意外部 Worker 授权。
新适配器复用 Core adapter SDK 的 defineMessageAdapter；复杂原生组装可使用它的 internal-advanced 入口，不复制能力协商、重试或生命周期 owner。Node Worker 与 Bun 1.4.3 原生 Worker 已有业务与关闭运行证据；这些结果不证明浏览器、Deno 或 Electron 的权限与退出能力。

最终 channel 的 `transport.observe(probe)` 安装物理消息观察；发送、接收各报告一次。发送 detail.transfers 为原生 transfer 列表长度，接收为 -1，因为 structured clone 不能说明收到的 buffer 是复制还是转移。直接 ArrayBuffer / view 的 sizeBytes 是字节长度，其它原生消息为 -1，不通过额外序列化估算对象大小。
仅 probe.capturing 开启时读取内容；未转移内容借用原引用，实际转移的 buffer 在发送前复制以保留观察字节。Core 对 own-data 原生容器的选择性捕获保留 Array、Record、Map、Set 中的环、共享 backing 和未转移对象引用；只经 accessor 返回转移 buffer 的情形不提供额外读取保证，不能为捕获再执行 getter。
probe 失败经 onListenerError 报 Core TRANSPORT，原异常保留在 cause，消息仍继续发送和接收。重复 observe 替换旧代，旧 disposer 不会移除新代；当前 disposer、逻辑 close 和既有原生 terminal 路径退休观察。借用端口 close 不改变物理端口所有权，也不改变既有监听与错误 cause 次序。

blocks.text: Node launcher 的原生 Worker 构造参数被拒绝时，使用 Core INVALID_CONFIG 标识；若已有原生 code，则以包装错误保留原 Error、name、message、stack 和原生 code 于 cause，不覆盖它们。此分类只描述 Node 构造边界，不泛化为所有 Web 构造器异常。

本包本地错误码对象 RpcThreadErrorCode 只有 usageSampleFailed，值为 THREAD_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED，RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE 为 @migaia/rpc/threads。调用、监督和 Host 边界各使用自己的 source，不把所有失败改成本包采样码。按 source / code 分支，不匹配 message 文本；业务异常跨 Worker 后保留原生类型、message、stack、source/code 与 cause / errors 链，不能承诺接收端对象与发送端同一 identity。
Worker 单独运行配置失败通常是没有库 launcher bootstrap；默认 buffer 未失效是复制语义；Worker 是否重启取决于 restart 策略。需人工恢复时用 Host 的 restart / replace，并查看 list / get 的当前代次与退出信息。
Run functions in real Workers and use one bidirectional request and stream API to manage results, restart, and closure.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: A Worker gets stuck and the call never returns. The input is too large, the algorithm loops, or the user has cancelled, yet the main thread's Promise stays pending and you have to build timeouts and cancel messages yourself. Example
After a Worker crashes, waiting calls never get a reply. The thread is gone and nothing rejects the Promises still waiting on it. Example
An error thrown in a Worker reaches the main thread without its `code`. A custom error turns into a plain `Error`, so you cannot handle it by kind. Example
Under a request peak, messages pile up in the Worker's queue. Every call waits longer, memory grows, and the caller cannot tell the Worker is overloaded. Example
A Worker needs to call back into the main thread or return results one by one. You end up adding another set of message types and routes and matching requests to replies all over again. Example

blocks.text: The usual approach is to add request ids on top of `postMessage`, or to use a thin wrapper that turns a Worker into a proxy object so calls read `await api.method()`. Those make a call look local, but they leave you on your own once the call goes wrong. That is the part this module covers:

items: Stuck calls expire, and any call can be cancelled. A typical wrapper resolves only when the Worker replies, so timeouts and cancellation are yours to build. Here every call has a 30-second deadline by default, which `timeoutMs` overrides, and accepts an `AbortSignal`; a call that expires or is cancelled rejects with a `TimeoutError` or `AbortError` carrying a `code`. Example

When the Worker crashes, calls in flight fail at once. A typical wrapper leaves you to listen for `exit` and reject each waiting call yourself. Here, as soon as the connection drops, unfinished calls reject with `REMOTE_RESULT_UNKNOWN`, which tells you plainly that the result is unknown and should be reconciled before a retry; by default the Worker is also restarted with a growing delay. Example

Errors come back intact. Structured cloning turns a custom error into a plain `Error` and drops custom fields such as `code`. Here the class name, `code` and `cause` chain are restored, so the main thread keeps branching on `code`. Example

Overload is rejected, not queued forever. A typical wrapper pushes every message into the Worker's queue. Here the number of calls running at once is capped; a call over the cap rejects immediately with `OVERLOADED` without running the provider, so the caller can throttle or degrade right away. Example

Calls in both directions and streams share one connection. Either side can provide methods and make calls, and a method that returns an async generator is read item by item with `stream()`, with no extra message routing. Example

blocks.text: When you do not need it: if you only hand the occasional computation to a Worker and do not care about timeouts, crashes or overload, plain `postMessage` is simpler. When you need process-level permission or fault isolation, use rpc-process.
Install this module and both Core and Contract peers, save overview.ts in an ESM project, and run the real file with Node 24; the Worker re-executes the complete entry.

import { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads'

const source = `
  import { parentPort } from 'node:worker_threads'
  parentPort.on('message', (value) => parentPort.postMessage(value * 2))
`

worker.once('message', (value) => console.log(value)) // No request id to correlate concurrent results

void worker // No final release; the Worker can remain alive

blocks.text: This module creates Workers, connects their message ports, and delegates admission budgets, startup, restart, and release to supervision. Core owns call correlation, catalogs, deadlines, cancellation, error restoration, and retry; Contract owns the protocol and portable values. Use it to move parsing, compression, image processing, or similar work off the main thread, or to let a Host manage several Worker connections.

Threads share a process and do not replace separate process permissions or fault isolation. Use rpc-process for a separate process. rpc-browser provides Peers for windows, iframes, SharedWorkers, and reliable ordered RTCDataChannels, and Endpoint transports for Service Workers and BroadcastChannels. blocks.text: Configure authentication with sign and verify on both ordinary createThreadPeer factories to use signed native binary; a custom Endpoint is unnecessary. sign must protect the complete semantic input, including Core's integrity digest for native backing storage; verify must reject forged signatures. This profile signs without encryption and uses the default any encodedType. Actual ports acknowledge capability proposals; configuration labels do not establish trust.

For HMAC, both sides obtain the same key from their own deployment configuration. Never send it over RPC or log it. Application code can sign the complete input using createHmac, check the received signature length, then verify with timingSafeEqual and reject invalid authentication. RPC_SIGNING_KEY in the previous example is an application environment variable, not a credential supplied by the library. Node Workers inherit the environment; configure it before importing a module that reads the key.

Storage detaches when the message is physically submitted: byteLength becomes 0 and every view sharing its backing becomes unusable. A later signature rejection or failed call cannot restore it. Transfer calls are not automatically retried, and the library retains no input copy. Reconcile the business outcome before rebuilding data for a retry. This describes the native mechanism without making an unmeasured speed claim.

createNodeThreadChannel(port, peerId, options) borrows an EventEmitter port; createWebThreadChannel borrows an EventTarget port. options.scheduler is required. Extension proposals return a Promise and wait for Core's bilateral ACK on the actual ports; missing or invalid ACK rejects rather than accepting a one-sided declaration.

In a Peer connect callback, pass context.capabilities to the channel and start both sides together. context.self is Core's prepared local address; peerId identifies the opposite connection. Explicit capabilities narrow the proposal and cannot expand a real launch offer or counterfeit agreement or trust. Logical channel.close / Peer.close removes its own listeners and observer without closing the borrowed native port. The caller closes that port last. A fixed raw channel is not a complete runtime Peer.

The former maps to Node Worker's maxOldGenerationSizeMb, while the latter caps a call deadline; neither is a whole-process memory or CPU quota.

handle.identity contains a stable fingerprint and, on Node, the threadId captured at construction. handle.port holds real messaging; terminate requests stopping; exited observes exit; Web also exposes prepared. Deno, browsers and Electron renderer declare exit observation unsupported: forced reap immediately reports supervision EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE and retains an abandoned budget lease without waiting for reapTimeoutMs or falsely freeing admission capacity. Observable exit timeouts still report REAP_TIMEOUT; best-effort admission still reports CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED. Custom Node / Web handles open a generation with open(signal, { scheduler, capabilities? }); the factory must share its scheduler.

When construction or opening fails, launcher / supervision ownership releases acquired listeners and the candidate Worker. The primary exception stays identical or reachable through cause, with cleanup failures retained in errors. A Node Endpoint construction failure reaps the real Worker and frees its budget. New adapters reuse defineMessageAdapter from the Core adapter SDK; complex native assembly may use its internal-advanced entry without duplicating capability negotiation, retries, or lifecycle ownership. Node Workers and Bun 1.4.3 native Workers have business and shutdown evidence; these results do not establish browser, Deno, or Electron permissions and exit capabilities.

transport.observe(probe) on the final channel installs physical message observation, with one event per send and receive. Outbound detail.transfers is the native transfer-list length; inbound is -1 because structured clone does not reveal whether a received buffer was copied or transferred. sizeBytes is the byte length for a direct ArrayBuffer / view and -1 for other native messages, without additional object serialization.

Content is read only when probe.capturing is enabled. Non-transferred content borrows the original reference; transferred backing is copied before sending to preserve observable bytes. Core's selective own-data capture preserves cycles, shared backing, and non-transferred references inside Array, Record, Map, and Set. No additional getter evaluation is promised for transferred buffers exposed only through accessors.

Probe failures report Core TRANSPORT through onListenerError with the original exception on cause, while messaging continues. Reinstalling observe replaces its generation; an old disposer cannot remove the new one. The current disposer, logical close, and existing native terminal path retire observation. sections.heading: Run work on a real Worker without confusing it with another process

Reexecuting the same entry without a child branch creates more Workers, while checking only process ids cannot distinguish threads of one Node process.

spawn: true reuses the current entry. Omitted self uses a generated thread identity; omitted provide exposes no application methods. provide.double takes a number and identity returns native process.pid / threadId. blocks.code:
42
true
true

blocks.text: Output is `42`, `true`, `true`: the result is correct, process ids match, and native thread ids differ.
