sections.heading: Call the parent and consume Worker results through one connection

blocks.text: A Worker needs a parent-owned operation while also exposing a sequence of task results.
Separate postMessage routes require their own correlation and cleanup, and collecting the whole sequence delays access to its individual values.
Provide the parent method, await its request from the Worker, and expose an async generator for stream(); the parent closes one owner afterward.

The parent's provide.prefix accepts a string. The Worker's label awaits the reverse request, while count takes limit and returns an async generator. The stream sends when consumed; 3 bounds this sequence. Unset source, deadline, and close rules are unchanged from the first example.
Output:

blocks.code:
main:job
1,2,3

blocks.text: Output is `main:job` and `1,2,3`: one request crosses back to the parent and the stream supplies three values.
These are separate methods on the same connection; streams are lazy until iteration, and notify completion would not acknowledge provider completion.

sections.heading: Fail a stuck call at its deadline or cancel it midway

blocks.text: The main thread hands report rendering to a Worker. One input is too large and the Worker never finishes, or the user has already pressed "Cancel" and no longer needs the result.

A typical `postMessage` wrapper resolves only when a reply arrives. If the Worker gets stuck, that Promise stays pending forever. For a timeout you wrap it again in `Promise.race` and must remember to delete the entry from your callback table when time runs out. For cancellation you design another "cancel" message and teach the Worker to recognize it.

Here every `request` has a 30-second deadline by default, which `timeoutMs` overrides per call, and passing an `AbortSignal` cancels it. Both reject the call with a native error that carries a `code`.

`render` takes about 20 ms per page, so 500 pages take about 10 seconds. The first call renders only 2 pages and returns normally. The second sets `timeoutMs: 100`. The third calls `controller.abort()` after 50 ms.
Output:

blocks.code:
2 pages
TimeoutError DEADLINE_EXCEEDED
AbortError CANCELLED

blocks.text: The normal call returns as usual. The call that runs out of time rejects with `TimeoutError`, the cancelled call with `AbortError`, and both carry a `code` you can branch on.

A deadline or cancellation only ends the caller's wait. It does not interrupt a function that has already started in the Worker; that function runs to completion and keeps its concurrency slot until then. So neither a timeout nor a cancellation proves the Worker did nothing, and a non-idempotent operation must be reconciled before it is retried. To stop the computation right away, close or restart the Worker.

sections.heading: Fail in-flight calls at once when the Worker crashes

blocks.text: A Worker crashes while converting a file, for example because a native module fails and the thread exits.

A typical wrapper keeps each call's resolve and reject in a table and looks them up by id when the Worker replies. Once the Worker exits, no reply ever comes, and every call in that table stays pending forever. Unless you also listen for the `exit` event and walk the table to reject each call yourself, callers wait indefinitely.

Here, when the connection drops, every unfinished call rejects immediately with `REMOTE_RESULT_UNKNOWN`. The code means "result unknown": the Worker may have done part of the work, so the caller decides whether to reconcile or retry.

`convert` takes 5 seconds to return. `crash` makes the Worker thread exit with `process.exit(1)`, and the parent triggers it with `notify`, which does not wait for a reply. The `spawn` object sets `supervisor.restart.mode` to `'never'` so the Worker is not restarted; this example only looks at the call in flight. The default `report` writes a "supervision stopped" diagnostic to stderr.
Output:

blocks.code:
REMOTE_RESULT_UNKNOWN
true

blocks.text: The conversion call rejects with `REMOTE_RESULT_UNKNOWN` less than a second after the Worker exits. It neither waits the full 5 seconds nor hangs forever.

The rejection only says the result is unknown; it does not say the Worker did nothing, so reconcile a non-idempotent operation before retrying it. Whether the Worker restarts after a crash is set by `supervisor.restart`; this example turns restarts off, while the default `on-failure` restarts it automatically with a growing delay. Calls made before the restart finishes reject with `REMOTE_CLOSED`; calls made after it are handled by the new Worker.

sections.heading: Get the error class, code and cause back from the Worker

blocks.text: Order validation inside a Worker fails and throws a custom `OrderError`. It carries a `code`, and its `cause` holds the original `RangeError` behind the failure.

`postMessage` moves data by structured cloning. After cloning, built-in error types and `message` survive, but a custom error class turns into a plain `Error` and loses its name, and custom fields such as `code` are dropped. The main thread then has nothing to branch on.
Here an error coming back from a Worker keeps its class name, `message`, `code` and `cause` chain. The caller branches on `code` and follows `cause` exactly as it would for a local error.
`OrderError` sets its own `name` and `code`, and its `cause` is a `RangeError`. The Worker's default `report` also writes this failure to stderr, so it can be traced from the Worker side too.
Output:

blocks.code:
OrderError ORDER_INVALID order rejected
true quantity must be positive

blocks.text: The class name, `code` and `message` are restored, and `cause` is still a `RangeError` with its original message.

What comes back is the error's name and fields, not the same object: the error the main thread receives is not an `OrderError` instance. Branch on `code`; do not rely on `instanceof` with a custom class or on matching `message` text.

sections.heading: Reject calls beyond the Worker's limit instead of queueing them

blocks.text: During an upload peak, the main thread sends a burst of image resize requests to a Worker.

A typical wrapper posts every request straight to the Worker, where messages queue without limit. When the Worker cannot keep up, requests pile up, every call waits longer, memory grows, and the caller cannot tell that the Worker is overloaded.

Here the number of calls a provider runs at the same time is capped, by default 64 per peer and 256 overall, and `providerLimits` adjusts both. A call over the cap rejects at once with `OVERLOADED` and the provider function does not run, so the caller can degrade, throttle or retry later right away.

The Worker sets `providerLimits.maxPerPeer: 2`, so it runs at most two calls from the parent at a time; each resize takes 100 ms. The parent sends three calls at once, and `started` counts how many times the provider actually began work.
Output:

blocks.code:
1 2 OVERLOADED
2

blocks.text: The first two calls complete, the third is rejected at once, and the provider ran only twice.

The cap limits how many calls run at the same time, not how long a queue grows. A function that has timed out or been cancelled but is still running in the Worker keeps its slot. `OVERLOADED` guarantees the provider did not run, so the call is safe to retry.

sections.heading: Keep copied bytes usable when unsigned RPC transfer is refused

blocks.text: A Worker mutates its input, but the caller still needs its original bytes for later work.
Assuming every native port send transfers ownership can detach storage unexpectedly; requesting RPC transfer without its trust configuration must not silently bypass that boundary.
Use the default copying request, then attempt transfer without authentication and check the error, original storage and provider call count.

inspect accepts an ArrayBuffer and changes its own copy; calls reports actual executions. The final request option requests transfer of that backing. Authentication is absent, so rejection occurs before detachment or a second inspect invocation. Default copying needs no signature; signed-transfer deployment is described below.
Output:

blocks.code:
3 7
3 7
CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED
3 1

blocks.text: Output is `3 7`, `3 7`, `CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`, then `3 1`: the Worker changed only its copy, and rejected transfer neither detached the original nor invoked it again.
Signed RPC transfer requires both endpoints' real authentication configuration and negotiated native capabilities; this example intentionally leaves it disabled.

sections.heading: Call a restarted Worker as soon as its Host reports ready

blocks.text: A Host restarts a Worker, and the next request must reach the fresh generation rather than a retired instance.
A native restart result alone may not mean an application directory has rebound; adding arbitrary delays obscures that boundary.
Install a named thread plugin in a real Host, await its restart result, and immediately call its counter again without a sleep.

The plugin requires name, here worker; spawn: true uses the current entry. Both Host execution.mutationTimeoutMs and pipelineDrainTimeoutMs are required. false explicitly disables those budgets rather than selecting an omitted default. expose defaults to an empty array. restart reports ready after catalog publication; dispose returns a cleanup result containing cleanupComplete.
Output:

blocks.code:
1
ready
1
true

blocks.text: Output is `1`, `ready`, `1`, then `true`: the fresh Worker starts its counter again, accepts an immediate call, and Host cleanup completes.
The Host owns the installed Worker; both required execution budgets are explicitly false for no deadline, and restart does not migrate the old Worker's in-memory state.

sections.heading: Close a borrowed channel while keeping its native port usable

blocks.text: A component stops using an existing MessagePort, but its caller still owns that physical port.
Unconditionally closing the port during adapter cleanup can break the caller's remaining protocol or another explicitly managed use.
Construct a fixed-profile Node channel, release its subscription and shared close result, then send a native message through the same held port.

createNodeThreadChannel borrows a native MessagePort. peerId labels its opposite connection, and options.scheduler is required; this example passes systemScheduler directly. Omitted capabilities select the synchronous static profile. subscribe returns a subscription disposer, and close shares its Promise without owning the native port.
Output:

blocks.code:
static true
true
still open

blocks.text: Output is `static true`, `true`, then `still open`: fixed construction preserves the scheduler, close shares its Promise, and the native port still delivers afterward.
This is a borrowed low-level channel, not a spawned Worker owner; the caller finally closes both ports, and omitted capabilities do not perform runtime-extension ACK.

sections.heading: Retain captured bytes across a real native transfer and observer replacement

blocks.text: A diagnostics tool must retain transferred bytes even after native sending detaches the caller's original buffer.
Keeping only the detached reference loses those bytes, while an old unsubscribe can accidentally remove a replacement observer if generations are not distinguished.
Observe the actual Node carrier, replace its observer, invoke the old disposer, and transfer through two real MessagePorts before stopping the current observer.

capturing controls whether observation includes content; the example explicitly uses false and true. emit receives direction, sizeBytes, carrier, detail, and content. send.transfer is a native carrier transfer list. subscribe receives the carrier value as message.data. This is not an RPC request or an authentication agreement. Install utils directly because this example imports it.
Output:
Output is `0`, `7,9`, `7,9`, `0 1`, then `42 1`: storage detaches, delivery and captured bytes agree, the old disposer leaves the new observer active, and stopping it prevents another capture.
This is physical carrier transfer, not signed RPC admission; captured transferred bytes require a copy, and no end-to-end allocation or speed claim follows.

This module creates Workers, connects their message ports, and delegates admission budgets, startup, restart, and release to supervision. Core owns call correlation, catalogs, deadlines, cancellation, error restoration, and retry; Contract owns the protocol and portable values. Use it to move parsing, compression, image processing, or similar work off the main thread, or to let a Host manage several Worker connections.

Threads share a process and do not replace separate process permissions or fault isolation. Use rpc-process for a separate process. rpc-browser provides Peers for windows, iframes, SharedWorkers, and reliable ordered RTCDataChannels, and Endpoint transports for Service Workers and BroadcastChannels. SharedArrayBuffer / Atomics shared memory is outside this module's supported profile.

rows: Peer, Plugin, child guard, error codes, advanced channels and Web launcher, plus public configuration and handle types.

blocks.text: Install both Core and Contract peer dependencies explicitly. The module does not enforce a hardcoded equality between their version numbers. lifecycle, supervision, and utils are runtime dependencies. The Electron-main entry additionally uses the optional peer `electron: ^44.0.0`. Install PluginHost or utils directly when an example imports them.

Web, Bun, Deno, and Electron renderer use the root Web launcher and channel factory. Import `INodeThreadHandle`, `IWebThreadHandle`, `IWebThreadLauncherOptions`, and advanced native runtime types from the root. Core's typed surfaces, query/detail/list/event types, and thread stop options are re-exported rather than defining another call protocol.

`createThreadPeer<TRemote>(options, runtime?)` returns a typed Peer. `TRemote` defaults to `Record<never, never>`; it checks the caller's paths without registering Worker methods. `IRuntimeDynamicSurface` relaxes static path checking while the actual remote catalog still controls runtime admission. The default local identity is `{ name: 'thread', instanceId: generated value }`; set self.name and self.instanceId for a stable address.

On the main thread, choose a short spawn, a full spawn source, or Core's connect / listen source; do not combine sources. Inside a Worker launched by this library, omit the source to connect through its real Node parentPort / workerData or Web bootstrap. Running an ordinary Worker file separately does not grant that connection. `isThreadChild()` reads the launch marker to choose a branch; it does not authorize an external Worker or replace capability acknowledgement.

Omitting provide exposes no application methods. Own enumerable data properties containing functions define methods; nested objects form dotted paths. Accessors are not method declarations. Call iterable / async iterable providers through stream. The Worker also receives a Peer and can request methods from its parent's provide descriptor.

rows: Await one result using the actual catalog and typed surface.
Send a one-way invocation without a receipt proving business completion.
Consume a remote iterable / async iterable incrementally; cancellation remains cooperative.
Use Core's group, result reconciliation, catalog, and event contracts.
The creator releases an independent Peer; spawn also releases its owned Worker, while a borrowed source releases only its connection.

blocks.text: defaultTimeoutMs defaults to 30000, must be positive and finite, and applies only to request / stream. Per-call timeoutMs accepts a nonnegative finite value or false: 0 expires immediately and false disables that deadline. Provider concurrency defaults to 256 globally and 64 per peer, configurable through providerLimits.maxGlobal and providerLimits.maxPerPeer. OVERLOADED rejects before running that provider. spec.limits.callWallTimeMs, when present, caps a longer call deadline.

signal requests cooperative cancellation. A timeout, cancellation, or disconnect does not prove the Worker did not execute. Reconcile non-idempotent writes using a business identifier. For declared idempotent calls with retained results, idempotencyKey and outcome(key) can help; arbitrary retries do not become exactly-once execution. report defaults to Core's diagnostic reporter, normally console.error. probe, contract, authentication, endpointFactory, keyFactory, and retryPort retain their Core-owned contracts.

blocks.text: The default RPC health policy uses a 5000 ms interval, a 2000 ms check budget, and 3 consecutive failures. The original preparation deadline governs an unbound Endpoint; a bound check addresses only the Endpoint for that actual handle. Removing ping without supplying custom health produces INVALID_CONFIG. A health check does not strengthen an unsupported native exit capability.

Node / Bun self spawn retains runtime flags. A different explicit entry filters the parent's eval, print, and test controller flags while retaining loader and runtime flags. Self spawn rejects with INVALID_CONFIG when a REPL, eval, single binary, Electron application, or test runner has no reusable main module. It does not guess an entry, nor does this rule prohibit an explicitly supplied usable entry.

Node 24 strips TypeScript types but does not redirect a relative ./x.js import to ./x.ts; Bun supports that mapping. Use built output or a suitable loader under Node / Deno for modules containing such specifiers; resolution failures retain the original cause. Browsers require an explicit URL and reject true / bare strings. Dynamic Worker construction also cannot replace a bundler's literal source discovery: supply a built module URL or keep the literal Worker construction in a custom constructor. Deno Workers still require the appropriate host permissions.

`createThreadPlugin(options, runtime?)` shares Peer sources, provide, and authentication. It additionally requires name. expose defaults to an empty array, exposing no Host application methods to the Worker; only explicitly selected paths are visible. The Host owns installed connections and Workers through host.thread, while the creator owns an independent Peer.

host.thread.request / notify / stream / group / outcome take a connection name or `{ name, instanceId }` first. list / get inspect connections and generations; broadcast returns an individual outcome per target; on / watch use Core's event catalog. stop / kill / restart / replace apply only to spawn sources and cannot terminate an external Worker behind a borrowed connection. Thread stop accepts only `{ graceMs }`; a signal field is rejected even when its value is undefined.

When restart returns ready or replace returns replaced, the new generation is already in the call catalog and may be called immediately. No extra ready event or application backoff is required. Replacement does not move calls already sent to the old generation. Host execution.mutationTimeoutMs and pipelineDrainTimeoutMs require explicit configuration; false disables the respective budget.

rows: Copied by default, leaving caller storage usable; Uint8Array offset / length are preserved.
Requires actual agreement on native binary and transfer, plus signing authentication; otherwise CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED.
Unsupported and rejected during call admission.

blocks.text: Configure authentication with sign and verify on both ordinary createThreadPeer factories to use signed native binary; a custom Endpoint is unnecessary. sign must protect the complete semantic input, including Core's integrity digest for native backing storage; verify must reject forged signatures. This profile signs without encryption and uses the default any encodedType. Actual ports acknowledge capability proposals; configuration labels do not establish trust.

For HMAC, both sides obtain the same key from their own deployment configuration. Never send it over RPC or log it. Application code can sign the complete input using createHmac, check the received signature length, then verify with timingSafeEqual and reject invalid authentication. RPC_SIGNING_KEY in the previous example is an application environment variable, not a credential supplied by the library. Node Workers inherit the environment; configure it before importing a module that reads the key.

Storage detaches when the message is physically submitted: byteLength becomes 0 and every view sharing its backing becomes unusable. A later signature rejection or failed call cannot restore it. Transfer calls are not automatically retried, and the library retains no input copy. Reconcile the business outcome before rebuilding data for a retry. This describes the native mechanism without making an unmeasured speed claim.

createNodeThreadChannel(port, peerId, options) borrows an EventEmitter port; createWebThreadChannel borrows an EventTarget port. options.scheduler is required. Omitted capabilities select the fixed baseline, return synchronously, and perform no runtime hello. Fixed subsets containing only stream / batch also use this synchronous path. Extension proposals return a Promise and wait for Core's bilateral ACK on the actual ports; missing or invalid ACK rejects rather than accepting a one-sided declaration.

In a Peer connect callback, pass context.capabilities to the channel and start both sides together. context.self is Core's prepared local address; peerId identifies the opposite connection. Explicit capabilities narrow the proposal and cannot expand a real launch offer or counterfeit agreement or trust. Logical channel.close / Peer.close removes its own listeners and observer without closing the borrowed native port. The caller closes that port last. A fixed raw channel is not a complete runtime Peer.

A full IRuntimeThreadSpawn requires spec, launcher, budget, scheduler, channelFactory, and report; health, supervisor, keyFactory, and retryPort are optional. It does not inherit the short syntax's isolation override: omitting supervisor.isolation leaves supervision's required default. spec.entry is a Node absolute path / file URL or a Web absolute module URL; spec.name / data / limits are optional. heapBytes and callWallTimeMs are positive limits. The former maps to Node Worker's maxOldGenerationSizeMb, while the latter caps a call deadline; neither is a whole-process memory or CPU quota.

rows: termination, exit-observation, and heap-limit are enforced; only a real exit settles exited.
termination and exit-observation are enforced; the native Worker close event settles exited. heap-limit remains unsupported.
All three are unsupported; a terminate request supplies no actual-exit receipt.
Reuse worker_threads but explicitly retain all three as unsupported; Node evidence is not Electron proof.

blocks.text: The Web launcher requires report and accepts a Worker constructor, defaulting to global Worker, plus optional runtimeApi. Its constructor receives entry and `{ type: 'module', name }`. Node launcher options default to an empty object and accept execArgv / runtimeApi; advanced createAdapterNodeThreadLauncher also takes a real runtime resource. Host capabilities are acquired only when a launch occurs. Node sampleUsage is a cold query for this isolate's available heap, CPU microseconds, and ELU. sharedPid is identity only; unavailable native methods leave fields absent, and an exited Worker returns an empty object rather than borrowing parent-process totals.

handle.identity contains a stable fingerprint and, on Node, the threadId captured at construction. handle.port holds real messaging; terminate requests stopping; exited observes exit; Web also exposes prepared. Node settles exited from native exit and Bun from native Worker close. Deno, browsers and Electron renderer declare exit observation unsupported: forced reap immediately reports supervision EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE and retains an abandoned budget lease without waiting for reapTimeoutMs or falsely freeing admission capacity. Observable exit timeouts still report REAP_TIMEOUT; best-effort admission still reports CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED. Custom Node / Web handles open a generation with open(signal, { scheduler, capabilities? }); the factory must share its scheduler.

When construction or opening fails, launcher / supervision ownership releases acquired listeners and the candidate Worker. The primary exception stays identical or reachable through cause, with cleanup failures retained in errors. A Node Endpoint construction failure reaps the real Worker and frees its budget. A Web terminate request still cannot manufacture exit proof. Advanced callers that launch directly own logical channel closure, termination, and actual-exit observation; do not await Web exited forever when the platform supplies no receipt.

AdapterNodeThreadParentChannel retains the real parentPort without adding listeners until open selects the fixed profile. createAdapterNodeThreadPeer receives an already held parentPort and original workerData. A runtime resource loads the real Worker module; its pid identifies the shared process. receiveThreadData consumes the matching initial bootstrap, removes its listener, awaits prepare(data, peerId), sends ready, and returns portable business data. readThreadBootstrap validates and extracts peerId / data. These helpers do not authorize arbitrary external Workers.

New adapters reuse defineMessageAdapter from the Core adapter SDK; complex native assembly may use its internal-advanced entry without duplicating capability negotiation, retries, or lifecycle ownership. Node Workers and Bun 1.4.3 native Workers have business and shutdown evidence; these results do not establish browser, Deno, or Electron permissions and exit capabilities.

transport.observe(probe) on the final channel installs physical message observation, with one event per send and receive. Outbound detail.transfers is the native transfer-list length; inbound is -1 because structured clone does not reveal whether a received buffer was copied or transferred. sizeBytes is the byte length for a direct ArrayBuffer / view and -1 for other native messages, without additional object serialization.

Content is read only when probe.capturing is enabled. Non-transferred content borrows the original reference; transferred backing is copied before sending to preserve observable bytes. Core's selective own-data capture preserves cycles, shared backing, and non-transferred references inside Array, Record, Map, and Set. No additional getter evaluation is promised for transferred buffers exposed only through accessors.

Probe failures report Core TRANSPORT through onListenerError with the original exception on cause, while messaging continues. Reinstalling observe replaces its generation; an old disposer cannot remove the new one. The current disposer, logical close, and existing native terminal path retire observation. Closing a borrowed channel changes neither physical port ownership nor the existing listener and error-cause ordering.

rows: Thread CPU / memory sampling failed, with cause retained; display unavailable without changing Worker lifecycle.
Exit observation is explicitly unsupported; immediate abandonment retains the lease without a reap wait.

TimeoutError; the Worker may already have executed, so reconcile first.
AbortError; cooperative cancellation does not prove non-execution.
Provider concurrency was full and that provider was not called; reduce load before retrying.

blocks.text: When native Node Worker construction rejects its arguments, the Node launcher classifies the failure as Core INVALID_CONFIG. If a native code already exists, a wrapper keeps the original Error, name, message, stack, and native code on cause rather than overwriting them. This describes the Node constructor boundary, not every Web constructor exception.

The local RpcThreadErrorCode object contains only usageSampleFailed, whose value is THREAD_USAGE_SAMPLE_FAILED; RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE is @migaia/rpc/threads. Calls, supervision, and Host boundaries retain their own sources rather than becoming sampling failures. Branch on source / code rather than message text. Business errors crossing Workers preserve native type, message, stack, source/code, and cause / errors chains; the received object cannot retain sender-side identity.

A standalone Worker configuration failure usually means no library bootstrap exists. A caller buffer that remains attached is the default copy behavior. Restart depends on policy; use Host restart / replace for explicit recovery and list / get for generation and exit information.

ISerializeChunk 是只读二元组：text 携带 string，bytes 携带 Uint8Array，value 携带已经完成的 unknown 业务对象。text/bytes 是可传输的文本/字节；value 没有隐含文本或字节形式。ISerializeChunkKind 为三个标签的联合类型。

ISerializeParser 要求 name、encode(value, context)、decode(chunk, context)，可选 dispose()。encode 可返回单段、Promise 单段、同步 Iterable 或 AsyncIterable；decode 返回值或 Promise。上述四种编码结果的联合类型是 ISerializeOutput。同步 parser 直接返回值即可，无需自己制造 Promise。ISerializeContext 含组合 signal 和定位字符串 context；名称不是旧 source，避免与错误来源混淆。ISerializePlugin 是 { type, parser }，把格式标签与实现绑定。

registry.encode 将一次 parser 输出收集为一个 chunk：全 text 拼文本；出现 bytes 就用 encoder 将 text 转为字节再合并；value 必须独占，混入任何其他段均为 INVALID_CHUNK；零段为 ENCODE_FAILED。逐段接纳会记录真实 chunkIndex 与 bytesConsumed；每次消费前检查取消。异步迭代失败会调用 iterator.return 清理，次要清理错误交 report，不覆盖主错误。
isChunkShape 仅区分单段与段容器：必须是长度为 2 的数组，首项是字符串。它不检查标签是否合法，后续校验才区分 unknown tag、text 数据非字符串、bytes 数据非真正 Uint8Array 等错误。公开边界取得的 tuple 字段需要作为一次快照使用，不应靠后续反复读取来重解释输入。

根入口常量与值联合复用规范值：SerializeChunkKind/ISerializeChunkKind 为 text/bytes/value；SerializeOutput/ISerializeOutputFormat 为 text/structured/binary；SerializeTextFormat/ISerializeTextFormat 为 json/yaml/toml；SerializePhase/ISerializePhase 为 encode/decode；SerializeCleanupPolicy/ISerializeCleanupPolicy 为 throw/report；SerializeCleanupKind/ISerializeCleanupKind 为 cleanup-error/drain-timeout；SerializePluginType/ISerializePluginType 为 json。这些标签不发出 instrumentation 事件，也不是新增错误码。

createSerializeRegistry(plugins, options?) 要求非空插件数组，第一项 type 为 primaryType。每个 type 必须是长度 1–64 的 ASCII token，首位字母/数字，其余可含点、下划线、连字符；SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN 为 /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i，assertSerializeType 非法时抛 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION。写入 HTML 或存档信封时仍需正确转义，token 校验不能代替输出转义。

插件 type 不能重复；parser 必须有可调用 encode/decode，dispose 提供时也必须可调用。空表、重复 type 是 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION，结构非法是 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION。插件列表、字段和方法在接管前完成准入快照，原对象后续改写不能替换已接纳的行为；准入失败不调用 parser 或其 dispose，也没有半接管后回滚的义务。options 省略为空对象，提供时必须为对象或函数。

no-op；已公开结算后才到达的失败，以及次要 iterator 清理失败的观察口。

blocks.text: options getter、scheduler、Encoding 能力的读取和调用按准入边界保留原始 cause；不能让裸访问器失败替代本包错误身份。scheduler.schedule(callback, delayMs) 返回有 cancel()、可选 unref() 的任务；core 使用 timer 时不直接读取全局计时器。

primaryType 是第一项格式；types 是登记顺序的只读名字列表；has(type) 查询是否登记。encode(value, options?) 和 decode(chunk, options?) 返回 Promise。操作 options.type 默认 primaryType，context 默认 anonymous，signal 默认未提供；传给 parser 的 context.signal 包含调用方与内部 closing 信号，谁先被观察为取消就采用谁。未知格式为 CODEC_NOT_FOUND，错误 context 固定 registry。ISerializeRegistry 与 ISerializeRegistryOptions 分别表示返回接口和构造选项。
decode 的准入先看是否关闭，再找格式，最后校验 chunk，因此分别优先产生 REGISTRY_DISPOSED、CODEC_NOT_FOUND、INVALID_CHUNK。关闭后的调用失败是带码原生 Error，不必是 SerializeCodecError。即使 parser 忽略 signal，框架也会在取消时提前拒绝并丢弃晚到结果，不代表底层同步计算或外部任务被强制终止。
close() 同步且幂等：拒绝新请求并取消当前操作，但不释放 parser。dispose(options?) 先 close，再排空，随后逐个 await parser.dispose；共享一个 parser 的多个 type 只释放一次。重复 dispose 返回第一次的同一 Promise。

dispose 的唯一可选字段 deadlineAt 默认 undefined，提供时必须是 scheduler.now 时间域的有限绝对时间。首次接纳调用固定截止值；后续调用不能修改。截止只限制 drain，不是 parser cleanup 的硬超时。截止已过或等待期间到期时可触发 { kind: 'drain-timeout', source, deadlineAt, pendingCount }，随后继续释放。pendingCount 可以为 0；onDrainTimeout 是诊断，不是新的错误码。ISerializeTimeoutDiagnostic 描述该事件；ISerializeCleanupError 描述清理失败事件。
取消 listener 登记后会立即重查信号，不依赖宿主重放事件；进入操作时已经关闭的内部信号优先。取消原因保持 cause 身份，读取信号失败为 INVALID_OPTION。公开 Promise 可及时取消，底层 parser task 仍由 registry 跟踪；close 本身不等待它。

cleanup.policy 为 throw 时，清理失败成为 dispose 的拒绝；已有 primary 时，次要失败追加到 errors，必要时通过 AggregateError 保留全部原因。report 策略发出 { kind: 'cleanup-error', source, error } 并保持正常结算。report/onDrainTimeout 自身异常被限制在诊断路径，不能改写已公开结果；report 自身失败交 utils 宿主异常通路。底层 detached task 的迟到失败也要观察，不重新加入已关闭的生命周期；未配置 report 保持既有 no-op。

jsonParser(options?) 返回 name=json 的 ISerializeParser；jsonPlugin(options?) 返回 type=json 的插件。IJsonPluginOptions 的 replacer、reviver、space 默认未提供，分别交 JSON.stringify、JSON.parse 和缩进；decoder 默认在字节解码时使用宿主 TextDecoder。配置缺省为空对象，普通 JSON 语义并不等于 portable 严格校验。

encode 产出 text；stringify 返回 undefined 时拒绝，原生编码失败标 ENCODE_FAILED。decode 的 value 直接返回原对象；text 直接 parse；bytes 经 decoder 后 parse，缺失能力为 ENV_UNSUPPORTED，解析失败标 DECODE_FAILED。独立 parser 也有错误身份；可附码原生错误保留实例、类型和 stack，冲突或不可扩展时用 coded TypeError wrapper 的 cause 保留原错。

chunkToText(chunk, decoder) 与 chunkToBytes(chunk, encoder) 的 Encoding 参数必填。前者 text 原样返回，bytes 解码；后者 text 编码，bytes 返回 slice 副本，不共享原数组。value 均拒绝为 TypeError/INVALID_CHUNK。转换器自身抛错按 decode/encode 标注，错误原因不丢失。

sliceByFrameBudget(items, options) 是 async generator，items 为只读数组，options 和 scheduler 必填，没有 core 全局 timer 默认值。它在 yield 后恢复时观察消费者处理该片的耗时，用 targetMs / max(elapsed, 0.05) 估计下一片大小，与当前值取中点，再限制到 minItems/maxItems；这是协作式切片，不保证任何设备上的帧率。IFrameBudgetOptions 是切片选项，IEncodeStreamOptions 增加编码选项，ICollectStreamOptions 是收集策略；自定义 yieldTo 负责自己的 Promise 与取消，不能假定其等待总能及时中断。

rows: 2048，安全整数且至少 1；实际切片受上下界限制。
未提供时 scheduler.schedule(resolve, 0)；默认等待可被 signal 取消。
未提供；每次继续取片前检查取消。
必填，now 有限，schedule 返回可 cancel 任务。

blocks.text: encodeStream(registry, items, options) 使用同一切片选项，另加 type（默认 registry 主格式）、context（默认 stream）、maxInFlight（默认 1，必须为正安全整数）。每片单独调用 registry.encode，按输入顺序 yield，maxInFlight 限制同时在途的编码。单个 JSON 数组片段不因相邻而成为一个完整 JSON 文档；需要还原整批时逐片 decode，再在业务层合并数组。

decodeStream(registry, chunks, options?) 接受同步或异步 chunk iterable，options 默认空对象，type 默认 registry 主格式，context 默认 stream，signal 默认未提供；逐片 decode 并 yield，不整体拼装。两种 stream 错误分别包装 ENCODE_FAILED/DECODE_FAILED，chunkIndex 是外层片序，bytesConsumed 为 0，原内层错误留在 cause。外层位置与单次 parser 的内部段号不同。
流入口先读取选项快照，再取得 iterator；失败不能被误报成迭代失败。取消在异步边界后仍需复查，源/生成器提前结束时要结束所属 iterator；次要 return 失败走报告，不覆盖主错。encodeStream 提前 break 时取消自己创建的操作并观察剩余在途任务，不等待不合作的 parser 无限挂起；parser drain 仍由 registry.dispose 管理。

collectStream(chunks, encoder?, options?) 只适合确实需要一整块结果的消费者，不能免除全量驻留。options.signal 默认未提供，empty 默认 text（空流返回 ['text', '']），另值 reject；context 默认 stream。全 text 用 join 拼接；单个 bytes 可以直接返回；多个 chunk 且含 bytes（即使全 bytes）须显式传 encoder，否则 ENV_UNSUPPORTED，core 不读取全局 TextEncoder。value 一律 INVALID_CHUNK。坏 tuple 保留 chunkIndex/累计 bytesConsumed，源迭代失败标 ENCODE_FAILED；Abort 保留取消身份，相关 iterator 清理仍受边界约束。

sections.heading: Base64 与二进制文本通道

blocks.text: bytesToBase64(Uint8Array) 返回完整 RFC 4648 Base64；base64ToBytes(string) 要求规范填充、有效末尾未用位，失败为 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION，cause 保留 utils 原始 INVALID_ENCODING。它不同于 portable tag 使用的不填充 base64url。

streamBase64Chunks(bytes) 为同步惰性 Generator，逐块 yield 而不拼完整字符串，空输入零块。内部块长 32763 字节，是 3 的倍数，避免片间填充破坏编码；没有公开块长选项。算法来自 utils/bytes，不构造整份 binary string，也不调用 btoa/atob。最终必须得到单一字符串时用 bytesToBase64；能直接传字节的通道无需先转 Base64。4/3 的体积变化是编码格式的性质，不是性能测量。

`ICodec<TValue, TEncoded, TId, TVersion>` 含只读 id、version、encodedType、encode、decode；后两项是函数属性，保留严格参数方差。TId 默认 string、TVersion 默认 number。encodedType 只能 unknown/string/uint8array，codec 的同步函数不等于 registry 的异步 parser。identityCodec 固定 id=identity、version=1、encodedType=unknown，encode/decode 原样返回同一值及具体类型；旧 alias 和无版本 identity 子入口已删除。

defineJsonCodec、defineMessagePackCodec、defineCBORCodec 的 options.version 必填，为正安全整数；工厂返回冻结 codec，id 分别为 json、message-pack、cbor，输出分别为 string、Uint8Array、Uint8Array。三者先做同一 portable 投影/校验；JSON、集合 JSON、CBOR 与 MessagePack 按 Object.keys 属性枚举顺序投影，不做比较排序，getter 每次按该顺序读取；MessagePack 不使用扩展；CBOR 关闭 records 和宿主扩展，解码 bigint 整数仅在可精确表示为安全整数时转 number，否则拒绝。

defineProtobufCodec 的 options 必含 version、schema、binding。schema.id 符合 /^[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$/u，schema.version 为正安全整数，与 codec.version 独立；binding 必须为生成的 Buf DescMessage，不能传自定义 encode/decode hook。返回冻结 schema 身份，业务值为 `MessageShape<TBinding>`；encodedType=uint8array，encode/decode 验证真实 Uint8Array，并保留 Buf 原错误原因。格式工厂自身不提供存储或网络信封。

ICodecValue 的静态域为 null、boolean、number、string、嵌套只读数组和记录；数值仍需运行时有限性检查。normalizeCodecFailure(error, code, message) 原样保留本包已标注 Error，其他失败包装为 TypeError 并保留 cause；CodecErrorText 持有稳定版本、schema、编解码和 portable 拒绝文案。

sections.heading: Portable 默认规则与可复用 walker

blocks.text: toPortableValue(value, active?) 返回旧中间投影，不等于最终断言：普通对象按排序字符串键逐项读取并递归，得到可变 ordinary 对象，不冻结；Uint8Array 变成 { $rpc: 'bytes', base64url }。继承/非枚举/symbol 字段不进入记录投影，getter 可能执行，重复兄弟引用各复制一次；环只按当前祖先路径判断。投影阶段可暂存 undefined/NaN 等中间值，格式 codec 最终校验才拒绝。

assertPortableValue(value, active?) 返回 void，asCodecValue(value) 验证后返回同一 ICodecValue 视图；不复制或冻结。默认 decoded profile 拒绝非有限数、undefined、函数、symbol、bigint、Date/Map/Set、非法数组和 native bytes；认可的 bytes tag 保留既有字符集规则，不冒称额外协议的 canonical 位校验。默认深度不限。ArrayBuffer/class 等旧投影行为不应被误称为通用安全快照。

createPortableWalker(strategy) 从根或 codec 导入，在模块/owner 作用域创建一次并复用。每次 walk(value, active?, initialDepth?, beforeNativeBinary?) 返回 { value, byteUpperBound, hasBinary }；walk.value 用同一递归，只返回值。active 为当前祖先 Set，缺省按本次需要建立并在结束后释放图引用；initialDepth 默认 0，根深度 0，大于 maxDepth 才拒绝。binary guard 是本次调用的可选边界，不是全局注册。

rows: 必填；返回 primitive 或 { value, violation? }，保留延迟失败优先级。
必填；返回 inline base64url string、借用 Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer，或 undefined 继续容器准入。
native 结果必需的 intrinsic 长度读取器，不能信任 caller shadow getter。
必填；返回 { entries, output?, tag?, hasBinary?, validate? } 或 undefined；entries 可预捕获或惰性读取，未给 output 时仅校验。
可选；返回原数组或 { value, length?, violation? }，默认沿 map，捕获 length 可免重读。
arrayValue(value, ownedVisit, childDepth, ancestors, guard, bounds, context)
与 array 互斥，直接返回原投影，用 visit 保持词法遍历归属，不能自己另写递归。
默认无限制，由策略决定预算。
可选，在访问子值前校验保留字段。
可选；默认 defineProperty，确保 own `__proto__` 不改原型。
可选，可冻结容器；native leaf 不复制、不冻结、不调用 finish。
必填，抛调用方已拥有的 coded 原生错误，保留原始 cause 和 stack。

blocks.text: context 提供 reject、isAncestor、isUint8Array、bytesToBase64url、isCanonicalBase64url 及可选 beforeNativeBinary。通用原因有 depth/cycle/access/ancestor，其余由策略拥有。context 只供同步 hook 使用；已分类错误保持身份，应用回调异常交 violation('access', original)，祖先 Set 自身失败保持原边界。
byteUpperBound 是 JSON UTF-8 保守上界，不是实际长度：每 UTF-16 单元最多 6 个转义字节、数值最多 32 字节，加容器标点与 bytes tag。值、字节上界和 hasBinary 同次遍历融合，不再扫描输入；native 长度由策略给出，不能把这个数当完整共享 backing/offset 协议预算。

IPortableBinaryResult 是 string/Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer 的非包装联合。native 对象保留 exact identity，不复制或冻结；finish 的第二参数仅证明 native descendant，hasBinary 还包含 inline tags，不能据此授予某协议 native 权限。重入 getter 会恢复外层会计与活动路径，已完成调用不保留输入；value-only 数组路径不额外探测输出 length。

默认 JSON/MessagePack/CBOR 仍为 inline-only，保留原字节与失败优先级：先完成投影，再抛延迟校验错误，较晚 getter 失败仍可优先。RPC 的 null-prototype/freeze、父字段预捕获、深度 64、canonical tag 与协议身份由 rpc-contract 自己的策略拥有，serialize 不内置消费者 profile，也不拥有 manifest 或 native 协商。
emitOutput(value, format?) 同步返回完整文本，format 默认 json，另有 yaml/toml；JSON 复用 jsonParser，YAML/TOML 仅输出、不引入第三方运行时，也不是 registry parser。
输入只接受有限数、字符串、布尔、数组和 plain own-data 记录，JSON/YAML 允许 null。描述符准入拒绝可枚举访问器而不求值，也拒绝循环、稀疏数组、命名数组属性、可枚举 symbol、不支持的值与非普通原型。不会调用 toJSON、replacer 或业务 getter，失败不返回部分文本，诊断不回显输入。
TOML 只接受对象根，任意深度 null 和未配对 surrogate 都拒绝；键和字符串加引号，嵌套集合保持结构。负零输出 -0.0，不安全整数用浮点写法避免进入 TOML 整数域。错误为带 source/code 的原生 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION，读取失败保留原因。这个严格 own-data 输出规则与旧 portable 投影不同。

SerializeCodecError(message, details) 的 details 必含 code、type、phase、chunkIndex、bytesConsumed，可选 context、source、cause；source 默认 @migaia/serialize，TCode 默认 ISerializeErrorCode，上层可用自己的 code 联合与 source 复用它。phase 为 encode/decode，cause 保留原对象。registry 编解码失败和原生构造/生命周期失败载体不同，统一按 (source, code) 判断，不能只靠 instanceof。

rows: ENCODE_FAILED：编码、空输出或流迭代失败；cause 保留原错。
INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。
ABORTED：协作式取消；可能为 SerializeCodecError 或 tagged 原生错误，取决于边界。
INVALID_OPTION：插件、版本、portable、scheduler、流选项、Base64 或输出准入非法。
ENV_UNSUPPORTED：Encoding 等必需宿主能力缺失。
TAG_MISSING：无标签输入缺少显式 untagged 读取器。
TAG_UNKNOWN：合法标签没有对应的登记版本。

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) 返回原错误并附只读 source/code，context 未提供保持未设；同身份重复附加幂等，context 仅补一次。冲突委托 utils，抛 (@migaia/utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT)，原错误在 cause，不能静默改写身份。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

sections.heading: 在 JSON 中保留 Map 与 Set

blocks.text: 值含 Map 或 Set 时显式选集合 codec。它复用严格 JSON 的 portable 规则，增加递归集合，投影类实例的可枚举字段，拒绝非有限数字、undefined、Date 与循环引用。保留的 $rpc 记录须符合 bytes/map/set 的精确形状。集合按插入顺序遍历，使用内部槽及内建迭代器。字节解码后仍为 bytes 记录；旧集合元组按普通数据读取。
格式 codec 先枚举整数索引，再按字符串插入顺序输出，getter 遍历顺序相同。公开 toPortableValue 仍提供按键排序的中间投影。RPC owned 快照与普通对象、字节 JSON 路径均保持对象自身的 key 顺序；RPC 私有快照仍由原单遍遍历同时完成复制与字节上限计算，并跳过已经编码的二进制子树。

sections.heading: 编码结果自带格式标签

blocks.text: 首项 codec 写新值，列表内各 id/version 读取自己的带标签载荷。可选 untagged 只读取原始旧数据。未知标签报 TAG_UNKNOWN；保留头部损坏报 TAG_INVALID，不回退。无标签文本若以 mgt1: 开头，也会当作有标签输入，即使它来自 untagged codec。

字符串载体前置 mgt1:<id>@<version>;。字节载体前置 00 4d 47 54、格式字节 01、两字节大端 UTF-8 标签长度与标签。unknown 载体返回带自有 $migaia.codec 和 value 的冻结对象，内层值不冻结。所有 codec 声明同一载体，外层身份为 tagged@1，与存储 envelope 版本独立。ICodecEncodedType、ITaggedCodecOptions、ITaggedEncoded、ITaggedValue 与 ITaggedCodec 保留载体及业务值推断。

sections.heading: 编码设置后再读回原值

blocks.text: 设置页面需要生成可保存的文本，再次打开时还要走同一条解码路径。
把字符串化和解析散在调用方，会把业务绑定到一种格式，也没有统一的地方管理格式选择和解析器清理。
把 `jsonPlugin()` 登记到序列化注册表，首个插件决定默认写入格式。`encode()` 返回带类型的片段，`decode()` 负责读回；文本通道用 `chunkToText()` 取得载荷，结束时释放注册表。

插件列表必填，本例只有 jsonPlugin()，因此 primaryType 为 json。registry options 省略，scheduler 默认 systemScheduler，encoder/decoder 默认宿主 Encoding 能力，cleanup 默认 throw，两个诊断口默认 no-op。encode/decode 的 type 默认主格式、context 默认 anonymous、signal 省略；chunkToText 的第二参数 TextDecoder 必填。theme 是业务数据，不是配置字段。
输出：
依次输出 `格式: json`、`文本: {"theme":"dark"}`、`主题: dark`。
同一个已登记解析器完成编码和解码。片段只是 `[kind, payload]`，不是保存格式标签的存储封套；多格式共存时，应把 `primaryType` 另存到数据旁。解析器清理由注册表持有，结束后必须释放。

sections.id: 默认写新格式-按已保存标签读旧格式
sections.heading: 默认写新格式，按已保存标签读旧格式

blocks.text: 新设置不应继续保存本地预览缓存，但已保存的设置仍带旧格式标签，必须可以读回。
直接替换唯一解析器，可能让旧记录再也无法读取；根据 `[kind, payload]` 猜格式也不可靠，因为片段不包含应用的格式标签。
把新解析器放在登记列表首位，并用旧标签保留旧解析器。新写入默认使用首个类型，读旧记录时把已保存的 `type` 显式传给 `decode()`。两版都使用 JSON，新写入器省略 `localCache`，旧读取器则把存档中的数字主题 0 还原成 `light`。

每项插件包含 type 和 parser；首项 json-v2 默认写入，json-v1 仅在 decode 的 type 指定时选择。新 parser 的 replacer 接收 key/value，遇到 localCache 返回 undefined；旧 parser 的 reviver 把 theme 的数字 0 转回 light，证明实际选用了旧读取器。其余 space/decoder 省略。saved.type 由业务另存，chunk 的 text 标签只说明载荷形态，不说明格式版本。
输出：

blocks.code:
新格式: json-v2
新文本: {"theme":"dark"}
旧主题: light
旧缓存: legacy

blocks.text: 依次输出 `新格式: json-v2`、`新文本: {"theme":"dark"}`、`旧主题: light`、`旧缓存: legacy`。
默认写入器改变了，旧读取器仍在。显式传入已保存的旧标签，会选到其还原器，把存档中的 0 变成 `light`；误用新读取器则仍会得到 0。登记类型字符串属于应用封套元数据，与 codec 工厂的 `version` 字段是两种契约。JSON 插件遵循原生替换器和还原器行为，不使用更严格的 portable codec 规则。

sections.id: 拒绝非有限计数-避免悄悄存成-null
sections.heading: 拒绝非有限计数，避免悄悄存成 null

blocks.text: 包含 `NaN` 的计量结果被存成了 `null`，之后读取时无法区分输入无效与有意清空。
原生 JSON 会把非有限数字替换为 null，TypeScript 的 number 类型本身又不会拒绝 `NaN`，因此原值可能在没有报错的情况下丢失。
用 `defineJsonCodec({ version: 1 })` 创建 JSON codec，经由 portable 规则编码；portable 是供不同格式共同使用的受限数据域。有限数字可通过，非有限数字会以 `INVALID_OPTION` 失败，不会被悄悄替换。
defineJsonCodec 的 options.version 必填，本例为 1，允许正安全整数；返回 id=json、encodedType=string 的 codec。count 的 number 类型仍可能包含 NaN，portable 运行时规则会拒绝它。工厂 version 不自动写进编码文本。
输出：
依次输出 `有限值: {"count":2}`、`原生 JSON: {"count":null}`、`portable 拒绝: INVALID_OPTION`。
codec 拒绝了这次会丢失标量含义的转换。必填版本为正安全整数，是 codec 自身的元数据，不会自动嵌入返回字符串。这套严格规则与有意保留原生 JSON 行为的 `jsonPlugin()` 不同。

sections.id: 把同一份配置导出为三种文本格式
sections.heading: 把同一份配置导出为三种文本格式

blocks.text: 配置下载需要 JSON、YAML 和 TOML，分别拼接文本时，对输入值的接受规则不同，同一份设置可能得到不一致的内容。
手写格式化会把值校验、引号转义和嵌套集合语法混在一起，增加格式时容易顺带改变保留哪些字段或怎样转义字符串。
把配置交给 `emitOutput()`，用 `SerializeTextFormat` 选择格式。三种格式共用普通数据接纳规则，每次调用都会先对输入校验并投影，再输出所选格式；省略格式时使用 JSON。
emitOutput 的第一个参数是普通自有数据，第二个 format 可省略，默认 json；SerializeTextFormat.yaml/toml 分别选择另外两种输出。theme 和 retries 是业务字段。格式全集为 json/yaml/toml，YAML/TOML 只生成文本，不提供反向 parser。

blocks.code:
import { emitOutput, SerializeTextFormat } from '@migaia/serialize'

const settings = { theme: 'dark', retries: 2 }
console.log('JSON:', emitOutput(settings))
console.log('YAML:', emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.yaml))
console.log('TOML:\n' + emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.toml))

blocks.text: 输出：
依次输出 `JSON: {"theme":"dark","retries":2}`、`YAML: {"theme": "dark", "retries": 2}`，然后三行 `TOML:`、`"theme" = "dark"`、`"retries" = 2`。
三种输出保留了传入字段，YAML 使用合法的流式集合语法。这是文本生成工具，不是 YAML 或 TOML 解析器。TOML 要求根值为记录并拒绝 null，其余格式也会拒绝不支持的值，不会悄悄省略。

sections.id: 拒绝访问器字段-不执行其读取代码
sections.heading: 拒绝访问器字段，不执行其读取代码

blocks.text: 配置对象中出现了访问器属性，序列化读取它时可能暴露数据或执行额外工作。
普通复制或字符串化中的属性读取会执行 getter；读完以后再删字段，已经无法撤销执行或暴露。
需要普通数据导出边界时使用 `emitOutput()`。它先检查自有可枚举属性描述器，在执行 getter 前拒绝访问器，只有有效数据投影完成后才生成文本。
本例 options 没有额外配置，省略 format 仍为 json。token 是带 getter 的业务字段，拒绝发生在属性描述符检查阶段；reads 计数证明没有调用其读取逻辑。普通 Proxy 的描述符陷阱仍可能运行，不能把该保证扩大成不执行任何用户代码。
输出：

blocks.code:
拒绝: true INVALID_OPTION
getter 读取次数: 0

blocks.text: 依次输出 `拒绝: true INVALID_OPTION`、`getter 读取次数: 0`。
这个访问器在没有执行 getter 的情况下被拒绝，也没有返回部分字符串。边界接纳由支持的标量及数据值组成的普通记录或稠密数组，不是任意对象序列化器，检查描述器时也不承诺避开 Proxy 陷阱。

sections.id: 逐片处理数组-不把多个-json-文档直接拼接
sections.heading: 逐片处理数组，不把多个 JSON 文档直接拼接

blocks.text: 大数组导出先编码成完整字符串，第一片数据能被处理前，就必须在内存里保留整份编码文档。
只把数组分片还不够；之后直接拼接 JSON 字符串，会把 `[1,2]` 和 `[3,4]` 变成两个相邻文档，而不是一个 JSON 数组。接收方必须把每片当作独立帧处理。
这个独立示例直接导入调度器，运行前应同时安装 `@migaia/serialize` 和 `@migaia/utils`。向 `encodeStream()` 传入注册表和调度器，逐个消费产生的片段。示例把分片上下限固定为两项，`maxInFlight: 1` 等待每片编码结束后才接纳下一片。

encodeStream 必填 registry、items、options.scheduler。本例 systemScheduler 提供 now/schedule，minItems/maxItems/initialItems 都是 2，maxInFlight 为 1。省略 targetMs 为 8，type 为主格式，context 为 stream，signal 不提供，yieldTo 使用 scheduler 的零延时任务。最后不足两项的片仍正常输出，结束时 finally 释放 registry。
本例直接导入 @migaia/utils/scheduler，请在消费项目显式安装该依赖：

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/utils

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
独立片段: [1,2]
独立片段: [3,4]
独立片段: [5]

blocks.text: 每个片段都包含一份独立编码的切片，按输入顺序交付，应按独立帧消费；此 API 不拼装单份文档，也不把各片变成一个连续 JSON 数组。`maxInFlight` 默认 1，调大可重叠请求，但会保留更多在途数据；消费方提前退出会取消排队操作，不会强行中断解析器代码。
本包负责值、分段协议、格式与编解码生命周期，不实现存储、Worker、HTTP 或 SSR 宿主。根入口聚合 core、plugins、registry，并提供格式常量、emitOutput、createPortableWalker 及 codec 相关类型。常见协议入口如下。

rows: chunk/parser/context/registry 契约、SerializeCodecError、错误工具、Base64、流式工具与相关类型。
唯一公开 identityCodec 入口；保持运行时对象与具体 TypeScript 类型。
defineJsonCodec 与 IJsonCodecOptions，不加载二进制格式运行时。

blocks.text: core 静态复用 @migaia/lifecycle/abort 作为唯一取消 owner，打包消费者保留必要 abort 闭包，其他 lifecycle root、scope、scheduler、generation、quiescence、disposal 可被移除。core 的 timer 与 Encoding 能力由调用方注入，不导出 registry 实现、chunk 转换 helper、JSON 插件或根入口格式常量。registry 复用 lifecycle 的 scheduler/abort/scope/quiescence；字节算法与错误身份来自 @migaia/utils。依赖方向不反向指向 Store、RPC 或 UI。
IAbortSignal 从 @migaia/utils/promise 导入，本包不重复导出。它是含 aborted、reason?、addEventListener、removeEventListener 的结构契约，不依赖 DOM 类型；原生 AbortSignal 可直接传入。仅用根入口、codec 或 JSON codec 不需要以下可选 peer。
该子入口提供 defineProtobufCodec、IProtobufCodecOptions 与 IProtobufSchema，需要可选 peer @bufbuild/protobuf，支持范围 ^2.14.0。

blocks.code: pnpm add @bufbuild/protobuf

blocks.text: 缺少该 peer 时，Node 导入此子入口抛 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND，消息包含 @bufbuild/protobuf；其他入口仍可加载。
该子入口提供 defineMessagePackCodec 与 IMessagePackCodecOptions，需要可选 peer @msgpack/msgpack，支持范围 ^3.1.3。

blocks.code: pnpm add @msgpack/msgpack

blocks.text: 缺少该 peer 时，Node 导入此子入口抛 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND，消息包含 @msgpack/msgpack；其他入口仍可加载。
该子入口提供 defineCBORCodec 与 ICborCodecOptions，需要可选 peer cbor-x，支持范围 ^1.6.6。

blocks.code: pnpm add cbor-x

blocks.text: 缺少该 peer 时，Node 导入此子入口抛 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND，消息包含 cbor-x；其他入口仍可加载。
ISerializeChunk 是只读二元组：text 携带 string，bytes 携带 Uint8Array，value 携带已经完成的 unknown 业务对象。text/bytes 是可传输的文本/字节；value 没有隐含文本或字节形式。ISerializeChunkKind 为三个标签的联合类型。

ISerializeParser 要求 name、encode(value, context)、decode(chunk, context)，可选 dispose()。encode 可返回单段、Promise 单段、同步 Iterable 或 AsyncIterable；decode 返回值或 Promise。上述四种编码结果的联合类型是 ISerializeOutput。同步 parser 直接返回值即可，无需自己制造 Promise。ISerializeContext 含组合 signal 和定位字符串 context；名称不是旧 source，避免与错误来源混淆。ISerializePlugin 是 { type, parser }，把格式标签与实现绑定。

registry.encode 将一次 parser 输出收集为一个 chunk：全 text 拼文本；出现 bytes 就用 encoder 将 text 转为字节再合并；value 必须独占，混入任何其他段均为 INVALID_CHUNK；零段为 ENCODE_FAILED。逐段接纳会记录真实 chunkIndex 与 bytesConsumed；每次消费前检查取消。异步迭代失败会调用 iterator.return 清理，次要清理错误交 report，不覆盖主错误。
isChunkShape 仅区分单段与段容器：必须是长度为 2 的数组，首项是字符串。它不检查标签是否合法，后续校验才区分 unknown tag、text 数据非字符串、bytes 数据非真正 Uint8Array 等错误。公开边界取得的 tuple 字段需要作为一次快照使用，不应靠后续反复读取来重解释输入。

根入口常量与值联合复用规范值：SerializeChunkKind/ISerializeChunkKind 为 text/bytes/value；SerializeOutput/ISerializeOutputFormat 为 text/structured/binary；SerializeTextFormat/ISerializeTextFormat 为 json/yaml/toml；SerializePhase/ISerializePhase 为 encode/decode；SerializeCleanupPolicy/ISerializeCleanupPolicy 为 throw/report；SerializeCleanupKind/ISerializeCleanupKind 为 cleanup-error/drain-timeout；SerializePluginType/ISerializePluginType 为 json。这些标签不发出 instrumentation 事件，也不是新增错误码。

createSerializeRegistry(plugins, options?) 要求非空插件数组，第一项 type 为 primaryType。每个 type 必须是长度 1–64 的 ASCII token，首位字母/数字，其余可含点、下划线、连字符；SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN 为 /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i，assertSerializeType 非法时抛 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION。写入 HTML 或存档信封时仍需正确转义，token 校验不能代替输出转义。

插件 type 不能重复；parser 必须有可调用 encode/decode，dispose 提供时也必须可调用。空表、重复 type 是 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION，结构非法是 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION。插件列表、字段和方法在接管前完成准入快照，原对象后续改写不能替换已接纳的行为；准入失败不调用 parser 或其 dispose，也没有半接管后回滚的义务。options 省略为空对象，提供时必须为对象或函数。

rows: @migaia/utils/scheduler 的 systemScheduler，创建后固定；要求 now/schedule 可调用，now 返回有限数字。
宿主 TextEncoder；提供时必须有 encode(string): Uint8Array，缺省且宿主缺失为 ENV_UNSUPPORTED。
宿主 TextDecoder；提供时必须有 decode(Uint8Array): string，缺省且宿主缺失为 ENV_UNSUPPORTED；此处只捕获校验，不自动配置 jsonParser。
{ policy: 'throw' }；另一值为 { policy: 'report', report }，report 必须可调用。
no-op；截止已过，或到期仍有在途工作时通知，pendingCount 可为 0。
no-op；已公开结算后才到达的失败，以及次要 iterator 清理失败的观察口。

blocks.text: options getter、scheduler、Encoding 能力的读取和调用按准入边界保留原始 cause；不能让裸访问器失败替代本包错误身份。scheduler.schedule(callback, delayMs) 返回有 cancel()、可选 unref() 的任务；core 使用 timer 时不直接读取全局计时器。

primaryType 是第一项格式；types 是登记顺序的只读名字列表；has(type) 查询是否登记。encode(value, options?) 和 decode(chunk, options?) 返回 Promise。操作 options.type 默认 primaryType，context 默认 anonymous，signal 默认未提供；传给 parser 的 context.signal 包含调用方与内部 closing 信号，谁先被观察为取消就采用谁。未知格式为 CODEC_NOT_FOUND，错误 context 固定 registry。ISerializeRegistry 与 ISerializeRegistryOptions 分别表示返回接口和构造选项。
decode 的准入先看是否关闭，再找格式，最后校验 chunk，因此分别优先产生 REGISTRY_DISPOSED、CODEC_NOT_FOUND、INVALID_CHUNK。关闭后的调用失败是带码原生 Error，不必是 SerializeCodecError。即使 parser 忽略 signal，框架也会在取消时提前拒绝并丢弃晚到结果，不代表底层同步计算或外部任务被强制终止。
close() 同步且幂等：拒绝新请求并取消当前操作，但不释放 parser。dispose(options?) 先 close，再排空，随后逐个 await parser.dispose；共享一个 parser 的多个 type 只释放一次。重复 dispose 返回第一次的同一 Promise。

dispose 的唯一可选字段 deadlineAt 默认 undefined，提供时必须是 scheduler.now 时间域的有限绝对时间。首次接纳调用固定截止值；后续调用不能修改。截止只限制 drain，不是 parser cleanup 的硬超时。截止已过或等待期间到期时可触发 { kind: 'drain-timeout', source, deadlineAt, pendingCount }，随后继续释放。pendingCount 可以为 0；onDrainTimeout 是诊断，不是新的错误码。ISerializeTimeoutDiagnostic 描述该事件；ISerializeCleanupError 描述清理失败事件。
取消 listener 登记后会立即重查信号，不依赖宿主重放事件；进入操作时已经关闭的内部信号优先。取消原因保持 cause 身份，读取信号失败为 INVALID_OPTION。公开 Promise 可及时取消，底层 parser task 仍由 registry 跟踪；close 本身不等待它。

cleanup.policy 为 throw 时，清理失败成为 dispose 的拒绝；已有 primary 时，次要失败追加到 errors，必要时通过 AggregateError 保留全部原因。report 策略发出 { kind: 'cleanup-error', source, error } 并保持正常结算。report/onDrainTimeout 自身异常被限制在诊断路径，不能改写已公开结果；report 自身失败交 utils 宿主异常通路。底层 detached task 的迟到失败也要观察，不重新加入已关闭的生命周期；未配置 report 保持既有 no-op。

jsonParser(options?) 返回 name=json 的 ISerializeParser；jsonPlugin(options?) 返回 type=json 的插件。IJsonPluginOptions 的 replacer、reviver、space 默认未提供，分别交 JSON.stringify、JSON.parse 和缩进；decoder 默认在字节解码时使用宿主 TextDecoder。配置缺省为空对象，普通 JSON 语义并不等于 portable 严格校验。

encode 产出 text；stringify 返回 undefined 时拒绝，原生编码失败标 ENCODE_FAILED。decode 的 value 直接返回原对象；text 直接 parse；bytes 经 decoder 后 parse，缺失能力为 ENV_UNSUPPORTED，解析失败标 DECODE_FAILED。独立 parser 也有错误身份；可附码原生错误保留实例、类型和 stack，冲突或不可扩展时用 coded TypeError wrapper 的 cause 保留原错。

chunkToText(chunk, decoder) 与 chunkToBytes(chunk, encoder) 的 Encoding 参数必填。前者 text 原样返回，bytes 解码；后者 text 编码，bytes 返回 slice 副本，不共享原数组。value 均拒绝为 TypeError/INVALID_CHUNK。转换器自身抛错按 decode/encode 标注，错误原因不丢失。

sliceByFrameBudget(items, options) 是 async generator，items 为只读数组，options 和 scheduler 必填，没有 core 全局 timer 默认值。它在 yield 后恢复时观察消费者处理该片的耗时，用 targetMs / max(elapsed, 0.05) 估计下一片大小，与当前值取中点，再限制到 minItems/maxItems；这是协作式切片，不保证任何设备上的帧率。IFrameBudgetOptions 是切片选项，IEncodeStreamOptions 增加编码选项，ICollectStreamOptions 是收集策略；自定义 yieldTo 负责自己的 Promise 与取消，不能假定其等待总能及时中断。

rows: 2048，安全整数且至少 1；实际切片受上下界限制。
未提供时 scheduler.schedule(resolve, 0)；默认等待可被 signal 取消。
未提供；每次继续取片前检查取消。
必填，now 有限，schedule 返回可 cancel 任务。

blocks.text: encodeStream(registry, items, options) 使用同一切片选项，另加 type（默认 registry 主格式）、context（默认 stream）、maxInFlight（默认 1，必须为正安全整数）。每片单独调用 registry.encode，按输入顺序 yield，maxInFlight 限制同时在途的编码。单个 JSON 数组片段不因相邻而成为一个完整 JSON 文档；需要还原整批时逐片 decode，再在业务层合并数组。

decodeStream(registry, chunks, options?) 接受同步或异步 chunk iterable，options 默认空对象，type 默认 registry 主格式，context 默认 stream，signal 默认未提供；逐片 decode 并 yield，不整体拼装。两种 stream 错误分别包装 ENCODE_FAILED/DECODE_FAILED，chunkIndex 是外层片序，bytesConsumed 为 0，原内层错误留在 cause。外层位置与单次 parser 的内部段号不同。
流入口先读取选项快照，再取得 iterator；失败不能被误报成迭代失败。取消在异步边界后仍需复查，源/生成器提前结束时要结束所属 iterator；次要 return 失败走报告，不覆盖主错。encodeStream 提前 break 时取消自己创建的操作并观察剩余在途任务，不等待不合作的 parser 无限挂起；parser drain 仍由 registry.dispose 管理。

collectStream(chunks, encoder?, options?) 只适合确实需要一整块结果的消费者，不能免除全量驻留。options.signal 默认未提供，empty 默认 text（空流返回 ['text', '']），另值 reject；context 默认 stream。全 text 用 join 拼接；单个 bytes 可以直接返回；多个 chunk 且含 bytes（即使全 bytes）须显式传 encoder，否则 ENV_UNSUPPORTED，core 不读取全局 TextEncoder。value 一律 INVALID_CHUNK。坏 tuple 保留 chunkIndex/累计 bytesConsumed，源迭代失败标 ENCODE_FAILED；Abort 保留取消身份，相关 iterator 清理仍受边界约束。

sections.heading: Base64 与二进制文本通道

blocks.text: bytesToBase64(Uint8Array) 返回完整 RFC 4648 Base64；base64ToBytes(string) 要求规范填充、有效末尾未用位，失败为 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION，cause 保留 utils 原始 INVALID_ENCODING。它不同于 portable tag 使用的不填充 base64url。

streamBase64Chunks(bytes) 为同步惰性 Generator，逐块 yield 而不拼完整字符串，空输入零块。内部块长 32763 字节，是 3 的倍数，避免片间填充破坏编码；没有公开块长选项。算法来自 utils/bytes，不构造整份 binary string，也不调用 btoa/atob。最终必须得到单一字符串时用 bytesToBase64；能直接传字节的通道无需先转 Base64。4/3 的体积变化是编码格式的性质，不是性能测量。

`ICodec<TValue, TEncoded, TId, TVersion>` 含只读 id、version、encodedType、encode、decode；后两项是函数属性，保留严格参数方差。TId 默认 string、TVersion 默认 number。encodedType 只能 unknown/string/uint8array，codec 的同步函数不等于 registry 的异步 parser。identityCodec 固定 id=identity、version=1、encodedType=unknown，encode/decode 原样返回同一值及具体类型；旧 alias 和无版本 identity 子入口已删除。

defineJsonCodec、defineMessagePackCodec、defineCBORCodec 的 options.version 必填，为正安全整数；工厂返回冻结 codec，id 分别为 json、message-pack、cbor，输出分别为 string、Uint8Array、Uint8Array。三者先做同一 portable 投影/校验；JSON、集合 JSON、CBOR 与 MessagePack 按 Object.keys 属性枚举顺序投影，不做比较排序，getter 每次按该顺序读取；MessagePack 不使用扩展；CBOR 关闭 records 和宿主扩展，解码 bigint 整数仅在可精确表示为安全整数时转 number，否则拒绝。

defineProtobufCodec 的 options 必含 version、schema、binding。schema.id 符合 /^[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$/u，schema.version 为正安全整数，与 codec.version 独立；binding 必须为生成的 Buf DescMessage，不能传自定义 encode/decode hook。返回冻结 schema 身份，业务值为 `MessageShape<TBinding>`；encodedType=uint8array，encode/decode 验证真实 Uint8Array，并保留 Buf 原错误原因。格式工厂自身不提供存储或网络信封。

ICodecValue 的静态域为 null、boolean、number、string、嵌套只读数组和记录；数值仍需运行时有限性检查。normalizeCodecFailure(error, code, message) 原样保留本包已标注 Error，其他失败包装为 TypeError 并保留 cause；CodecErrorText 持有稳定版本、schema、编解码和 portable 拒绝文案。

sections.heading: Portable 默认规则与可复用 walker

blocks.text: toPortableValue(value, active?) 返回旧中间投影，不等于最终断言：普通对象按排序字符串键逐项读取并递归，得到可变 ordinary 对象，不冻结；Uint8Array 变成 { $rpc: 'bytes', base64url }。继承/非枚举/symbol 字段不进入记录投影，getter 可能执行，重复兄弟引用各复制一次；环只按当前祖先路径判断。投影阶段可暂存 undefined/NaN 等中间值，格式 codec 最终校验才拒绝。

assertPortableValue(value, active?) 返回 void，asCodecValue(value) 验证后返回同一 ICodecValue 视图；不复制或冻结。默认 decoded profile 拒绝非有限数、undefined、函数、symbol、bigint、Date/Map/Set、非法数组和 native bytes；认可的 bytes tag 保留既有字符集规则，不冒称额外协议的 canonical 位校验。默认深度不限。ArrayBuffer/class 等旧投影行为不应被误称为通用安全快照。

createPortableWalker(strategy) 从根或 codec 导入，在模块/owner 作用域创建一次并复用。每次 walk(value, active?, initialDepth?, beforeNativeBinary?) 返回 { value, byteUpperBound, hasBinary }；walk.value 用同一递归，只返回值。active 为当前祖先 Set，缺省按本次需要建立并在结束后释放图引用；initialDepth 默认 0，根深度 0，大于 maxDepth 才拒绝。binary guard 是本次调用的可选边界，不是全局注册。

rows: 必填；返回 primitive 或 { value, violation? }，保留延迟失败优先级。
必填；返回 inline base64url string、借用 Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer，或 undefined 继续容器准入。
native 结果必需的 intrinsic 长度读取器，不能信任 caller shadow getter。

arrayValue(value, ownedVisit, childDepth, ancestors, guard, bounds, context)
与 array 互斥，直接返回原投影，用 visit 保持词法遍历归属，不能自己另写递归。

blocks.text: context 提供 reject、isAncestor、isUint8Array、bytesToBase64url、isCanonicalBase64url 及可选 beforeNativeBinary。通用原因有 depth/cycle/access/ancestor，其余由策略拥有。context 只供同步 hook 使用；已分类错误保持身份，应用回调异常交 violation('access', original)，祖先 Set 自身失败保持原边界。
byteUpperBound 是 JSON UTF-8 保守上界，不是实际长度：每 UTF-16 单元最多 6 个转义字节、数值最多 32 字节，加容器标点与 bytes tag。值、字节上界和 hasBinary 同次遍历融合，不再扫描输入；native 长度由策略给出，不能把这个数当完整共享 backing/offset 协议预算。

IPortableBinaryResult 是 string/Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer 的非包装联合。native 对象保留 exact identity，不复制或冻结；finish 的第二参数仅证明 native descendant，hasBinary 还包含 inline tags，不能据此授予某协议 native 权限。重入 getter 会恢复外层会计与活动路径，已完成调用不保留输入；value-only 数组路径不额外探测输出 length。

默认 JSON/MessagePack/CBOR 仍为 inline-only，保留原字节与失败优先级：先完成投影，再抛延迟校验错误，较晚 getter 失败仍可优先。RPC 的 null-prototype/freeze、父字段预捕获、深度 64、canonical tag 与协议身份由 rpc-contract 自己的策略拥有，serialize 不内置消费者 profile，也不拥有 manifest 或 native 协商。
emitOutput(value, format?) 同步返回完整文本，format 默认 json，另有 yaml/toml；JSON 复用 jsonParser，YAML/TOML 仅输出、不引入第三方运行时，也不是 registry parser。
输入只接受有限数、字符串、布尔、数组和 plain own-data 记录，JSON/YAML 允许 null。描述符准入拒绝可枚举访问器而不求值，也拒绝循环、稀疏数组、命名数组属性、可枚举 symbol、不支持的值与非普通原型。不会调用 toJSON、replacer 或业务 getter，失败不返回部分文本，诊断不回显输入。
TOML 只接受对象根，任意深度 null 和未配对 surrogate 都拒绝；键和字符串加引号，嵌套集合保持结构。负零输出 -0.0，不安全整数用浮点写法避免进入 TOML 整数域。错误为带 source/code 的原生 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION，读取失败保留原因。这个严格 own-data 输出规则与旧 portable 投影不同。

SerializeCodecError(message, details) 的 details 必含 code、type、phase、chunkIndex、bytesConsumed，可选 context、source、cause；source 默认 @migaia/serialize，TCode 默认 ISerializeErrorCode，上层可用自己的 code 联合与 source 复用它。phase 为 encode/decode，cause 保留原对象。registry 编解码失败和原生构造/生命周期失败载体不同，统一按 (source, code) 判断，不能只靠 instanceof。

rows: ENCODE_FAILED：编码、空输出或流迭代失败；cause 保留原错。
INVALID_CHUNK：tuple/标签/数据错、value 混流或转 wire。
ABORTED：协作式取消；可能为 SerializeCodecError 或 tagged 原生错误，取决于边界。
INVALID_OPTION：插件、版本、portable、scheduler、流选项、Base64 或输出准入非法。
ENV_UNSUPPORTED：Encoding 等必需宿主能力缺失。
TAG_MISSING：无标签输入缺少显式 untagged 读取器。
TAG_UNKNOWN：合法标签没有对应的登记版本。

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) 返回原错误并附只读 source/code，context 未提供保持未设；同身份重复附加幂等，context 仅补一次。冲突委托 utils，抛 (@migaia/utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT)，原错误在 cause，不能静默改写身份。

ISerializeTaggedError 为原生错误附 source/code/context 的类型；ISerializeTypeError、ISerializeRangeError 保持各自原生类型，ISerializeLifecycleError 另允许 errors。createSerializeError、createSerializeTypeError、createSerializeRangeError 分别构造带码 Error/TypeError/RangeError；code/message 必填，options 默认未提供，均允许 cause/context，普通 Error 另允许 errors 的冻结快照。错误码是公开 API，错误 factory 不改写 stack。空输出进度为 0；decode 坏 chunk 进度为 0；decode parser 原错携带该段字节数；外层 stream 重新包装保留自己的片序，不丢掉内层原因。
value 不能转文本/字节或混用时应回到业务对象处理；CODEC_NOT_FOUND 先检查 types 与存档的 type；REGISTRY_DISPOSED 需要新 registry；collectStream 合并含 bytes 的多段须显式 encoder。大数据仍阻塞时检查初始片大小、上下限与 yieldTo，不能把切片当作抢占式终止。

完整组合顺序为：创建 registry；逐片 encode 并交实际 sink；接收端逐片 decode；旧格式用记录的 type 读取，新写默认 primaryType；需要文本边界时再显式做 UTF-8/Base64；最后 await dispose，若设 deadline，记住它只限排空。包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test 与单独 build，不把未复核历史测量当作性能结论。

sections.heading: 在 JSON 中保留 Map 与 Set

blocks.text: 值含 Map 或 Set 时显式选集合 codec。它复用严格 JSON 的 portable 规则，增加递归集合，投影类实例的可枚举字段，拒绝非有限数字、undefined、Date 与循环引用。保留的 $rpc 记录须符合 bytes/map/set 的精确形状。集合按插入顺序遍历，使用内部槽及内建迭代器。字节解码后仍为 bytes 记录；旧集合元组按普通数据读取。
格式 codec 先枚举整数索引，再按字符串插入顺序输出，getter 遍历顺序相同。公开 toPortableValue 仍提供按键排序的中间投影。RPC owned 快照与普通对象、字节 JSON 路径均保持对象自身的 key 顺序；RPC 私有快照仍由原单遍遍历同时完成复制与字节上限计算，并跳过已经编码的二进制子树。

blocks.text: 首项 codec 写新值，列表内各 id/version 读取自己的带标签载荷。可选 untagged 只读取原始旧数据。未知标签报 TAG_UNKNOWN；保留头部损坏报 TAG_INVALID，不回退。无标签文本若以 mgt1: 开头，也会当作有标签输入，即使它来自 untagged codec。

Separate format selection, value validation, framed encoding and parser cleanup from storage and transport code, with explicit paths for old archives, strict values and large arrays.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: A new format makes old archives unreadable because the old reader and saved format tag were discarded.
Saving NaN turns it into null because native JSON conversion is being used as a business validation boundary.
Three configuration exports disagree because each formatter validates and assembles its own data.
Exporting configuration executes a getter because the code reads accessors before checking own data properties.
A large export builds one complete string before any data can be consumed because encoding and consumption are not framed independently.
New writes can coexist with old readers. Replacing the sole parser loses an old format; registry writes through its first plugin and reads through the saved type’s parser. Run the example.
Nonfinite numbers do not silently become null. Native JSON makes that substitution; the versioned JSON codec’s portable profile rejects it explicitly. Run the example.
Three text formats share one admission policy. Handwritten formatting can change retained fields; emitOutput validates and projects plain data for JSON/YAML/TOML. Run the example.
Configuration getters are rejected before reading. Copying or stringify invokes accessors; emitOutput checks descriptors first, leaving the rejected getter’s read count at zero. Run the example.

Array slices arrive as independent encoded frames. Whole-array encoding waits for a complete result; encodeStream produces slices with bounded in-flight requests for incremental receivers. Run the example.

Output:
For format migration, see retaining an old reader; for large arrays, see independent encoded frames.
A settings round trip is simple; evolving formats also need explicit reader selection and field policy. This example is displayed and type-checked only; it is not executed:

const restored = JSON.parse(saved.chunk) as { theme: string } // Pitfall: the type assertion does not remove the runtime cache field.

Applications still save the format tag separately; chunks do not embed type automatically. Use the tagged entry when the encoded value itself must carry its codec identity. blocks.text: A “chunk” pairs a representation label with a payload. A “parser” encodes, decodes and optionally disposes resources. A “plugin” binds a format type to a parser; the “registry” selects and owns them. “Portable” names the accepted cross-format value domain. “Backpressure” limits outstanding work. A “frame” is decoded independently rather than being an arbitrary substring of one document.

ISerializeChunk is a read-only pair: text carries a string, bytes carries Uint8Array, and value carries an already-completed unknown business value. Text and bytes have wire representations; value has no implicit text or byte form. ISerializeChunkKind is the union of those three labels.

ISerializeParser requires name, encode(value, context) and decode(chunk, context), with optional dispose(). Encode can return a chunk, a Promise of one chunk, a synchronous Iterable or an AsyncIterable. Decode returns a value or Promise. ISerializeOutput names that four-way encoding-output union. A synchronous parser can return directly without creating its own Promise. ISerializeContext contains the composed signal and diagnostic context string. The field is context rather than the old source name, keeping it distinct from error ownership. ISerializePlugin pairs type with parser.

registry.encode collects one parser output into one chunk. All-text chunks join as text. Once bytes appear, text is encoded and the output is assembled as bytes. A value chunk must be the only output: combining it with anything produces INVALID_CHUNK. Zero chunks produce ENCODE_FAILED. Incremental admission records actual chunkIndex and bytesConsumed and checks cancellation before consumption. Failed async iteration invokes iterator.return; secondary cleanup failures go to report without replacing the primary failure.

isChunkShape distinguishes a single chunk from a chunk container: it requires an array of length two whose first item is a string. It does not validate the label. Later validation distinguishes unknown labels, non-string text data and non-Uint8Array bytes. Boundary tuple fields are captured facts rather than values to reinterpret through repeated later reads.

Root constants and value unions use canonical domains: SerializeChunkKind/ISerializeChunkKind are text/bytes/value; SerializeOutput/ISerializeOutputFormat are text/structured/binary; SerializeTextFormat/ISerializeTextFormat are json/yaml/toml; SerializePhase/ISerializePhase are encode/decode; SerializeCleanupPolicy/ISerializeCleanupPolicy are throw/report; SerializeCleanupKind/ISerializeCleanupKind are cleanup-error/drain-timeout; SerializePluginType/ISerializePluginType are json. These labels neither emit instrumentation events nor introduce error codes.

createSerializeRegistry(plugins, options?) requires a nonempty plugin array. The first type becomes primaryType. Each type is an ASCII token of 1–64 characters, starting with a letter/digit and continuing with letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN is /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i. assertSerializeType rejects invalid tokens with RangeError/INVALID_OPTION. HTML and archive-envelope writers still need correct escaping; token validation is not output escaping.

Types must be unique. Each parser needs callable encode/decode, and dispose must be callable when supplied. Empty lists and duplicate types produce RangeError/INVALID_OPTION; malformed structures produce TypeError/INVALID_OPTION. Plugin lists, fields and methods are admitted before ownership transfers. Later input mutation cannot replace captured behavior. Failed admission invokes neither parser work nor parser cleanup and creates no partially owned parser set to roll back. Options default to an empty object and must be an object or function when supplied.

rows: systemScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler, fixed at creation. Requires callable now/schedule and finite now results.
Host TextEncoder. An injected capability must implement encode(string): Uint8Array; omission with no host implementation produces ENV_UNSUPPORTED.
Host TextDecoder. Injection requires decode(Uint8Array): string; omission without host support produces ENV_UNSUPPORTED. Captured and validated here, not automatically passed to JSON parsers.
{ policy: 'throw' }, or { policy: 'report', report } with a callable reporter.
No-op observer when a deadline is already past, or expires with work pending; pendingCount can be zero.
No-op observer for failures arriving after public settlement and secondary iterator cleanup failures.

blocks.text: Option getters, scheduler operations and Encoding capability boundaries retain original causes rather than leaking unclassified property-access failures. scheduler.schedule(callback, delayMs) returns a task with cancel() and optional unref(). Core timer use does not read global timer functions.

primaryType is the first format. types lists registered types in order; has(type) checks membership. encode(value, options?) and decode(chunk, options?) return Promises. Operation type defaults to primaryType, context to anonymous and signal to omission. The parser receives a composition of caller and internal closing signals: the first observed cancellation wins. Unknown formats produce CODEC_NOT_FOUND with context fixed to registry. ISerializeRegistry names the returned interface and ISerializeRegistryOptions the construction options.

Decode first checks closing, then finds the requested format, then validates the chunk. The corresponding failure priority is REGISTRY_DISPOSED, CODEC_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_CHUNK. Closed-registry failures are tagged native Errors rather than necessarily SerializeCodecError instances. Even if a parser ignores signal, the framework rejects on cancellation and discards late output; that does not forcibly terminate synchronous computation or an external task.

close() is synchronous and idempotent: it denies new operations and aborts current ones without disposing parsers. dispose(options?) closes first, drains, then awaits each parser disposer. Sharing one parser under several types still disposes that instance once. Repeated dispose calls return the first Promise by identity.

The sole disposal option deadlineAt defaults to undefined. A supplied value must be a finite absolute time in the scheduler.now clock domain. The first admitted call fixes it; later calls cannot replace it. The deadline bounds draining, not parser cleanup. If the deadline is already past or expires while waiting, onDrainTimeout can receive { kind: 'drain-timeout', source, deadlineAt, pendingCount } before cleanup continues. pendingCount can be zero. A drain timeout is a diagnostic event rather than a new error code. ISerializeTimeoutDiagnostic describes it; ISerializeCleanupError describes cleanup-failure events.

Signal state is rechecked immediately after listener registration without depending on host event replay. An already-closing internal signal takes precedence at entry. Cancellation causes retain identity, and failing signal reads produce INVALID_OPTION. Public Promises can reject promptly while registry still tracks the underlying parser task; close itself does not wait.

With cleanup.policy throw, cleanup failure rejects disposal. If another primary failure already exists, secondary failures stay in errors, using AggregateError when necessary to retain all originals. Report policy emits { kind: 'cleanup-error', source, error } while allowing normal settlement. Diagnostic callback failures cannot rewrite an already-published result; report failures reach the shared utils host-error path. Detached task failures remain observed without rejoining a closed lifecycle. Omitting report retains the existing no-op policy.

jsonParser(options?) returns a parser named json; jsonPlugin(options?) returns a plugin of type json. IJsonPluginOptions replacer, reviver and space default to omission and feed JSON.stringify, JSON.parse and indentation respectively. The optional byte decoder falls back to the host TextDecoder. Options default to an empty object. Native JSON semantics are distinct from strict portable codec validation.

Encode returns text and rejects when stringify returns undefined. Native encoding failures receive ENCODE_FAILED. Decode returns value payloads unchanged, parses text directly and decodes bytes before parsing. Missing decoding capability produces ENV_UNSUPPORTED; parse failures receive DECODE_FAILED. A standalone parser also provides error identity. Annotatable native errors retain instance, type and stack; conflicting or non-extensible errors are retained as the cause of a coded TypeError wrapper.

chunkToText(chunk, decoder) and chunkToBytes(chunk, encoder) require their Encoding argument. The former returns text unchanged or decodes bytes. The latter encodes text or returns a slice copy of bytes, without sharing the original array. Both reject value chunks with TypeError/INVALID_CHUNK. Conversion failures are tagged at the decode/encode boundary with their causes retained.

sliceByFrameBudget(items, options) is an async generator over a read-only array. Options and scheduler are required; core provides no default global timer. On resumption after yield, it observes the consumer’s slice-processing time, estimates a next size using targetMs / max(elapsed, 0.05), averages that estimate with the current size and clamps to minItems/maxItems. This is cooperative slicing rather than a frame-rate guarantee on every device. IFrameBudgetOptions names slicing options, IEncodeStreamOptions adds encoding settings, and ICollectStreamOptions names collection policy. A custom yieldTo owns its Promise and cancellation behavior; its wait is not guaranteed to abort promptly.

rows: 64; safe integer of at least one.
250000; safe integer no smaller than minItems.
2048; safe integer of at least one, clamped to the configured bounds.
scheduler.schedule(resolve, 0) when omitted; the default wait responds to signal cancellation.

blocks.text: encodeStream(registry, items, options) adds type (registry default format), context (stream) and maxInFlight (1, a positive safe integer) to those options. It calls registry.encode independently for each slice and yields in input order. maxInFlight bounds concurrent encoding requests. Adjacent JSON array slices are not one complete JSON document: decode frames separately and combine arrays in the application when that is the intended result.

decodeStream(registry, chunks, options?) accepts a synchronous or asynchronous chunk iterable. Options default to an empty object, type to the registry format, context to stream and signal to omission. It decodes and yields each frame without assembling the complete result. Stream encoding/decoding failures wrap ENCODE_FAILED/DECODE_FAILED with the outer frame index, bytesConsumed zero and the inner error on cause. That position differs from the parser’s internal chunk index.

Stream entry points capture options before acquiring an iterator, so admission failures are not mislabeled as iteration failures. Cancellation is rechecked across async boundaries. Early source/generator completion closes its owned iterator; secondary return failures are reported without replacing the primary failure. An early encodeStream break cancels operations it created and observes outstanding tasks without waiting forever for uncooperative parser code. Registry disposal still owns parser draining.

collectStream(chunks, encoder?, options?) is for consumers that actually need one complete result; it retains the whole output. Signal defaults to omission, empty defaults to text (returning ['text', ''] for an empty stream), the other empty policy is reject, and context defaults to stream. All-text data joins as text. A single byte chunk can return directly; multiple chunks with any bytes require an explicit encoder, even when all are bytes. Without it, ENV_UNSUPPORTED is raised; core does not read a global TextEncoder. Value chunks always produce INVALID_CHUNK. Malformed tuples retain chunkIndex and accumulated bytesConsumed, source iteration failures become ENCODE_FAILED, and abort preserves cancellation identity with iterator cleanup handled at its boundary.

bytesToBase64(Uint8Array) returns complete RFC 4648 Base64. base64ToBytes(string) requires canonical padding and valid unused trailing bits. Invalid input produces TypeError/INVALID_OPTION whose cause retains the original utils INVALID_ENCODING failure. This differs from unpadded base64url used by portable tags.

streamBase64Chunks(bytes) is a lazy synchronous Generator, yielding pieces without assembling one full string. Empty input yields none. Its internal block length is 32763 bytes, divisible by three so padding cannot corrupt an intermediate boundary; block size is not an option. Algorithms come from utils/bytes without constructing a whole binary string or using btoa/atob. Use bytesToBase64 when the destination requires one string, and keep bytes as bytes when the destination supports them. The 4/3 size expansion is a format property, not a performance measurement.

`ICodec<TValue, TEncoded, TId, TVersion>` has read-only id, version, encodedType, encode and decode. Encode/decode are function properties preserving strict parameter variance. TId defaults to string and TVersion to number. encodedType is unknown/string/uint8array. A synchronous codec is a different contract from an asynchronous registry parser. identityCodec fixes id=identity, version=1 and encodedType=unknown; both functions preserve the exact value and concrete type. The old alias and unversioned identity entry are removed.

defineJsonCodec, defineMessagePackCodec and defineCBORCodec require a positive safe-integer options.version and return frozen codecs. IDs are json, message-pack and cbor; outputs are string, Uint8Array and Uint8Array respectively. All three use the same portable projection/validation. JSON, collections JSON, CBOR and MessagePack project fields in Object.keys enumeration order without comparison sorting; getters run once in that order. MessagePack uses no extensions. CBOR disables records and host extensions, converting decoded bigint integers to numbers only when they are exact safe integers; otherwise it rejects.

defineProtobufCodec requires version, schema and binding. schema.id matches /^[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$/u and schema.version is a positive safe integer independent of codec.version. Binding must be a generated Buf DescMessage rather than custom encode/decode hooks. The returned schema identity is frozen, values use `MessageShape<TBinding>`, and encodedType is uint8array. Encode/decode validate genuine Uint8Array data and preserve original Buf failure causes. Factories provide no storage or network envelope.

ICodecValue’s static domain contains null, boolean, number, string, nested read-only arrays and records; finite numbers still require runtime checks. normalizeCodecFailure(error, code, message) preserves errors already owned by serialize and wraps other failures in TypeError with cause. CodecErrorText owns stable version, schema, encoding, decoding and portable-rejection diagnostics.

sections.heading: Portable defaults and the reusable walker

blocks.text: toPortableValue(value, active?) is the legacy intermediate projection rather than a final assertion. It reads sorted string keys and recursively produces mutable ordinary objects without freezing. Uint8Array becomes { $rpc: 'bytes', base64url }. Inherited, nonenumerable and symbol record fields are omitted. Getters may run. Repeated sibling references are copied independently, while cycles are checked on the active ancestor path. Projection can temporarily retain undefined/NaN; codecs reject them during final portable validation.

assertPortableValue(value, active?) returns void. asCodecValue(value) validates and returns the same object narrowed to ICodecValue. Neither copies nor freezes. The default decoded profile rejects nonfinite numbers, undefined, functions, symbols, bigint, Date/Map/Set, invalid arrays and native bytes. Recognized byte tags retain the existing character-set checks rather than a different protocol’s stricter canonical-bit policy. Default depth is unlimited. Legacy projections of ArrayBuffer/class objects are not general-purpose safe snapshots.

Import createPortableWalker from root or codec, create it once per module/owner and reuse it. walk(value, active?, initialDepth?, beforeNativeBinary?) returns { value, byteUpperBound, hasBinary }; walk.value uses the same recursion but returns only the value. Active is the caller’s ancestor Set, otherwise created as needed for the call, with no retained graph afterward. Initial depth defaults to zero; the root is depth zero and only depth greater than maxDepth fails. The optional native-binary guard belongs to that invocation rather than global registration.
