blocks.text: Context supplies reject, isAncestor, isUint8Array, bytesToBase64url, isCanonicalBase64url and optional beforeNativeBinary. Generic reasons include depth/cycle/access/ancestor; strategies own other reasons. Context is for synchronous hook use. Classified errors retain identity; application callback failures go through violation('access', original), and caller ancestor-Set failures retain their existing boundary.

byteUpperBound is a conservative JSON UTF-8 bound rather than an exact length: up to six escape bytes per UTF-16 unit, up to 32 per number, plus container punctuation and byte tags. Value, bound and hasBinary are fused in one traversal without rescanning the input. Strategies supply native lengths; this value is not a complete shared-backing/offset protocol budget.

IPortableBinaryResult is the unboxed union string/Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer. Borrowed native objects retain exact identity without copying/freezing. The second finish argument proves only native descendants; hasBinary also includes inline tags and grants no protocol permission. Reentrant getters restore outer accounting and active paths. Completed calls retain no caller graph, and the value-only array path does not add output-length observations.

Default JSON/MessagePack/CBOR remain inline-only with existing wire bytes and failure precedence: projection finishes before deferred validation fails, so a later getter failure can still take precedence. RPC’s null prototypes, freezing, parent-field capture, depth 64, canonical tags and protocol identities belong to rpc-contract strategies. Serialize embeds no consumer profile, manifest or native-negotiation owner.

emitOutput(value, format?) synchronously returns complete text. Format defaults to json, with yaml/toml alternatives. JSON reuses jsonParser. YAML/TOML are output-only without third-party runtimes, and are not registry parsers.

Inputs contain finite numbers, strings, booleans, arrays and plain own-data records. JSON/YAML accept null. Descriptor admission rejects enumerable accessors without evaluating them, along with cycles, sparse arrays, named array properties, enumerable symbols, unsupported values and nonplain prototypes. No toJSON, replacer or business getter is invoked. Failure returns no partial string and diagnostics do not echo input.

TOML requires a record root and rejects null at every depth as well as unpaired surrogates. Keys/strings are quoted and nested collections retain their shapes. Negative zero becomes -0.0; unsafe integers use floating-point spelling instead of the TOML integer domain. Failures are tagged native TypeError/INVALID_OPTION with read failures retained as causes. These strict own-data rules differ from legacy portable projection.

SerializeCodecError(message, details) requires code, type, phase, chunkIndex and bytesConsumed, with optional context, source and cause. Source defaults to @migaia/serialize and TCode to ISerializeErrorCode; consumers can reuse the class with their own code union/source. Phase is encode/decode and cause retains the original object. Codec failures and native construction/lifecycle failures use different carriers, so branch on (source, code) rather than instanceof alone.

rows: REGISTRY_DISPOSED: new work after close/dispose, tagged Error.
CODEC_NOT_FOUND: unregistered format, SerializeCodecError with context=registry.
ENCODE_FAILED: encoding, empty output or stream iteration failure, retaining cause.
DECODE_FAILED: parsing or frame decoding fails.
INVALID_CHUNK: invalid tuple/label/data, mixed value output or value-to-wire conversion.
ABORTED: cooperative cancellation; SerializeCodecError or tagged native error depending on the boundary.
INVALID_OPTION: invalid plugin, version, portable input, scheduler, stream option, Base64 or output admission.
ENV_UNSUPPORTED: required host capabilities such as Encoding are unavailable.
TAG_MISSING: raw input has no explicit untagged reader.
TAG_INVALID: reserved header is malformed; no fallback.
TAG_UNKNOWN: valid tag has no registered codec revision.

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) returns the original error with read-only source/code. Omitted context stays absent. Repeating the same identity is idempotent, with context filled only once. Identity conflicts delegate to utils and throw (@migaia/utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT), retaining the original error on cause instead of silently overwriting ownership.

ISerializeTaggedError adds source/code/context to a native error type. ISerializeTypeError and ISerializeRangeError retain their native types; ISerializeLifecycleError also permits errors. createSerializeError, createSerializeTypeError and createSerializeRangeError create coded native Error/TypeError/RangeError. Code/message are required. Options default to omission and permit cause/context; the ordinary Error also permits a frozen errors snapshot. Codes are public API, and error factories never rewrite stack. Empty output reports zero progress. Malformed decode chunks report zero progress, while parser decode failures report that chunk’s byte count. Stream wrappers use outer frame positions without losing inner causes.

For value-to-wire or mixed-value failures, return to the business value rather than forcing a representation. For CODEC_NOT_FOUND inspect types and the saved type tag. REGISTRY_DISPOSED requires a new registry. Multi-chunk byte collection requires an explicit encoder. If exports still block, inspect initial slice size, bounds and yieldTo; slicing is not preemptive termination.

A complete workflow creates the registry, encodes independent frames into the real sink, decodes them individually at the receiver, reads old formats using saved type tags and writes the default primaryType. Apply UTF-8/Base64 only at an actual text boundary, then await dispose. A configured deadline limits draining only. module scripts provide fmt, lint, typecheck, typecheck:test, test and a separate build; unverified historical measurements are not performance claims.

sections.heading: Preserve Map and Set in JSON

blocks.text: Use the collection codec explicitly when values contain Map or Set. It shares the strict portable profile with JSON, adds recursive collections, projects enumerable class fields, and rejects nonfinite numbers, undefined, Date and cycles. Reserved $rpc records must have the exact bytes/map/set shape. Collection iteration preserves insertion order and uses intrinsic slots and iterators. Bytes remain bytes records after decoding; old collection tuples are ordinary data.

Format codecs keep integer-index enumeration followed by string insertion order, including getter traversal. Public toPortableValue still supplies a sorted intermediate projection. RPC owned snapshots and ordinary object and byte JSON paths preserve each object's own key order. The existing private RPC snapshot owner still copies and computes the byte upper bound in one traversal, skipping already encoded binary subtrees.

sections.heading: Carry a format tag in the encoded value

blocks.text: The first codec writes new values; every listed id/version can read its own tagged payload. An optional untagged codec only reads raw legacy values. Unknown tags fail with TAG_UNKNOWN; malformed reserved headers fail with TAG_INVALID and never fall back. A raw text value starting with mgt1: is interpreted as tagged input, even when it was produced by the untagged codec.

String carriers prepend mgt1:<id>@<version>;. Byte carriers prepend 00 4d 47 54, framing byte 01, a two-byte big-endian UTF-8 tag length and the tag. Unknown carriers return a frozen object with own $migaia.codec and value fields; the inner value stays unfrozen. All codecs must declare the same carrier. The framing identity is tagged@1; it is separate from storage envelope versions. ICodecEncodedType, ITaggedCodecOptions, ITaggedEncoded, ITaggedValue and ITaggedCodec preserve carrier and business-value inference.

sections.heading: Encode settings and read them back

blocks.text: A settings screen needs a text representation for saving and the same decoding path when it opens again.
Scattering stringify and parse calls across callers couples them to one format and leaves format selection and parser cleanup without a single owner.

Register `jsonPlugin()` in a serialize registry. Its first plugin chooses default writes; `encode()` returns a tagged chunk and `decode()` reads it. Use `chunkToText()` when a text channel needs the payload, then dispose the registry.

The required plugin list contains only jsonPlugin(), making primaryType json. Omitted registry options use systemScheduler, host Encoding capabilities, cleanup policy throw and no-op diagnostic callbacks. Operation type defaults to the primary format, context to anonymous and signal to omission. chunkToText requires its second TextDecoder argument. theme is application data rather than a serializer option.
Output:
Prints `format: json`, `text: {"theme":"dark"}`, then `theme: dark`.

The same registered parser handles encoding and decoding. A chunk is only `[kind, payload]`, not a stored envelope containing the format tag; keep `primaryType` beside persisted data when several formats coexist. The registry owns parser cleanup and must be disposed.

sections.heading: Write a new format while retaining an explicit old reader

blocks.text: New settings should omit a local preview cache, but existing saved settings still use the old format tag and must remain readable.
Replacing the only parser can strand old records. Guessing a format from `[kind, payload]` also fails because the chunk does not carry the application’s format tag.

Register the new parser first and keep the old parser under its saved tag. New writes use the first type by default; pass the stored `type` explicitly to `decode()` for old data. Both formats use JSON: the new writer omits `localCache`, while the old reader revives a stored numeric theme of 0 as `light`.

Each plugin contains type and parser. The first type, json-v2, handles default writes; json-v1 is selected explicitly by decode’s type. The new parser replacer receives key/value and returns undefined for localCache. The old reviver maps numeric theme 0 back to light, proving that its reader was selected. Space/decoder are omitted. saved.type is separate application metadata; the chunk’s text label describes representation, not format version.
Output:

blocks.code:
new format: json-v2
new text: {"theme":"dark"}
old theme: light
old cache: legacy

blocks.text: Prints `new format: json-v2`, `new text: {"theme":"dark"}`, `old theme: light`, then `old cache: legacy`.

The default writer changed without removing the old reader. Passing the saved old tag selects its reviver, which changes the stored 0 into `light`; using the new reader would leave 0 unchanged. Registered type strings are application envelope metadata; codec factory `version` fields are a separate contract. The JSON plugin follows native replacer/reviver behavior rather than the stricter portable codec profile.

sections.heading: Reject a nonfinite count instead of saving null

blocks.text: A measurement containing `NaN` is saved as `null`, and a later reader cannot distinguish invalid input from an intentionally empty value.
Native JSON replaces nonfinite numbers with null. Checking only the TypeScript number type does not reject `NaN`, so the original value can be lost without a failure.

Create `defineJsonCodec({ version: 1 })` and encode through its portable profile, a restricted cross-format data domain. Finite numbers pass; nonfinite numbers fail with `INVALID_OPTION` instead of being silently replaced.

The required options.version is 1 here and accepts positive safe integers. The codec returns id=json and encodedType=string. A TypeScript number can still be NaN, which the portable runtime rule rejects. Factory version metadata is not automatically embedded in the encoded string.
Output:
Prints `finite: {"count":2}`, `native JSON: {"count":null}`, then `portable failure: INVALID_OPTION`.

The codec rejects this lossy scalar conversion. Its required version is a positive safe integer and is metadata on the codec, not automatically embedded in the returned string. This strict profile differs from `jsonPlugin()`, which intentionally retains native JSON behavior.

sections.heading: Export the same configuration in three text formats

blocks.text: A configuration download needs JSON, YAML and TOML, but separate emitters accept different values and produce inconsistent representations of the same settings.
Handwritten formatting mixes value validation with quoting and nested collection syntax. Adding a format can accidentally change which fields survive or how strings are escaped.

Pass the configuration to `emitOutput()` and select `SerializeTextFormat`. All formats share the same plain-data admission rules; each call projects the input before emitting its selected format. Omitting the format selects JSON.

emitOutput takes plain own-data input and an optional format defaulting to json. SerializeTextFormat.yaml/toml select the other outputs; the complete format domain is json/yaml/toml. theme and retries are business fields. YAML/TOML emission supplies no reverse parser.

blocks.code:
import { emitOutput, SerializeTextFormat } from '@migaia/serialize'

const settings = { theme: 'dark', retries: 2 }
console.log('JSON:', emitOutput(settings))
console.log('YAML:', emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.yaml))
console.log('TOML:\n' + emitOutput(settings, SerializeTextFormat.toml))

blocks.text: Output:
Prints `JSON: {"theme":"dark","retries":2}`, `YAML: {"theme": "dark", "retries": 2}`, then three lines: `TOML:`, `"theme" = "dark"`, `"retries" = 2`.

All three outputs retain the supplied fields, and YAML uses valid flow syntax. This is text emission, not a YAML/TOML parser. TOML requires a root record and rejects null; other formats also reject unsupported values rather than silently omitting them.

sections.heading: Reject an accessor without evaluating it

blocks.text: A configuration object contains a getter that exposes data or performs work when serialization reads the property.
Ordinary property access during copying or stringify executes that getter. Deleting the field only after it has been read cannot undo the work or the exposure.

Use `emitOutput()` for a plain-data export boundary. It inspects own enumerable property descriptors first and rejects accessors before evaluating their getter; valid data is projected before text is produced.

No extra options are used; omitted format still selects json. token is an accessor business field rejected during descriptor admission. The reads counter proves its getter was never called. Proxy descriptor traps may still execute, so this is not a promise that no user code can run.
Output:

blocks.code:
rejected: true INVALID_OPTION
getter reads: 0

blocks.text: Prints `rejected: true INVALID_OPTION`, then `getter reads: 0`.

This accessor is rejected without executing its getter, and no partial string is returned. The boundary accepts plain records or dense arrays containing supported scalar/data values; it is not a general object serializer and does not promise to avoid Proxy traps while inspecting descriptors.

sections.heading: Process independent array slices without joining JSON documents

blocks.text: A large export is encoded into one full array string before its first piece can be processed, retaining the complete encoded document in memory.

Splitting an array is not enough if the caller later concatenates the JSON strings: `[1,2]` followed by `[3,4]` is two documents, not one JSON array. The stream needs a receiver that understands each slice as its own frame.

This standalone example directly imports the scheduler, so install `@migaia/utils` alongside `@migaia/serialize`. Use `encodeStream()` with the registry and a scheduler, then consume each emitted chunk separately. Fixed slice bounds make this example produce two items per slice; `maxInFlight: 1` waits for each encoded slice before admitting the next.

encodeStream requires registry, items and options.scheduler. systemScheduler provides now/schedule. minItems, maxItems and initialItems are all 2, with maxInFlight 1. Omitted targetMs is 8, type uses the primary format, context is stream, signal is absent and yieldTo uses a zero-delay scheduled task. A final slice shorter than two items is valid; finally disposes the registry.
This example imports @migaia/utils/scheduler directly. Add that dependency explicitly to the consuming project:

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/utils

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
frame: [1,2]
frame: [3,4]
frame: [5]

blocks.text: Prints `frame: [1,2]`, `frame: [3,4]`, then `frame: [5]`.

Each chunk contains one independently encoded slice in input order. Consume them as frames; this API does not assemble a single document or serialize each item as one continuous JSON array. The default `maxInFlight` is 1; higher values overlap requests but retain more in-flight data, and an early consumer return cancels queued operations without forcibly interrupting parser code.

This module owns value representations, chunks, formats and codec lifecycles. Storage, Worker, HTTP and SSR hosts belong to consumers. The root combines core, plugins and registry, and adds format constants, emitOutput, createPortableWalker and codec-related types.

blocks.text: Core statically reuses @migaia/lifecycle/abort as its cancellation owner. ISerializeChunk is a read-only pair: text carries a string, bytes carries Uint8Array, and value carries an already-completed unknown business value. Text and bytes have wire representations; value has no implicit text or byte form. ISerializeChunkKind is the union of those three labels.

ISerializeParser requires name, encode(value, context) and decode(chunk, context), with optional dispose(). Encode can return a chunk, a Promise of one chunk, a synchronous Iterable or an AsyncIterable. Decode returns a value or Promise. ISerializeOutput names that four-way encoding-output union. A synchronous parser can return directly without creating its own Promise. ISerializeContext contains the composed signal and diagnostic context string. The field is context rather than the old source name, keeping it distinct from error ownership. ISerializePlugin pairs type with parser.

registry.encode collects one parser output into one chunk. All-text chunks join as text. Once bytes appear, text is encoded and the output is assembled as bytes. A value chunk must be the only output: combining it with anything produces INVALID_CHUNK. Zero chunks produce ENCODE_FAILED. Incremental admission records actual chunkIndex and bytesConsumed and checks cancellation before consumption. Failed async iteration invokes iterator.return; secondary cleanup failures go to report without replacing the primary failure.

isChunkShape distinguishes a single chunk from a chunk container: it requires an array of length two whose first item is a string. It does not validate the label. Later validation distinguishes unknown labels, non-string text data and non-Uint8Array bytes. Boundary tuple fields are captured facts rather than values to reinterpret through repeated later reads.

Root constants and value unions use canonical domains: SerializeChunkKind/ISerializeChunkKind are text/bytes/value; SerializeOutput/ISerializeOutputFormat are text/structured/binary; SerializeTextFormat/ISerializeTextFormat are json/yaml/toml; SerializePhase/ISerializePhase are encode/decode; SerializeCleanupPolicy/ISerializeCleanupPolicy are throw/report; SerializeCleanupKind/ISerializeCleanupKind are cleanup-error/drain-timeout; SerializePluginType/ISerializePluginType are json. These labels neither emit instrumentation events nor introduce error codes.

createSerializeRegistry(plugins, options?) requires a nonempty plugin array. The first type becomes primaryType. Each type is an ASCII token of 1–64 characters, starting with a letter/digit and continuing with letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. SERIALIZE_TYPE_PATTERN is /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/i. assertSerializeType rejects invalid tokens with RangeError/INVALID_OPTION. HTML and archive-envelope writers still need correct escaping; token validation is not output escaping.

Types must be unique. Each parser needs callable encode/decode, and dispose must be callable when supplied. Empty lists and duplicate types produce RangeError/INVALID_OPTION; malformed structures produce TypeError/INVALID_OPTION. Plugin lists, fields and methods are admitted before ownership transfers. Later input mutation cannot replace captured behavior. Failed admission invokes neither parser work nor parser cleanup and creates no partially owned parser set to roll back. Options default to an empty object and must be an object or function when supplied.

rows: systemScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler, fixed at creation. Requires callable now/schedule and finite now results.
Host TextEncoder. An injected capability must implement encode(string): Uint8Array; omission with no host implementation produces ENV_UNSUPPORTED.
Host TextDecoder. Injection requires decode(Uint8Array): string; omission without host support produces ENV_UNSUPPORTED. Captured and validated here, not automatically passed to JSON parsers.
{ policy: 'throw' }, or { policy: 'report', report } with a callable reporter.
No-op observer when a deadline is already past, or expires with work pending; pendingCount can be zero.
No-op observer for failures arriving after public settlement and secondary iterator cleanup failures.

blocks.text: Option getters, scheduler operations and Encoding capability boundaries retain original causes rather than leaking unclassified property-access failures. scheduler.schedule(callback, delayMs) returns a task with cancel() and optional unref(). Core timer use does not read global timer functions.

primaryType is the first format. types lists registered types in order; has(type) checks membership. encode(value, options?) and decode(chunk, options?) return Promises. Operation type defaults to primaryType, context to anonymous and signal to omission. The parser receives a composition of caller and internal closing signals: the first observed cancellation wins. Unknown formats produce CODEC_NOT_FOUND with context fixed to registry. ISerializeRegistry names the returned interface and ISerializeRegistryOptions the construction options.

Decode first checks closing, then finds the requested format, then validates the chunk. The corresponding failure priority is REGISTRY_DISPOSED, CODEC_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_CHUNK. Closed-registry failures are tagged native Errors rather than necessarily SerializeCodecError instances. Even if a parser ignores signal, the framework rejects on cancellation and discards late output; that does not forcibly terminate synchronous computation or an external task.

close() is synchronous and idempotent: it denies new operations and aborts current ones without disposing parsers. dispose(options?) closes first, drains, then awaits each parser disposer. Sharing one parser under several types still disposes that instance once. Repeated dispose calls return the first Promise by identity.

The sole disposal option deadlineAt defaults to undefined. A supplied value must be a finite absolute time in the scheduler.now clock domain. The first admitted call fixes it; later calls cannot replace it. The deadline bounds draining, not parser cleanup. If the deadline is already past or expires while waiting, onDrainTimeout can receive { kind: 'drain-timeout', source, deadlineAt, pendingCount } before cleanup continues. pendingCount can be zero. A drain timeout is a diagnostic event rather than a new error code. ISerializeTimeoutDiagnostic describes it; ISerializeCleanupError describes cleanup-failure events.

Signal state is rechecked immediately after listener registration without depending on host event replay. An already-closing internal signal takes precedence at entry. Cancellation causes retain identity, and failing signal reads produce INVALID_OPTION. Public Promises can reject promptly while registry still tracks the underlying parser task; close itself does not wait.

With cleanup.policy throw, cleanup failure rejects disposal. If another primary failure already exists, secondary failures stay in errors, using AggregateError when necessary to retain all originals. Report policy emits { kind: 'cleanup-error', source, error } while allowing normal settlement. Diagnostic callback failures cannot rewrite an already-published result; report failures reach the shared utils host-error path. Detached task failures remain observed without rejoining a closed lifecycle. Omitting report retains the existing no-op policy.

jsonParser(options?) returns a parser named json; jsonPlugin(options?) returns a plugin of type json. IJsonPluginOptions replacer, reviver and space default to omission and feed JSON.stringify, JSON.parse and indentation respectively. The optional byte decoder falls back to the host TextDecoder. Options default to an empty object. Native JSON semantics are distinct from strict portable codec validation.

Encode returns text and rejects when stringify returns undefined. Native encoding failures receive ENCODE_FAILED. Decode returns value payloads unchanged, parses text directly and decodes bytes before parsing. Missing decoding capability produces ENV_UNSUPPORTED; parse failures receive DECODE_FAILED. A standalone parser also provides error identity. Annotatable native errors retain instance, type and stack; conflicting or non-extensible errors are retained as the cause of a coded TypeError wrapper.

chunkToText(chunk, decoder) and chunkToBytes(chunk, encoder) require their Encoding argument. The former returns text unchanged or decodes bytes. The latter encodes text or returns a slice copy of bytes, without sharing the original array. Both reject value chunks with TypeError/INVALID_CHUNK. Conversion failures are tagged at the decode/encode boundary with their causes retained.

sliceByFrameBudget(items, options) is an async generator over a read-only array. Options and scheduler are required; core provides no default global timer. On resumption after yield, it observes the consumer’s slice-processing time, estimates a next size using targetMs / max(elapsed, 0.05), averages that estimate with the current size and clamps to minItems/maxItems. This is cooperative slicing rather than a frame-rate guarantee on every device. IFrameBudgetOptions names slicing options, IEncodeStreamOptions adds encoding settings, and ICollectStreamOptions names collection policy. A custom yieldTo owns its Promise and cancellation behavior; its wait is not guaranteed to abort promptly.

rows: 64; safe integer of at least one.
250000; safe integer no smaller than minItems.
2048; safe integer of at least one, clamped to the configured bounds.
scheduler.schedule(resolve, 0) when omitted; the default wait responds to signal cancellation.
Omitted; checked before proceeding to the next slice.
Required: finite now results and scheduled tasks with cancel().

blocks.text: encodeStream(registry, items, options) adds type (registry default format), context (stream) and maxInFlight (1, a positive safe integer) to those options. It calls registry.encode independently for each slice and yields in input order. maxInFlight bounds concurrent encoding requests. Adjacent JSON array slices are not one complete JSON document: decode frames separately and combine arrays in the application when that is the intended result.

decodeStream(registry, chunks, options?) accepts a synchronous or asynchronous chunk iterable. Options default to an empty object, type to the registry format, context to stream and signal to omission. It decodes and yields each frame without assembling the complete result. Stream encoding/decoding failures wrap ENCODE_FAILED/DECODE_FAILED with the outer frame index, bytesConsumed zero and the inner error on cause. That position differs from the parser’s internal chunk index.

Stream entry points capture options before acquiring an iterator, so admission failures are not mislabeled as iteration failures. Cancellation is rechecked across async boundaries. Early source/generator completion closes its owned iterator; secondary return failures are reported without replacing the primary failure. An early encodeStream break cancels operations it created and observes outstanding tasks without waiting forever for uncooperative parser code. Registry disposal still owns parser draining.

collectStream(chunks, encoder?, options?) is for consumers that actually need one complete result; it retains the whole output. Signal defaults to omission, empty defaults to text (returning ['text', ''] for an empty stream), the other empty policy is reject, and context defaults to stream. All-text data joins as text. A single byte chunk can return directly; multiple chunks with any bytes require an explicit encoder, even when all are bytes. Without it, ENV_UNSUPPORTED is raised; core does not read a global TextEncoder. Value chunks always produce INVALID_CHUNK. Malformed tuples retain chunkIndex and accumulated bytesConsumed, source iteration failures become ENCODE_FAILED, and abort preserves cancellation identity with iterator cleanup handled at its boundary.

bytesToBase64(Uint8Array) returns complete RFC 4648 Base64. base64ToBytes(string) requires canonical padding and valid unused trailing bits. Invalid input produces TypeError/INVALID_OPTION whose cause retains the original utils INVALID_ENCODING failure. This differs from unpadded base64url used by portable tags.

streamBase64Chunks(bytes) is a lazy synchronous Generator, yielding pieces without assembling one full string. Empty input yields none. Its internal block length is 32763 bytes, divisible by three so padding cannot corrupt an intermediate boundary; block size is not an option. Algorithms come from utils/bytes without constructing a whole binary string or using btoa/atob. Use bytesToBase64 when the destination requires one string, and keep bytes as bytes when the destination supports them. The 4/3 size expansion is a format property, not a performance measurement.

`ICodec<TValue, TEncoded, TId, TVersion>` has read-only id, version, encodedType, encode and decode. Encode/decode are function properties preserving strict parameter variance. TId defaults to string and TVersion to number. encodedType is unknown/string/uint8array. A synchronous codec is a different contract from an asynchronous registry parser. identityCodec fixes id=identity, version=1 and encodedType=unknown; both functions preserve the exact value and concrete type. The old alias and unversioned identity entry are removed.

defineJsonCodec, defineMessagePackCodec and defineCBORCodec require a positive safe-integer options.version and return frozen codecs. IDs are json, message-pack and cbor; outputs are string, Uint8Array and Uint8Array respectively. All three use the same portable projection/validation. JSON, collections JSON, CBOR and MessagePack project fields in Object.keys enumeration order without comparison sorting; getters run once in that order. MessagePack uses no extensions. CBOR disables records and host extensions, converting decoded bigint integers to numbers only when they are exact safe integers; otherwise it rejects.

defineProtobufCodec requires version, schema and binding. schema.id matches /^[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$/u and schema.version is a positive safe integer independent of codec.version. Binding must be a generated Buf DescMessage rather than custom encode/decode hooks. The returned schema identity is frozen, values use `MessageShape<TBinding>`, and encodedType is uint8array. Encode/decode validate genuine Uint8Array data and preserve original Buf failure causes. Factories provide no storage or network envelope.

ICodecValue’s static domain contains null, boolean, number, string, nested read-only arrays and records; finite numbers still require runtime checks. normalizeCodecFailure(error, code, message) preserves errors already owned by serialize and wraps other failures in TypeError with cause. CodecErrorText owns stable version, schema, encoding, decoding and portable-rejection diagnostics.

sections.heading: Portable defaults and the reusable walker

blocks.text: toPortableValue(value, active?) is the legacy intermediate projection rather than a final assertion. It reads sorted string keys and recursively produces mutable ordinary objects without freezing. Uint8Array becomes { $rpc: 'bytes', base64url }. Inherited, nonenumerable and symbol record fields are omitted. Getters may run. Repeated sibling references are copied independently, while cycles are checked on the active ancestor path. Projection can temporarily retain undefined/NaN; codecs reject them during final portable validation.

assertPortableValue(value, active?) returns void. asCodecValue(value) validates and returns the same object narrowed to ICodecValue. Neither copies nor freezes. The default decoded profile rejects nonfinite numbers, undefined, functions, symbols, bigint, Date/Map/Set, invalid arrays and native bytes. Recognized byte tags retain the existing character-set checks rather than a different protocol’s stricter canonical-bit policy. Default depth is unlimited. Legacy projections of ArrayBuffer/class objects are not general-purpose safe snapshots.

Import createPortableWalker from root or codec, create it once per module/owner and reuse it. walk(value, active?, initialDepth?, beforeNativeBinary?) returns { value, byteUpperBound, hasBinary }; walk.value uses the same recursion but returns only the value. Active is the caller’s ancestor Set, otherwise created as needed for the call, with no retained graph afterward. Initial depth defaults to zero; the root is depth zero and only depth greater than maxDepth fails. The optional native-binary guard belongs to that invocation rather than global registration.

rows: Required. Returns a primitive or { value, violation? }, preserving deferred-failure precedence.
Required. Returns inline base64url text, borrowed Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer, or undefined for container admission.
Required for native results; reads intrinsic lengths rather than caller-shadowed properties.
Required. Returns { entries, output?, tag?, hasBinary?, validate? } or undefined. Entries may be captured or lazy; omitting output validates in place.
Optional. Returns the array or { value, length?, violation? }; defaults to map, with captured length avoiding another read.
arrayValue(value, ownedVisit, childDepth, ancestors, guard, bounds, context)
Mutually exclusive with array. Returns the raw projection through the provided traversal’s lexical ownership, without implementing another recursion.
Unlimited by default; the strategy chooses its budget.
Optional reserved-field check before visiting a child.
Optional. Default defineProperty keeps own `__proto__` data from changing the output prototype.
Optional container finalization such as freezing; native leaves are neither copied nor frozen and do not call finish.
Required. Throws a caller-owned coded native error retaining the original cause and stack.

blocks.text: Context supplies reject, isAncestor, isUint8Array, bytesToBase64url, isCanonicalBase64url and optional beforeNativeBinary. Generic reasons include depth/cycle/access/ancestor; strategies own other reasons. Context is for synchronous hook use. Classified errors retain identity; application callback failures go through violation('access', original), and caller ancestor-Set failures retain their existing boundary.

byteUpperBound is a conservative JSON UTF-8 bound rather than an exact length: up to six escape bytes per UTF-16 unit, up to 32 per number, plus container punctuation and byte tags. Value, bound and hasBinary are fused in one traversal without rescanning the input. Strategies supply native lengths; this value is not a complete shared-backing/offset protocol budget.

IPortableBinaryResult is the unboxed union string/Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer. Borrowed native objects retain exact identity without copying/freezing. The second finish argument proves only native descendants; hasBinary also includes inline tags and grants no protocol permission. Reentrant getters restore outer accounting and active paths. Completed calls retain no caller graph, and the value-only array path does not add output-length observations.

Default JSON/MessagePack/CBOR remain inline-only with existing wire bytes and failure precedence: projection finishes before deferred validation fails, so a later getter failure can still take precedence. RPC’s null prototypes, freezing, parent-field capture, depth 64, canonical tags and protocol identities belong to rpc-contract strategies. Serialize embeds no consumer profile, manifest or native-negotiation owner.

emitOutput(value, format?) synchronously returns complete text. Format defaults to json, with yaml/toml alternatives. JSON reuses jsonParser. YAML/TOML are output-only without third-party runtimes, and are not registry parsers.

Inputs contain finite numbers, strings, booleans, arrays and plain own-data records. JSON/YAML accept null. Descriptor admission rejects enumerable accessors without evaluating them, along with cycles, sparse arrays, named array properties, enumerable symbols, unsupported values and nonplain prototypes. No toJSON, replacer or business getter is invoked. Failure returns no partial string and diagnostics do not echo input.

TOML requires a record root and rejects null at every depth as well as unpaired surrogates. Keys/strings are quoted and nested collections retain their shapes. Negative zero becomes -0.0; unsafe integers use floating-point spelling instead of the TOML integer domain. Failures are tagged native TypeError/INVALID_OPTION with read failures retained as causes. These strict own-data rules differ from legacy portable projection.

SerializeCodecError(message, details) requires code, type, phase, chunkIndex and bytesConsumed, with optional context, source and cause. Source defaults to @migaia/serialize and TCode to ISerializeErrorCode; consumers can reuse the class with their own code union/source. Phase is encode/decode and cause retains the original object. Codec failures and native construction/lifecycle failures use different carriers, so branch on (source, code) rather than instanceof alone.

rows: REGISTRY_DISPOSED: new work after close/dispose, tagged Error.
CODEC_NOT_FOUND: unregistered format, SerializeCodecError with context=registry.
ENCODE_FAILED: encoding, empty output or stream iteration failure, retaining cause.
DECODE_FAILED: parsing or frame decoding fails.
INVALID_CHUNK: invalid tuple/label/data, mixed value output or value-to-wire conversion.
ABORTED: cooperative cancellation; SerializeCodecError or tagged native error depending on the boundary.
INVALID_OPTION: invalid plugin, version, portable input, scheduler, stream option, Base64 or output admission.
ENV_UNSUPPORTED: required host capabilities such as Encoding are unavailable.
TAG_MISSING: raw input has no explicit untagged reader.
TAG_INVALID: reserved header is malformed; no fallback.
TAG_UNKNOWN: valid tag has no registered codec revision.

blocks.text: tagSerializeError(error, code, context?) returns the original error with read-only source/code. Omitted context stays absent. Repeating the same identity is idempotent, with context filled only once. Identity conflicts delegate to utils and throw (@migaia/utils, ERROR_IDENTITY_CONFLICT), retaining the original error on cause instead of silently overwriting ownership.

ISerializeTaggedError adds source/code/context to a native error type. ISerializeTypeError and ISerializeRangeError retain their native types; ISerializeLifecycleError also permits errors. createSerializeError, createSerializeTypeError and createSerializeRangeError create coded native Error/TypeError/RangeError. Code/message are required. Options default to omission and permit cause/context; the ordinary Error also permits a frozen errors snapshot. Codes are public API, and error factories never rewrite stack. Empty output reports zero progress. Malformed decode chunks report zero progress, while parser decode failures report that chunk’s byte count. Stream wrappers use outer frame positions without losing inner causes.

For value-to-wire or mixed-value failures, return to the business value rather than forcing a representation. For CODEC_NOT_FOUND inspect types and the saved type tag. REGISTRY_DISPOSED requires a new registry. Multi-chunk byte collection requires an explicit encoder. If exports still block, inspect initial slice size, bounds and yieldTo; slicing is not preemptive termination.

A complete workflow creates the registry, encodes independent frames into the real sink, decodes them individually at the receiver, reads old formats using saved type tags and writes the default primaryType. Apply UTF-8/Base64 only at an actual text boundary, then await dispose. A configured deadline limits draining only. module scripts provide fmt, lint, typecheck, typecheck:test, test and a separate build; unverified historical measurements are not performance claims.

sections.heading: Preserve Map and Set in JSON

blocks.text: Use the collection codec explicitly when values contain Map or Set. It shares the strict portable profile with JSON, adds recursive collections, projects enumerable class fields, and rejects nonfinite numbers, undefined, Date and cycles. Reserved $rpc records must have the exact bytes/map/set shape. Collection iteration preserves insertion order and uses intrinsic slots and iterators. Bytes remain bytes records after decoding; old collection tuples are ordinary data.

Format codecs keep integer-index enumeration followed by string insertion order, including getter traversal. Public toPortableValue still supplies a sorted intermediate projection. RPC owned snapshots and ordinary object and byte JSON paths preserve each object's own key order. The existing private RPC snapshot owner still copies and computes the byte upper bound in one traversal, skipping already encoded binary subtrees.

sections.heading: Carry a format tag in the encoded value

blocks.text: The first codec writes new values; every listed id/version can read its own tagged payload. An optional untagged codec only reads raw legacy values. Unknown tags fail with TAG_UNKNOWN; malformed reserved headers fail with TAG_INVALID and never fall back. A raw text value starting with mgt1: is interpreted as tagged input, even when it was produced by the untagged codec.

String carriers prepend mgt1:<id>@<version>;. Byte carriers prepend 00 4d 47 54, framing byte 01, a two-byte big-endian UTF-8 tag length and the tag. Unknown carriers return a frozen object with own $migaia.codec and value fields; the inner value stays unfrozen. All codecs must declare the same carrier. The framing identity is tagged@1; it is separate from storage envelope versions. ICodecEncodedType, ITaggedCodecOptions, ITaggedEncoded, ITaggedValue and ITaggedCodec preserve carrier and business-value inference.

libraries.description: Runtime-neutral storage contract: key-value store, codec, capability, context, key-domain and contract-level error types.

blocks.text: 运行时中立的存储契约。根入口只拥有类型、能力 token/定义、错误、枚举式常量和纯校验；执行、资源与作者快照由 `@migaia/storage-host/authoring/*` 拥有。基础包不依赖 host、浏览器存储或数据库客户端。

items: `@migaia/storage-contract`：存储/codec/context/query/transaction 类型、标准 token、定义身份和纯校验。
`@migaia/storage-contract/conformance`：由消费者现有 runner 执行的后端契约组；不内置 runner，也不依赖 host。
后端和 host 向内依赖本包。运行时作者 API 从下表入口导入；根入口不保留旧名称重导出或兼容别名。

rows: 键快照、有序键/组织编码、批次键 capture/projection
term、RDF 快照/编码、组织图映射
blob 输入快照、body reader 与 object 资源
createMigrationPlan、迁移执行与 envelope 恢复

blocks.text: 这些入口属于 `@migaia/storage-host`。`/authoring/backend` 继续拥有既有有限后端接点；共享模板捕获仅是 SQL/SPARQL 的内部模块，不是公开子路径。使用步骤见 USEGUIDE 与 host 指南。

`IStorageBase` 是 backend、capabilities 和原资源清理接口；`IKeyValueStore` 加入文本操作；`IRecordStore` 加入 bytes、records、iteration 与 transaction。`ISyncKeyValueStore` 只描述真实同步文本通道。query、transaction、vector、RDF、blob、TTL、counter、durable feed 的接口和输入类型继续从本包导入。

rows: 检查当前完整 shape 与能力事实，不复制、不调用存储或清理方法
成功返回同一原对象；缺能力报 `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`
检查布尔事实与可选非负安全整数 `maxValueBytes`；不补写调用方字段
检查 typed-key 域或字符串域；分别沿 `INVALID_KEY` / `INVALID_ARGUMENT` 边界
校验字段，不分配快照、计时器或取消订阅
校验非空 name、text/binary/structured output 和可调用 encode/decode；不执行转换
校验规范 UUID 或 text/bytes/record/vector/RDF 锁域
复用向量 schema、有限分量及稠密 ID 规则，不复制输入
复用 RDF 词法与位置规则；完整 quad 必须有四个位置
复用锁目标及非负期限规则；TTL 不接纳 RDF 目标
只校验 blob 的 key/body/options 结构，不取得 reader

blocks.text: shape guard 面向普通受支持输入，不承诺拦截抛错 getter、Proxy、恶意 thenable 或属性读取次数。异步执行、native 错误归一及取消结果属于相应运行时拥有者。
`IStorageKey` 接纳有限数、字符串、有效 Date、ArrayBuffer，以及这些值构成的非空稠密嵌套数组。深度上限 32，节点上限 4096，每个二进制组件上限 1 MiB；循环、空数组、稀疏数组和普通对象不在键域内。纯 guard 不复制 Date、buffer 或数组。异步保留输入时使用 host 的键快照。
`IOperationContext.timeoutMs` 是非负安全整数，`pageSize` 是 1–4096 的整数；省略不插入缺省值。signal 使用结构化 `IAbortSignal`，已取消的有效信号仍可通过 shape 校验。同步写选项只接纳可选 `conflictPolicy`，不接纳非 undefined 的 signal/timeoutMs。
`IStorageCapabilities.batch` 声明完整 KV 批量写与计数前缀删除；省略表示不支持。共享 conformance 将未声明的 batch 组记为不适用。`secondaryIndexes`、`changeFeed` 的旧省略形状可通过 guard；需要独立规范化说明的 host 快照把这两项补 false。

`defineStorageCapability`、标准 `kv/records/sql/ttl/counter/vector/rdf/sparql/blob/durableChangeFeed` token 和 `implement` 留在本包。名称只作诊断；同名 token 不能互换。`readCapabilityTokenFacts` 与 `readStorageImplementation` 只读取原定义身份，不发布能力、不执行回调、不维护每 store 表。
publication、store has/use 和 transaction implementation lookup 统一由 host `/authoring/capability` 拥有。调用方继续使用同一 token 和原 API 实例；支持合法 class 的方法 receiver。查询/事务/锁/iterator 的状态表也只在 host 中存在。

`StorageContractError` 保持 `source: '@migaia/storage-contract'`、公开 code、原 `cause`、原 stack 与扩展 details。未改名或新增错误码。`INVALID_ARGUMENT` 表示输入结构问题，`INVALID_KEY` 表示 typed-key 域问题，`UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY` 表示缺少已请求能力；执行拥有者继续使用本包既有生命周期、并发、查询和迁移码。
错误实例保留既有冻结行为，cause 对象不会随之冻结。归档迁移的进度错误通过既有 `onArchiveRunError` 通道报告，不修改已冻结错误实例。codec 不承诺冻结或复制：纯 `assertCodec` 只校验；host `snapshotCodec` 校验后返回同一实例，使 `#private` 方法保持 receiver。
普通 store/options/query 与输入快照不作为冻结协议。需要跨排队、native await 或公开返回值边界隔离可变 Date、bytes、数组、RDF term 时，由相应 host 作者入口说明并执行必要复制。公开锁诊断的键必须与仍活动的原 lease 分离。
先区分纯校验与执行拥有者。类型、token、定义和错误从 `@migaia/storage-contract` 导入；需要保存可变输入、运行查询或管理资源时，使用 README 的 host 入口表。

blocks.code:
import { assertStorageKey, type IStorageKey } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const input: unknown = ['orders', new Date(0)]
assertStorageKey(input, 'memory')
const key: IStorageKey = input
console.log((key as [string, Date])[1].getTime()) // 0

blocks.text: 纯校验不打开 store，也不复制键。需要在异步写入前保留键时，由 host 原作者入口复制可变组件：

blocks.code:
import { snapshotStorageKey } from '@migaia/storage-host/authoring/key'

const input = ['orders', new Date(0)] as const
const saved = snapshotStorageKey(input, 'memory') as [string, Date]
input[1].setTime(1000)
console.log(saved[1].getTime()) // 0

blocks.text: 没有跨异步或公开所有权边界的同步校验直接使用原输入，不建立第二份快照。

blocks.code:
import { assertOperationContext, assertSyncWriteOptions } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

assertOperationContext({ timeoutMs: 0, pageSize: 100 })
assertSyncWriteOptions({ conflictPolicy: 'replace' })

blocks.text: 这两个函数不运行取消、计时或写入。非法字段沿现有 `INVALID_ARGUMENT` 边界；省略字段不插入后端默认值。signal 是原 live signal，已取消的有效信号也符合 shape。

blocks.code:
import { snapshotOperationContext } from '@migaia/storage-host/authoring/context'

const controller = new AbortController()
const options = { signal: controller.signal, timeoutMs: 10 }
const captured = snapshotOperationContext(options)!
options.timeoutMs = 20
controller.abort()
console.log(captured.timeoutMs, captured.signal === controller.signal) // 10 true
console.log(captured.signal?.aborted) // true

blocks.text: 快照用于后续实际 await，不冻结，不保证再次 snapshot 返回相同对象，也不承诺属性读取次数。后端已捕获的上下文应复用，不重复复制。

blocks.code:
import { isStorageCapabilities, type IStorageCapabilities } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const facts: IStorageCapabilities = {
  syncRead: false,
  binary: false,
  records: false,

}
console.log(isStorageCapabilities(facts)) // true

blocks.text: `batch` 省略表示不提供完整批量写；共享 conformance 的该组记为不适用。shape guard 不创建规范化副本。需要在宿主异步准入期间保存事实时，从 `/authoring/store` 使用 `snapshotStorageCapabilities`。
这一步没有发布 store。发布和 has/use 在 host `/authoring/capability`；定义 token 的名字不能替代原对象身份。完整资源和清理示例见 host 指南。

`assertCodec(codec)` 只检查普通对象或合法 class 的公开结构。`snapshotCodec` 已归 host `/authoring/codec`，现在校验后借用同一对象；它不复制 `{name, output, encode, decode}`，因此 `#private` 方法不会丢失 receiver。调用使用 `codec.encode(value)` / `codec.decode(raw)`。格式转换适配仍使用同入口的 `fromValueCodec`。
既有错误实例仍冻结，cause 与 stack 保留。归档迁移通过原 `onArchiveRunError` 报告进度，不向错误实例添加状态。

从 `@migaia/storage-contract/conformance` 导入 `runConformance`，提供消费者原有的 describe/it/expect（以及可选 skip）、fresh fixture、真实 token 清单和能力事实。每组执行原公开操作并清理该 fixture；不安装第二个 runner，不据后端名字推断未声明能力。完整参数类型是同入口的 `IConformanceHarness` 与 `IConformanceSubject`。

Runtime-neutral storage contracts. The root owns types, capability tokens/definitions, errors, enum-like constants and pure validators. Execution, resources and authoring snapshots belong to `@migaia/storage-host/authoring/*`. This module does not depend on host, browser storage or database clients.

items: `@migaia/storage-contract`: storage, codec, context, query and transaction types; standard tokens; definition identity; pure validation.
`@migaia/storage-contract/conformance`: backend contract groups run by the consumer's existing runner. It supplies no runner and imports no host runtime.
Host and backends depend inward on this module. Runtime authoring APIs use the entries below; the root retains no old runtime re-export or compatibility alias.

rows: Publication, original store has/use, transaction implementation lookup
Record/vector/RDF queries, condition compilation and snapshots
Policies, lock factories, the concurrency loop and lock snapshots
Transaction owner, builder, execution and iterator derivation
Key copies, ordered/organization encoding and batch capture/projection
Store admission and capability descriptor snapshots
Fragments, native tags and terminal binding
Term factories, snapshots, encoding and organization graphs
Vector input snapshots and recommendation synthesis
Input snapshots, upload readers and object resources
Value-codec adapter and original codec admission
Migration plans, execution and envelope recovery

blocks.text: All these entries belong to `@migaia/storage-host`. `/authoring/backend` retains its finite backend ports. Shared template capture remains a private SQL/SPARQL module. See the usage guide and host guide.

`IStorageBase` describes backend, capabilities and the original cleanup surface. `IKeyValueStore` adds text operations; `IRecordStore` adds bytes, records, iteration and transactions. `ISyncKeyValueStore` describes a real synchronous text channel. Query, transaction, vector, RDF, blob, TTL, counter and durable-feed types remain here.

rows: Check complete supported shapes and capability facts without copying or invoking native methods
Return the same original object; missing capability reports `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`
Checks boolean facts and optional nonnegative safe-integer `maxValueBytes`; never fills caller fields
Validate typed or string keys; retain `INVALID_KEY` / `INVALID_ARGUMENT` respectively
Validate fields without a snapshot, timer or abort subscription
Checks nonempty name, text/binary/structured output and callable encode/decode; performs no conversion
Validate canonical UUIDs and text/bytes/record/vector/RDF lock domains
Reuse schema, finite-component and dense-ID rules without input copies
Reuse lexical and positional rules; complete quads require all four positions
Reuse target and nonnegative-duration rules; RDF is not a TTL target
Validate keys, bodies and option shapes without acquiring a reader
Validate the original envelope or callback without executing migration or transaction work

blocks.text: Guards accept ordinary supported inputs. They promise no hostile getter, Proxy or thenable interception and no property-read count. Runtime owners retain native failure normalization, cancellation and actual operation outcomes.

`IStorageKey` accepts finite numbers, strings, valid Dates, ArrayBuffers and nonempty dense nested arrays of those values. Limits are depth 32, 4096 visited nodes and 1 MiB per binary component. Cycles, sparse/empty arrays and ordinary objects are invalid. Pure validation does not copy key data; use host key snapshots when asynchronous work retains mutable input.

`IOperationContext.timeoutMs` is a nonnegative safe integer and `pageSize` is an integer from 1 through 4096. Omission supplies no default. A structurally valid already-aborted `IAbortSignal` is accepted. Sync write options allow optional `conflictPolicy`, without non-undefined signal/timeoutMs.

`IStorageCapabilities.batch` declares complete KV batch writes and counted prefix deletion. Omission means unsupported, and shared conformance marks that group not applicable. Legacy omissions of secondaryIndexes/changeFeed pass pure shape admission; host descriptor snapshots normalize those two flags to false.

Custom and standard capability tokens plus `implement` stay here. Names are diagnostics; same-name tokens are not interchangeable. `readCapabilityTokenFacts` and `readStorageImplementation` inspect canonical definition identity without publication, callback execution or per-store state.

Host `/authoring/capability` owns publication, store has/use and transaction implementation lookup. It uses the same token and original API identity, including legitimate class receivers. Query, transaction, lock and iterator runtime state belongs only to host.

`StorageContractError` retains source `@migaia/storage-contract`, its public code, original cause and stack, and extension details. No code was added or renamed. `INVALID_ARGUMENT` denotes argument shape, `INVALID_KEY` denotes the typed-key domain, and `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY` denotes missing requested behavior. Runtime owners reuse the existing lifecycle, query, concurrency and migration codes.

Error instances retain their existing frozen behavior; cause objects are not frozen with them. Archive migration reports progress failures through the existing `onArchiveRunError` hook rather than modifying the frozen error. Codec admission does not clone or freeze: pure `assertCodec` validates, while host `snapshotCodec` returns the same admitted instance so class-private methods keep their receiver.

Ordinary store, option, query and snapshot records are not a freezing protocol. Host authors retain copies only where queued/native awaits or a public ownership boundary exposes mutable Date, bytes, array or RDF data. Public lock diagnostics detach keys from a still-active native lease.
Import types, tokens, definitions, errors and pure validators from `@migaia/storage-contract`. Input retention, query execution and resources use the host entry table.

blocks.code:
import { assertStorageKey, type IStorageKey } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

const input: unknown = ['orders', new Date(0)]
assertStorageKey(input, 'memory')
const key: IStorageKey = input
console.log((key as [string, Date])[1].getTime()) // 0

blocks.text: Validation opens no store and copies no key. When asynchronous writes retain caller data, the original host authoring helper detaches mutable components:

blocks.code:
import { snapshotStorageKey } from '@migaia/storage-host/authoring/key'

const input = ['orders', new Date(0)] as const
const saved = snapshotStorageKey(input, 'memory') as [string, Date]
input[1].setTime(1000)
console.log(saved[1].getTime()) // 0

blocks.text: Synchronous validation with no asynchronous or public ownership boundary borrows the original input.

blocks.code:
import { assertOperationContext, assertSyncWriteOptions } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

assertOperationContext({ timeoutMs: 0, pageSize: 100 })
assertSyncWriteOptions({ conflictPolicy: 'replace' })

blocks.text: These functions execute no cancellation, timers or writes. Invalid fields retain `INVALID_ARGUMENT`; omission supplies no backend default. Structurally valid aborted signals remain valid inputs.

blocks.code:
import { snapshotOperationContext } from '@migaia/storage-host/authoring/context'

const controller = new AbortController()
const options = { signal: controller.signal, timeoutMs: 10 }
const captured = snapshotOperationContext(options)!
options.timeoutMs = 20
controller.abort()
console.log(captured.timeoutMs, captured.signal === controller.signal) // 10 true
console.log(captured.signal?.aborted) // true

blocks.text: Snapshots support later real awaits. They are not frozen, do not promise repeated-call identity, and specify no accessor read count. Reuse a context already captured by its backend owner.

import { isStorageCapabilities, type IStorageCapabilities } from '@migaia/storage-contract'

blocks.text: Omitted `batch` means no complete batch-write support; shared conformance marks that group not applicable. Pure shape guards do not normalize copies. Host `/authoring/store` supplies `snapshotStorageCapabilities` when deferred admission must retain those facts.

This creates no published store. Host `/authoring/capability` owns publication and has/use. A token's name never substitutes for the original identity. Resource and cleanup examples remain in the host guide.

`assertCodec(codec)` checks the public shape of an ordinary object or legitimate class. Host `/authoring/codec` owns `snapshotCodec`: it validates and borrows the same original instance. It does not copy `{name, output, encode, decode}`, so methods using `#private` state retain their receiver. Invoke `codec.encode(value)` and `codec.decode(raw)` directly. `fromValueCodec` remains the format adapter on that same entry.
Existing error instances remain frozen; original cause and stack survive. Archive migration reports progress through its existing `onArchiveRunError` hook rather than adding state to errors.

Import `runConformance` from `@migaia/storage-contract/conformance`. Supply the consumer's existing describe/it/expect and optional skip, fresh fixtures, actual token list and capability facts. Groups execute public operations and clean each fixture. They install no extra runner and infer no unlisted capability from a backend name. The entry exports the exact `IConformanceHarness` and `IConformanceSubject` types.

libraries.description: Runtime-neutral storage host and typed backend authoring

blocks.text: 把内存、数据库和文件后端装到同一个存储宿主（host），用带类型的 `backend(id)` 获取对应存储，并统一结束工作与释放资源。适合同时使用多个数据源、需要组织隔离或事务的应用：先安装后端插件，再选择各后端提供的能力；多个后端的写入不会自动合成一个原子事务。
English · 使用指南

items: 数据库连接关了，订阅或排队任务还在运行：业务代码没有统一的结束入口。
两个后端都叫 `cache`，调用时才发现拿错实例：字符串查找丢失了安装时的类型信息。
给每个方法手动加租户前缀，偶尔漏掉一次：组织隔离依赖调用方逐项遵守约定。
同时更新文本和记录，一半成功一半失败：多次独立写入没有放进同一个事务。
`backend(id)` 保留已安装插件的具体类型；重复 ID 在安装时拒绝。安装后端
内置 memory 后端可直接存文本、字节和记录，也能执行事务。事务与查询
`org(id)` 固定同一组织，传递给实体或组合插件后仍保持隔离。组织数据
`dispose()` 等待已接纳的工作并释放已安装资源；组织视图没有关闭整个宿主的方法。结束工作

blocks.text: 下面把状态写入 memory，再从同一个后端读取。支持顶层 `await` 的 TypeScript 环境可直接使用。

同样的状态存取，用普通 Map 很容易开始，但组织隔离与退出处理需要另外约定：

const values = new Map<string, string>()
values.set('order:1:status', 'paid') // 没有组织前缀，不同组织会碰到同一键。
console.log(values.get('order:1:status'))
values.clear() // 只能清数据，不能等待其它异步存储工作。

blocks.text: Map 适合局部数据；需要多后端、事务或统一释放时，再使用宿主。
`createStorageHost → 安装插件 → backend(id) → 存取数据 → dispose()`。

实际存数据，例如 memory、SQLite 或对象存储

安装时明确选择的额外 API；经 `store.api` 使用

同一应用服务多个组织

blocks.text: 这些 storage 包当前是 `private: true` 的仓库 workspace 包，尚不作为已发布的 registry 包提供。以下命令用于仓库内的消费包：

blocks.code: pnpm add --workspace @migaia/storage-host @migaia/storage-contract

blocks.text: 内置 memory 不需要数据库客户端。其它后端由各自的插件提供。只有配置 `journal` 或导入 `/journal` 时才需要可选 peer：

blocks.code: pnpm add --workspace @migaia/logger

rows: 创建宿主，默认在返回前执行环境检查
获取已安装后端，或检查动态 ID
追加一批插件，成功后返回包含新类型的宿主
获取组织视图，或删除该组织在各后端的数据
显式执行尚未成功完成的环境检查
停止接纳新工作，等待并释放资源

items: `plugins` 的 ID 必须唯一。一批插件全部成功才会出现在查找结果中；安装失败会释放本批已创建的资源。重叠安装批次报 `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`。
`autoDetect` 默认 `true`，`installTimeoutMs` 默认 `30000` 毫秒。设 `autoDetect: false` 后，应先 `await host.detect()` 再执行数据操作；检查未完成的操作会报 `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`。追加插件后也要检查新增后端。
`org` 默认零 UUID；显式组织 ID 必须是规范的小写 UUID，可用 `createOrgId()` 生成。`org()` 返回的视图不能安装插件、删除组织或关闭宿主。删除组织尝试所有后端，部分失败不会撤回已成功的删除，错误为 `ORG_DELETE_FAILED`，具体失败在 `AggregateError.errors` 中。
后端支持什么能力由实际实例决定。非默认组织不会自动得到只绑定到根后端的自定义能力；先检查 `has(token)`。组织视图不支持原生 SQL/SPARQL 入口。
显式 `dispose()` 的失败会拒绝，重复调用复用同一个 Promise。`await using` 清理会报告失败并完成，以免覆盖业务代码的主错误。调用方提供的原生客户端是否需要单独关闭，见相应后端说明。
宿主错误的 `source` 为 `@migaia/storage-host`；共享参数和能力错误来自 `@migaia/storage-contract`。排查时同时读取 `source`、`code` 与 `cause`，不要匹配错误文案。

blocks.text: 应用只调用 `backend()` 时无需导入作者工具。实现后端时，运行时工具从以下入口获取；类型、能力 token、定义和纯校验继续从 contract 获取。
表中的 `/authoring/...` 均以 `@migaia/storage-host` 开头。

headers: 原 contract 运行时用途
rows: 键编码、输入快照、资源管理

blocks.text: 完整路径和依赖说明见 storage-contract。旧 contract 根入口不保留这些运行时导出。
实体装配变更：`/entity` 提供基础读写。旧版自动包含的查询、索引、unique 检查、迁移和 keyset，现需在 `features` 中声明对应 `/entity/*` 单元；业务只导入需要的单元。缺少时抛出 `ENTITY_FEATURE_REQUIRED`。迁移方式见实体仓储。
基础宿主不导入 journal runtime、通知控制器或变更迭代器。此前 journal 选项会自动加载日志实现，memory 默认提供变更通知和 watch；现在这些能力由业务显式选择，避免基础存读包含未使用代码。
使用 journal 选项或 `storageLogStore()` 前，在同一插件列表中把从 `@migaia/storage-host/journal` 导入的 `storageJournalPlugin()` 放到后端前。缺少插件时报 `JOURNAL_NOT_ASSEMBLED`。配置格式、日志内容和事务提交语义保持原契约。
memory 通知和变更流分别由两个 Feature 装配：

未选择变更流时，memory 的 `capabilities.changeFeed` 为 `false`；调用 watch 报 `CHANGE_ITERATOR_NOT_ASSEMBLED`。只选通知可调用 `subscribeChanges()`；变更流依赖通知，缺少通知时报 `CHANGE_CONTROLLER_NOT_ASSEMBLED`。基础读写与物理资源关闭仍由轻量生命周期 owner 负责。

后端作者从 `/authoring/change-controller` 导入通知工厂，并显式传给 `core.createChangeController(options, createBackendChangeController)`。基础物理资源可使用同入口的 `createBackendLifecycleController`。变更迭代器改从 `/authoring/change-iterator` 导入，不再从 `/authoring/backend` 转出。
English · 概览与安装

rows: 先存数据，再追加其它后端
多项写入需要一起成功
用对象主键读写与查询
把应用日志放进存储后端

blocks.text: 初始插件放在 `plugins` 数组中。后续 `use()` 返回带新增后端类型的宿主；两者共享同一个生命周期，关闭其中一个宿主引用一次即可。
同一批次里的插件不能借用彼此尚未发布的后端。缓存、归档等组合插件需要读取已有后端时，应先完成基础后端安装，再 `use()` 安装组合插件。ID 必须在整个宿主中唯一。
`autoDetect` 默认开启。需要先完成配置再检查环境时，可设置 `autoDetect: false`，随后显式 `detect()`。并发检查共享同一个 Promise；成功结果会缓存，失败后可再次调用。`installTimeoutMs` 是整批安装的毫秒上限，默认 `30000`，允许有限非负数。安装失败会回滚本批资源，不删除早先已成功安装的后端。
memory 的文本、字节和记录可以在同一个事务中写入。回调失败时草稿不提交。查询从 `records` 能力取得，下面在事务结束后读取已提交记录。
memory 的记录过滤在客户端执行。换用数据库后端时，下推能力和事务范围由该后端决定。事务可能因冲突重放回调；不要在回调中发送邮件、扣款或执行其它无法随事务回滚的副作用。
同一逻辑键的文本、字节和记录有通道冲突规则。需要替换已有通道时，应明确选择相应写入策略，不把三种值当成互不相干的键空间。批量写入的重复键会在提交前拒绝；批量删除的重复键只计一次。
`/entity` 现在只包含定义、连接和基础读写。附加能力需从独立子路径显式装配；缺少装配时抛出 `source: @migaia/storage-host`、`code: ENTITY_FEATURE_REQUIRED`，消息写明所需导入。

只在 `features` 中选择用到的单元：`/entity/query` 的 `entityQueryFeature()` 开启 query/list/stream；`/entity/indexes` 的 `entityIndexesFeature()` 开启索引声明和规划；`/entity/unique` 的 `entityUniqueFeature()` 开启唯一提交检查；`/entity/migration` 的 `entityMigrationFeature()` 开启版本计划和持久迁移；`/entity/keyset` 的 `entityKeysetFeature()` 准入 page/after。索引查询与唯一约束的回退校验还需要 query。没有索引或唯一约束的迁移直接扫描原生记录或文本键，不需要 query 或 unique。单元不会自动开启其他单元。
unique 单元能单独捕获约束投影，不会因此开启索引规划；仅做唯一写入检查时不需 indexes 单元。
`defineEntity<T>()({...})` 声明对象的主键与索引，`connect(store)` 连接实际后端。下面先写入，再用同一声明查询。
实体不会关闭传入的后端。事务中使用 `orders.in(tx)`；`orders.batch(...)` 使用一个原生记录事务。schema 与 codec 用于运行时校验和转换，TypeScript 类型本身不校验外部输入。需要外部 schema 时，可从同一 `/entity` 入口使用 `fromStandardSchema`；转换失败保留原错误在 `cause` 中。

查询的 `index` 或 `range` 要最先选择，且只能选一次；普通 `where`、`select`、`skip`、`limit` 会产生新分支。自定义比较器应搭配有限 `limit`，或使用 `first()`。`stream()` 返回可释放迭代器；提前停止时使用 `await using` 或显式 `dispose()`。`watch()` 是可用后端的失效通知，并非结果行流，也不保证重放。事务查询没有 `watch()`。
迁移没有索引或唯一约束的记录时，只需选择 migration 单元。读取旧记录会升级返回值；需要持久化新版本信封时，再调用 `migrate()`。内存记录的每个迁移批次沿用原生事务。
声明唯一约束时仍需选择 unique 单元；其回退校验还需要 query。迁移不会隐式补装任何一个单元。
组织 ID 是规范小写 UUID。保存组织视图后，同一视图的提取方法也继续使用该组织。
省略 `org` 选项时，根后端使用零 UUID。memory 的每个插件实例独立，namespace 相同也不会共享数据。组织视图只提供业务操作，没有安装与关闭方法。`dropOrg()` 尝试所有后端；一个失败不撤回其它成功删除，调用方应检查聚合错误。不要把多后端组织删除视为一个全局事务。
非默认组织只获得其后端实际提供的能力。根后端上的自定义 capability 不会自动复制；Feature 的 `api` 方法则经组织视图调用。原生 SQL/SPARQL 不支持组织视图，应使用对应组织化数据接口。
先安装可选 peer `@migaia/logger`。`storageLogStore()` 是异步工厂，接受宿主或组织视图、后端 ID 和非空 `prefix`，不能传普通 KV 对象。下面追加一条记录，再读取序号与待处理状态。
日志记录与业务键分开；业务枚举、clear 和容量限制不会操作日志。后端必须支持所需日志存储，打开时先恢复已确认状态。独占存储上的同一组织与前缀只允许一个打开句柄；支持共享事务的存储可允许多个句柄。序号不因截断而重用。写入是否提交无法确认时，日志停止接纳操作，应关闭后重新打开恢复。`dropOrg()` 后旧日志句柄报 `STORE_DISPOSED`。

打开日志不等于开启自动业务日志。自动记录需要 `createStorageHost({ plugins: [storageJournalPlugin(), backend], journal: ... })`；配置可以直接提供 `{ logger, namespace, ... }`，或用异步初始化函数为每个组织准备配置。初始化函数接收 `orgId` 和异步 `storageLogStore(id, { prefix })`。宿主借用 logger，不负责 shutdown。

根据需要选择 binlog、WAL、undo 与同事务日志对象。`atomicBinlog` / `atomicUndo` 按后端 ID 指定真实日志存储；需要它们与业务后端能在同一事务提交。其它组合是否可用由实际后端支持决定，不支持会在业务修改前拒绝。外置 binlog 追加失败会报告，已提交业务数据不回滚；结果未知不能通过盲目重放写入恢复。undo 先检查记录与修订，冲突为 `UNDO_CONFLICT`，缺失为 `UNDO_NOT_FOUND`。

开启 `telemetry: true` 还需要 logger 的 level 插件；日志可能包含操作 payload 和错误，应按应用要求配置 logger。只开 telemetry 也会安装异步阶段，此时使用异步数据方法；同步读写会报 `ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY`。没有配置 journal 且没有导入 `/journal` 时，宿主运行时不加载 logger。更多 logger 配置见 logger 指南。
业务失败会通过调用的 Promise 返回；观察监听器和报告回调的失败不改变已完成的数据操作。配置 `report(error)` 接收这类诊断，检查 `source`、`code` 和原始 `cause`。

Use it when an application needs several data sources, organization isolation or transactions: install the relevant plugins, then select the capabilities each backend provides. Writes across separate backends do not automatically form one atomic transaction.

items: Plugin IDs must be unique. A batch becomes visible only after every installation succeeds; failed installation releases resources created by that batch. Overlapping batches reject with `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`.

`autoDetect` defaults to `true`; `installTimeoutMs` defaults to `30000`. With `autoDetect: false`, call `await host.detect()` before data operations. Operations whose checks are unfinished reject with `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`. Check newly added backends after `use()` as well.

The default `org` is the zero UUID. Explicit IDs must be canonical lowercase UUIDs; `createOrgId()` generates one. An organization view cannot install plugins, drop organizations or close the host. `dropOrg()` attempts every backend; successful deletions remain if another fails. `ORG_DELETE_FAILED` exposes the failures through `AggregateError.errors`.

Capabilities depend on the actual backend instance. A non-default organization does not automatically inherit a custom capability attached only to the root backend; check `has(token)`. Native SQL/SPARQL entry points are unavailable through organization views.

Explicit `dispose()` rejects on cleanup failure and reuses its Promise on repeated calls. `await using` cleanup reports failures and completes so it does not replace a primary business error. See each backend's guide for closing caller-supplied native clients.

Host errors use `source: '@migaia/storage-host'`. Shared argument and capability errors come from `@migaia/storage-contract`. Inspect `source`, `code` and `cause` together rather than matching message text.

blocks.text: Put initial plugins in `plugins`. A later `use()` returns a host type that includes the new backends. Both references share one lifetime; close either host reference once.

Plugins in one batch cannot borrow each other's unpublished backends. Install base backends first, then install a cache, archive or other composed plugin with `use()`. IDs must be unique throughout the host.

`autoDetect` defaults to `true`. Set it to `false` when configuration must finish before checks, then explicitly call `detect()`. Concurrent checks share their Promise; successful checks are cached and failed checks can be retried. `installTimeoutMs` bounds the entire install batch in milliseconds, defaults to `30000`, and accepts finite nonnegative numbers. Failed installation rolls back that batch's resources without deleting previously installed backends.

The memory backend can write strings, bytes and records in one transaction. A failed callback does not commit its draft. Obtain queries through the `records` capability; this example reads committed data after the transaction finishes.

Memory filters records on the client. With a database backend, pushdown and transaction scope depend on that backend. Conflict handling may replay a transaction callback. Keep email, payments and other effects that cannot roll back outside it.

Strings, bytes and records have channel-conflict rules for the same logical key. Choose the appropriate write policy when replacing another channel. Do not treat these channels as unrelated key spaces. Duplicate batch-write keys reject before commit; duplicate deletion keys count once.

`/entity` provides definition, connection and basic reads/writes. Optional operations require explicit subpath units. Missing units throw `ENTITY_FEATURE_REQUIRED` with `source: @migaia/storage-host` and name the required import.

Select only required units in `features`: `entityQueryFeature()` from `/entity/query` adds query/list/stream; `entityIndexesFeature()` from `/entity/indexes` adds index declaration/planning; `entityUniqueFeature()` from `/entity/unique` adds unique commit checks; `entityMigrationFeature()` from `/entity/migration` adds version plans and persisted migration; `entityKeysetFeature()` from `/entity/keyset` admits page/after. Index-backed queries and fallback uniqueness validation also require query. Migration without indexes or unique constraints scans native records or text keys directly and needs neither query nor unique. Units never enable another unit implicitly.
The unique unit captures its own constraint projections without enabling index planning. Unique write checks alone do not require the indexes unit.
`defineEntity<T>()({...})` declares an object's primary key and indexes. `connect(store)` attaches it to a backend. This example writes first, then queries through the same definition.

The repository does not close its backend. Use `orders.in(tx)` inside a transaction; `orders.batch(...)` uses one native record transaction. Schemas and codecs perform runtime validation and conversion; TypeScript types alone do not validate external input. `fromStandardSchema` is available from the same `/entity` entry. Conversion failures retain the original error through `cause`.

Select `index` or `range` first and only once. `where`, `select`, `skip` and `limit` create new query branches. Pair custom comparators with a finite `limit`, or use `first()`. `stream()` returns a disposable iterator; use `await using` or explicit `dispose()` if stopping early. When available, `watch()` supplies invalidation notifications, not result rows or reliable replay. Transaction queries do not expose `watch()`.

Select only migration when upgrading records without indexes or unique constraints. Reading an old record upgrades the returned value; call `migrate()` to persist the new envelopes. Each memory-record batch uses the original native transaction.
Declaring unique constraints still requires the unique unit. Its fallback check also requires query; migration does not supply either unit implicitly.
Organization IDs are canonical lowercase UUIDs. Saving an organization view, including extracting one of its methods, keeps that organization fixed.

Without an `org` option, the root backend uses the zero UUID. Each memory plugin instance is independent even if namespaces match. Organization views provide business operations without installation or shutdown methods. `dropOrg()` attempts every backend; a failure does not reverse successful deletions elsewhere. Inspect the aggregate error rather than treating organization deletion as a cross-backend transaction.

A non-default organization receives the capabilities its backend actually provides. A custom capability on the root backend is not copied automatically; Feature `api` methods are routed through the organization view. Native SQL/SPARQL entry points do not support organization views; use the relevant organized data APIs.

Install the optional `@migaia/logger` peer first. `storageLogStore()` is asynchronous and accepts a host or organization view, a backend ID and a nonempty `prefix`. A plain KV object is not accepted. Append one record, then inspect its sequence and pending state:

Log records are separate from business keys. Business enumeration, clear and capacity limits do not touch them. A backend must support the required log storage; opening it first recovers confirmed state. Exclusive storage permits one open handle for an organization and prefix, while shared transactional storage may permit several. Truncation does not reuse sequence numbers. An unconfirmed write stops further operations: close and reopen the log to recover. Old log handles reject with `STORE_DISPOSED` after `dropOrg()`.

Opening a log does not enable automatic business logging. Configure `createStorageHost({ plugins: [storageJournalPlugin(), backend], journal: ... })` for that. Supply `{ logger, namespace, ... }` directly, or use an asynchronous initializer for each organization. The initializer receives `orgId` and asynchronous `storageLogStore(id, { prefix })`. The host borrows the logger and does not shut it down.

Choose binlog, WAL, undo and same-transaction log stores as needed. `atomicBinlog` / `atomicUndo` select real log stores by backend ID and require a shared transaction with the business backend. Other combinations depend on backend support and reject before business mutation when unavailable. Failed external binlog appends are reported without rolling back committed business data. Do not recover unknown results by blindly replaying writes. Undo checks stored data and revisions first; conflicts use `UNDO_CONFLICT`, and missing history uses `UNDO_NOT_FOUND`.

`telemetry: true` additionally requires the logger level plugin. Logs can include operation payloads and errors; configure the logger for the application's needs. Even telemetry-only configuration installs an asynchronous stage, so use asynchronous data methods; synchronous reads and writes reject with `ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY`. With neither journal configuration nor a `/journal` import, the host does not load logger at runtime. See the logger guide for logger configuration.

Business failures reject the operation's Promise. Observer and reporting-callback failures do not change completed data operations. Use `report(error)` for these diagnostics and inspect `source`, `code` and the original `cause`.

Move rarely read records out of the storage used for everyday updates and into blob storage, while keeping reads by original key and an explicit restore operation. Connect the plugin to installed hot and object backends, then run archive rules when your application chooses. Each segment commits separately; the whole archive job is not a transaction across both stores.

`write: 'back'` 不是持久队列。失败不重试；`flush()` 立即处理当前待写项，关闭前也会刷出一次。开启传播时，back 层必须位于所有变更源下方且有 TTL；不满足会拒绝配置。
多层 `removeByPrefix` 无法给出可靠去重数量，会在 I/O 前报 `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`。用无计数的 `invalidate({ prefix })` 删除多层副本；`removeMany` 对已知不同逻辑键只计一次。
`host.org(uuid).backend('cache')` 把各层路由到同一组织。关闭缓存排空已接纳工作并取消订阅，不单独关闭借用层；关闭宿主会统一释放它安装的后端。

blocks.text: 基础层必须先安装，再用 `host.use(cachePlugin(...))` 追加缓存。只有配置 `negativeTtlMs` 后，加载结果 `undefined` 才会被短期保存。

`getOrLoadEntry` 还返回 `tier`、`stale`、`negative`、`ageMs`、`meta` 与 `tags`。`peek()` 不回源；缺失返回 `undefined`。`getOrLoadMany(keys, loader)` 对输入去重，按层批量读取，只把缺失且尚无共享任务的键交给 loader；loader 返回 `ReadonlyMap<string, value | undefined>`。
`stampedeLock: { backend, timeoutMs? }` 可选择 tiers 中支持真实事务与键锁的层，锁内复查并把值与 TTL 写入同一事务。timeoutMs 默认 `30000` 毫秒。事务重放可能再次调用 loader，不承诺回源只执行一次。
普通 `get/set` 只读写普通字符串条目，不用于读取上面编码的对象。键只接受字符串。需要由复杂参数生成稳定键时，使用 `await cacheKey('profile', { id: 'ada', version: 1 })`，从根入口导入 `cacheKey`；不支持的输入保留原 serializer 错误。
`tiers` 按从快到慢排列，默认每层 `write: 'through'`。下面用两个独立 memory 实例展示配置；换成 SQLite、Redis 或 PostgreSQL 时，先安装对应后端并保留相同 ID。
through 写入从最慢层向上完成；命中慢层会回填更快层。back 把同键待写项合并，默认每 `1000` 毫秒处理一次；失败报告后丢弃，不自动重试。最慢层不能用 back。这里关闭传播，以便独立演示 back；默认 `propagate: true` 时，所有变更源上方的层必须有 TTL，而 back 层必须在所有变更源下方并有 TTL。
失效订阅在 `detect()` 建立。可靠变更源的游标失效或丢失时，会先清上层对应前缀，再继续订阅；普通通知也不保证所有副本同时更新。给上层设置硬 TTL，限定通知遗漏造成的旧值期限。建议各层使用专用后端或专用实例。
`prefix` 默认是 `cache:<插件ID>:`，可为同一数据后端上的独立缓存选择不同前缀。`clock` 默认 `Date.now`，`random` 默认 `Math.random`；只有需要可控时间或抖动来源时才覆盖。`$cache.cursor` 是传播游标的保留键，不用于业务条目。
缓存没有跨层事务。层故障会报告并降级为未命中或跳过写入；一次调用成功不代表每个副本都已持久化。多层删除前缀请用 `invalidate({ prefix: 'profile:' })`，不要用需要返回数量的 KV `removeByPrefix`。

blocks.text: 单次 `ttlMs/maxAgeMs/staleAfterMs/negativeTtlMs` 只能缩短已有配置上限，不能延长。正数单次 TTL 要求目标层都有 TTL 能力；普通 KV `setMany` 的共享 TTL 域另允许零，表示立即删除。

加载函数接收缓存关闭的 signal；调用方的 `options.ctx.signal` 只取消自己的等待，以 contract `ABORTED` 拒绝，不取消其它请求共享的加载。加载函数应响应传入 signal，关闭才能及时排空。`cacheIf(value)` 为 false 时不写各层。加载和编码失败为 `CACHE_LOAD_FAILED`，原错误留在 cause；不要把它当未命中吞掉。
标签索引需要 records 与 TTL；offload 需要 blob，且引用层必须有 TTL。下面均用内置 memory 能力展示完整组合，应用可换成对象存储插件保存大值。
达到 `minBytes` 的编码内容按内容哈希保存，对应层只保存引用；未达到则直接存值。`maxEntryBytes` 可让过大条目跳过某层。标签记录先于值写入，标签索引失败时报告并跳过值，避免生成无法按标签清理的条目。
失效只删除引用，不立即删除可能仍被其它键引用的对象。`sweepOffload()` 清理已过保留期限的对象，刚失效的对象可能仍需保留到最长引用 TTL；不要期待失效后立即释放全部空间。
从独立入口导入 `semanticCacheFeature`，在缓存插件第二参数选择。下面的两维嵌入只演示精确重复；真实应用应接自己的模型，维度、metric 和模型版本需与 collection 一致。
向量后端须在更早批次发布；设置 semantic TTL 时还需 TTL 能力。metric 默认为 `cosine`，还支持 `dot`、`euclid`；分数和候选顺序由原生向量引擎决定，不能跨 metric 沿用同一阈值。`candidates` 为 `1` 到 `10`，默认 `1`；逐个执行可选 `accept`，返回 false 则继续，accept 失败报告后跳过该候选。
payload 只支持字符串、有限数字与布尔值，`$cache.*` 是保留字段。相同 prompt 与不同 payload 分开保存。`getOrLoad` 按组织、prompt 与规范 payload 共享回源；其单次 TTL 只能缩短上限，`cacheIf` 可拒绝写入，单调用取消不影响其它等待者。嵌入失败报 `CACHE_EMBED_FAILED`。
`invalidate(where, { count })` 返回向量后端的删除数量；默认 `precount`，也可选 `scroll`。数量包含物理仍在但已过期的匹配点，继承后端的并发边界，不代表全局快照。semantic 只在明确选择后存在，经 `api.semantic` 使用，不增加缓存事务或关闭向量后端。
使用 `host.org(uuid).backend('cache')`，所有借用层及 Feature API 都使用该组织。缓存关闭会取消共享加载、等待已接纳工作、刷出一次 back 队列并取消订阅。它不单独关闭借用层；仍由宿主统一关闭已安装后端。`stats()` 只返回计数，tier 故障通过宿主 `report` 与缓存 hook 报告。

Arrange installed key-value backends from faster to slower cache tiers, share loads for repeated requests, and fill upper tiers from lower ones. Use it to combine memory and persistent storage without writing refill and invalidation logic at every call. Configure expiry, caching of missing results and optional delayed writes as needed; tiers do not commit atomically, and delayed writes are not a durable queue.
中文 · Usage guide

items: A burst of requests loads the same hot key repeatedly because every request runs its own loader.
Missing data keeps reaching the database because misses have no short-lived cache entry.
A lower layer changes while an upper layer serves old data because copies lack invalidation or hard expiry.
Batch loading needs its own maps, deduplication and cancellation because single-key and batch requests do not share loads.
Reads, promotion and writes use installed backends in the tier order you choose. Tiered caching
`getOrLoad` and `getOrLoadMany` share loads for the same key. Cancelling one caller does not interrupt other waiters. Loading policy
