blocks.text: 每个场景是独立的 .ts 文件，可用 Node 24 在 ESM 项目中直接运行。它们只使用真实 Store、Runtime 和公开句柄，不需要浏览器扩展。

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/store-devtools @migaia/store-light @migaia/reactive

sections.id: 回放保留状态而不新增回放历史
sections.heading: 回放保留状态而不新增回放历史

blocks.text: 排查问题时，需要回到较早的 Store 状态，再从那里继续修改。
普通变更监听若把回放触发的注水也当成用户编辑，每跳转一次就会多记一条历史。
把工具接到真实 Store，保留初始 id 后调用 `jumpTo()`；会话会抑制回放产生的历史，后续真实修改仍正常记录。

runtime 是本例显式创建并交给 Store 的 Runtime。schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() 将调度改为同步，便于逐条观察；省略时 Runtime 默认通过注入的微任务调度。createStore 的初始 count 为 0，options.runtime 使用该实例；工具 captureRuntimeTrace: false 关闭自动 trace / action，仍保留状态历史。其余 maxHistory / maxTrace 为 100 / 1000，clone 为 diagnostic，now 为 Date.now。
输出：
输出为 `2 3`、`0 3`、`1 4`、`0 true`：回放恢复计数但不追加历史，后续修改继续记录，初始状态保持浅冻结。
`jumpTo` 只向 Store 已知字段注水，不会撤销外部副作用、恢复已淘汰条目，也不保证所有诊断值都完全深度隔离。

sections.id: 分别限制历史与手动动作队列
sections.heading: 分别限制历史与手动动作队列

blocks.text: 长时间调试时，需要只保留少量最近状态，同时留下选定的手动动作说明。
共用一个队列会让动作说明挤掉状态；把清空当成新会话，还可能重用旧 id，留下含混的锚点。
分别设置 `maxHistory`、`maxTrace`，关闭自动追踪并追加手动动作，再清空并检查新的初始条目。
maxHistory 和 maxTrace 均覆盖为 2，分别限制不同队列；captureRuntimeTrace 为 false 时手动 recordAction 仍可用。now: () => 100 返回确定时间戳，省略为 Date.now。recordAction.name 是说明，timestamp 由工具补；jumpTo 接收历史 id，clear 无参数且不重置序号。
输出：

blocks.code:
2,3
第二,第三 0
true UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY
5 initial 0 0

blocks.text: 输出为 `2,3`、`第二,第三 0`、`true UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY`、`5 initial 0 0`：两个队列各自保留最近条目，清空也不重置 id 序列。
`maxHistory` 默认 `100`；`maxTrace` 默认分别为 actions、trace 保留 `1000` 条，`captureRuntimeTrace: false` 也会关闭自动动作捕获。

sections.id: 报告快照失败而不打断业务写入
sections.heading: 报告快照失败而不打断业务写入

blocks.text: 普通 Store 更新期间，诊断快照回调可能失败，但业务写入仍应可用。
让该回调从 Store 监听器直接逃出，就把调试失败变成业务失败；准备完成前先占用 id，也会在失败后留下空号。
使用真实 Runtime 报告入口和会失败的克隆回调；自动捕获报告原错，手动 `record()` 则在发布前抛出它。

Runtime onError 接收真实错误，本例收集到 reports，省略时使用 Runtime 默认报告器。clone 是应用回调，这里只做浅展开；fail 开启后抛出同一个 TypeError，默认 clone 则为 diagnostic。captureRuntimeTrace 为 false 使本例只考察状态快照失败；手动 record 未传 label，默认 state change。
输出：

blocks.code:
1 1
true CALLBACK_FAILED
true
2

blocks.text: 输出为 `1 1`、`true CALLBACK_FAILED`、`true`、`2`：写入成功，自动报告保留原 TypeError，手动记录抛出同一个错误，恢复后使用下一个 id。
这里隔离的只是诊断准备失败；回放克隆的未归属失败会带 `CALLBACK_FAILED` 抛出，Store 注水仍沿自身失败路径传播；此自定义克隆仅作浅展开。

sections.id: 释放诊断会话后继续使用-store
sections.heading: 释放诊断会话后继续使用 Store

blocks.text: 调试面板关闭后，应用仍需要它刚才查看的 Store。
面板退出时连 Store 一起释放，会越过应用的所有权边界；保留诊断监听器，又会让隐藏历史继续增长。
只释放诊断会话，保留其只读队列，再继续写真实 Store；新的诊断修改会被拒绝。
dispose 不接参数、同步且幂等；释放后 record 拒绝，但 history 数组快照仍可读取。Store 与 Runtime 是借用资源，tools.dispose 不销毁它们。本例 finally 另行调用 store.$dispose；Runtime 的调度与 Store 初始值同前几例。
输出：

blocks.code:
1 1
SESSION_DISPOSED
2

blocks.text: 输出为 `1 1`、`SESSION_DISPOSED`、`2`：重复释放无额外影响，旧历史仍可读且不增长，调用方拥有的 Store 仍能写入。
会话释放只移除 Store 与 Runtime 订阅，不清空队列，也不释放借用的 Store；调用方最后单独释放 Store。

sections.id: 展开共享依赖的两条路径
sections.heading: 展开共享依赖的两条路径

blocks.text: 两个计算值共享一个信号，effect 同时读取两者；排查时需要看见回到同一信号的两条路径。
全局已访问集合可能把第二条共享路径误标为环，或直接省略它，尽管它并没有递归回到自身。
用真实 Runtime 句柄组成菱形依赖，再检查 effect；遍历只跟踪当前路径，并遵守显式深度上限。
signal 的初值为 1，left / right 的函数分别读取来源信号，effect 读取两者以建立真实依赖。debugName 是诊断标签，省略时树依次回退到 constructor.name / AnonymousReactiveNode。getDependencyTree 的第二参数默认 20，本例另传 0 验证不展开直接边；函数不拥有这些句柄，最后由创建者释放。
输出：

blocks.code:
视图 左分支,右分支
来源,来源
true
0

blocks.text: 输出为 `视图 左分支,右分支`、`来源,来源`、`true`、`0`：共享依赖的两条路径都展开，且没有环标记；深度为零时不展开直接边。
默认深度为 `20`，必须是非负安全整数；返回的是上游关系的即时视图，不会新增订阅，也不会执行 effect。

sections.id: 在-effect-释放后查看当前订阅者
sections.heading: 在 effect 释放后查看当前订阅者

blocks.text: 一个信号通过计算值供两个 effect 使用，但其中一个面板已经停止观察。
另外维护订阅者清单，容易留下已经关闭的面板，误导排查人员判断哪些观察者还会重跑。
直接读取真实信号的下游树，用公开句柄释放一个 effect，再次检查；整个过程不需要创建诊断会话。
count 初值 2，total 为 count × 2，两 effect 读取它；debugName 标识本例各节点。getObserverTree 接受真实 signal / computed 句柄，maxDepth 默认 20，显式 0 仅返回根。返回树不是持续订阅；first.dispose 后需重新调用函数取得当前关系。
输出：

blocks.code:
计数 合计
第一个,第二个
第二个
0

blocks.text: 输出为 `计数 合计`、`第一个,第二个`、`第二个`、`0`：重新取得的树反映了公开 effect 释放，深度为零则省略全部订阅边。
默认深度为 `20`；返回的树是即时数据，下一次订阅变化后不会自行更新，需要再次读取。
本包是已有 Store 的本地诊断会话，不创建 Store，不改写或代理写入路径。它使用 Store 的 $subscribe、$runtime.subscribeTrace / reportError、$plain、$hydrate，记录内存历史和 action，另提供两个不依赖会话的响应式图遍历函数。适合排查字段变化、动作失败和节点依赖，不是持久化审计、网络回放或外部副作用的事务回滚。
唯一入口为 `@migaia/store-devtools`，导出 createStoreDevTools、getDependencyTree、getObserverTree、五种公开数据类型、错误码与三个错误工厂。reactive、store-light、store-middleware、utils 是运行时依赖；示例直接导入 reactive / store-light 时仍应直接安装它们。

本包不实现浏览器扩展协议。要连接 Redux DevTools，使用 Store Middleware 的 createReduxDevToolsAdapter / connectDevTools。原 StoreDevtoolsCommand / IStoreDevtoolsCommand 已移出此入口；自建桥接改为从 store-middleware 导入 ReduxDevToolsCommand / IReduxDevToolsCommand。六个协议值保持 DISPATCH、COMMIT、JUMP_TO_STATE、JUMP_TO_ACTION、ROLLBACK、RESET；这是导入位置的迁移，不是新增协议层。
`createStoreDevTools<S>(store, options?)` 同步返回 IStoreDevTools。store 必须是 createStore 返回的真实 `IReactiveStore<S>`；会话借用 Store 和 Runtime，不拥有或销毁它们。options 省略为空对象。

rows: 100；仅限制 history，必须是正安全整数。
1000；分别限制 actions 和 trace 的独立队列，没有 maxActions。
缺省启用；只有严格等于 false 才完全跳过 Runtime trace 订阅，actions 也不再自动填充。
Date.now；为历史和 action 记录提供时间戳，显式提供时必须是函数。
ClonePolicy.diagnostic；接收 $plain() 或历史 state 并返回记录对象，显式提供时必须是函数。

blocks.text: null / 非对象 options 以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝；反射或 option 属性读取失败也使用该码，并在 cause 保留捕获的原错。构造读取描述符后读取五个选项，getter 可能在这些属性读取中执行；它不是“完全不执行 getter”的接纳方式。maxHistory / maxTrace 经空值回退后校验，不把 0、负数、分数、无穷或 NaN 静默夹到合法值。now / clone 的非函数配置同样在订阅前拒绝。

通过配置校验后，先同步创建第一条 initial 历史，再订阅当前 Store 的粗粒度状态通知。开启 trace 时订阅的是这个 Store 所用的整个 Runtime，因此共享 Runtime 上其他 Store 或 runTracedAction 的动作也可能进入 actions / trace；它们不自动按本 Store 身份过滤。配置失败不建立订阅；订阅建立失败则尝试释放已取得订阅，主错与回滚错误的保留方式见错误章节。

rows: 每次读取返回按时间顺序排列的新冻结数组，元素为 IStoreHistoryEntry。
label 默认 state change；先准备时间戳和状态，再分配 id、追加记录，并返回该条目。
必填历史 id；找不到（含已裁剪）抛 UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY RangeError，找到则 clone(state) 后交给 Store 的 $hydrate。
无参数；先准备新的 initial，再清三队列并发布这一条，id 继续递增，不归零。

blocks.text: IStoreHistoryEntry 含 id、timestamp、label、state；公开字段类型没有额外 readonly 修饰，但发布时 entry 与 state 顶层实际冻结。history 的数组快照不随之后入队而变化，嵌套 state 的隔离程度由 clone 决定，不保证任意对象图深冻结。超出 maxHistory 后淘汰最早条目，包括 initial；保留已裁剪 id 也不能继续 jumpTo。

默认 record 从 clone(store.$plain()) 取状态。$plain 只包含 Store 的 signal 支撑字段，不含 computed、方法或 WASM 字段。默认 diagnostic clone 通过公共 structured-clone-first owner 尽力复制；不可克隆或不安全子树可能保持引用，自定义类也不保证原型保持。它不自动脱敏；需要剔除 token 等字段时，应用应提供明确的 clone，或不让敏感值进入可记录状态。
record / clear 的准备失败不发布半条历史，也不消耗下一个 id；clear 准备失败保留全部旧队列。准备完成后还会检查会话是否已被回调释放，已释放则 SESSION_DISPOSED，不发布数据。

jumpTo 不是撤销业务的事务。$hydrate 只写已知 signal 字段，未知、派生、WASM 键按 Store 自身规则跳过；computed 随依赖重算，不直接恢复派生结果、外部资源或已发出的网络请求。回放深度计数只屏蔽同步回放期间新增 history，支持嵌套 jumpTo，不屏蔽 Runtime trace / action，也不承诺取消之后调度的通知。回放 clone 失败同样经既有 CALLBACK_FAILED 分类并保留原错或 cause；$hydrate 的失败继续沿 Store 上游路径传播，不把整次回放任意异常都改成本包码。

rows: Runtime action 的非 start 事件自动生成记录；maxTrace 限制条数。
必填去掉 timestamp 的 action 对象，通常至少 name；读取自身可枚举属性后由 now() 补时间戳，再检查终态并发布。
保存原始 IRuntimeTraceEvent，独立受 maxTrace 限制，不转换事件对象。

blocks.text: Store 定义中的方法由 Store 包装成具名 action，名称通常为 debugName.方法名。成功 end 和失败 error 都会记录，error 字段只在失败时提供。$batch / $set / $hydrate 不经 Store 方法的 runTracedAction 包装，不能因此期待自动出现 action；可自行 recordAction。captureRuntimeTrace 为 false 时 trace 保持空，actions 仍接受手动记录。它关闭一条诊断订阅，不关闭状态历史，也不改变 Store 写入策略。

rows: timestamp、observable、observer，phase 为 connect / disconnect，可选 reason 为 retrack / invalidate / dispose。
timestamp、observer，phase 为 start / end / error，可选 durationMs / error。
timestamp、name，phase 为 start / end / error，可选 durationMs / error。

blocks.text: 节点描述符含 id、kind（observable / observer / computed）和可选 debugName；action 没有通用节点描述符。此联合由 reactive 维护，trace 的 timestamp 与 durationMs 使用 Runtime 的记录语义，不能假定都来自本会话 now。
actions / trace getter 每次也返回新冻结数组，但 action 条目和 trace 事件对象本身不被冻结，payload、error 等嵌套值保留引用。三条队列分别有界，不是总字节或整个应用内存上限；读取数组也会分配快照，不提供未经测量的速度结论。

记录准备中的 now、clone，回放 clone，以及 recordAction 属性读取失败由 CALLBACK_FAILED 分类。可注记、尚无身份的原生错误保留同一对象、类型和 stack；已有完整外包 source/code 则保留，冻结错误、非 Error 或身份冲突值以 cause 保留，反射身份读取失败也保留在聚合错误中。手动 record / recordAction / clear 及 jumpTo 的克隆准备抛错；自动 Store / Runtime 监听把失败交给 Runtime.reportError，phase 为 trace-listener，不反过来让已触发的正常业务写入因诊断失败而抛错。Runtime 自己负责收容 reporter 失败与宿主回退。
dispose() 无参数、同步且幂等：先把会话置为终态，再尝试 Store unsubscribe 和 trace unsubscribe 两个清理。一个清理失败直接重抛原错；多个失败生成 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError，errors 保留全部原错。即便第一次清理抛错，重复 dispose 也不重试或再次抛错。
终态后 record / recordAction / jumpTo / clear 均先抛 SESSION_DISPOSED；history / actions / trace 仍可读取，已有队列不清空，不再由会话监听增长。它不销毁借用的 Store / Runtime；调用方仍分别负责它们的释放。开发期按需创建会话，在组件卸载或调试结束时释放，避免持续保留诊断订阅与快照工作。
构造订阅失败时，按 trace unsubscribe、Store unsubscribe 尝试回滚；若回滚全成功原样抛出主错，有清理失败则 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError 的 errors 以主错开头，再列清理失败。订阅与单个清理异常保留实际提供者的公共身份，不强行改为本包码。

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: Jumping to an old state adds another history entry because a change listener treats replay writes as user edits.
Action notes evict needed states because history and tracing share one retention limit.
A failed debugging snapshot turns a business write into an exception because its callback is not isolated.
Closing a debug panel destroys the Store because session ownership is confused with application ownership.
The second path to a shared dependency disappears because a global visited set mistakes a diamond for a cycle.

Replay state without recording synchronous replay as another edit. Instead of adding a separate replay switch around a change listener, the example keeps history length stable during a jump and records the next edit, as shown in the scenario.

Retain recent history and actions independently. Rather than mixing notes and states in one capacity, the example demonstrates separate eviction and increasing ids after clear, as shown in the scenario.

Report automatic snapshot failure while completing the business write. The example keeps the diagnostic callback from breaking that write and checks original-error identity, manual failure, and the next recovered id in the scenario.
Release diagnostics without destroying the application Store. The example stops hidden history growth while leaving the Store writable, separating panel closure from state ownership in the scenario.
Keep both paths to a shared dependency. Rather than truncating a diamond with a global visited set, the example expands real Runtime nodes along both paths and checks zero depth in the scenario.

createStore starts at count 0 and borrows the default Runtime when runtime is omitted. Explicit flush completes this change notification before replay. captureRuntimeTrace false overrides enabled capture. Other defaults are maxHistory 100, maxTrace 1000, diagnostic clone, and Date.now. Cleanup releases the session and Store separately.
The same state-replay task, displayed without execution:

blocks.code:
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'

const store = createStore({ count: 0 })
const history = [store.$plain()]
const off = store.$subscribe(() => history.push(store.$plain())) // History has no retention bound
store.count = 1
store.$runtime.flush()
store.$hydrate(history[0]!)
store.$runtime.flush() // Replay adds history again, indistinguishable from an edit
void off // The panel still has not released its subscription

blocks.text: The preceding example uses jumpTo to suppress synchronous replay history and releases the diagnostic subscription in finally. The Store creator still disposes the Store separately. This handwritten version only displays the pitfalls of that same task and is not executed.

blocks.text: This module adds a local diagnostic session to an existing Store. It neither creates the Store nor rewrites or proxies its mutation path. It uses the Store's $subscribe, $runtime.subscribeTrace / reportError, $plain, and $hydrate, records in-memory history and actions, and exposes two independent reactive graph traversals. Use it to investigate state changes, failed actions, and dependencies; it is not durable auditing, network replay, or transactional reversal of external effects.

The only entry is `@migaia/store-devtools`. It exports createStoreDevTools, getDependencyTree, getObserverTree, five public data types, error codes, and three error factories. reactive, store-light, store-middleware, and utils are runtime dependencies. Still install reactive / store-light directly when your examples import them.

This module does not implement the browser extension protocol. Use Store Middleware and its createReduxDevToolsAdapter / connectDevTools for Redux DevTools. StoreDevtoolsCommand / IStoreDevtoolsCommand were removed from this entry; custom bridges import ReduxDevToolsCommand / IReduxDevToolsCommand from store-middleware. DISPATCH, COMMIT, JUMP_TO_STATE, JUMP_TO_ACTION, ROLLBACK, and RESET retain their values. This is an import migration, not another protocol layer.

`createStoreDevTools<S>(store, options?)` synchronously returns IStoreDevTools. store must be a real `IReactiveStore<S>` returned by createStore. The session borrows its Store and Runtime rather than disposing them. Omitted options is an empty object.

rows: 100; bounds history only and must be a positive safe integer.
1000; independently bounds actions and trace, with no maxActions option.
Enabled unless strictly false; false skips the Runtime trace subscription and automatic action capture.
Date.now; timestamps history and action records, and must be a function when supplied.
ClonePolicy.diagnostic; receives $plain() or retained history state and returns a record, and must be a function when supplied.

blocks.text: Null / non-object options produce INVALID_OPTION. Failed reflection or option-property reads use the same code and preserve the caught failure on cause. Construction obtains descriptors and then reads the five options; getters can run during those property reads. This admission does not promise to avoid all getters. Queue limits use nullish defaults before validation, rejecting zero, negatives, fractions, infinity, and NaN rather than clamping them. Non-function now / clone options also reject before subscription.

After configuration admission, construction synchronously records the initial entry, then subscribes to coarse changes of the selected Store. Trace capture subscribes to that Store's entire Runtime. Actions from another Store or runTracedAction on a shared Runtime can therefore appear; they are not automatically filtered to this Store. Invalid configuration acquires no subscriptions. A later subscription failure rolls back those already acquired; error retention is described below.

rows: Each read returns a new frozen chronological array of IStoreHistoryEntry values.
Defaults label to state change; prepares timestamp and state before allocating an id, appending, and returning the entry.
Requires a retained history id; missing or evicted ids produce UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY RangeError, otherwise clone(state) is passed to Store $hydrate.
Takes no arguments; prepares a replacement initial before clearing all three queues and publishing it, without resetting the id sequence.

blocks.text: IStoreHistoryEntry contains id, timestamp, label, and state. Its public fields have no additional readonly modifiers, but the published entry and top level of state are frozen. An array snapshot does not grow with later publication. Nested independence depends on clone rather than deep freezing every possible graph. maxHistory evicts the oldest entries, including initial; retaining an evicted id does not make it a valid jump target.

record obtains clone(store.$plain()). $plain includes signal-backed Store fields, excluding computed values, methods, and WASM fields. Default diagnostic cloning uses the shared structured-clone-first implementation for a best-effort copy. Unsupported or unsafe subtrees can remain aliases, and custom class prototypes need not survive. It does not redact secrets. Provide an explicit clone to remove tokens or other sensitive fields, or keep them outside recorded state.

Failed record / clear preparation publishes no partial history and consumes no id. Failed clear preparation preserves all existing queues. Preparation also rechecks whether a callback disposed the session; if so it throws SESSION_DISPOSED rather than publishing.

jumpTo is not a business transaction rollback. $hydrate writes known signal fields and follows the Store's own rules for ignoring unknown, derived, or WASM keys. Computed values recalculate from dependencies; external resources and already sent requests are not restored. A replay-depth counter suppresses history publication during synchronous replay, including nested jumpTo, rather than suppressing Runtime trace / actions or guaranteeing suppression of later scheduled notifications. Replay clone failures also use the existing CALLBACK_FAILED classification with the original error or cause retained. $hydrate failures continue through the upstream Store path; arbitrary replay exceptions are not all relabeled with a local code.

rows: timestamp and name, with optional payload, durationMs, and error.
Automatically records Runtime action events other than start, independently bounded by maxTrace.
Requires an action without timestamp, normally at least name; spreads its own enumerable properties, adds now(), rechecks disposal, then publishes.
Retains original IRuntimeTraceEvent values, independently bounded by maxTrace, without converting event objects.

blocks.text: Store-defined methods are wrapped as named actions, typically debugName.methodName. Both successful end and failed error events are recorded, with error supplied only on failure. $batch / $set / $hydrate do not pass through a Store method's runTracedAction wrapper, so those calls alone do not imply an action record; record one manually if needed. With captureRuntimeTrace false, trace stays empty while actions still accepts recordAction. This disables one diagnostic subscription rather than state history or the Store's mutation policy.

rows: timestamp, observable, and reason set / notify.
timestamp, observable, observer, phase connect / disconnect, and optional reason retrack / invalidate / dispose.
timestamp, observer, phase start / end / error, and optional durationMs / error.
timestamp, name, phase start / end / error, and optional durationMs / error.

blocks.text: Node descriptors contain id, kind (observable / observer / computed), and optional debugName; action has no general node descriptor. reactive owns this union. Runtime timestamps and durations follow Runtime semantics rather than necessarily using this session's now function.

actions / trace getters also return fresh frozen arrays, but action entries and trace events themselves are not frozen. Nested payloads and errors retain references. The three queues have independent entry limits, not a total byte or application-memory cap. Reading them allocates array snapshots; no measured speed conclusion follows.

Failures in record preparation's now / clone, replay clone, or recordAction property reads are classified as CALLBACK_FAILED. An extensible native error without an identity stays the same object with its type and stack. A complete foreign source/code remains unchanged. Frozen errors, non-Errors, or conflicting partial identities remain on cause, and failed identity reflection is retained in an aggregate. Manual record / recordAction / clear calls and jumpTo clone preparation throw. Automatic Store / Runtime listeners report through Runtime.reportError with phase trace-listener, preventing diagnostic failure from turning the triggering normal mutation into a thrown business error. Runtime owns reporter containment and host fallback.

dispose() takes no arguments, is synchronous and idempotent, and marks the session terminal before attempting Store and trace unsubscription. One cleanup failure is rethrown unchanged; multiple failures become CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError with all originals in errors. Even if the first call throws, later dispose calls neither repeat cleanup nor throw again.

After disposal, record / recordAction / jumpTo / clear first throw SESSION_DISPOSED. history / actions / trace remain readable without clearing retained data or further growth from session listeners. The borrowed Store and Runtime remain caller-owned. Create diagnostics when needed during development and dispose them when a component or debugging session ends to stop retained subscriptions and snapshot work.

Construction rollback attempts trace unsubscribe before Store unsubscribe. If cleanup succeeds, the primary failure propagates unchanged. Otherwise CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError.errors begins with that primary failure followed by cleanup errors. Subscription and single-cleanup exceptions retain their provider's public identity instead of being forcibly relabeled.

getDependencyTree(root, maxDepth?) reads observer deps and accepts real Runtime effect / computed handles or an extension IObserver. getObserverTree(root, maxDepth?) follows observable subs in reverse and accepts signal / computed handles or an extension IObservable. Neither requires a devtools session, creates business dependencies, or owns the nodes.

maxDepth defaults to 20 and must be a nonnegative safe integer. At 0, even the root's immediate edges remain unexpanded. Negative, fractional, NaN, and infinite values synchronously produce INVALID_OPTION RangeError. Traversal uses the actual graph; examples need no fabricated cycles or nodes.

rows: observable / observer, reflecting the node's role in this traversal direction.
The current observable version; a dependency root represented as observer has no version field.
The successors expanded in this tree.
True only when this node is already on the current recursion path, stopping expansion there.

blocks.text: A shared node reached through two distinct diamond branches is not circular and expands on both paths. Only an actual path revisit sets circular. Reaching maxDepth stops expansion without marking a cycle. A Computed has both roles: it is an observable child in dependency traversal and an observer child in subscriber traversal. These data dependencies are distinct from plugin capability graphs.
STORE_DEVTOOLS_SOURCE is @migaia/store-devtools. Branch on source / code rather than matching message text.

rows: A diagnostic mutation after disposal; create another session instead of retrying the retired one.
jumpTo id is absent from current history; RangeError, so choose a retained id.
Invalid options, getters, capacity, callback configuration, or tree depth; normally Error for options and RangeError for depth.
Unclassified recording-preparation callback, replay clone, or action-property failure; correct it and inspect the original or cause.
Multiple dispose failures, or construction failure plus rollback cleanup failure; inspect AggregateError.errors.

blocks.text: Three factories are public but rarely needed by ordinary callers. createStoreDevtoolsError(code, message, options?) returns a tagged native Error, with optional options.cause. createStoreDevtoolsRangeError(code, message) returns RangeError. createStoreDevtoolsAggregateError(code, errors, message) returns AggregateError; errors is a required readonly list retaining all values without deduplication. code and message are required, code has type IStoreDevtoolsErrorCode, and factories do not overwrite stack.

blocks.text: Save each scenario as an independent .ts file and run it in an ESM project with Node 24. They use real Stores, Runtimes, and public handles without a browser extension.

sections.heading: Replay retained state without creating replay history

blocks.text: An investigation needs to revisit an earlier Store state and then continue editing from it.
A plain change listener can record the hydration caused by replay as another user edit, making the history grow every time the investigator jumps.
Attach tools to a real Store, retain its initial id, and call jumpTo(); the session suppresses replay-generated history while later edits still record.

This example explicitly creates a Runtime and passes it to the Store. schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() makes scheduling synchronous for stepwise observation; omission uses Runtime's injected microtask scheduling. The Store begins with count 0 and options.runtime selects that instance. captureRuntimeTrace false disables automatic trace / actions without disabling state history. Other defaults are maxHistory 100, maxTrace 1000, diagnostic clone, and Date.now.
Output:
Output is `2 3`, `0 3`, `1 4`, then `0 true`: replay restores count without extending history, the next edit records again, and the initial state stays shallow-frozen.
jumpTo hydrates retained Store fields; it does not undo external side effects, restore evicted entries, or guarantee deep isolation for every diagnostic value.

sections.heading: Bound history and manual action queues independently

blocks.text: A long debugging session needs a small recent history while still retaining selected manual action notes.
One shared queue can make action notes evict states, and treating clear as a fresh session can reuse old ids or leave ambiguous anchors.
Set independent maxHistory and maxTrace limits, disable automatic trace, add manual actions, then clear and inspect the new initial entry.

maxHistory and maxTrace are both overridden to 2 but bound separate queues. Manual recordAction remains available with captureRuntimeTrace false. now: () => 100 supplies a deterministic timestamp, replacing Date.now. recordAction.name is its note and tools supplies timestamp. jumpTo takes a history id; clear takes no arguments and does not reset ids.
Output:

blocks.code:
2,3
second,third 0
true UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY
5 initial 0 0

blocks.text: Output is `2,3`, `second,third 0`, `true UNKNOWN_HISTORY_ENTRY`, then `5 initial 0 0`: queues keep their own newest entries and clear preserves the id sequence.
maxHistory defaults to 100; maxTrace defaults to 1000 for each of actions and trace, and captureRuntimeTrace false also disables automatic action capture.

sections.heading: Report snapshot failure without interrupting the business write

blocks.text: A diagnostic snapshot callback fails during an ordinary Store update, but the update must remain usable.
Letting that callback escape the Store listener turns a debugging failure into a business failure; reserving an id before preparation also leaves a hole after failure.
Use the real Runtime reporter and a failing clone callback; automatic capture reports the original error, while manual record throws it before publishing.

Runtime onError receives the actual error, collected in reports here; omission uses Runtime's default reporter. The custom clone only spreads the top level, throwing the same TypeError after fail is enabled; the default clone is diagnostic. captureRuntimeTrace false keeps this example focused on state snapshots. Omitted record label defaults to state change.
Output:

blocks.code:
1 1
true CALLBACK_FAILED
true
2

blocks.text: Output is `1 1`, `true CALLBACK_FAILED`, `true`, then `2`: the write succeeds, automatic reporting keeps the original TypeError, manual recording throws it, and recovery uses the next id.
Only diagnostic preparation is isolated here; unclassified replay clone failures throw with `CALLBACK_FAILED`, while Store hydration keeps its own failure path; this custom clone is a shallow spread.

sections.heading: Release diagnostics while leaving the Store usable

blocks.text: A debugging panel closes, while the application still needs the Store it was inspecting.
Disposing the Store with the panel releases a resource owned by the application, but keeping the diagnostic listeners attached makes hidden history keep growing.
Dispose only the diagnostic session, retain its read-only queues, and continue writing the real Store; new diagnostic mutations reject.

dispose takes no arguments, is synchronous and idempotent, and retires record while leaving history readable. The Store and Runtime are borrowed, so tools.dispose does not destroy them. finally separately calls store.$dispose. Runtime scheduling and Store initial state follow the preceding examples.
Output:

blocks.code:
1 1
SESSION_DISPOSED
2

blocks.text: Output is `1 1`, `SESSION_DISPOSED`, then `2`: repeated disposal is harmless, the old history remains readable and unchanged, and the caller-owned Store still accepts writes.
Session dispose detaches its Store and Runtime subscriptions; it does not clear queues or dispose the borrowed Store, which the caller releases separately.

sections.heading: Expand both paths of a shared dependency

blocks.text: Two computed values share one signal, and an effect reads both; an investigation needs to see both paths back to that signal.
A global visited set can label the second shared path as a cycle or omit it, even though that path does not recurse into itself.
Build the diamond with real Runtime handles and inspect the effect; traversal tracks only the current path and respects an explicit depth bound.

The source signal starts at 1. left / right read it and the effect reads both computed values, creating real dependencies. debugName labels diagnostics; tree labels otherwise fall back to constructor.name and AnonymousReactiveNode. getDependencyTree defaults maxDepth to 20, while explicit 0 leaves direct edges unexpanded. The function does not own these handles, so their creator releases them.
Output:

blocks.code:
view left,right
source,source
true
0

blocks.text: Output is `view left,right`, `source,source`, `true`, then `0`: both shared paths expand without a cycle flag, and maxDepth zero returns no direct edges.
The default depth is 20 and must be a nonnegative safe integer; this is an instantaneous upstream view, not a new subscription or an effect execution.

sections.heading: Find current subscribers after an effect releases its subscription

blocks.text: A signal feeds a computed value and two effects, but one panel has already stopped observing it.
A separately maintained subscriber list can retain the closed panel and mislead an investigation into what can still rerun.
Read the real signal's downstream tree, dispose one effect through its public handle, and inspect again without creating a diagnostic session.

count starts at 2, total computes count × 2, and both effects read total. debugName labels the nodes. getObserverTree accepts real signal / computed handles, defaults maxDepth to 20, and returns only the root at 0. Its returned tree is not a live subscription; call it again after first.dispose to read current relationships.
Output:

blocks.code:
count total
first,second
second
0

blocks.text: Output is `count total`, `first,second`, `second`, then `0`: the fresh tree reflects public effect disposal, while a zero depth omits all subscriber edges.
The default depth is 20; returned trees are point-in-time data and do not update themselves after another subscription change.

Replay clone failures also use the existing CALLBACK_FAILED classification with the original error or cause retained. $hydrate failures continue through the upstream Store path; arbitrary replay exceptions are not all relabeled with a local code.

rows: timestamp and name, with optional payload, durationMs, and error.
Automatically records Runtime action events other than start, independently bounded by maxTrace.
Requires an action without timestamp, normally at least name; spreads its own enumerable properties, adds now(), rechecks disposal, then publishes.
Retains original IRuntimeTraceEvent values, independently bounded by maxTrace, without converting event objects.

blocks.text: Store-defined methods are wrapped as named actions, typically debugName.methodName. Both successful end and failed error events are recorded, with error supplied only on failure. $batch / $set / $hydrate do not pass through a Store method's runTracedAction wrapper, so those calls alone do not imply an action record; record one manually if needed. With captureRuntimeTrace false, trace stays empty while actions still accepts recordAction. This disables one diagnostic subscription rather than state history or the Store's mutation policy.

rows: timestamp, observable, and reason set / notify.
timestamp, observable, observer, phase connect / disconnect, and optional reason retrack / invalidate / dispose.
timestamp, observer, phase start / end / error, and optional durationMs / error.
timestamp, name, phase start / end / error, and optional durationMs / error.

blocks.text: Node descriptors contain id, kind (observable / observer / computed), and optional debugName; action has no general node descriptor. reactive owns this union. Runtime timestamps and durations follow Runtime semantics rather than necessarily using this session's now function.

actions / trace getters also return fresh frozen arrays, but action entries and trace events themselves are not frozen. Nested payloads and errors retain references. The three queues have independent entry limits, not a total byte or application-memory cap. Reading them allocates array snapshots; no measured speed conclusion follows.

Failures in record preparation's now / clone, replay clone, or recordAction property reads are classified as CALLBACK_FAILED. An extensible native error without an identity stays the same object with its type and stack. A complete foreign source/code remains unchanged. Frozen errors, non-Errors, or conflicting partial identities remain on cause, and failed identity reflection is retained in an aggregate. Manual record / recordAction / clear calls and jumpTo clone preparation throw. Automatic Store / Runtime listeners report through Runtime.reportError with phase trace-listener, preventing diagnostic failure from turning the triggering normal mutation into a thrown business error. Runtime owns reporter containment and host fallback.

dispose() takes no arguments, is synchronous and idempotent, and marks the session terminal before attempting Store and trace unsubscription. One cleanup failure is rethrown unchanged; multiple failures become CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError with all originals in errors. Even if the first call throws, later dispose calls neither repeat cleanup nor throw again.

After disposal, record / recordAction / jumpTo / clear first throw SESSION_DISPOSED. history / actions / trace remain readable without clearing retained data or further growth from session listeners. The borrowed Store and Runtime remain caller-owned. Create diagnostics when needed during development and dispose them when a component or debugging session ends to stop retained subscriptions and snapshot work.

Construction rollback attempts trace unsubscribe before Store unsubscribe. If cleanup succeeds, the primary failure propagates unchanged. Otherwise CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError.errors begins with that primary failure followed by cleanup errors. Subscription and single-cleanup exceptions retain their provider's public identity instead of being forcibly relabeled.

getDependencyTree(root, maxDepth?) reads observer deps and accepts real Runtime effect / computed handles or an extension IObserver. getObserverTree(root, maxDepth?) follows observable subs in reverse and accepts signal / computed handles or an extension IObservable. Neither requires a devtools session, creates business dependencies, or owns the nodes.

maxDepth defaults to 20 and must be a nonnegative safe integer. At 0, even the root's immediate edges remain unexpanded. Negative, fractional, NaN, and infinite values synchronously produce INVALID_OPTION RangeError. Traversal uses the actual graph; examples need no fabricated cycles or nodes.

rows: observable / observer, reflecting the node's role in this traversal direction.
The current observable version; a dependency root represented as observer has no version field.
The successors expanded in this tree.
True only when this node is already on the current recursion path, stopping expansion there.

blocks.text: A shared node reached through two distinct diamond branches is not circular and expands on both paths. Only an actual path revisit sets circular. Reaching maxDepth stops expansion without marking a cycle. A Computed has both roles: it is an observable child in dependency traversal and an observer child in subscriber traversal. These data dependencies are distinct from plugin capability graphs.
STORE_DEVTOOLS_SOURCE is @migaia/store-devtools. Branch on source / code rather than matching message text.

rows: A diagnostic mutation after disposal; create another session instead of retrying the retired one.
jumpTo id is absent from current history; RangeError, so choose a retained id.
Invalid options, getters, capacity, callback configuration, or tree depth; normally Error for options and RangeError for depth.
Unclassified recording-preparation callback, replay clone, or action-property failure; correct it and inspect the original or cause.
Multiple dispose failures, or construction failure plus rollback cleanup failure; inspect AggregateError.errors.

blocks.text: Three factories are public but rarely needed by ordinary callers. createStoreDevtoolsError(code, message, options?) returns a tagged native Error, with optional options.cause. createStoreDevtoolsRangeError(code, message) returns RangeError. createStoreDevtoolsAggregateError(code, errors, message) returns AggregateError; errors is a required readonly list retaining all values without deduplication. code and message are required, code has type IStoreDevtoolsErrorCode, and factories do not overwrite stack.

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { ObservableObject } from '@migaia/store-indexed'

const runtime = createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })
const user = new ObservableObject({ name: '艾达', age: 30 }, runtime)
const seen: string[] = []
const watch = runtime.effect(() => {
  seen.push(user.get('name'))
  user.peek('age')
})
user.set('age', 31)
user.set('name', '格蕾丝')
console.log(JSON.stringify(seen))
watch.dispose()
user.dispose()

blocks.code: ["艾达","格蕾丝"]

sections.heading: Cell 生命周期、清理与 guard

blocks.text: 新 cell 在最后一个订阅者离开时尝试回收；从未成功接上观察者的临时 cell 通过所属 Runtime 的 idle 通道清理，默认微任务。删除成员时仍有观察者的 cell 保留并发布缺失值，直到退订。Object/Map/Set 的 prune 只整理已删除且无观察者的 key/member，不释放活观察者；Array 仅走自动路径。
集合不会感知组件卸载或请求结束，应用必须调用 dispose。dispose 通过集合 owner 同时释放仍拥有的 Signal 与 pool 引用，重复是空操作；随后数据读写及 prune 拒绝，但仍可读 runtime/disposed。借入 Runtime 不由集合销毁。它不承诺清空 backing data、清除已有快照或销毁应用对象。

guard 是同步写入许可检查，签名 `assertMutationAllowed(operation?:string):void`，每个公开写入入口调用一次，包括最终没有变化的写入；读方法不调用。操作名如 `users.set(u1)`，来自 debugName 与具体方法，不是 IndexedOperation 值。Object.update 的 guard 先于 updater；拒绝时 updater 不执行。可组合 store-middleware 的 MutationPolicy 与 runInAction，策略及 action 范围由那个包负责；使用它应另行安装该包。本包只保证外层提交没有发生，不回滚回调自己的外部副作用。
`IndexedOperation` 为消费方诊断/日志提供 `read:'read'`、`write:'write'`、`delete:'delete'`；`IIndexedOperation` 是这些值的联合。本包方法不直接引用该词表。

blocks.text: 资料视图显示姓名，同时读取年龄作本地判断；修改年龄不应重新运行姓名视图，修改姓名才需要更新。
订阅整个对象信号会把所有字段绑到同一次更新；无意中追踪年龄读取，也会给视图增加本来不需要的依赖。
用 `ObservableObject.get` 订阅所需字段，用 `peek` 旁读其他字段；直接安装 `@migaia/reactive`，本例的 `schedulerStrategy` 是运行时选项，用同步执行让输出顺序确定。

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { ObservableObject } from '@migaia/store-indexed'

const runtime = createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })
const user = new ObservableObject({ name: '艾达', age: 30 }, runtime)
const seen: string[] = []
const watch = runtime.effect(() => {
  seen.push(user.get('name'))
  user.peek('age')
})
user.set('age', 31)
user.set('name', '格蕾丝')
console.log(JSON.stringify(seen))
watch.dispose()
user.dispose()

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code: ["艾达","格蕾丝"]

blocks.text: 输出 `["艾达","格蕾丝"]`；年龄写入没有新增观察记录，姓名写入只追加一个新值。
只有追踪上下文中的 `get` 才订阅该键，`peek` 始终不追踪；`Object.has` 与 `keys` 则订阅整组键的结构，本例借用运行时，并显式释放观察者与集合。

`initial` 是必填的姓名/年龄对象；`runtime` 使用本例 createRuntime 的实例，省略则 defaultRuntime。options 省略为 `{}`，mutationGuard 为 undefined，debugName 默认为 `'ObservableObject'`。get/set/peek 的 key 均为 initial 推导出的字符串键，set 接受该字段类型。

sections.id: 保留旧顶层快照并看清浅复制边界
sections.heading: 保留旧顶层快照并看清浅复制边界

blocks.text: 历史面板需要保留此前顶层字段的值，也需要知道修改嵌套对象是否会改变那份旧记录。
直接保留底层对象引用，会在字段重新赋值后丢失历史；仅冻结外层结构，也不会让引用到的嵌套对象变成不可变数据。
`ObservableObject.snapshot` 返回浅冻结、空原型的对象，并在集合修订变化前复用缓存；它能保留旧顶层值，需要独立的嵌套数据时仍须由应用复制。
输出：

blocks.code:
true true true
1 2 false
9 9
1

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true true true`、`1 2 false`、`9 9`、`1`；修订未变时复用同一冻结结果，顶层赋值后产生新快照，但两者仍引用同一个嵌套对象。
集合释放后快照仍可读取；浅冻结不提供嵌套数据的历史版本，省略运行时时使用 `defaultRuntime`，省略集合选项时不设置 `mutationGuard`，诊断名使用类名。
nested 对象属于应用，构造、snapshot、set 均不深拷贝它。省略 runtime/options 使用 defaultRuntime、无 guard 与类名诊断前缀；count 顶层赋值会产生新 revision，nested.visits 原地修改不会。

sections.id: 分开观察一行下标与列表长度
sections.heading: 分开观察一行下标与列表长度

blocks.text: 表格观察第一行并显示总行数；修改其他行不应影响这两处观察，追加行则只需更新数量。
观察整个数组会把每次编辑都当成列表变化；把下标当作稳定记录 ID，也会在删除首项、后续值向前移动时出错。
`ObservableArray.at` 订阅下标，`length` 订阅结构；本例直接安装并传入 `@migaia/reactive` 的运行时，用其同步 `schedulerStrategy` 明确展示观察次数。

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { ObservableArray } from '@migaia/store-indexed'

const runtime = createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })
const rows = new ObservableArray([10, 20], runtime)
let indexRuns = 0
let lengthRuns = 0
const indexWatch = runtime.effect(() => {
  rows.at(0)
  indexRuns += 1
})
const lengthWatch = runtime.effect(() => {
  void rows.length
  lengthRuns += 1
})
rows.set(1, 21)
console.log(indexRuns, lengthRuns)
rows.set(0, 11)
console.log(indexRuns, lengthRuns)
rows.push(30)
console.log(indexRuns, lengthRuns)
rows.splice(0, 1)
console.log(indexRuns, lengthRuns, rows.at(0))
indexWatch.dispose()
lengthWatch.dispose()
rows.dispose()

blocks.text: 输出：
逐行输出 `1 1`、`2 1`、`2 2`、`3 3 21`；旁边一行的修改被忽略，下标 `0` 独立更新，追加只更新长度，删除首项后 `21` 移入观察位置。
下标表示位置，不表示实体；`set` 只接受已有范围内的非负整数，`at` 还接受负整数，次数均包括首次运行观察函数，本例只借用运行时。
initial 是可迭代数值序列，省略为 `[]`；runtime 显式传入，options 默认 `{}`、无 guard、debugName 为 `'ObservableArray'`。at 支持整数负下标，set 仅已有非负整数；push 使用 rest 参数，splice 本例 start=0/deleteCount=1。

sections.id: 替换输入读取失败时保留旧数组
sections.heading: 替换输入读取失败时保留旧数组

blocks.text: 替换数据源先产出一行，随后读取失败；界面集合应保留完整旧内容，不能只显示读到一半的新输入。
在消费迭代器前清空旧列表，等于过早提交；每拿到一项就追加，也会在下一次迭代抛错时暴露半份结果。
`ObservableArray.replace` 先完整读取可迭代输入，再提交替换；本例让真实生成器产出一项后抛错，随后再传入合法替换值。
输出：

blocks.code:
INVALID_OPTION true
[1,2]
[4,5]

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `INVALID_OPTION true`、`[1,2]`、`[4,5]`；迭代错误保留在 `cause`，失败输入没有提交半份替换，之后合法输入仍能成功。
原子准备只保证当前集合不被部分修改，不撤销迭代器自身的副作用；替换保留嵌套值引用，也接受按字符迭代的字符串，等长输入仍须比较各项值。
replace 的 values 是完整可迭代输入；默认构造 runtime 为 defaultRuntime，options 无 guard、debugName 为 `'ObservableArray'`。incoming 在产出一个值后抛出应用错误，catch 校验 code 与 cause 身份；有效数组替换随后仍可用。

sections.id: 分别观察键顺序与值的变化
sections.heading: 分别观察键顺序与值的变化

blocks.text: 导航列表需要映射的键，摘要区域需要值；更新已有值时，应刷新摘要，而不必重建键列表。
订阅整个映射无法区分值修改与结构变化；只比较成员是否相同，又会漏掉同一批条目调整插入顺序的替换。
`ObservableMap.keys` 订阅结构，`valuesArray` 订阅值迭代，`replace` 也检查插入顺序；直接安装 `@migaia/reactive`，本例选用同步运行时调度来展示准确次数。

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { ObservableMap } from '@migaia/store-indexed'

const runtime = createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })
const values = new ObservableMap<string, number>(
  [
    ['a', 1],
    ['b', 2]
  ],
  runtime
)
let keyRuns = 0
let valueRuns = 0
const keysWatch = runtime.effect(() => {
  values.keys()
  keyRuns += 1
})
const valuesWatch = runtime.effect(() => {
  values.valuesArray()
  valueRuns += 1
})
values.set('a', 10)
console.log(keyRuns, valueRuns)
values.replace([
  ['b', 2],
  ['a', 10]
])
console.log(keyRuns, valueRuns, JSON.stringify(values.keys()), JSON.stringify(values.valuesArray()))
values.replace([
  ['b', 2],
  ['a', 10]
])
console.log(keyRuns, valueRuns)
keysWatch.dispose()
valuesWatch.dispose()
values.dispose()

blocks.text: 输出：
逐行输出 `1 2`、`2 3 ["b","a"] [2,10]`、`2 3`；修改 `a` 只更新值观察者，重排分别更新两者一次，重复相同有序内容则都不更新。
`size` 也订阅结构，重排时即使数量不变仍可能重跑；`Map.has` 复用所选键的值信号，因此同键换值也可能让它重跑，它不是独立的仅成员存在性信号。
initial 为 `[key,value]` 可迭代条目，省略为空表；本例显式传 runtime，options 默认无 guard 与 `'ObservableMap'` 诊断名。set 的两个参数分别是 key 与 value；replace 使用给定条目的插入顺序，重复相同有序内容不通知。

sections.id: 只观察一个选中成员并独立释放集合
sections.heading: 只观察一个选中成员并独立释放集合

blocks.text: 选择标记只关心条目 `a`，用户还会选择其他条目；关闭这份集合，也不能关闭其他应用状态共用的运行时。
观察整个 `Set` 会在每次无关选择时重跑标记；把借用的运行时和单个集合一起销毁，又会破坏运行时的其他使用者。
`ObservableSet.has` 订阅单个成员，显式释放观察者和集合后，传入的运行时仍可使用；直接安装 `@migaia/reactive`，同步运行时调度仅用于本例展示。

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { ObservableSet } from '@migaia/store-indexed'

const runtime = createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })
const selected = new ObservableSet(['a'], runtime)
let runs = 0
let present = false
const watch = runtime.effect(() => {
  present = selected.has('a')
  runs += 1
})
selected.add('b')
console.log(runs, present)
selected.delete('a')
console.log(runs, present)
selected.add('a')
console.log(runs, present)
watch.dispose()
selected.dispose()
selected.dispose()
const count = runtime.signal(1)
count.value = 2
console.log(selected.disposed, count.value)
count.dispose()

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
1 true
2 false
3 true
true 2

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `1 true`、`2 false`、`3 true`、`true 2`；添加 `b` 不重跑 `a` 的观察者，删除与恢复 `a` 会更新，幂等释放集合后，新建的运行时信号仍能使用。
集合拥有内部信号，不拥有运行时或嵌套应用对象；先释放观察者，集合释放后的数据访问会抛 `COLLECTION_DISPOSED`，`disposed` 状态本身仍可读取。
initial 默认 `[]`，本例传入成员 `'a'`；runtime 显式借入，options 默认无 guard 与 `'ObservableSet'` 诊断名。has/add/delete 参数是成员值；dispose 没有参数，重复为空操作。最后 runtime.signal(1) 创建独立的值格子，证明运行时仍可使用。

本包只有根导出，提供四个集合类、`IObservableCollectionOptions`、`IndexedOperation`/`IIndexedOperation` 和错误码/错误构造函数。内部 cell pool 与 registry 不是导入入口。普通 dependencies 为 `@migaia/reactive`、`@migaia/utils`、`@migaia/store-light`；后者在集合代码中仅提供 `IMutationGuard` 类型，没有 peerDependencies。示例直接导入 reactive，安装时也要显式列出它。
适合表格行、消息列表等只观察部分位置的集合。只需一个整体值时，`runtime.signal(value)` 更直接。四类都用命名方法建立依赖，不拦截用户对象的属性访问；嵌套对象的原地修改不自动成为集合写入。数组按位置定位，splice/pop/replace 后同一索引可以表示另一条记录；按稳定实体标识定位时，应由应用选择按 key 的集合。
唯一创建入口是类构造，参数统一为 `(initial, runtime?, options?)`。旧薄工厂已经移除；原 `(initial, options, runtime)` 调用迁移时交换后两参数，没有工厂别名或兼容 wrapper。

rows: 读取自有可枚举字符串键及其值；键类型为 `keyof T & string`，符号键不进入集合
默认 `[]`，接受字符串并按字符物化
默认 `[]`；条目按原生 Map 规则接纳，拒绝字符串作为外层输入
默认 `[]`，接受字符串，成员按原生 Set 规则去重

blocks.text: 四类的 `runtime` 默认 `defaultRuntime`，绑定后不转移；公开只读 `runtime` 和 `disposed:boolean`。默认 `options={}`：

rows: Signal 调试名前缀、disposed 信息与 guard 操作名前缀

blocks.text: options 为 null/非 object、debugName 非 undefined 且非 string，或读取选项失败，抛带 `INVALID_OPTION` 的 TypeError；读取失败的原错在 cause。构造先读完整初值，再接纳集合的 Runtime 所有权。Object 的 getter、Iterable 的 `Symbol.iterator` getter/调用/next、Map 条目形状失败也归 `INVALID_OPTION`，原错通过 cause 保留。迭代器入口 getter 和捕获的函数各使用一次，函数以原 iterable 为 receiver。replace 也先物化全部输入，输入失败不提交部分替换。
cell 是“某个 key、索引或成员自己的响应式格子”。Object.get、Array.at、Map.get/has、Set.has 只在集合 Runtime 正在追踪时才物化对应 cell；普通同步读取直接访问 backing data，不创建 cell。peek 是显式非追踪读取，即使在 effect/computed 中也不建立依赖；Set 没有 peek。

rows: 全部 key 的结构信号；其他 key 增删也会触发 has 的观察者
修订信号，任意实际值或键变化
有效位置的值 cell；负索引及越界读取还依赖长度结构
长度结构 / 整体修订
同一个 key 的值 cell；has 也会因该 key 的已有值改变重算
key 集合及插入顺序的结构信号
值与迭代顺序的迭代信号
该成员自己的 boolean cell
成员与顺序的结构信号

blocks.text: 追踪型读取不能接入另一个 Runtime 的依赖图；本包检测的跨图读取为 `CROSS_RUNTIME`，底层 reactive 检测的失败保留其实际错误归属。普通非追踪读取与 peek 可以跨 Runtime 取值。多请求或多应用隔离应显式构造 Runtime，并把对应观察者放进同一 Runtime。
keys() 仍会分配键数组，且在追踪中订阅结构；它不是零成本遍历。peek 不建 cell，但 Array.peek() 会复制整个数组。replace 只逐个通知已经物化的 cell；等长 Array 仍可能比较全部值，Map/Set 仍比较内容与顺序，不承诺常数开销或某个速度。

rows: 追踪 / 非追踪读取；删除后运行时可为 undefined，即使静态 T[K] 未含 undefined
判断键是否存在，追踪整体结构
batch 内更新；新增键升结构，新增或 Object.is 不等的值升修订
先 guard，再校验/调用 updater，再提交；updater 非函数为 INVALID_OPTION
返回是否存在；缺失键不通知，存在则发布缺失值并提升结构/修订
按 revision 缓存、浅冻结、空原型对象
先读取所有属性，再一次 batch 删除缺失键、设置新值；只调用一次 guard
回收已删除且无观察者的 cell，返回回收数

blocks.text: Object 的 key 必须是字符串，否则 INVALID_OPTION；使用固定字面量 T 时不能通过 set 的类型签名新增未声明键，需要开放键集合可显式使用 `Record<string, V>`。snapshot 用空原型对象，让 `__proto__` 成为普通数据键；冻结只覆盖外层对象，嵌套值仍是原引用。

rows: 整数索引，支持负数从末尾计数；越界返回 undefined 并追踪结构
revision 缓存的浅冻结数组
每次复制并浅冻结，不追踪
必须在 [0,length)；不支持负索引，Object.is 相等不通知
返回新长度；空参数不通知
移除末项；空数组不通知
按原生 splice 位置转换，返回浅冻结的被删除数组
幂等关闭，没有手动 prune

blocks.text: at/set 的非整数索引为 TypeError `INVALID_INDEX`；set 越界为 RangeError `INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE`。splice 省略 deleteCount 删除到末尾，显式 undefined 按 0；JavaScript 零参数调用是空操作。显式零删除且无插入同样不改变集合。splice/replace/clear 在一次 batch 更新已物化 cell，长度变化才通知结构，长度或逐项 Object.is 变化才升修订。set 也把值 cell 与修订放在同一 batch，同步观察者不会看到“新元素、旧快照”的混合状态。

追踪该 key 的值 cell，不是只在存在性变化时通知
已有值 Object.is 相等时不通知，否则更新值 cell 与迭代；新增 key 也更新结构

blocks.text: 原生 Map 的 key 身份规则仍适用。replace 即使成员和值未变，只要重新排序，keys/迭代/snapshot 的观察者仍会失效；单 key 观察不因此变成整个集合订阅。clear/replace 不逐 key 调用公开写方法，guard 只在入口执行一次。

已有成员不通知，否则发布 true 并升结构

blocks.text: Set 采用原生成员身份规则，值就是成员，没有单独的 revision/iteration 信号，也没有 get 或 peek。replace 的重排属于可观察变化；clear/replace 只调用一次 guard、最多提升一次结构信号。

sections.heading: Cell 生命周期、清理与 guard

blocks.text: 新 cell 在最后一个订阅者离开时尝试回收；从未成功接上观察者的临时 cell 通过所属 Runtime 的 idle 通道清理，默认微任务。删除成员时仍有观察者的 cell 保留并发布缺失值，直到退订。Object/Map/Set 的 prune 只整理已删除且无观察者的 key/member，不释放活观察者；Array 仅走自动路径。
集合不会感知组件卸载或请求结束，应用必须调用 dispose。dispose 通过集合 owner 同时释放仍拥有的 Signal 与 pool 引用，重复是空操作；随后数据读写及 prune 拒绝，但仍可读 runtime/disposed。借入 Runtime 不由集合销毁。它不承诺清空 backing data、清除已有快照或销毁应用对象。

guard 是同步写入许可检查，签名 `assertMutationAllowed(operation?:string):void`，每个公开写入入口调用一次，包括最终没有变化的写入；读方法不调用。操作名如 `users.set(u1)`，来自 debugName 与具体方法，不是 IndexedOperation 值。Object.update 的 guard 先于 updater；拒绝时 updater 不执行。可组合 store-middleware 的 MutationPolicy 与 runInAction，策略及 action 范围由那个包负责；使用它应另行安装该包。本包只保证外层提交没有发生，不回滚回调自己的外部副作用。
`IndexedOperation` 为消费方诊断/日志提供 `read:'read'`、`write:'write'`、`delete:'delete'`；`IIndexedOperation` 是这些值的联合。本包方法不直接引用该词表。

sections.heading: Ownership, entry point, and intended use

blocks.text: The module has one root entry: four collection classes, `IObservableCollectionOptions`, `IndexedOperation`/`IIndexedOperation`, and the error codes and error factories. Internal cell pools and registries are not import paths. Ordinary dependencies are `@migaia/reactive`, `@migaia/utils`, and `@migaia/store-light`; collection code uses the last module only for the `IMutationGuard` type. There are no peerDependencies. These examples import reactive directly, so install it explicitly too.

Use these collections for tables or message lists where observers read only some positions. A single `runtime.signal(value)` is simpler when the whole value is the unit of observation. Named methods establish dependencies; the classes do not intercept property access on user objects. Mutating a nested object in place does not become a collection write. Arrays identify positions: splice/pop/replace can make one index refer to a different record. Choose a keyed collection when record identity must remain stable.

Class constructors are the only creation entry points, with `(initial, runtime?, options?)`. The former thin factories were removed. Migrate old `(initial, options, runtime)` calls by swapping the last two arguments; no factory aliases or compatibility wrappers remain.

A cell is one reactive value for a key, index, or member. Object.get, Array.at, Map.get/has, and Set.has materialize that cell only while their Runtime is tracking. Ordinary synchronous reads access backing data without creating cells. peek explicitly avoids tracking even inside an effect/computed; Set has no peek.

sections.heading: Cell lifetime, disposal, and mutation guards

blocks.text: A new cell attempts reclamation when its last subscriber leaves. A speculative cell that never gained an observer is cleaned through its Runtime's idle channel, using microtasks by default. Deleting a still-observed member retains its cell and publishes absence until observers leave. Object/Map/Set prune only deleted, unobserved keys/members; it cannot release live observers. Arrays use automatic reclamation only.

Collections do not detect component unmount or request completion; the application must dispose them. The collection owner releases its remaining Signals and pool references together. Repeated disposal is a no-op. Later data reads/writes and prune reject, while runtime/disposed remain readable. The borrowed Runtime is not destroyed. Disposal does not promise to clear backing data, erase existing snapshots, or destroy application objects.

A guard is a synchronous permission check with `assertMutationAllowed(operation?:string):void`. Each public write entry invokes it once, including writes that eventually make no change; reads do not. Operation names such as `users.set(u1)` combine debugName and the concrete method, rather than using IndexedOperation values. Object.update invokes the guard before its updater; rejection prevents the updater from running. MutationPolicy/runInAction from store-middleware can supply an action policy, whose action scope belongs to that module; install it separately if used. Only the outer collection commit is prevented: callback-owned external effects are not rolled back.

`IndexedOperation` gives diagnostic/logging consumers `read:'read'`, `write:'write'`, and `delete:'delete'`. `IIndexedOperation` is the union of those values. Collection methods do not use the vocabulary directly.

blocks.text: A profile view renders a name while checking age for a local decision. Changing age should not rerun the name view; changing the name should.

Use ObservableObject.get for the field to track and peek for the untracked read. Install reactive directly; schedulerStrategy is its Runtime option, set here to run effects synchronously.

Only tracked get reads subscribe to that key; peek never tracks. Object.has and keys track the whole key structure instead. The supplied Runtime is borrowed, and observers and collection are explicitly disposed.

initial is the required name/age object. runtime is the instance created here, or defaultRuntime when omitted. Omitted options use `{}`, undefined mutationGuard, and debugName `'ObservableObject'`. get/set/peek keys come from the inferred string-key domain, and set requires the field's value type.

sections.heading: Keep a previous top-level snapshot without assuming a deep copy

blocks.text: A history panel needs an earlier record of top-level field assignments. It also needs to know whether editing a nested object changes that earlier record.
Keeping the backing object loses history when fields are reassigned. Freezing only its outer shape does not make referenced nested objects immutable.

ObservableObject.snapshot caches a shallow-frozen null-prototype object until a collection revision changes. Keep that result for earlier top-level values; copy nested application data separately when needed.
Output:

blocks.code:
true true true
1 2 false
9 9
1

blocks.text: Prints `true true true`, `1 2 false`, `9 9`, and `1`. An unchanged revision reuses one frozen result; a later assignment creates another, while both retain the same nested object.

The snapshot remains readable after collection disposal. Its freeze is shallow and does not provide deep history. Omitting Runtime uses defaultRuntime; omitting collection options uses no mutationGuard and the class debugName.

The application owns nested; construction, snapshot, and set do not deep-clone it. Omitting runtime/options uses defaultRuntime, no guard, and the class debug name. Reassigning count advances revision, while an in-place nested.visits change does not.

sections.heading: Separate one row index from the list length

blocks.text: A table watches its first row and shows a row count. Updating another row should affect neither observation; appending should update only the count.
Watching an entire array treats every edit as a list change. Assuming an index is a stable record ID also breaks when removing the first item moves every later value.
ObservableArray.at tracks an index, while length tracks structure. Use a directly installed reactive Runtime; its synchronous schedulerStrategy makes the observer counts explicit here.

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { ObservableArray } from '@migaia/store-indexed'

const runtime = createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })
const rows = new ObservableArray([10, 20], runtime)
let indexRuns = 0
let lengthRuns = 0
const indexWatch = runtime.effect(() => {
  rows.at(0)
  indexRuns += 1
})
const lengthWatch = runtime.effect(() => {
  void rows.length
  lengthRuns += 1
})
rows.set(1, 21)
console.log(indexRuns, lengthRuns)
rows.set(0, 11)
console.log(indexRuns, lengthRuns)
rows.push(30)
console.log(indexRuns, lengthRuns)
rows.splice(0, 1)
console.log(indexRuns, lengthRuns, rows.at(0))
indexWatch.dispose()
lengthWatch.dispose()
rows.dispose()

blocks.text: Output:
Prints `1 1`, `2 1`, `2 2`, then `3 3 21`. A sibling edit is ignored, index 0 changes independently, append changes length, and splice moves 21 into the watched position.

Indices identify positions, not entities. set accepts only existing nonnegative integer positions; at also accepts negative integers. Every displayed count includes the initial effect run, and the Runtime is borrowed.

initial is an iterable of numbers, defaulting to `[]`. runtime is supplied explicitly; omitted options mean `{}`, no guard, and debugName `'ObservableArray'`. at supports negative integer positions, set only existing nonnegative integers. push uses rest arguments; splice here uses start 0 and deleteCount 1.

sections.heading: Preserve the old array when replacement input fails

blocks.text: A streamed replacement yields one row and then fails. The visible collection should keep its complete previous contents rather than show half the new input.
Clearing the old list before consuming an iterator commits too early. Pushing each incoming item also exposes partial results if the next iterator step throws.
ObservableArray.replace materializes its whole iterable before committing. This example uses a real generator that throws after one value, then supplies a valid replacement.
Output:

blocks.code:
INVALID_OPTION true
[1,2]
[4,5]

blocks.text: Prints `INVALID_OPTION true`, `[1,2]`, and `[4,5]`. The iterator error stays on cause, no partial replacement is committed, and a later valid input succeeds.

Input preparation is atomic for this collection; it does not undo effects performed by the iterator itself. Replacement is shallow, strings are accepted as character iterables, and equal-length input still requires value comparisons.

replace requires a complete iterable. The omitted construction runtime is defaultRuntime; options use no guard and debugName `'ObservableArray'`. incoming throws an application error after one item, and the catch checks code and cause identity. A valid array replacement remains usable afterward.

sections.heading: Observe key order separately from changing values

blocks.text: A navigation list needs map keys, while a summary displays values. Updating an existing value should refresh the summary without rebuilding the key list.
One whole-map subscription cannot distinguish value edits from structural changes. Comparing membership alone also misses a replacement that reorders the same entries.

ObservableMap.keys tracks structure and valuesArray tracks value iteration. replace also checks insertion order. Install reactive directly; the example selects synchronous Runtime scheduling for exact counts.

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { ObservableMap } from '@migaia/store-indexed'

const runtime = createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })
const values = new ObservableMap<string, number>(
  [
    ['a', 1],
    ['b', 2]
  ],
  runtime
)
let keyRuns = 0
let valueRuns = 0
const keysWatch = runtime.effect(() => {
  values.keys()
  keyRuns += 1
})
const valuesWatch = runtime.effect(() => {
  values.valuesArray()
  valueRuns += 1
})
values.set('a', 10)
console.log(keyRuns, valueRuns)
values.replace([
  ['b', 2],
  ['a', 10]
])
console.log(keyRuns, valueRuns, JSON.stringify(values.keys()), JSON.stringify(values.valuesArray()))
values.replace([
  ['b', 2],
  ['a', 10]
])
console.log(keyRuns, valueRuns)
keysWatch.dispose()
valuesWatch.dispose()
values.dispose()

blocks.text: Output:
Prints `1 2`, `2 3 ["b","a"] [2,10]`, and `2 3`. Updating a changes only the values observer; reordering updates both once; repeating identical ordered content updates neither.

size also tracks structure and can rerun on reorder even when its numeric value stays equal. Map.has shares the selected value cell, so changing that key’s value can also rerun has; it is not a separate membership-only signal.

initial is an iterable of `[key,value]` entries, defaulting to an empty map. runtime is explicit; omitted options use no guard and debugName `'ObservableMap'`. set takes a key and a value. replace adopts entry insertion order, and repeating identical ordered content does not notify.

sections.heading: Watch one selected member and release the collection independently

blocks.text: A selection badge watches item a while other items are selected. Closing that badge’s collection must not shut down the Runtime used by other application state.
Watching the entire Set reruns the badge for every unrelated selection. Giving a borrowed Runtime the same disposal lifetime as one collection also breaks its other users.

ObservableSet.has tracks one member. Dispose its observer and collection explicitly; the supplied Runtime remains usable. Install reactive directly, with synchronous Runtime scheduling chosen only for this example.

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { ObservableSet } from '@migaia/store-indexed'

const runtime = createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })
const selected = new ObservableSet(['a'], runtime)
let runs = 0
let present = false
const watch = runtime.effect(() => {
  present = selected.has('a')
  runs += 1
})
selected.add('b')
console.log(runs, present)
selected.delete('a')
console.log(runs, present)
selected.add('a')
console.log(runs, present)
watch.dispose()
selected.dispose()
selected.dispose()
const count = runtime.signal(1)
count.value = 2
console.log(selected.disposed, count.value)
count.dispose()

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
1 true
2 false
3 true
true 2

blocks.text: Prints `1 true`, `2 false`, `3 true`, and `true 2`. Adding b does not rerun a’s observer; deleting and restoring a do; after idempotent collection disposal, a new Runtime signal still works.

The collection owns its internal signals, not the Runtime or nested application objects. Dispose observers first. Later data access through the disposed collection throws COLLECTION_DISPOSED; disposed itself remains readable.

initial defaults to `[]`; this example supplies member `'a'`. runtime is explicitly borrowed; omitted options mean no guard and debugName `'ObservableSet'`. has/add/delete take a member value. dispose takes no arguments and repeats as a no-op. runtime.signal(1) creates a separate reactive value to show the Runtime remains usable.

blocks.text: A tracked read cannot connect another Runtime's dependency graph. Cross-graph reads detected here carry `CROSS_RUNTIME`; failures detected by reactive retain that module's actual identity. Ordinary untracked reads and peek can read across Runtimes. For request or application isolation, construct a Runtime explicitly and create the observers in that same Runtime.

keys() still allocates an array and tracks structure; it is not a free traversal. peek avoids cells, but Array.peek() copies the whole array. Replacement individually notifies only materialized cells; equal-length arrays can still compare every value, and Map/Set still compare content and order. No constant-time or speed claim follows from this mechanism.

rows: Tracked / untracked lookup; a deleted key can return undefined at runtime even when T[K] does not include it
Tests existence and tracks the full key structure
Updates in a batch; new keys advance structure, and new keys or Object.is-unequal values advance revision
Runs the guard before validating/invoking the updater, then commits; a nonfunction updater is INVALID_OPTION
Reports whether the key existed; missing keys do not notify; deletion publishes absence and advances structure/revision
Reads all properties first, then deletes absent keys and sets new values in one batch; invokes the guard once
Reclaims deleted cells without observers and returns the count

blocks.text: Object keys must be strings, otherwise INVALID_OPTION. With a finite literal T, set cannot add an undeclared key through its type signature; use an explicit `Record<string,V>` for an open key domain. The null-prototype snapshot treats `__proto__` as a data key. Freezing covers only the outer object; nested values retain their original references.

A fresh shallow-frozen copy with no tracking
Requires [0,length); negative indices are not accepted; Object.is-equal values do not notify
Returns the new length; no arguments do not notify

blocks.text: Noninteger at/set indices produce TypeError `INVALID_INDEX`; out-of-range set produces RangeError `INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE`. Omitting deleteCount removes through the end; explicitly passing undefined means zero. A JavaScript call with no splice arguments is a no-op, as is an explicit zero deletion without insertions. splice/replace/clear update materialized cells in one batch. Only length changes notify structure; length or per-item Object.is changes advance revision. set also publishes its cell and revision in one batch, so a synchronous observer does not see a new item with an old snapshot.

blocks.text: Native Map key identity rules still apply. Reordering unchanged keys and values through replace invalidates keys/iteration/snapshot observers; it does not turn keyed readers into whole-collection subscriptions. clear/replace do not invoke public writes once per key, and the guard runs only at the entry.

blocks.text: Native Set membership rules apply. Values are the members, so there is no separate revision/iteration signal, get, or peek. Reordering is observable. clear/replace invoke the guard once and advance structure at most once.

sections.heading: Cell lifetime, disposal, and mutation guards

blocks.text: A new cell attempts reclamation when its last subscriber leaves. A speculative cell that never gained an observer is cleaned through its Runtime's idle channel, using microtasks by default. Deleting a still-observed member retains its cell and publishes absence until observers leave. Object/Map/Set prune only deleted, unobserved keys/members; it cannot release live observers. Arrays use automatic reclamation only.

Collections do not detect component unmount or request completion; the application must dispose them. The collection owner releases its remaining Signals and pool references together. Repeated disposal is a no-op. Later data reads/writes and prune reject, while runtime/disposed remain readable. The borrowed Runtime is not destroyed. Disposal does not promise to clear backing data, erase existing snapshots, or destroy application objects.

A guard is a synchronous permission check with `assertMutationAllowed(operation?:string):void`. Each public write entry invokes it once, including writes that eventually make no change; reads do not. Operation names such as `users.set(u1)` combine debugName and the concrete method, rather than using IndexedOperation values. Object.update invokes the guard before its updater; rejection prevents the updater from running. MutationPolicy/runInAction from store-middleware can supply an action policy, whose action scope belongs to that module; install it separately if used. Only the outer collection commit is prevented: callback-owned external effects are not rolled back.

`IndexedOperation` gives diagnostic/logging consumers `read:'read'`, `write:'write'`, and `delete:'delete'`. `IIndexedOperation` is the union of those values. Collection methods do not use the vocabulary directly.

rows: Invalid options, input, iterator, Map entry, debugName, Object key, or updater shape
Data access or mutation after closing
A guard/updater fails without an existing module identity
A cross-Runtime tracked read detected here

blocks.text: Errors owned here use `STORE_INDEXED_SOURCE='@migaia/store-indexed'`. Existing foreign source/code pairs retain their actual owner. An uncoded guard/updater native error keeps its object, type, message, and stack when identity can be attached; otherwise cause/errors retain the original value. Branch on code rather than message. Stable diagnostics remain available for locating a failure:

rows: `[store] observable collection options must be an object`
Invalid options or failed option reads
`[store] observable collection debugName must be a string`
`[store] observable collection input must be a non-null object or iterable`
Invalid initial/replacement input, iterator, or updater shape
`[store] ObservableObject key must be a string`
`[store] cross-runtime dependency is not allowed: collection read belongs to another Runtime`
A cross-Runtime tracked read detected here
`[store] ObservableArray index must be an integer`
Callback wrapper when identity cannot be attached directly

blocks.text: All three public error factories require `code:IStoreIndexedErrorCode` and `message:string`. `createStoreIndexedError(code,message,options?)` returns a native Error; `createStoreIndexedTypeError(...)` returns TypeError. options defaults to undefined and contains only optional cause. The Error factory forwards an own cause property, while the TypeError factory forwards cause when it is not undefined. `createStoreIndexedRangeError(code,message)` returns RangeError and has no third argument. All attach nonwritable source/code and leave stack intact; a cause's message is not guaranteed to appear in the top-level stack text.

If an observer does not rerun, check that the read happens inside effect/computed, that it did not use peek, and that the new value is not Object.is-equal. A deleted cell can remain while observers are active; prune cannot force their release. Align Runtimes after a cross-graph error. Create a new collection after disposal.

libraries.description: Definition-based keyed Store state, AtomStore, family, and optics.

blocks.text: English

服务端每个请求、每个测试用例、每个对话窗口，都需要同一套状态的独立副本；放在模块变量里的状态却被所有人共用。`@migaia/store-keyed` 把“状态是什么”（定义）和“值放在哪里”（store）分开：定义写在模块顶层，不保存值；每个 `createAtomStore` 为这些定义各保存一份值。它还能把大对象拆到字段、把列表拆到每一项分别订阅，并按 id 产出定义。它建立在 `@migaia/reactive` 之上，不依赖 React 或 DOM。

items: 请求或测试之间串状态：服务端一个请求的购物车出现在另一个请求里，上一个测试留下的数据弄坏了下一个。根因是状态放在模块级变量里，被所有导入方共用。
改一个字段，整个对象的读取方都重新渲染：资料对象里在线状态一变，只显示名字的组件也重新渲染。根因是订阅的粒度是整个对象。
改一行，整个列表都重新渲染：勾选一条待办，每一行都重新渲染。根因是每一行读的都是同一个数组，而数组每次修改都会被替换。
按 id 保存的状态越来越多：手写的 `Map<chatId, state>` 只增不减，同一个 id 还可能建出两份状态。根因是按 key 缓存需要保证同一性、容量和清理，手写很难都顾到。
测试要替换依赖，只能改被测代码：价格依赖当前时间，想测夜间折扣只能等到晚上或改成注入参数。根因是被测代码直接引用了具体实现。
定义和值分开。 常见做法把状态包进工厂再到处传实例；这里定义放在模块顶层，每个 store 为它保存一份值，对象和数组初值在每个 store 里各复制一份。示例
字段级订阅。 `focusDef` 只在这个字段变化时通知读取方，写入时自动生成替换了该字段的新对象，不用手写不可变更新。示例
列表项级订阅。 `splitDef` 按 key 把列表拆成逐项定义，改一项只通知这一项；读写已经删除的 key 会报错，而不是返回过期数据。示例
按 id 的定义稳定且有上限。 `familyDef` 对同一个 key 永远返回同一个定义，缓存有 `maxSize`，可以显式 `forget`。示例
测试替身不改被测代码。 `store.override()` 只在一个 store 里替换某个定义，撤销后状态原样保留，并检查替换前后写入方式一致。示例

blocks.text: 下面模拟服务端：两个请求用同一份购物车定义，各自创建 store。用 Node 24 直接运行。
输出：
两个请求用的是同一份定义，但各自的 store 保存各自的值；在一个 store 里原地修改初值对象，也不会影响另一个。
下一步：更多用法看 USEGUIDE 的“按场景查找”；列表很长、只想让变化的那一行更新时，看 改一行不让整个列表重新渲染。
下面是常见的手写共享状态。它能跑，但有三个隐患（只用于说明，不必运行）：
用 store-keyed 时，定义不保存值，每个请求或测试用自己的 store；`splitDef` 让每一行只订阅自己那一项；`familyDef` 按 key 产出定义，有容量上限并可以显式删除。
可以把定义想成“变量声明”，把 store 想成“一块内存”：同一个声明在每块内存里各有一份值。

blocks.text: 几个说法：

items: 释放的单位是整个 store。 store 持有它建出的每一个节点，`dispose()` 时按逆序全部释放；只想提前释放某一个，用 `release(definition)`。
定义可以跨 store 共用，节点不能。 同一个定义在两个 store 里是两个独立的节点。
同步初值。 初值和工厂函数不能返回 Promise；异步数据交给 `@migaia/resource`。

blocks.text: 全部签名、边界行为与错误码见 USEGUIDE.md。下面是使用时最需要记住的约束。

1. `get` 登记依赖，`peek` / `preview` 不登记。 React 适配层的快照读取必须用 `peek` 或 `preview`。 2. `set` 只接受可写定义（`atomDef`、`atomDefFactory`、`writableDef` 及其 optics）。对只读派生写入抛 `TypeError`，经过 `override` 间接指向只读定义时也一样。`set` 在一个批次里执行，不会被外层的追踪记成依赖。 3. `override` 必须保持写入方式。 只读定义可以换成任何同值类型的定义；源定义只能换成源定义；可写派生只能换成参数和返回值相同的可写派生。override 链成环抛 `CYCLIC_OVERRIDE`。 4. 对象初值按 store 复制。 复制用 `structuredClone`，值不可克隆（例如含函数）时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，宿主缺少 `structuredClone` 时抛 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`。 5. `preview` 不执行未声明安全的工厂。 `atomDefFactory` 的工厂在 `preview` 里会抛 `PREVIEW_UNSAFE`；确认工厂纯、无副作用后改用 `previewSafeAtomDefFactory`。推测出的值在 Runtime 空闲清理（默认微任务）后，若始终没有变成真实节点就丢弃。 6. `dispose()` 的顺序。 先标记为已释放，再取消全部订阅，再按建出的逆序释放节点；单个失败不阻断其余步骤，多个失败合并成 `AggregateError`（`DISPOSAL_FAILED`）。释放后的任何访问抛 `ATOM_STORE_DISPOSED`。 7. 缓存清理和节点释放是两回事。 `splitDef(...).prune(store)`、`familyDef(...).forget()` / `clear()` 只清理定义的缓存，不释放 store 里已建的节点；节点用 `store.release()` 或 `store.dispose()` 释放。`forget` 之后同一个 key 会得到新定义，旧定义的状态与新定义互不相通。 8. family 需要 `WeakRef` 和 `FinalizationRegistry`。 宿主缺少它们时，调用 `familyDef` / `derivedFamilyDef` 就抛 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`，不会悄悄退化。 9. key 比较用 SameValueZero，和 `Map` / `Set` 一致：`-0` 与 `+0` 是同一个 key，`NaN` 等于自身。 10. 错误身份。 本包产生的错误带 `source === STORE_KEYED_SOURCE`（`@migaia/store-keyed`）和 `StoreKeyedErrorCode` 里的 `code`；其他包已有身份的错误保持原样。按 `source` / `code` 判断，不要比较 message。
破坏性迁移：十个高级 optics 原语只从 `@migaia/store-keyed/optics` 导出，`assertNotThenable` 只从 `@migaia/store-keyed/atom/definition` 导出，根入口不保留兼容别名。
不适合的场景：整个应用只有一份全局状态、永远不需要多个作用域时，直接用 `runtime.signal()` / `runtime.computed()` 更简单；需要 Provider 和 Hook 时用 `@migaia/store-react`。
English
包的定位、亮点和心智模型见 README。本指南先按场景给出可以直接运行的示例（Node 24），再逐项列出每个 API 的签名、边界行为和抛错条件。

sections.id: 一份定义每个请求或测试各有一份值
sections.heading: 一份定义每个请求或测试各有一份值

blocks.text: 放在模块级变量里的状态，被所有导入它的代码共用。在服务端，一个请求的购物车会出现在另一个请求里；在测试里，上一个用例留下的数据会弄坏下一个。
常见的修法是把状态包进工厂函数，再把实例传给每个需要它的函数，所有调用点都得改；而且如果有人忘了复制对象初值，几份状态仍然共用同一个对象。
这里的定义（`atomDef`、`derivedDef`）只描述状态，不保存值，所以可以放在模块顶层。每个 `createAtomStore` 为这份定义各自保存一份值；对象和数组初值会在每个 store 里各复制一份。
输出：
Ada 的购物车有 2 件，Grace 的有 1 件，两个请求用的是同一份定义。在一个 store 里原地修改初值对象，另一个 store 的初值仍然是空的。
定义是共用的“词汇”，store 才是值存放的地方。请求或测试结束时释放对应的 store，它创建的所有值都会一起释放。

sections.id: 只订阅大对象里的一个字段
sections.heading: 只订阅大对象里的一个字段

blocks.text: 资料对象里有名字、头像和在线状态。只显示名字的组件，在线状态一变它也重新渲染。
订阅整个对象最简单，于是任何字段一变，所有读取方都收到通知；改成把对象拆成几个独立的 store，写入方又得同时更新好几处。
`focusDef(profileDef, 'name')` 是“这个字段”的定义。读取它只订阅这个字段的值；写入它会生成一个替换了该字段的新资料对象。
输出：

blocks.code:
名字更新：Ada Lovelace
资料对象：{"name":"Ada Lovelace","avatar":"a.png","online":false}

blocks.text: 修改在线状态时，名字的订阅者没有收到通知；写入新名字时收到了，资料对象最终包含两处修改。
路径最多三层（`focusDef(def, 'user', 'address', 'city')`）；更深的路径可以组合多个 `focusDef`，或者写一个 `opticDef`。

sections.id: 改一行不让整个列表重新渲染
sections.heading: 改一行不让整个列表重新渲染

blocks.text: 勾选一条待办，整个列表的每一行都重新渲染，因为每一行读的都是同一个数组，而数组每次修改都会被替换。
手写逐行订阅，要按 id 查找，要处理重新排序和删除，还要把修改不可变地写回数组。
`splitDef(todosDef, (todo) => todo.id)` 把数组拆成按 key 的逐项定义。每一行读取 `todos.of(id)`，只在自己那一项变化时收到通知；写入这一项会把新数组写回源定义。
输出：

blocks.code:
第 t2 行重新渲染：{"id":"t2","title":"修登录 bug","done":true}
列表：t1=false, t2=true

blocks.text: 只有 `t2` 这一行重新渲染，源列表里 `t2` 已标记为完成。
key 必须唯一：读取列表时遇到重复 key 会抛错。读写已经从数组里删除的 key 也会抛错，而不是返回过期数据。

sections.id: 每个对话一份状态不用手写-map
sections.heading: 每个对话一份状态不用手写 Map

blocks.text: 每个对话都需要自己的草稿。手写的 `Map<chatId, state>` 只要没人记得删条目就会一直增长，而且同一个 id 查两次可能建出两份不同的状态。
按 key 缓存看起来简单，但它必须对同一个 key 返回同一个对象、要有容量上限，还要在同一个对话被几个独立作用域同时打开时依然正确。
`familyDef(initial)` 返回一个“key → 定义”的函数：同一个 key 永远得到同一个定义，于是每个 store 都为这个对话保存一份自己的值。`maxSize`（默认 4096）限制缓存大小，`forget(key)` 删除一个 key。
输出：

blocks.code:
同一个 id 是同一个定义：true
产品群草稿：明天发版，4 个字
技术群草稿：（技术群 的空草稿）
缓存的对话数：1

blocks.text: 同一个 id 得到同一个定义；产品群保留了它的草稿，技术群从初始草稿开始；`forget` 之后只剩一个对话被缓存。
超过 `maxSize` 后，最久没用的条目改为弱引用：仍被引用的定义（例如已在某个 store 里实例化）用同一个 key 仍能找到。这需要宿主支持 `WeakRef` 和 `FinalizationRegistry`。

sections.id: 测试时替换一个依赖不用改被测代码
sections.heading: 测试时替换一个依赖不用改被测代码

blocks.text: 价格取决于当前时间，想测夜间折扣，要么等到晚上 10 点，要么改写代码让时间可以注入。
把这类依赖都改成手动注入，会让只为测试存在的参数散落在生产代码里；全局替换 `Date` 又会影响无关的测试。
`store.override(definition, replacement)` 只在这个 store 里把对一个定义的读取转到另一个定义。被测代码仍然使用原来的定义，调用返回的函数就能撤销替换。
输出：

blocks.code:
23 点的价格：50
9 点的价格：100

blocks.text: 时间固定为 23 点时价格是 50；撤销后固定为 9 点，价格是 100。
替换必须保持写入方式不变：只读定义可以换成任何同值类型的定义，可写定义只能换成写法相同的定义，否则抛 `TypeError`。
