import {
  createStore,
  createAsyncStore,
  storeReady,
  raw,
  isRaw,
  isFieldBuilder,
  FIELD_BUILDER,
  createStoreResource,
  createStoreResourceScope
} from '@migaia/store-light'

blocks.text: `store-light` 依赖 `@migaia/reactive`（图与 Runtime）、`@migaia/resource`（请求）、`@migaia/lifecycle`（所有权与清理）、`@migaia/event-subscriber`（通知）及 `@migaia/utils`（基础协议与调度）。所有节点默认创建在 `@migaia/reactive` 的 `defaultRuntime` 上；需要隔离运行时（多 root、SSR 每请求、单测互不串状态）时，通过 `@migaia/reactive` 的 `createRuntime()` 构造独立 Runtime，再传入 `options.runtime`。`store-light` 本身不 import 任何 UI 框架，也不假设特定宿主环境。
`createStore(shape, options?)` 接收一个对象字面量，逐个属性描述符（`Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors`）按以下规则分类：

rows: `this` 绑定到 Store 自身；惰性求值，依赖变化才重新计算；对外只读，`store.x = v` 不做任何事（严格模式下抛 TypeError，因为底层是只有 getter 的属性）
即使 `value` 是函数也不当 Action；可读可写可整体替换（典型用途：存 `onSubmit` 这类回调）
自动包一层 `runtime.runTracedAction` + batch + untracked；`this` 绑定到 Store，方法内可以自然读写其他字段
交给 Builder 的 `create()` 产出实际字段对象，见 第 6 节
读时自动订阅（在 Computed/Effect 内读取时建立依赖），写时触发通知

blocks.text: `IStoreDefinition<S>` 类型给输入对象附加了 `ThisType<IReactiveStore<S>>`——这意味着方法体和 getter 体内的 `this` 拿到的是解析后的 Store 类型（`FieldBuilder` 已经变成它 `create()` 产出的真实字段类型），而不是输入字面量里那个还没解析的 `FieldBuilder` 类型；不加这个类型标注，方法里写 `this.wasmField.value` 之类的代码会类型报错。
字段名到暴露类型的映射由 `IStoreShape<S>` 完成；工程上不需要手写这个映射，`createStore` 的返回值类型会自动推导正确。

rows: 同步创建；shape 中任意字段是非 `mode: 'sync'` 的 `FieldBuilder`（`mode: 'async'` 或历史无 mode 的 Builder）会在读取属性描述符阶段直接抛错，不会执行任何 I/O，提示改用 `createAsyncStore`
允许异步 `FieldBuilder`；返回的 Promise 在全部异步字段初始化完成（或抛错）后才 resolve/reject，resolve 后每个字段都已就绪
返回该 Store 的就绪 Promise；只对通过上述任一入口创建的 Store 有效，传入非 Store 对象会抛 `[store] store has no asynchronous initialization`

blocks.text: 创建入口只有 `createStore`（纯同步定义）和 `createAsyncStore`（含异步字段的定义）。

纯 Signal/Computed Store 不建立异步 lifecycle scope；遇到 FieldBuilder、source capability、订阅 Effect 或 `$own` 外部资源时才创建。相邻原生节点合为一个同步逆序释放段，在不同资源边界登记该段，保持原混合 LIFO。初始化 AbortController 只在第一个 Builder 准入时通过 lifecycle native factory 创建。`$dispose()` 的 Promise identity、外部异步清理与错误策略保持。
初始化失败的清理语义：无论走哪个入口，构造过程中任何一步抛错（字段类型非法、Builder 的 `create()` 拒绝所有权等），已经创建的内部节点都会按注册逆序回收，不会遗留半初始化的资源。异步字段初始化失败（`readyList` 中的 Promise reject）同样会把整个 Store 标记为 `disposed` 并回收资源，即使有的字段在此之前已经初始化成功。

rows: 显式指定节点所属的 Runtime；同一个 Runtime 上的节点共享一张依赖图，跨 Runtime 的节点完全隔离
调试名前缀，出现在内部节点的 `debugName`（形如 `${debugName}.${key}`）里，不参与状态语义
开启后，若某个 Action 返回了一个 thenable（说明它是 async 方法），首次调用时会 `Runtime.reportError` (`ACTION_BATCH_BOUNDARY`) 提示"只有首个 await 之前的写入被自动 batch"
接入 MobX 风格的严格写入守卫，见 第 7 节

blocks.text: 输入字段不能使用内置 API 的同名键（例如 `$snapshot`、`$dispose`）：冲突以 `INVALID_OPTION` TypeError 拒绝，已经创建的字段进入同一构造回滚。
`$`-前缀的方法/属性挂载为不可枚举属性，不会出现在 `for...in`、`Object.keys()` 或 `$snapshot()` 的用户字段遍历里。

rows: 该 Store 所有节点所属的 Runtime；可写 data 属性，供 React 适配层等在同一张图上建 Effect
定义里是否含异步 `FieldBuilder`；为 `false` 时整个 Store 同步就绪
是否已释放，实时求值，不是构造时的静态快照
返回全部字段（signal + computed + wasm 字段）的一次性快照对象；要求 Store 已就绪，异步字段未就绪时抛 `[store] store is pending; use createAsyncStore()...`
只返回 signal 支撑的标量字段（含 `raw()` 字段），排除 computed/wasm 字段/方法；不要求 Store 已就绪，异步字段初始化期间也能调用；持久化层（`@migaia/store-persist`）基于它取快照
宽松写回：只写已知 signal 键，未知/computed/wasm 键按 `options.unknown` 处理；不要求 Store 已就绪；整批写入经 mutation policy 与 `runtime.batch` 合并通知，不回滚已经完成的写入

注册一个粗粒度订阅 Effect：读取全部 signal 与 computed 的 `.value` 和 wasm source 的 `track()`；首次建立订阅会求值 computed getter，也能追踪其 Store 外依赖；`fireImmediately: true` 时订阅建立后立即调用一次 `fn`；`fn` 抛错会经 `runtime.reportError` 上报，不会中断订阅本身
整个 recipe 在一次 `batch` 内执行，多次字段写入只触发一次通知；`draft` 就是 Store 本身；不是事务，recipe 中途抛错不回滚已写入的字段；写只读 computed 字段会自然抛错（属性只有 getter）
低层批量赋值；编译期只接受非 computed/非 FieldBuilder/非方法的字段（含 `raw()` 字段），运行期对每个 key 额外校验对应 signal 是否存在，不存在则抛 `[store] field is not settable: ${key}`（防御动态/非法输入）
把外部资源纳入本 Store 的所有权作用域，`$dispose()` 时一并释放；资源必须未归属或已归属本 Runtime，跨 Runtime 直接拒绝（见 第 10 节）
首次调用同步切换 `$disposed`、中止在途异步字段初始化并启动全部内部节点清理；所有调用返回同一个 Promise，成功或失败均稳定重放，Promise settle 表示 owned cleanup 已完成

blocks.text: `ISubscribeOptions`：`{ fireImmediately?: boolean }`，默认 `false`。 `IHydrateOptions`：`{ unknown?: 'ignore' | 'report' | 'strict'; onUnknown?: (key: string) => void }`，默认 `unknown: 'ignore'`（向后兼容的部分 hydration）；`'strict'` 遇到未知 key 直接抛错；`'report'` 对每个未知 key 调用一次 `onUnknown`，写入过程本身继续。
Store 定义协议，扩展去实现——`store-light` 不知道 WASM、也不知道任何具体字段实现，`FieldBuilder` 只是一份约定。`@migaia/store-wasm` 的 `number()`/`string()`/`boolean()`/`array()`/`record()` 都是这份协议的具体实现。

rows: 品牌 symbol，不导出为公共构造 API，只用于 `isFieldBuilder` 的身份判定（防止结构类似的普通对象被误判为 Builder）
类型守卫，判断某个值是否为 `IFieldBuilder`
Runtime 为自定义存储签发的最小响应式能力：`track()`（建立依赖）、`notify()`（触发下游更新）、`commit(write)`（在发布前保留版本号，随后一次性 publish，避免"先写后通知"之间的撕裂）、`observed`（是否有人在观察）
Builder 的 `create()` 唯一入参：`runtime` 用于创建普通节点；`createSource` 接入同一张依赖图；`signal` 是 Store dispose 时用来中止在途初始化的 `AbortSignal`

blocks.text: 所有权规则：`IFieldContext` 刻意不传 `scope`——所有权登记是 Store 的职责，不是 Builder 的职责。Builder 只管"造出字段"，Store 在拿到字段后统一 `claimOwnership` + `scope.own`；这样第三方 Builder 实现"创建了资源却忘了登记"时，`$dispose()` 也不会漏释放，因为登记这一步根本不由 Builder 完成。
同步 vs 异步字段：所有 Builder 显式给出 `mode: 'sync'` 或 `mode: 'async'`。同步 Builder 可传任一创建入口；异步 Builder 仅传 `createAsyncStore()`。无 mode 的旧形式不再接受。
一个最小的自定义同步字段实现（改编自 `@migaia/store-wasm` 的 `number()`）：
`store-light` 只定义协议，不提供具体策略实现：

blocks.code:
export type IMutationGuard = { assertMutationAllowed(operation?: string): void }
export type IMutationPolicy = IMutationGuard & { runInAction<T>(fn: () => T): T }

items: Store 与 collections 类的包只需要回答"能不能改"这一个问题（`IMutationGuard`）；
Store facade 额外需要"把一次动作标记为正在动作内"这个能力（`IMutationPolicy`），因为方法/`$batch`/`$set`/`$hydrate` 内部的写入应该被放行，直接对字段赋值则由策略决定是否允许。

blocks.text: 具体实现（MobX 风格 actions-only 模式）由 `@migaia/store-middleware` 提供：
不传 `mutationPolicy` 时（默认），任何地方直接赋值都允许，这是为了不改变既有 Store 的行为——严格模式是显式接入的。

sections.heading: 8. StoreResource：Suspense 安全的异步值容器

blocks.text: `createStoreResource(factory, options?)` 创建一个独立于对象 facade 的异步值容器，`createStoreResourceScope()` 管理一组资源的统一释放。两者都不要求配合 `createStore` 使用。
请求、数据、取消和共享 Promise 由 `@migaia/resource` 唯一拥有；下图是 StoreLight 结合版本租约派生的视图。

blocks.code:
idle --start()--> loading --resolve--> ready --无持有者+超时--> idle（缓存过期，值被释放）
                     |                   |
                     +---reject--------> failed（若有 stale 值则退回 ready 并保留旧值）
ready/loading --dispose()（有持有者）--> closing --最后一个持有者释放--> disposed
任意非 disposed 状态 --forceDispose()/dispose()（无持有者）--> disposed

items: `idle`：尚未开始加载。
`loading`：`factory` 正在执行；若存在上一个已加载的值（`retry()` 触发的重新加载），该值作为 `previous` 保留，读取时可以拿到旧值而不是挂起。
`ready`：已有值可读。
`failed`：加载失败且没有可回退的旧值；有旧值时优先回退到 `ready`（保留旧值），不会转到 `failed`。
`closing`：`dispose()` 时如果还有持有者（resource lease 或 version lease），资源进入这个中间态，等最后一个持有者释放才真正终止；不存在"半关闭"对外可见状态。
`disposed`：逻辑终态，实际 disposer 完成后 `whenTerminal()` 才 resolve，所有方法要么 no-op 要么抛 `[store] resource is disposed`。

rows: 读取当前值；`loading` 中会 `throw` 正在进行的 Promise（React Suspense 协议），`failed` 会 `throw` 错误对象
如果还没开始加载就触发 `start()`；不建立任何持有租约
把当前值标记为 stale 后重新加载；重新加载完成前旧值仍可读
获取一个"资源级"持有租约（不锁定具体版本），返回释放函数；有此类租约时资源不会因超时被回收
锁定某个具体版本不被回收（即使后续 `retry()` 产生了新版本），常用于"后台刷新但保留当前渲染值"
渲染期的临时保护：先拿到一个 capture token，不立即计入正式持有者
提交期把 capture 转成正式的版本持有租约；`captureVersion`/`commitCapture` 这一对是给 React"渲染可能被丢弃、提交才算数"的两阶段场景设计的（`@migaia/store-react` 的 `useStoreResource` 就是这样用的）
优雅释放：仍有持有者时转入 `closing`，等最后一个持有者释放后才真正清理
无视持有者，立即转入终态并清理全部内部状态
逻辑 disposed 后等待实际 disposer 完成才 resolve；不依赖 GC，任何时候调用都能正确等到
注册变更监听（配合 `getSnapshot()` 可直接喂给 `useSyncExternalStore`）
单调递增的 revision 号，每次状态变化都会自增
同 `read()`，但额外带上版本号和 `IVersionToken`，供需要精确版本信息的调用方使用
组合了读取快照与 `captureVersion` 的便捷方法，`existingLease` 传入上一次已提交的 release 函数用于跳过重复 capture
负责延迟的空闲清理和诊断上报
创建时读取一次，用于缓存有效期和临时 capture 的过期；任务的取消与 unref 语义保持不变
无任何持有者（resource lease + version lease + 挂起的 capture）之后，缓存值继续存活的毫秒数；必须是有限非负数，否则构造时抛 `RangeError`
自定义清理函数；提供后，值必须是引用类型（对象/函数），否则抛 `TypeError`；不提供时，若值本身带 `$dispose` 方法（例如另一个 Store），会自动调用
'listener'` 三个阶段的失败；reporter 自身抛错或拒绝时，原失败与 reporter 失败均由所属 Runtime 报告，资源状态不变
资源到达终态时调用一次

blocks.text: `factory` 既可以是函数 `(context) => T \| Promise<T>`，也可以是 `{ load, runtime?, scheduler?, dispose?, keepAliveMs?, onError?, onTerminal? }` 对象形式（等价于把这些字段和 `options` 合并）。`IStoreResourceLoadContext` 提供 `{ signal, generation, token }`，`signal` 在该次加载被取代/资源关闭时中止。

构造时只读取上述已知字段并形成稳定快照：`load` 与每个已知 accessor 最多读取一次，不枚举或执行未知字段 getter；显式 `options` 的 own-enumerable 字段覆盖 factory 对象上的同名字段。`dispose`、`onError`、`onTerminal` 若存在必须是函数，否则在任何请求或 Resource 状态建立前同步抛出 tagged `INVALID_OPTION`。

自动 `$dispose` 与自定义 disposer 的返回值遵循 lifecycle 的统一接纳语义：disposer getter、then getter 均只读取一次，捕获函数分别以原资源、原 thenable 作为 receiver 调用。getter、调用或异步 rejection 的原始异常通过 `onError(error, 'dispose')` 可达；重复 `forceDispose()` 不会重复清理同一值。

`scope.resource()` 原样委托 `createStoreResource()` 的已知字段快照与 callback precedence，不会再次 spread/枚举 factory；用户的 effective `onTerminal` 保持不变。Scope 通过 `whenTerminal()` 从私有集合摘除自然终止的资源，不改写公开 disposer。`scope.dispose()` 会强制释放（`forceDispose`）组内所有仍然存在的资源，不等待持有者释放——它假定"整个作用域要关闭了，个别资源的持有者不再重要"。

sections.heading: 9. 状态常量与错误构造工具

blocks.text: 除上述创建入口、`$`-API、FieldBuilder 协议之外，包根还导出以下常量与错误构造工具：

blocks.code:
export const StoreFieldMode = { sync: 'sync', async: 'async' } as const
export type IStoreFieldMode = (typeof StoreFieldMode)[keyof typeof StoreFieldMode]

items: `StoreFieldMode`：`FieldBuilder.mode` 的合法取值（`'sync'` / `'async'`），自定义 Builder 实现时用它标注 `mode` 字段，见 第 6 节。
`STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE`：本包所有错误 `error.source` 的固定值 `'@migaia/store-light'`，用于按来源过滤/断言错误。
`createStoreLightError(code, message, options?)`：构造一个携带 `(source, code)` 身份（经 `@migaia/utils/error` 的 `attachErrorIdentity`）的普通 `Error`；`options.cause` 可选，设置了才会传给 `Error` 构造器的 `cause`。
`createStoreLightRangeError(code, message)`：同上，但构造 `RangeError`；无 `cause` 选项。
`createStoreLightTypeError(code, message, options?)`：同上，但构造 `TypeError`；`options.cause` 可选。
`createStoreLightAggregateError(code, errors, message)`：构造 `AggregateError(errors, message)` 并打上 `(source, code)` 身份；`errors: unknown[]`（必填）在结果的 `.errors` 上保持可达。

blocks.text: 这四个工厂函数是本包内部构造所有错误时使用的同一套工具，导出给需要"以 `@migaia/store-light` 身份抛出自定义诊断错误"的高级集成方（例如自定义 `FieldBuilder` 实现想复用同一套错误身份约定）；日常业务代码通常不需要直接调用它们，直接 `catch` 本包抛出的错误、按 `error.code` 分支即可（见下表）。

本包创建的错误使用 `source: '@migaia/store-light'` 与稳定 `code`。Reactive 所有权错误、Resource 请求失败与取消保留其原 owner。FieldBuilder 初始化失败与晚到字段清理失败若已具有完整身份则保留；其余原生可扩展 Error 在原对象上标记 `INITIALIZATION_FAILED` / `FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED`，保留类型、message 和 stack；不能附加身份的值通过 coded fallback 的 `cause` 保持可达。初始化与 cleanup 同时失败时，能写 cause 的主 Error 仍为原对象，已有 cause 与 cleanup 合并；不能写入时使用 `INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError。

rows: Store 终结后继续访问；创建新 Store，不复活旧实例
Resource closing/disposed 后读取或保留；停止使用并创建新资源
capture token 无效或已消费；重新捕获，token 只能提交一次
保留/捕获不可见版本；从当前 snapshot 重新取得版本
带 dispose 的 factory 返回原始值；返回可追踪身份的对象或函数
传入未在本包实例登记的对象；同步及异步 Store 均可等待
异步字段 pending/failed 时访问；先等待 `storeReady()`
不能在主错误上附加回滚失败；展开 `cause` / `errors`
未归类的 FieldBuilder 初始化失败；检查原错误及 cause
晚到字段清理失败；由所属 Runtime 报告
异步 action 首次 await 后继续写的诊断；把后续写显式放入 `$batch()`
keepAlive、写目标或 hydrate 选项非法；按 message 修正输入
`$dispose()` 后访问用户字段或受守卫方法（`$own` 先检查 disposed）；幂等 `$dispose()`、`$disposed`、`$runtime`、`$async` 仍可使用
`[store] store is ${status}; use createAsyncStore() before accessing async fields`
读取尚未就绪（`pending`）或已失败（`failed`）的异步字段
`[store] createStore() only accepts synchronous fields; "${key}" is a IFieldBuilder. Use createAsyncStore().`
`createStore()`（非 `createAsyncStore`）的 shape 里含非 `mode: 'sync'` 的 `FieldBuilder`
`$set()` 传入的 key 不对应任何 signal（computed/wasm/方法字段，或压根不存在的 key）
对非 Store 对象（或未经 `createStore`/`createAsyncStore` 创建的对象）调用 `storeReady()`
`this node is already owned by another Runtime` / `${what} belongs to a different Runtime than this scope` / `${what} is not a Runtime-owned reactive node` / `${what} belongs to another Runtime`
`$own(resource)` 传入已属于其他 Runtime 的资源，或资源不是本 Runtime 登记的响应式节点（来自 `@migaia/reactive` 的所有权校验）
对已 `disposed`/`closing` 的 `StoreResource` 调用 `preload`/`retry`/`retain*`/`captureVersion`/`commitCapture` 等操作
`retainVersion(version)`/`captureVersion(id)`/`commitCapture(capture)` 传入的版本号既不是当前版本，也不在 retired/stale/closing 列表里
`[store] resource factory returned a disposed value`
`factory` 返回了一个已经被标记为 disposed 的值（复用了已释放的引用）
`[store] disposable resource values must use reference identity`（`TypeError`）
配置了 `dispose` 但 `factory` 产出的是原始类型（非对象/函数），无法用引用去重和追踪生命周期
`commitCapture()`/`captures.inspect()` 收到的 capture 已提交过、已失效，或不是本资源签发的
`[store] keepAliveMs must be a finite non-negative number`（`RangeError`）

blocks.text: Store 构造失败：`shape` 里任意字段处理阶段抛错（比如某个 `FieldBuilder.create()` 抛错），整个构造过程回滚——原生节点同步分段释放、外部资源由 lifecycle scope 释放，内部的 `signals`/`computeds`/`wasmFields`/`fieldSources` 全部清空，原始错误继续向外抛出（清理阶段自身失败时，会尽量把清理错误挂到原错误的 `cause` 上，不会替换原始错误）。

异步字段初始化失败：`readyList` 中任一 Promise reject，Store 立即被标记为 `disposed = true`，中止其余在途初始化（`initAbort.abort()`），并回收已经创建的资源；这个转变发生在 `ready` Promise 的 reject 路径里，因此哪怕调用方没有 `await storeReady()`，Store 内部状态也已经正确收敛，不会有"部分字段可用"的僵尸状态。

`$dispose()` 时机：字段读写方法在闭包里直接引用底层节点（`node.value`），不经过任何"Store 对象本身"的代理层；因此 `$dispose()` 唯一要做的事就是把 `disposed` 标志位翻转、释放原生节点段与已有 scope、清空内部 Map。所有已经拿到 Store 引用的调用方，后续用户字段读写与受守卫方法调用会看到 `[store] store is disposed`。

`StoreResource` 的持有者概念：一份值被判定为"没有持有者"（可以被回收）需要同时满足：没有 `retainResource()`/`retainVersion()` 产生的活跃 lease，也没有任何未提交的 capture。直接 `captureVersion()` 不设 4 秒过期；只有 pending generation 成功后转换的 provisional capture 才有 4000ms 放弃窗口。`keepAliveMs` 超时只在"当前没有任何持有者"时才开始计算，一旦有新的持有者出现，倒计时会被取消。
一个"用户设置面板"场景：本地可写字段用严格 action 守卫，远端用户资料用 `StoreResource` 异步加载，并在组件卸载时统一释放。
Q：我在 getter 里写 `this.x = 1` 报错了。 Computed 只有 getter、没有 setter，属性描述符层面就不可写；ESM 严格模式下赋值给这样的属性会抛 `TypeError`。派生值只能通过它依赖的 signal 字段间接改变。
Q：`store.field = x` 没报错，但我明明传了 `mutationPolicy`。 检查是不是走了 `$batch`/`$set`/`$hydrate` 或方法（Action）内部——这几条路径会先 `runInAction()` 再执行，动作深度 > 0 时 `assertMutationAllowed` 自然放行。只有"在这些路径之外直接赋值"才会被拦截。
Q：`createStore()` 报 "only accepts synchronous fields"，但我看代码是同步的。 检查 `FieldBuilder.mode` 是否显式为 `'sync'`；异步字段使用 `'async'` 并交给 `createAsyncStore()`。无 mode 的历史形式已移除。

Q：`StoreResource.read()` 一直抛同一个 Promise，界面卡在 loading。 确认调用方确实在 Suspense 边界内 `await`/处理了这个抛出的 Promise；`read()` 抛 Promise 是设计如此（React Suspense 协议），不是错误——真正的问题通常是外层没有 `<Suspense>` 或没有等待 Promise settle 就再次同步渲染。
Q：`retry()` 之后旧值突然消失了。 `retry()` 只保证"重新加载完成前，旧值继续可读"；如果旧值没有任何 `retainVersion` 锁定，加载成功后旧值会按正常的 retire/回收流程被清理（触发 `dispose` 配置或值自身的 `$dispose`）。需要强制保留某个版本用 `retainVersion(version)`。

Q：`$plain()`/`$hydrate()` 和 `$snapshot()` 有什么区别，该用哪个？ `$snapshot()` 拿"当前展示状态"（含 computed/wasm 字段），要求 Store 已就绪；`$plain()`/`$hydrate()` 只处理可持久化的标量 signal 字段，且不要求 Store 已就绪——持久化/hydration 场景应该用后者，展示/调试场景用前者。
仓库根目录：`pnpm --filter @migaia/store-light fmt` → `lint` → `typecheck` → `typecheck:test` → `test` → `build`。浏览器集成路径另跑 `typecheck:e2e` 与 `test:e2e`。
单独导入 Store light 不创建默认 Runtime。第一次未显式传入 `options.runtime` 的 store 创建才取得 reactive 的共享默认实例；显式 runtime 的构造路径直接使用给定 owner。该实例与随后导入 reactive root 的 `defaultRuntime` 保持同一 identity。
Action 在同步写入回调之外保留方法原本的返回值或 Promise。只有第一个 `await` 之前的写入属于同一个批次；`await` 之后的写入要用 `$batch()` 合并。写入守卫的回调保持同步。开启 `warnAsyncActions` 后，Action 第一次返回 thenable 时会经 Store 的 Runtime 报告 `ACTION_BATCH_BOUNDARY`。

StoreResource 用创建时捕获的 Runtime 做空闲清理和诊断，用准入的 scheduler 计算缓存有效期和 4000ms 的临时 capture 窗口。`keepAliveMs: 0` 仍然同步回收。没有 `onError` 时，原始失败转交给 Runtime；用户的上报函数自己抛错或拒绝时，原失败和上报失败都以原对象送到 Runtime。不会退回到宿主的 console 或全局 reportError。

sections.id: 迁移说明-请求统一交给-resource
sections.heading: 迁移说明：请求统一交给 Resource

blocks.text: StoreLight 现在只适配一个 `@migaia/resource` 实例。它保留实际值的身份、渲染 capture、资源与版本租约以及值的释放，删除了自己重复的请求/数据控制器和请求协调器。`StoreResourceDataKind` 及其类型已删除；需要原生 Resource 状态时用 `ResourceStatus` / `ResourceFetchStatus`。`StoreResourceKind` 仍是门面内部的词汇；`readSnapshot()` 仍返回 `value`/`version`/`token`，没有公开的 kind 属性。

加载中的重复读取抛出的是同一个 Promise，它以原始值完成。`retry()` 或强制取消会让被取代的 Promise 立即以原生 `AbortError` 失败，`source` 为 `@migaia/resource`，`code` 为 `REQUEST_ABORTED`；以前，忽略中止信号的加载函数会让这个 Promise 一直挂起，直到它自己完成。手动驱动重试时要处理旧 Promise 的拒绝。迟到的返回值只释放一次。刷新失败时恢复旧数据；旧版本的租约会把它的释放推迟到租约释放之后。等待时钟结算的已加载值仍归资源所有，结算失败时也会被释放。临时 capture 的定时器准入失败时，已建立的部分 capture 和定时器会被释放，并作为释放过程的附带问题上报；已经加载成功的值仍可读，并会通知订阅者。不引入任何异步上下文机制。

sections.heading: 迁移说明：公开 API 收敛

blocks.text: 根入口不再导出 `StoreResourceKind` 和 `IStoreResourceKind`；所有权词汇留在内部，公开的资源只暴露快照和完成方法。`ILegacyFieldBuilder` 已删除，改用 `mode: 'async'` 的 `IAsyncFieldBuilder`。`IFieldBuilder` 仍是显式 sync/async Builder 的联合类型，store-wasm 的再导出也一样。`resource.retain()` 改为 `retainResource()`，`resource.retain(version)` 改为 `retainVersion(version)`。没有保留兼容别名。外部使用情况未知，应作为破坏性 API 变更发布。
中文

For object state such as forms, settings or a session, hand-written code has to recompute derived values and notify the page at every change, and remember to clean up on the way out. `@migaia/store-light` takes the object as you would write it: plain fields become reactive values, getters become derived values that update themselves, methods become actions that publish once, and the store adds subscription, persistence and disposal. It also has an async value container, `createStoreResource`, that releases loaded objects such as connections or decoders when nobody uses them. It is built on `@migaia/reactive` and depends on no UI framework.

items: A derived value is not updated: the item list changed, but the total and the summary were not updated with it. The cause is that derived values are recomputed by hand at every place that changes the data.

Listeners see half-written state: a method changes the list and then the total, and a listener runs between the two writes and sees the new list with the old total. The cause is that every write notifies on its own.

Restoring settings silently loses data: after an upgrade, restoring saved settings writes retired fields into the state, or drops fields the new version lacks without anyone noticing. The cause is persistence through something like `Object.assign`, which copies whatever it is given.

The previous user's data is still on screen after sign-out: the session state is no longer used, but a callback nobody cleaned up still reads it. The cause is that a plain object never knows it has been released.

Async-loaded objects are never closed: a connection or decoder stays open after the component unmounts, and after a reload the old one stays in memory. The cause is that nobody records who still uses it and when it should close.

Just write a plain object. The usual reactive style wraps every field in a signal and every derived value in a computed; here fields, getters and methods become reactive values, derived values and actions, and the state still looks like the object it describes. Example
An action publishes once when it returns. All writes inside one method call are announced together when it returns, so listeners never see half-written state. Example
Persistence takes only what can be restored. `$plain()` returns only the writable fields; `$hydrate()` writes back only fields the store has and can report or reject unknown ones. Example

Access after disposal fails at once. After `$dispose()`, reading or writing a field and calling a method throw `STORE_DISPOSED`, so a stale reader fails where it reads instead of showing old data. Example

Async values have a clear owner. `createStoreResource` tracks holders and releases the value `keepAliveMs` after the last holder leaves; a reload releases the old value only after the new one is published, and every value is released exactly once. Example

blocks.text: The example below is a cart: the list, the total and a summary live in one plain object, and `add` changes two fields. Run it directly with Node 24.
Output:

blocks.code:
notified: items: 1, total: 300
notified: items: 2, total: 400

blocks.text: `summary` is an ordinary getter that recomputes when the `items` and `total` it reads change. Each `add` call produces one notification, and by then both fields are updated.
Next: more uses are listed in Find by scenario in the USEGUIDE; for async values that must be released after loading, see Release an async value when nobody uses it.
Below is a common hand-written state object. It runs, but it has three traps (for illustration only; no need to run it):
With `createStore`, the summary is a getter that recomputes when the fields it reads change, a method's writes are published together when it returns, and any access after `$dispose()` throws.
`createStore` sorts every property of the object by how it is written:

rows: Reading records a dependency, writing notifies
Computed only when read, recomputed only when what it reads changes; read-only
Writes in one call are published together when it returns; reads inside it do not subscribe the caller
Even a function is stored as data, readable and writable

blocks.text: `createStore` takes a `shape` typed as `IStoreDefinition<S>` with inferred `this`, accepting synchronous fields only. Its optional `options?: ICreateStoreOptions` selects the Runtime and async Action warnings; the result is `IReactiveStore<S>`. Use `createAsyncStore` for asynchronous fields and await its Promise before reading the ready fields.
Every signature, boundary behaviour and error message is in USEGUIDE.en.md. These are the constraints that matter most in use.

1. Getters are read-only. A derived value has no setter, and assigning to it throws `TypeError`; change it only through the fields it reads. 2. In an async method, only writes before the first `await` share the batch. Put writes after an `await` into `$batch()`. With `warnAsyncActions`, the first thenable an action returns is reported through the Runtime as `ACTION_BATCH_BOUNDARY`. Actions keep the method's own return value or Promise. 3. `$batch()` is not a transaction. A recipe that throws halfway does not roll back writes already made; the same holds for `$hydrate()`. 4. `$dispose()` flips the state before releasing. `$disposed` becomes `true` before any resource is released; afterwards reading or writing a field and calling a method throw `STORE_DISPOSED`, while `$disposed`, `$runtime`, `$async` and another `$dispose()` keep working. Every call returns the same Promise, which completes after every internal node and every resource registered through `$own()` has been released. 5. A failed construction rolls back. If any step of construction fails, the nodes already created are released in reverse registration order and the original error keeps propagating; a failing cleanup is attached to the original error instead of replacing it. 6. Importing creates no default Runtime. The shared default Runtime of reactive is taken the first time a store is created without `options.runtime`, and it is the same object as the `defaultRuntime` exported from the root of `@migaia/reactive`. 7. StoreResource owns its values. With a `dispose` option, values must be objects or functions; without one, a value's own `$dispose` method is called. The countdown after the last holder leaves is `keepAliveMs` (default 1000; `0` releases synchronously); during React rendering, capture/commit leases protect the version on screen. 8. Error identity. Errors produced by this module carry `source === STORE_LIGHT_SOURCE` (`@migaia/store-light`) and a `code` from `StoreLightErrorCode`; ownership errors from reactive and request failures and cancellations from resource keep their original identity.

Requests, data, cancellation and the shared Promise are handled by one instance of `@migaia/resource`; StoreResource only adds value ownership, render captures, version leases and exactly-once release on top. Migration notes (removal of `StoreResourceDataKind`, `StoreResourceKind` and `retain()`) are at the end of the USEGUIDE.
When not to use it: for lists and collections with frequent inserts and removals, entities addressed by id, or data that needs index queries, use store-indexed, store-keyed and the related module.

sections.heading: Plain object in, reactive state out

blocks.text: A cart keeps a list, a total and a summary line. Hand-written, every method that changes the list must also recompute the summary and notify listeners, and a listener that runs between two writes sees a new list with the old total.
Reactive libraries fix that, but usually by asking you to wrap every field in a signal and every derived value in a computed, so the state no longer looks like the object it describes.

`createStore` takes the object as you would write it. Plain fields become writable reactive values, getters become derived values that recompute when what they read changes, and methods become actions: all writes inside one call are published together when the call returns.
Output:

blocks.code:
notified: items: 1, total: 300
notified: items: 2, total: 400

blocks.text: Two calls to `add` produce two notifications, and each one already sees both the new list and the new total.
An action publishes once, right when it returns, so a listener never observes half of a method's writes. Writes made directly on fields, outside any method, are merged in the next microtask instead.

sections.heading: Save only what can be restored

blocks.text: Settings are saved to local storage. After an upgrade some saved fields no longer exist and new ones were added; restoring the old JSON either writes keys the state does not have or silently loses data nobody noticed.
Hand-written persistence usually serializes the whole object, including derived values and methods, and restores with `Object.assign`, which copies whatever it is given.

`$plain()` returns only the writable fields. `$hydrate()` writes back only the fields this store has, in one batch; with `unknown: 'report'` it calls `onUnknown` for every key it skips, and `unknown: 'strict'` rejects the whole input instead.
Output:

The saved JSON contains `theme` and `fontSize` but not `label` or `reset`. Restoring into the new version reports `fontSize` and `legacyMode` as ignored, and the result keeps `theme` and the new `language`.
The default `unknown: 'ignore'` skips unknown keys silently; choose `report` when you want to log migrations and `strict` when bad input must not be applied at all.

sections.heading: Reading a released store fails loudly

blocks.text: After sign-out the session state is released, but a timer or a callback that was never cleaned up keeps reading it and quietly shows the previous user's name.
A plain object never knows it is no longer in use, so stale readers get old values instead of an error, and the bug only shows up as wrong data.

After `$dispose()`, reading or writing a field and calling a method throw `STORE_DISPOSED`. `$disposed` turns `true` before any resource is released, and repeated `$dispose()` calls return the same Promise.
Output:

blocks.code:
read failed: STORE_DISPOSED
disposed: true

blocks.text: The late read fails with `STORE_DISPOSED`, and `$disposed` is `true`.
A forgotten reader now shows up as an error at the exact place it reads, instead of as stale data on screen.

sections.heading: Keep a callback as a replaceable field

blocks.text: A form stores an `onSubmit` callback that the page swaps at run time. Written as a function in the store definition, it is treated as a method instead.
`createStore` turns every function into an action, so a function-valued field cannot be told apart from a method by looking at the object.
Wrapping the value in `raw()` marks it as data: the field stays readable and writable, assigning a new function notifies subscribers, and calling it runs the current function.
Output:

blocks.code:
default submit: draft
submit callback replaced
sent to the server: final

blocks.text: The first submit runs the default callback; replacing it notifies the subscriber, and the second submit runs the new one.
Use `raw()` for any function or value that should be stored as is rather than interpreted, such as callbacks, class instances handed in from outside, or formatter functions.

sections.heading: Release an async value when nobody uses it

blocks.text: A component opens a connection or a decoder when it mounts. When the last component that needs it unmounts it should be closed, but not immediately, because the next page often needs it again.
Hand-written code counts users in a module variable, and every early return or thrown error in a component is a chance to miss a decrement, leaving the resource open forever.
`createStoreResource` owns the loaded value. `retainResource()` returns a release function; when no holder is left, the value stays for `keepAliveMs` (default 1000) and then `dispose` is called once.
Output:

blocks.code:
open connection #1
read: connection #1
component unmounted
close connection #1
done

blocks.text: The connection opens once, is read while the component holds it, and closes about 20 ms after the component unmounts.
When no `dispose` option is given and the value has a `$dispose` method, that method is called instead. `keepAliveMs: 0` releases synchronously when the last holder leaves.

sections.heading: Reloading releases the old value exactly once

blocks.text: A reload creates a new decoder. The old one must be released, but only after the new one is ready, so the screen never shows nothing, and it must never be released twice.
Hand-written reload code tends to dispose the old value before the new one arrives, or forgets it once an error path is taken; values that resolve after being superseded leak entirely.

`retry()` starts a new load and keeps the old value until the new one is published, then disposes the old one once. Values that arrive after being superseded, or after the resource is disposed, are released as well.
Output:

blocks.code:
create decoder #1
using #1
create decoder #2
release decoder #1
using #2
release decoder #2
everything released

blocks.text: Decoder #2 is created first, then #1 is released, and the component reads #2. Disposing the resource releases #2, and `whenTerminal()` resolves after everything is released.
Each value created by the loader is released exactly once, whichever way it ends.

blocks.text: There are only two creation entry points: `createStore` (purely synchronous definitions) and `createAsyncStore` (definitions with async fields).

A store made only of signals and computeds creates no async lifecycle scope; one is created only when a FieldBuilder, a source capability, a subscription effect or an `$own` external resource appears. Adjacent native nodes are grouped into one synchronous segment released in reverse order, and each segment is registered at the boundary with a different kind of resource, keeping the original mixed LIFO order. The initialization AbortController is created through the lifecycle native factory only when the first builder is admitted. The Promise identity of `$dispose()`, asynchronous external cleanup and the error policy stay as they are.

Cleanup when initialization fails: whichever entry point is used, if any step of construction throws (an invalid field type, a builder's `create()` refusing ownership, ...), the internal nodes created so far are released in reverse registration order, and no half-initialized resource remains. An async field that fails to initialize (a rejected Promise in `readyList`) likewise marks the whole store `disposed` and releases its resources, even if some fields had already initialized successfully.

sections.heading: 8. StoreResource: a Suspense-safe async value container

blocks.text: `createStoreResource(factory, options?)` creates an async value container independent of the object facade, and `createStoreResourceScope()` releases a group of resources together. Neither needs `createStore`.
Requests, data, cancellation and the shared Promise are owned only by `@migaia/resource`; the diagram below is the view StoreLight derives from it together with version leases.

blocks.code:
idle --start()--> loading --resolve--> ready --no holder + timeout--> idle (cache expired, value released)
                     |                   |
                     +---reject--------> failed (falls back to ready with the old value when one exists)
ready/loading --dispose() (holders left)--> closing --last holder released--> disposed
any state except disposed --forceDispose()/dispose() (no holder)--> disposed

items: `idle`: loading has not started.
`loading`: `factory` is running; when an earlier value exists (a reload started by `retry()`), it is kept as `previous`, and reads return the old value instead of suspending.
`ready`: a value can be read.
`failed`: loading failed and there is no older value to fall back to; with an older value, the state falls back to `ready` (keeping it) instead of `failed`.

`closing`: when `dispose()` is called while holders (resource leases or version leases) remain, the resource enters this intermediate state and terminates only when the last holder releases; no half-closed state is visible from outside.
`disposed`: the logical end state. `whenTerminal()` resolves only after the actual disposers finish, and every method is either a no-op or throws `[store] resource is disposed`.

blocks.text: `factory` may be a function `(context) => T \| Promise<T>` or an object `{ load, runtime?, scheduler?, dispose?, keepAliveMs?, onError?, onTerminal? }` (equivalent to merging those fields with `options`). `IStoreResourceLoadContext` provides `{ signal, generation, token }`; `signal` aborts when that load is superseded or the resource closes.

Construction reads only the known fields above into a stable snapshot: `load` and each known accessor are read at most once, and unknown field getters are neither enumerated nor run; own enumerable fields of an explicit `options` override fields of the same name on the factory object. `dispose`, `onError` and `onTerminal` must be functions when present; otherwise a tagged `INVALID_OPTION` is thrown synchronously before any request or Resource state is created.

Automatic `$dispose` and custom disposers follow lifecycle's common admission rules: the disposer getter and the `then` getter are each read once, and the captured functions are called with the original resource and the original thenable as receiver. The original exception of a getter, a call or an async rejection is reachable through `onError(error, 'dispose')`; repeated `forceDispose()` never cleans the same value twice.

`scope.resource()` delegates to `createStoreResource()` as is, with the same known-field snapshot and callback precedence, and never spreads or enumerates the factory again; the user's effective `onTerminal` is unchanged. The scope removes resources that end on their own from its private set through `whenTerminal()`, without rewriting any public disposer. `scope.dispose()` force-releases (`forceDispose`) every resource still in the group without waiting for holders: it assumes the whole scope is closing and individual holders no longer matter.

blocks.text: These four factories are the tools this module uses to build all of its own errors. They are exported for advanced integrations that want to throw their own diagnostics under the `@migaia/store-light` identity (for example a custom `FieldBuilder` reusing the same identity convention); everyday code does not call them, and simply catches this module's errors and branches on `error.code` (see the table below).

Errors created by this module use `source: '@migaia/store-light'` and a stable `code`. Reactive ownership errors and Resource request failures and cancellations keep their original owner. FieldBuilder initialization failures and late field cleanup failures keep a complete existing identity; other native extensible Errors are marked `INITIALIZATION_FAILED` / `FIELD_DISPOSE_FAILED` on the original object, keeping type, message and stack; values that cannot carry an identity stay reachable through the `cause` of a coded fallback. When initialization and cleanup both fail, the primary Error stays the original object when its cause can be written, and an existing cause is merged with the cleanup failure; otherwise an `INIT_AND_CLEANUP_FAILED` AggregateError is used.

blocks.text: Failed store construction: when processing any field of `shape` throws (for example a `FieldBuilder.create()` throws), the whole construction rolls back: native nodes are released synchronously in segments, outside resources are released by the lifecycle scope, the internal `signals`/`computeds`/`wasmFields`/`fieldSources` are cleared, and the original error keeps propagating (when cleanup itself fails, the cleanup error is attached to the original error's `cause` where possible, never replacing it).

Failed async field initialization: when any Promise in `readyList` rejects, the store is marked `disposed = true` at once, the remaining initializations in flight are aborted (`initAbort.abort()`), and the resources already created are released. This happens in the reject path of the `ready` Promise, so even when the caller never awaits `storeReady()`, the store has converged correctly and never sits in a zombie state with some fields usable.

When `$dispose()` takes effect: field reads and writes reference the underlying nodes (`node.value`) directly in closures, with no proxy over the store object. `$dispose()` therefore only has to flip the `disposed` flag, release the native node segments and the existing scope, and clear the internal maps. Every caller that already holds the store sees `[store] store is disposed` on later user-field reads, writes and guarded method calls.

StoreResource holders: a value counts as having no holder (and can be reclaimed) only when there is no active lease from `retainResource()`/`retainVersion()` and no uncommitted capture. A direct `captureVersion()` has no 4-second expiry; only the provisional capture converted after a pending generation succeeds has the 4000 ms abandonment window. The `keepAliveMs` countdown starts only when there is no holder at all, and is cancelled as soon as a new holder appears.

A "user settings panel": local writable fields use a strict actions-only guard, the remote profile loads asynchronously through `StoreResource`, and everything is released together when the component unmounts.

Q: Writing `this.x = 1` inside a getter throws. A computed has only a getter and no setter, so the property is not writable at the descriptor level; assigning to it in ESM strict mode throws `TypeError`. A derived value changes only through the signal fields it depends on.

Q: `store.field = x` did not throw, although I passed `mutationPolicy`. Check whether the write went through `$batch`/`$set`/`$hydrate` or a method (action): these paths call `runInAction()` first, so `assertMutationAllowed` allows writes while the action depth is above zero. Only assignments outside those paths are blocked.

Q: `createStore()` says "only accepts synchronous fields", but the code looks synchronous. Check that `FieldBuilder.mode` is explicitly `'sync'`; async fields use `'async'` and go to `createAsyncStore()`. The legacy form without a mode has been removed.

Q: `StoreResource.read()` keeps throwing the same Promise and the page is stuck loading. Make sure the caller sits inside a Suspense boundary that awaits or handles the thrown Promise; throwing a Promise from `read()` is by design (the React Suspense protocol), not an error. The real problem is usually a missing `<Suspense>`, or rendering again synchronously before the Promise settles.

Q: The old value disappeared after `retry()`. `retry()` only guarantees that the old value stays readable until the reload completes. If no `retainVersion` locks the old value, it is retired and cleaned up normally once loading succeeds (running the `dispose` option or the value's own `$dispose`). Use `retainVersion(version)` to keep a version.

Q: What is the difference between `$plain()`/`$hydrate()` and `$snapshot()`? `$snapshot()` returns the current display state (including computeds and wasm fields) and requires the store to be ready; `$plain()`/`$hydrate()` handle only persistable signal fields and do not require readiness. Use the latter for persistence and hydration, the former for display and debugging.
From the repository root: `pnpm --filter @migaia/store-light fmt` → `lint` → `typecheck` → `typecheck:test` → `test` → `build`. The browser integration path also runs `typecheck:e2e` and `test:e2e`.

Importing Store light alone creates no default Runtime. The shared default instance of reactive is taken only the first time a store is created without an explicit `options.runtime`; with an explicit runtime, construction uses that owner directly. The instance is the same object as the `defaultRuntime` later imported from the reactive root.

Actions keep the method's own return value or Promise outside the synchronous mutation callback. Only writes before the first `await` share that batch; use `$batch()` for writes after it. Mutation-policy callbacks stay synchronous. With `warnAsyncActions`, the first thenable an action returns is reported as `ACTION_BATCH_BOUNDARY` through the store's Runtime.

StoreResource uses the Runtime captured at creation for idle cleanup and diagnostics, and its admitted scheduler for the cache lifetime and the 4000 ms provisional capture window. `keepAliveMs: 0` still evicts synchronously. Without `onError`, the original failure goes to the Runtime; when a user reporter throws or rejects, both the original failure and the reporter failure reach the Runtime as the original objects. There is no fallback to the host console or a global reportError.

sections.heading: Migration note: requests handed to Resource

blocks.text: StoreLight now adapts one `@migaia/resource` instance. It keeps the identity of actual values, render captures, resource and version leases and value release, and deletes its own duplicate request/data controller and request coordinator. `StoreResourceDataKind` and its type are removed; use `ResourceStatus` / `ResourceFetchStatus` for native Resource state. `StoreResourceKind` remains internal facade vocabulary; `readSnapshot()` still returns `value`/`version`/`token` and has no public kind property.

Repeated reads while loading throw the same Promise, which resolves with the original value. `retry()` or a forced cancellation rejects the superseded Promise at once with a native `AbortError`, source `@migaia/resource`, code `REQUEST_ABORTED`; previously a loader that ignored the abort could keep that Promise pending until it finished on its own. Handle the old Promise's rejection when driving retries by hand. Late returned values are released once. A failed refresh restores the old data; an old version lease delays its release until the lease is released. Loaded values still waiting for clock settlement remain owned and are released if settlement fails. When admitting the provisional-capture timer fails, the partial captures and timers are released and reported as release housekeeping; a value that loaded successfully stays readable and notifies subscribers. No async-context mechanism is introduced.

The root entry no longer exports `StoreResourceKind` or `IStoreResourceKind`; the ownership vocabulary stays internal, and public resources expose snapshots and completion methods. `ILegacyFieldBuilder` is removed: use `IAsyncFieldBuilder` with `mode: 'async'`. `IFieldBuilder` remains the union of explicit sync/async builders, including its store-wasm re-export. Replace `resource.retain()` with `retainResource()` and `resource.retain(version)` with `retainVersion(version)`. No compatibility alias remains. External usage is unknown; publish this as a breaking API change.

import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { bindStoreMiddleware, loggerMiddleware } from '@migaia/store-middleware'

const events: string[] = []
const store = createStore({ count: 0 })
const execution = { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false } as const

await host.dispose()

blocks.text: runAction 不等待返回 Promise；同步返回即发 end，后续 rejection 不会自动变成这次 action:error。它本身不克隆状态或撤销失败 action 之前的写入。recordState/recordError 和 runAction 的观察事件通过隔离通道报告诊断失败；公开 emit 不在该隔离保证内。

`IStoreMiddlewarePlugin<S,TExt,TConfig,TShared>` 直接复用通用 IPlugin；后三个类型默认分别为 Record<string,never>、Record<string,unknown>、Record<string,never>。install(core) 同时拿到通用 config/getShared/onDispose/usePipeline 和领域 runtime/getState()/applyState(state)/reportError(error,phase)。领域错误上报透传 Runtime。

只能 usePipeline 注册同步 stage；useAsyncPipeline/useGeneratorPipeline 模式不匹配，由 plugin-host 的 PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH 拒绝。next(event) 只记录继续值，下游在当前 stage 返回后执行；不能用 next 后的代码同步观察下游完成。只第一次 next 生效，重复/迟到按 PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE/PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE 报告。遗漏 next 阻止后续事件处理并向 Runtime trace-listener 报 MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED，不撤销已经发生的 Store 写入。

`loggerMiddleware<S=any>(sink?)` 创建名称固定 `'store-logger'` 的插件。sink 默认 `console.log('[store]',event,state)`，参数为 `(IMiddlewareEvent<unknown>,unknown)=>void`；不依赖状态类型，S 仅用于约束目标 Host。它先调用 next 记录继续值，再在当前 stage 读取 core.getState 并调用 sink；此时下游 stage 还未运行。state 是调用 sink 时读到的值，不是事件生成时自动固定的快照。sink 的返回 Promise 不被等待。

`IDevToolsAdapter<S>` 有同步 init(state:S)、send(event:IMiddlewareEvent<S>,state:S)，可选 subscribe(listener:(command:IDevToolsCommand<S>)=>void):IDisposer。init/send 必须为函数，subscribe 若存在也必须为函数，否则 connectDevTools 拒绝 INVALID_OPTION。

领域命令为 `{type:'commit'} | {type:'jump',state:S} | {type:'reset',state:S}`。连接时立即 init(core.getState())；每事件 stage 中 next 后调用 send，仍遵循“当前 stage 返回才到下游”。commit 重新 init 当前状态；jump/reset 用 runAction('devtools:<type>',()=>applyState(state)) 执行，会产生真正 action 事件。未提供 applyState 时 DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY；binding 已桥接 $hydrate。只恢复普通字段，不还原外部副作用、方法、computed 或 WASM 资源。

`createReduxDevToolsAdapter<S>(connection:IReduxDevToolsConnection<S>,runtime?)` 的 connection 必填且含 init(state)、send(action:unknown,state)、subscribe(listener):IDisposer；runtime 默认共享 Runtime，仅用于解析失败报告。IReduxDevToolsMessage 的 type、payload.type、state 都可省略，state 是 JSON 字符串。

blocks.text: immutable 先接纳严格数据图，再委托 Utils 唯一 structuredClone 实现。允许普通/null 原型记录、普通数组、当前 realm 原生 Map/Set/Date/RegExp/ArrayBuffer，以及非共享 ArrayBuffer 支撑的标准 TypedArray/DataView。递归检查 Map key/value、Set 成员和记录/数组数据属性；循环与共享引用交由原克隆引擎保持。自定义 class（含内建子类）、未接纳的原生类型拒绝；记录/数组访问器在求值前拒绝，不运行 getter。函数、symbol 等由 canonical clone 拒绝。缺 structuredClone 为 ENV_UNSUPPORTED，不支持值为 CLONE_UNSUPPORTED；Utils 错误整个保留在 cause，其下再到原生失败，不跳过中间层。
旧版 class 静默丢方法、getter 求值、跨 realm 或未列内建值应迁移为支持的数据，或明确选择 diagnostic/opaque。Utils 自身的投影契约没有被本策略改写。

diagnostic 优先 structuredClone，失败时复用 canonical 递归复制：plain object/array 递归，支持的 Date/RegExp/Map/Set/ArrayBuffer/TypedArray 子树单独克隆，函数/类/宿主子树可保留引用。枚举访问器按 Utils 行为读取并记录，`__proto__` 通过 defineProperty 写入；循环和共享结构由该遍历处理，不另建 clone 引擎。默认 binding 的 diagnostic 不能保证全树隔离；opaque 只是省去复制，不承诺实测速度。
Host 的 use/unUse/dispose、插件失败回滚、配置与资源逆序清理归 plugin-host。同一 Host 插件名唯一。dispose 首先关闭 binding disposer 登记，再同步按后进先出调用，尝试全部清理，之后卸载插件；不等待 disposer 返回的 Promise，应登记同步函数。重入登记立即执行；晚登记失败按 callback 身份规则同步传播。

重复 dispose 返回同一 Promise，结果为 `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`，可保留 plugin-host 的其它物理清理信息。绑定 disposer 失败排在 cleanupErrors 前面，然后是插件清理失败；这些被收集而不以清理异常拒绝 Promise。cleanupComplete 沿用插件清理完成状态，表示物理完成，不表示 cleanupErrors 必为空。关闭不会销毁借入 Store/Runtime；Store 可继续工作，只是不再被这一绑定观察。领域闭包没有统一的 open 守卫，保留的 runAction 仍可执行 fn；关闭插件接纳不等于取消任意业务回调。

sections.id: 观察-store-并在解绑后继续使用
sections.heading: 观察 Store 并在解绑后继续使用

blocks.text: 诊断面板需要观察已有 Store 的动作与状态事件；关闭面板应停止观察，同时让应用状态继续可用。
把已经发出追踪事件的 Store 动作再包进一层动作，会增加重复边界；把绑定当作 Store 所有者，又会让面板清理销毁应用状态。
`bindStoreMiddleware` 转发 Store 自身的动作追踪与状态通知；直接安装 `@migaia/store-light`，用 `loggerMiddleware` 收集事件类型，刷新 Store 运行时后，独立释放绑定。
输出：

blocks.code:
2 true 1
0 2

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `2 true 1`、`0 2`；首次动作产生两条动作事件及状态事件，绑定释放后，另一次动作仍改变 Store，却不再进入原中间件。
执行预算必填，`false` 显式取消对应截止时间；绑定只借用 Store 和运行时，默认诊断克隆尽力复制，不支持的子树仍可能按引用共享。

createStore 的 shape 包含 count 字段与 increment 方法；未传自定义 mutationPolicy。binding 的 execution 两字段明确为 false，其余选项省略：Host 使用 off 策略，actionPrefix 为 undefined，clone 使用 diagnostic。loggerMiddleware 的 sink 收集 event.type；省略 sink 时输出到 console.log。Store 与 Runtime 只借入，最后由应用显式 $dispose Store。

sections.id: 让-store-与宿主共享同一严格策略
sections.heading: 让 Store 与宿主共享同一严格策略

blocks.text: 组件不能直接赋值，但 Store 方法与宿主管理的动作都需要修改同一状态。
分别创建两个 `actions-only` 策略会产生两套动作深度；进入宿主策略的作用域，不能替另一个 Store 策略授权写入。
创建一份 `actions-only` 策略，把同一对象交给 `createStore` 与 `bindStoreMiddleware`；直接安装 `@migaia/store-light`，由 Store 执行守卫，`host.runAction` 进入共享作用域。
输出：

blocks.code:
ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED
true 2
3

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED`、`true 2`、`3`；直接赋值被拒绝，宿主持有同一个策略且能在动作内写入，Store 自身动作仍可使用。
策略模式默认 `off`；它检查写入许可，不是事务，也不会撤销用户副作用，作用域只覆盖同步执行，`await` 后的写入须重新进入作用域。

createMutationPolicy 的 mode 默认为 off，本例明确 actions-only。Store options.mutationPolicy 与 binding options.mutationPolicy 是同一个对象；两 execution 预算为 false。runAction 的 name 是诊断名，fn 同步写入，metadata 省略为 undefined。Store action 进入自身作用域，直接字段写入先经过守卫。

sections.id: 区分诊断接收器失败与业务失败
sections.heading: 区分诊断接收器失败与业务失败

blocks.text: 日志接收器在观察动作时失败；应用仍须执行业务函数，而真正的业务异常必须交给调用者。
在业务路径上直接调用诊断接收器，会让日志故障中断动作；反过来吞掉所有异常，又会掩盖真实业务失败，还可能让人误以为状态已经回滚。
`createStoreMiddlewareHost` 隔离 `runAction` 的观察事件，并向传入运行时报告失败；直接安装 `@migaia/reactive`，本例用 `onError` 收集诊断，业务回调仍正常返回或抛错。
输出：

blocks.code:
42 1 2
true 2 4

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `42 1 2`、`true 2 4`；成功业务结果不受两次诊断报告影响，失败动作交付原业务错误，失败前的赋值仍已生效。
`runAction`、`recordState/recordError` 隔离观察失败，公开 `emit` 则可能抛出流水线错误；`runAction` 同步批处理，不回滚写入，也不等待返回的 Promise。

createRuntime.onError 接收诊断错误；省略时使用 Runtime adapter.reportError。Host runtime 与 getState 必填，getState 返回本例 state 引用，不自动克隆；applyState 省略，mutationPolicy 默认为 off。两 execution 为 false。logger sink 同步抛诊断错误；两个 runAction 分别返回值或抛本地原错。

sections.id: 逆序释放绑定并保留清理失败
sections.heading: 逆序释放绑定并保留清理失败

blocks.text: 面板拥有两项绑定清理和一个插件资源；其中一项绑定清理失败，另一项绑定与插件仍须释放。
遇到第一个清理异常就停止，会遗留后续资源；多个调用者各自启动释放，也可能重复执行同一清理。
把同步绑定清理交给 `createStoreMiddlewareHost.attachBindingDisposer`，插件清理通过 `core.onDispose` 登记；直接安装 `@migaia/reactive`，`host.dispose` 先逆序执行绑定清理，再委托插件清理。
输出：

blocks.code:
true
["二号","一号","插件"]
true 1 true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true`、`["二号","一号","插件"]`、`true 1 true`；释放调用共享同一个 Promise，清理按输出顺序继续执行，原始失败保留在 `cleanupErrors`。
`cleanupComplete` 表示委托清理已完成，不等于错误列表为空，已完成的绑定清理失败仍会记录；此处绑定清理函数是同步函数，不据此推断所有插件钩子都串行执行。

Host 传入 createRuntime() 与 getState，execution 均为 false。attachBindingDisposer 接受同步无参函数；后登记的先执行。插件的 name 在该 Host 内唯一，install(core) 用 core.onDispose 登记插件资源并返回空扩展。dispose 无参数，cleanupComplete 和 cleanupErrors 各自描述完成情况与失败。

sections.id: 在-await-后重新进入动作作用域
sections.heading: 在 await 后重新进入动作作用域

blocks.text: 异步流程从获准动作开始，等待下一步后再尝试受保护写入；后续执行不应继承已经返回的同步许可作用域。
一直把全局动作标记留到 Promise 完成，会让期间的无关工作也得到授权；把同步守卫当作异步事务，又会隐藏许可真正结束的位置。
`MutationPolicy.runInAction` 只在调用回调期间增加深度，并在 `finally` 恢复；比较返回前后的 `insideAction`，等待失败后，再显式进入一次同步写入作用域。
输出：

blocks.code:
true false
ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED false
已重新进入

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true false`、`ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED false`、`已重新进入`；异步回调开始时在作用域内，`await` 后的执行被拒绝，显式重新进入后检查通过。
模式默认 `off`，本例选择 `actions-only`；`runInAction` 立即返回回调结果，支持同步嵌套，不等待也不自动捕获稍后的 Promise 拒绝。
MutationPolicy mode 明确为 actions-only，省略则 off。runInAction 的 fn 立即返回 Promise，后续 await 不保留同步作用域；assertMutationAllowed 的 operation 默认为 'mutation'，本例自定义字符串只作诊断。insideAction 是只读状态，不是可外部设置的授权开关。

sections.id: 明确选择独立副本或引用共享
sections.heading: 明确选择独立副本或引用共享

blocks.text: 审计历史需要独立的嵌套数据，诊断却可能需要保留无法克隆的回调；调用者必须明确选择需要哪种保证。
含糊的回退克隆可能在历史记录要求隔离时，悄悄返回实时引用；把结果称作不可变，还可能让人误以为返回对象已经冻结。
`ClonePolicy.immutable` 要求支持的数据图得到独立副本，`opaque` 返回原引用，`diagnostic` 尽力复制；严格路径在执行访问器 getter 前就拒绝该输入。
输出：

blocks.code:
1 2 false true
CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 0
1 true
false

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `1 2 false true`、`CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 0`、`1 true`、`false`；严格副本独立，不透明策略共享引用，getter 没被执行，诊断策略复制嵌套数据并保留回调身份。
独立不等于冻结；缺少 `structuredClone` 时严格策略可能抛 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`，不支持的数据可能抛 `CLONE_UNSUPPORTED`，诊断策略仍可能共享不支持的子树，不透明策略始终返回原值。
三种策略均只接收 value，无 options；本例 source 为普通记录与嵌套数据。immutable 得到独立可变副本，opaque 保持严格引用身份；diagnostic 复制支持的嵌套数据并保留函数引用。Object.defineProperty 的 getter 被严格准入拒绝，reads=0；immutable 不是冻结函数。

本包为 Store 提供写入许可、action/state/error 事件和可装卸诊断插件；状态字段、订阅、$plain/$hydrate 属于 store-light，依赖图与上报属于 reactive，安装/卸载和 pipeline 属于 plugin-host。它不实现持久化或历史面板，相关功能分别由 store-persist、store-devtools 组合。只要简单监听状态时，Store.$subscribe 已足够。

根入口导出 MutationPolicy/createMutationPolicy、事件与命令词表、Host/binding/logger/DevTools adapter 和错误；克隆策略只从 `@migaia/store-middleware/tolerant-clone` 导入。普通依赖为 middleware-pipeline、plugin-host、reactive、store-light、utils。示例直接导入 store-light/reactive 时要显式安装对应包。

旧 middlewarePlugin/IStoreMiddleware/IMiddlewareContext 已移除，改用 `IStoreMiddlewarePlugin` 的 install(core) 与 core.usePipeline。旧 tolerantClone 名在两入口都已删除；ClonePolicy、immutableSnapshotClone、opaqueReferenceClone、diagnosticClone 以及 IClonePolicyMode 都归窄入口。IMutationGuard/IMutationPolicy 直接从 store-light 导入，没有本包别名。原 store-devtools 的 StoreDevtoolsCommand/IStoreDevtoolsCommand 迁移到本包 ReduxDevToolsCommand/IReduxDevToolsCommand，协议字符串不变。

`new MutationPolicy(mode?)` 与 `createMutationPolicy(mode?)` 等价，mode 默认 `'off'`，联合为 `'off' | 'actions-only'`。off 放行；actions-only 在当前 action 深度为 0 时拒绝 assertMutationAllowed，错误为 ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED，信息为 `[store] {operation} is not allowed outside an action`。

blocks.text: 返回 Promise 不延长作用域，不等待其结算；await 后写入要重新进入 action。它不是事务，不回滚已完成写入或回调的外部副作用。同步 fn 失败保留已有包身份，未编码失败按 CALLBACK_FAILED 附码或通过 cause/errors 保留原值。
要让 host.runAction 授权 Store 写入，createStore 和 binding 必须共享同一个 mutationPolicy。不同实例不会取消 Store 自己的直接写守卫；Store action、$set/$batch 等仍进入其自身策略，但 Host 不能授权另一个实例。策略放行与真正拦截字段写入是两回事，后者由 Store 负责。
`IMiddlewareEvent<S>` 为以下三类的联合。metadata 均可省略，类型为 `Readonly<Record<string,unknown>>`，没有隐含复制策略。

blocks.text: runAction 不等待返回 Promise；同步返回即发 end，后续 rejection 不会自动变成这次 action:error。它本身不克隆状态或撤销失败 action 之前的写入。recordState/recordError 和 runAction 的观察事件通过隔离通道报告诊断失败；公开 emit 不在该隔离保证内。

`IStoreMiddlewarePlugin<S,TExt,TConfig,TShared>` 直接复用通用 IPlugin；后三个类型默认分别为 Record<string,never>、Record<string,unknown>、Record<string,never>。install(core) 同时拿到通用 config/getShared/onDispose/usePipeline 和领域 runtime/getState()/applyState(state)/reportError(error,phase)。领域错误上报透传 Runtime。

只能 usePipeline 注册同步 stage；useAsyncPipeline/useGeneratorPipeline 模式不匹配，由 plugin-host 的 PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH 拒绝。next(event) 只记录继续值，下游在当前 stage 返回后执行；不能用 next 后的代码同步观察下游完成。只第一次 next 生效，重复/迟到按 PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE/PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE 报告。遗漏 next 阻止后续事件处理并向 Runtime trace-listener 报 MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED，不撤销已经发生的 Store 写入。

`loggerMiddleware<S=any>(sink?)` 创建名称固定 `'store-logger'` 的插件。sink 默认 `console.log('[store]',event,state)`，参数为 `(IMiddlewareEvent<unknown>,unknown)=>void`；不依赖状态类型，S 仅用于约束目标 Host。它先调用 next 记录继续值，再在当前 stage 读取 core.getState 并调用 sink；此时下游 stage 还未运行。state 是调用 sink 时读到的值，不是事件生成时自动固定的快照。sink 的返回 Promise 不被等待。

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: One action is recorded twice and a closed panel keeps listening because manual wrappers and subscriptions have no common binding.
The host enters an action but the Store still rejects writes because each uses a different permission instance.
A logging failure stops business work while a real business exception disappears because diagnostics share its error boundary.
The first cleanup throws and later subscriptions or plugins remain because release stops at that exception.
Later edits rewrite historical snapshots because a fallback copy quietly returned shared references.

Reuse the Store's own events and end observation separately. The binding forwards existing traces and state notifications, while disposal releases the binding and plugins as shown in Observe a Store and detach without disposing it.

Share write permission between host actions and the Store. One policy instance makes host.runAction and the field guard check the same synchronous scope as shown in Share one strict policy between a Store and its host.

Handle diagnostic faults separately from business failure. runAction reports isolated observation failures while preserving the business result or original error as shown in Keep a diagnostic sink failure separate from a business failure.

Continue cleanup after a failure and retain the failed value. Binding disposers run in reverse order before plugin cleanup, sharing one disposal Promise as shown in Release bindings in reverse order and retain cleanup failures.

Choose independent data or shared references explicitly. The three ClonePolicy choices distinguish strict copying, the original value, and best-effort diagnostic copying as shown in Choose strict independence or explicit reference sharing.

blocks.text: This module adds mutation permission, action/state/error events, and removable diagnostic plugins to a Store. store-light owns fields, subscriptions, $plain/$hydrate; reactive owns the dependency graph and reporting; plugin-host owns installation, removal, and pipelines. Persistence and a history panel belong to store-persist and store-devtools. Store.$subscribe is enough for a simple state listener.

The root exports MutationPolicy/createMutationPolicy, event and command vocabularies, the Host/binding/logger/DevTools adapter, and errors. Clone strategies are available only from `@migaia/store-middleware/tolerant-clone`. Ordinary dependencies are middleware-pipeline, plugin-host, reactive, store-light, and utils. Explicitly install store-light/reactive when importing them directly in an example.

The old middlewarePlugin/IStoreMiddleware/IMiddlewareContext adapters were removed; use `IStoreMiddlewarePlugin`, install(core), and core.usePipeline. tolerantClone no longer exists at either entry. ClonePolicy, immutableSnapshotClone, opaqueReferenceClone, diagnosticClone, and IClonePolicyMode belong to the narrow entry. Import IMutationGuard/IMutationPolicy directly from store-light; this module has no aliases. The former store-devtools StoreDevtoolsCommand/IStoreDevtoolsCommand imports move to ReduxDevToolsCommand/IReduxDevToolsCommand here without changing protocol strings.

`new MutationPolicy(mode?)` and `createMutationPolicy(mode?)` are equivalent. mode defaults to `'off'` and is `'off' | 'actions-only'`. off allows writes; actions-only rejects assertMutationAllowed at action depth zero with ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED and `[store] {operation} is not allowed outside an action`.

operation defaults to `'mutation'` and identifies a diagnostic; the check does not mutate state
Calls fn synchronously and returns its original value; a depth counter supports nesting, and finally restores it

blocks.text: Returning a Promise does not extend the scope or wait for settlement. Reenter an action for writes after await. This is not a transaction: completed writes and callback-owned external effects are not rolled back. Synchronous fn failures retain an existing module identity; uncoded failures receive CALLBACK_FAILED or retain the original value through cause/errors.

createStore and its binding must share one mutationPolicy for host.runAction to authorize Store writes. Separate instances do not disable the Store's direct-write guard: Store actions and $set/$batch enter their own policy, but the Host cannot authorize a different instance. The Store owns actual field-write interception; the policy only grants permission.
`IMiddlewareEvent<S>` is the following union. Every metadata field is optional `Readonly<Record<string,unknown>>`; no implicit copy policy is applied.

blocks.text: Host-generated timestamps use Date.now. runAction measures durationMs with performance.now, falling back to Date.now. A binding forwards the Runtime trace timestamp and uses zero when durationMs is absent. This describes synchronous duration.

The enum-like objects and value unions are MiddlewareEventType/IMiddlewareEventType (action/state/error), MiddlewareEventPhase/IMiddlewareEventPhase (start/end/error), and MiddlewareCommandType/IMiddlewareCommandType (commit/jump/reset). None takes call arguments.

`createStoreMiddlewareHost<S>(options):IStoreMiddlewareHost<S>` creates one frozen managed Host handle, not a class to construct with new. Its use/unUse, configuration, plugin identity, and stable handle identity come from plugin-host. Store members are installed before that same canonical handle freezes; no second wrapper is published. Nonobject options or failed reflection/reads produce INVALID_OPTION with the original cause.

blocks.text: runAction does not wait for a returned Promise: synchronous return emits end, and a later rejection does not automatically become action:error. It does not clone state or undo writes before an action failed. recordState/recordError and runAction observation events report diagnostic failures through an isolated path. Public emit is outside that isolation guarantee.

`IStoreMiddlewarePlugin<S,TExt,TConfig,TShared>` reuses IPlugin. The last three type parameters default to Record<string,never>, Record<string,unknown>, and Record<string,never>. install(core) receives general config/getShared/onDispose/usePipeline plus domain runtime/getState()/applyState(state)/reportError(error,phase). Domain error reporting delegates to the Runtime.

Register synchronous stages with usePipeline. useAsyncPipeline/useGeneratorPipeline is rejected by plugin-host with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH. next(event) only records the continuation value; downstream starts after the current stage returns. Code after next therefore cannot synchronously observe downstream completion. Only the first next takes effect; duplicate/late calls are reported as PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE/PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE. Omitting next filters the remaining event chain and reports MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED through the Runtime's trace-listener phase; it does not undo a Store write that already happened.

`loggerMiddleware<S=any>(sink?)` creates a plugin with fixed name `'store-logger'`. sink defaults to `console.log('[store]',event,state)` and has type `(IMiddlewareEvent<unknown>,unknown)=>void`. It does not depend on state shape; S can pin the target Host type. The stage calls next to record continuation, then reads core.getState and invokes sink before the downstream stage runs. state is read at sink invocation, not automatically captured when the event was created. Returned sink Promises are not awaited.

sections.heading: bindStoreMiddleware: borrow a Store and bridge observations

blocks.text: `bindStoreMiddleware<S extends Record<string,unknown>>(store:IReactiveStore<S>,options:IStoreMiddlewareBindingOptions):IStoreMiddlewareBinding<S>` requires both arguments. It returns the same frozen canonical Host with a readonly store property strictly equal to the supplied instance. It creates neither another Store nor another Runtime.

Forwards only action trace names beginning with this prefix; an empty string does not filter

blocks.text: Binding captures clone(store.$plain()) as previous. A synchronous initial state-read/clone failure uses callback identity handling: uncoded failures become CALLBACK_FAILED, extensible native errors retain identity, and a frozen error remains on cause. Later subscription and Host reads keep their respective owner's error path. Each Store notification clones next, calls recordState('store:update',previous,next), then updates previous. Earlier history is not replayed: the first previous reflects binding time. Every getState clones $plain again, and applyState delegates to $hydrate.

Only ordinary fields exposed by $plain enter previous/next. Computed values, methods, WASM-backed fields, and external resources do not. Runtime action traces go straight to host.emit rather than host.runAction, avoiding a second policy scope. Wrapping the same bound Store action manually in host.runAction creates two independent event paths. actionPrefix filters names from the shared Runtime; it does not establish Store ownership.

If subscription construction fails, rollback attempts trace and state unsubscription before closing the Host. A synchronous rollback failure produces CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError with the primary error at errors[0], followed by original cleanup errors. Cleanup does not erase the initial binding failure. Normal disposal after successful binding uses a structured result instead of this exception path.

`IDevToolsAdapter<S>` provides synchronous init(state:S) and send(event:IMiddlewareEvent<S>,state:S), plus optional subscribe(listener:(command:IDevToolsCommand<S>)=>void):IDisposer. init/send must be functions, and a supplied subscribe must also be callable; otherwise connectDevTools rejects INVALID_OPTION.

Domain commands are `{type:'commit'} | {type:'jump',state:S} | {type:'reset',state:S}`. Connection immediately calls init(core.getState()). Its event stage calls next then send, still before downstream execution. commit reinitializes current state. jump/reset use runAction('devtools:<type>',()=>applyState(state)), creating real action events. Without applyState this is DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY; a binding already bridges $hydrate. Only ordinary fields are restored, not external effects, methods, computed values, or WASM resources.

`createReduxDevToolsAdapter<S>(connection:IReduxDevToolsConnection<S>,runtime?)` requires connection with init(state), send(action:unknown,state), and subscribe(listener):IDisposer. runtime defaults to the shared Runtime and reports parse failures. IReduxDevToolsMessage has optional type, payload.type, and state; state is a JSON string.

rows: Parses a supplied state and produces jump
Parses a supplied state and produces reset

blocks.text: Non-DISPATCH messages, unknown payload.type values, and state commands without state are ignored. Malformed JSON in a supported command is not executed: the requested Runtime reports its original SyntaxError/DEVTOOLS_MESSAGE_INVALID in trace-listener, and later valid commands still work. Successful JSON.parse does not validate S's domain shape. adapter.send labels an action as name:phase, a state event as name, or an error as error:phase, and includes the original event. IReduxDevToolsCommand is the wire-value union, distinct from domain MiddlewareCommandType.
The narrow entry provides three generic single-argument functions `(value:T)=>T` with no additional options. ClonePolicy groups them by the properties below; IClonePolicyMode is their name union.

rows: Independent deep copy or explicit rejection, without silently sharing an unsupported subtree; this does not mean Object.freeze
Returns the original value/reference without copying, explicitly accepting sharing
Best-effort copying without throwing clone failures; unsupported subtrees may retain references, so it is not strict history

blocks.text: immutable admits a strict data graph, then delegates to Utils' sole structuredClone implementation. Supported values include ordinary/null-prototype records, ordinary arrays, current-realm native Map/Set/Date/RegExp/ArrayBuffer, and standard TypedArray/DataView backed by nonshared ArrayBuffer. Map keys/values, Set members, and record/array data properties are recursively admitted. The clone engine preserves cycles and shared references. Custom classes, including built-in subclasses, and unsupported native types are rejected. Record/array accessors are rejected without invoking getters. The canonical clone rejects functions, symbols, and similar unsupported values. Missing structuredClone is ENV_UNSUPPORTED; unsupported data is CLONE_UNSUPPORTED. The complete Utils error stays on cause, with native failure beneath it rather than skipping a layer.

Migrate older custom-class flattening, getter evaluation, cross-realm values, or unlisted built-ins to supported data, or explicitly choose diagnostic/opaque. This policy does not change Utils' own projection contract.

diagnostic prefers structuredClone and falls back to canonical recursive copying. Plain objects/arrays recurse; supported Date/RegExp/Map/Set/ArrayBuffer/TypedArray subtrees are cloned separately; function/class/host subtrees may remain shared. Enumerable accessors follow Utils' read-and-record behavior, and `__proto__` is written with defineProperty. That traversal handles cycles and shared structure; this module does not implement another clone engine. The default binding diagnostic policy cannot guarantee complete isolation. opaque avoids copying but makes no measured speed promise.

plugin-host owns Host use/unUse/dispose, installation rollback, configuration, and reverse resource cleanup. Plugin names must be unique within one Host. Every Host requires execution.mutationTimeoutMs and execution.pipelineDrainTimeoutMs with no default. These examples explicitly use false to remove both deadlines. sections.heading: Observe a Store and detach without disposing it

blocks.text: A diagnostics panel needs action and state events from an existing Store. Closing the panel must stop those observations while leaving application state usable.
Wrapping an already traced Store action in another action adds duplicate action boundaries. Treating the binding as the Store owner also makes panel cleanup destroy live state.

bindStoreMiddleware forwards the Store’s own traces and state notifications. Install store-light directly, use loggerMiddleware to collect event types, flush the Store Runtime, and dispose the binding separately.
Output:

blocks.code:
2 true 1
0 2

blocks.text: Prints `2 true 1` and `0 2`. The first action produces two action events and a state event; after binding disposal, another action changes the Store without reaching the old middleware.

Execution budgets are required; false explicitly removes each deadline. The binding borrows Store and Runtime. Its default diagnostic clone is best effort and may retain unsupported subtrees by reference.

The createStore shape contains count and an increment method, without a custom mutationPolicy. Both binding execution fields are false. Other options are omitted: the Host has an off policy, undefined actionPrefix, and diagnostic cloning. The loggerMiddleware sink collects event.type; omitting it uses console.log. Store and Runtime are borrowed; the application finally calls Store.$dispose.

sections.heading: Share one strict policy between a Store and its host

blocks.text: A component must not assign state directly, while both a Store method and a host-managed action need permission to update that same state.
Creating two actions-only policies gives each its own action depth. Entering the host policy cannot authorize writes guarded by a different Store policy.
Create one actions-only policy and pass the same object to createStore and bindStoreMiddleware. Install store-light directly; the Store enforces the guard and host.runAction enters that shared scope.
Output:

blocks.code:
ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED
true 2
3

blocks.text: Prints `ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED`, `true 2`, and `3`. Direct assignment is rejected, the host exposes the identical policy and can write inside its action, and the Store’s own action remains usable.

The default policy mode is off. A policy checks permission; it is not a transaction and cannot undo user side effects. Scope covers only synchronous execution, so reenter it around writes after await.

createMutationPolicy mode defaults to off; this example chooses actions-only. Store options.mutationPolicy and binding options.mutationPolicy receive the identical object. Both execution budgets are false. runAction name is diagnostic, fn writes synchronously, and metadata is undefined. Store methods enter their own action scope, while direct field writes encounter the guard.

sections.heading: Keep a diagnostic sink failure separate from a business failure

blocks.text: A logging sink fails during action observation. The application must still run its business function, while a real business exception must reach the caller.

Calling a diagnostic sink directly on the business path lets a logging outage abort the action. Swallowing every exception instead hides genuine business failure and can imply rollback that never occurred.

createStoreMiddlewareHost isolates runAction observation and reports failures to the supplied Runtime. Install reactive directly; onError collects diagnostics, while the business callback still returns or throws.
Output:

blocks.code:
42 1 2
true 2 4

blocks.text: Prints `42 1 2` and `true 2 4`. The successful business result survives two diagnostic reports; the failed action throws the same business Error and leaves its prior assignment applied.

runAction and recordState/recordError isolate observation failures; public emit can throw pipeline failures. runAction batches synchronously and does not roll back writes or wait for a returned Promise.

createRuntime.onError receives diagnostic errors; omitting it selects Runtime adapter.reportError. Host runtime and getState are required. getState returns the state reference without implicit copying. applyState is omitted and mutationPolicy defaults to off. Both execution budgets are false. The logger sink throws synchronously, while the two runAction calls return or throw a local original error.

sections.heading: Release bindings in reverse order and retain cleanup failures

blocks.text: A panel owns two binding cleanups and a plugin resource. One binding cleanup fails, but the remaining binding and plugin must still be released.
Stopping on the first cleanup exception leaves later resources behind. Independent dispose calls can also repeat cleanup unless they share one terminal operation.

Attach synchronous binding disposers to createStoreMiddlewareHost and register plugin cleanup through core.onDispose. Install reactive directly; host.dispose runs bindings in reverse order before delegated plugin cleanup.
Output:

blocks.code:
true
["second","first","plugin"]
true 1 true

blocks.text: Prints `true`, `["second","first","plugin"]`, and `true 1 true`. Calls share one disposal Promise, cleanup proceeds in the shown order, and the original failure remains in cleanupErrors.

cleanupComplete describes completed delegated cleanup, not an empty error list; settled binding failures are still recorded. Binding disposers here are synchronous; this does not claim every plugin hook is serial.

The Host receives createRuntime() and getState with both execution budgets false. attachBindingDisposer takes a synchronous no-argument function; later registrations run first. The plugin name is unique within this Host; install(core) registers cleanup with core.onDispose and returns an empty extension. dispose takes no arguments. cleanupComplete and cleanupErrors describe completion and failure separately.

sections.heading: Reenter the action scope after an await

blocks.text: An asynchronous flow starts inside an allowed action, awaits another step, then attempts a protected write. The later continuation must not inherit a permission scope that has already returned.
Keeping one global action flag open until a Promise settles authorizes unrelated work in the meantime. Treating a synchronous guard as an async transaction also hides where permission ends.

MutationPolicy.runInAction increments depth only while invoking its callback and restores it in finally. Check insideAction before and after returning, await the rejection, then explicitly reenter for a synchronous write.
Output:

blocks.code:
true false
ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED false
reentered

blocks.text: Prints `true false`, `ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED false`, and `reentered`. The async callback begins inside the scope, its continuation is denied after await, and explicit reentry succeeds.

Mode defaults to off; this example chooses actions-only. runInAction returns the callback result immediately, supports nested synchronous scopes, and does not await or automatically catch later Promise rejection.

MutationPolicy mode is explicitly actions-only, defaulting to off when omitted. runInAction immediately returns fn's Promise; a later await does not preserve the synchronous scope. assertMutationAllowed operation defaults to 'mutation'; the supplied strings identify diagnostics only. insideAction is readonly state, not an externally writable permission flag.

sections.heading: Choose strict independence or explicit reference sharing

blocks.text: Audit history needs independent nested data, while diagnostics may need to keep a callback that cannot be cloned. The caller must choose which guarantee matters.
A generic fallback clone can silently return live references when history expected isolation. Calling a result immutable can also wrongly imply that the returned object is frozen.

ClonePolicy.immutable requires an independent supported data graph, opaque returns the same reference, and diagnostic copies what it can. The strict path rejects accessors without running their getters.
Output:

blocks.code:
1 2 false true
CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 0
1 true
false

blocks.text: Prints `1 2 false true`, `CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 0`, `1 true`, and `false`. The strict copy is independent, opaque aliases, the getter is not run, and diagnostic copies nested data while retaining the callback.

Independent does not mean frozen. immutable may throw ENV_UNSUPPORTED without structuredClone or CLONE_UNSUPPORTED for rejected data; diagnostic may share unsupported subtrees, while opaque always shares the original value.

All three policies take only value, with no options. source is ordinary nested data. immutable produces an independent mutable copy, opaque preserves strict reference identity, and diagnostic copies supported data while preserving the callback. Strict admission rejects the Object.defineProperty getter with reads still zero; immutable is not a freeze operation.

This module adds mutation permission, action/state/error events, and removable diagnostic plugins to a Store. store-light owns fields, subscriptions, $plain/$hydrate; reactive owns the dependency graph and reporting; plugin-host owns installation, removal, and pipelines. Persistence and a history panel belong to store-persist and store-devtools. Store.$subscribe is enough for a simple state listener.

The root exports MutationPolicy/createMutationPolicy, event and command vocabularies, the Host/binding/logger/DevTools adapter, and errors. Clone strategies are available only from `@migaia/store-middleware/tolerant-clone`. Ordinary dependencies are middleware-pipeline, plugin-host, reactive, store-light, and utils. Explicitly install store-light/reactive when importing them directly in an example.

The old middlewarePlugin/IStoreMiddleware/IMiddlewareContext adapters were removed; use `IStoreMiddlewarePlugin`, install(core), and core.usePipeline. tolerantClone no longer exists at either entry. ClonePolicy, immutableSnapshotClone, opaqueReferenceClone, diagnosticClone, and IClonePolicyMode belong to the narrow entry. Import IMutationGuard/IMutationPolicy directly from store-light; this module has no aliases. The former store-devtools StoreDevtoolsCommand/IStoreDevtoolsCommand imports move to ReduxDevToolsCommand/IReduxDevToolsCommand here without changing protocol strings.

`new MutationPolicy(mode?)` and `createMutationPolicy(mode?)` are equivalent. mode defaults to `'off'` and is `'off' | 'actions-only'`. off allows writes; actions-only rejects assertMutationAllowed at action depth zero with ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED and `[store] {operation} is not allowed outside an action`.
