blocks.text: The Provider never destroys a Runtime. disposeOnUnmount controls Registry cleanup, including its atomStore and owned registrations. Explicit disposeOnUnmount:true can transfer an external Registry's unmount cleanup. Changing an internally managed runtime prop selects a new candidate Registry and switches after commit; the old committed instance follows effect cleanup rather than mixing its reads into the new graph.

On the client, RegistryBoundary retains in an effect and releases in cleanup. The last release defers to setTimeout(0), then rechecks reference count and generation, protecting immediate StrictMode remount. Explicitly owned external Registries use the same path. SSR runs none of these effects, so there is no automatic unmount cleanup: a request owner must await disposeAsync in finally. React supplies no reliable permanently-abandoned-render callback for uncommitted candidates. Timers do not guess that state; use an externally observable owner for deterministic release. useMemo stabilizes identity without owning cleanup.

blocks.text: An IStoreReadyBarrier factory is `()=>Promise<unknown> or unknown`. Normalization invokes it synchronously and admits its result with Promise.resolve. All barriers must fulfill before children render. Rejection is thrown during render for an outer Error Boundary; the Provider supplies no error UI. An Error reason retains its identity, including frozen Errors. A non-Error reason becomes READY_REJECTED with the original cause, without string coercion. Any equivalent initialization barrier can satisfy features.wasm; store-wasm's ensureWasm is an optional composition.

Within one Provider/barrierScope, the same ready array identity reuses its list Promise. A new array creates another readiness generation and ReadyBoundary even with the same entries; old completion cannot unlock it. Factory results have a separate scope+factory cache: pending/successful results can be shared by different lists, while failure removes that factory's cache entry. Reusing the old array still reuses its cached rejected list Promise. A new array alone does not necessarily rerun a successful factory. Different Providers/request scopes remain isolated. Factory execution is not guaranteed exactly once across abandoned renders; an application owner should supply a stable Promise for non-idempotent initialization.

Even an already-settled Promise updates tracked status in a then microtask, so the first synchronous render can remain pending. A client effect rechecks; SSR renderToString does not run that effect. Keep ready arrays, Stores/Signals/Resources, and selector/equality identities stable. Configuration is readonly input: supply a new object for changes, do not write state during render, and do not create resource-owning business instances on each render.

Normalized features.wasm is boolean, features.experimental is a shallow-frozen null-prototype allowlist, defaults contains warnAsyncActions, and ready is null or an object with promise/status()/error(). Its states are pending/ready/error. Only the experimental allowlist is frozen; the outer features/defaults/ready containers are not guaranteed frozen. StoreProviderState/IStoreProviderState exports those three values; states are not error codes. Sorted experimental-key encoding makes input key order irrelevant. Accessors are ignored as enabling data without invoking their getters; `__proto__` remains an ordinary key.

blocks.text: useStore first calls use(storeReady(store)) when store.$async is true, suspending beneath an outer Suspense until ready. The selector receives `IStoreShape<S>`. useTracked captures reads during render and publishes the selector/snapshot and dependencies at commit. An abandoned render does not change committed subscription semantics. Changing Runtime rebuilds the binding without running an old reader against the new graph. Changing selector/equality identity recaptures without requiring a subscription teardown each time. Equal results reuse snapshots rather than returning a new wrapper on repeated getSnapshot calls.

The public `IStableNode<T>` shape is readonly value:T and peek():T, but the node must also satisfy reactive's actual ownership protocol. useNodeValue checks node/runtime during render. enabled=false disables only subscription, not ownership checks or reading. The initial subscription run records dependencies without notifying; snapshots read node.peek directly without another old-value cache. useSignal uses this fixed-node path instead of dynamic dependency capture. This is a mechanism distinction, not a speed claim.

Client notification invokes the React listener through runtime.untracked and reports listener failures in the subscription-listener phase without polluting the current graph's dependencies. useSyncExternalStore connects that behavior to React's subscription model. A server getServerSnapshot read does not establish a client subscription.

blocks.text: All take one required argument and no options. Resource and IStoreResource are not interchangeable. useResource returns `IResourceState<T>`: idle, pending, success (data and optional refreshing), error (error), or cancelled (DOMException error). useResourceValue returns successful data, throws error/cancelled errors during render, and throws resource.promise for idle/pending beneath Suspense. Business Promises/errors are not thrown from the scheduler's Effect callback. The hook does not take over Resource disposal from its application owner.

useStoreResource subscribes through resource.subscribe/getSnapshot, captures a version with captureSnapshot(existingLease) in render, and commitCapture in layout releases the prior lease. Unmount cleanup uses a microtask and epoch check to protect StrictMode replay. This manages captured-version leases rather than transferring the whole resource lifetime to React. The read/preload/retry/captureSnapshot/commitCapture protocol must come from a real IStoreResource.

blocks.text: IStoreRegistrationOptions contains only owned?:boolean. Nonobject options, failed reads, or a nonboolean flag produce INVALID_CONFIG; owned is captured once. register/replace use ownerOf to check declared ownership. A different Runtime produces CROSS_RUNTIME; plain values without a declared owner are accepted. get/require/has are queries, but still check active state. Whole-owner disposal seals admission and clears entries before invoking owned callbacks, preventing reentrant registration.

Owned cleanup prefers $dispose(), then dispose(), and otherwise does nothing. Borrowed values are merely detached. Whole cleanup starts owned callbacks in reverse current-entry order, then atomStore cleanup, without serially awaiting each. lifecycle reads a thenable's then once and invokes it with its original receiver. Synchronous dispose does not await Promises; late failure is observed and reported in the Runtime's lifecycle-hook phase. disposeAsync after synchronous dispose waits for the same pending plan. Its completion Promise is published before callbacks, so reentrant cleanup can share it.

One synchronous failure can retain its native Error with REGISTRY_DISPOSAL_FAILED attached; multiple failures use AggregateError. Frozen/non-Error reasons remain reachable through cause/errors, and foreign identity is preserved. The stable completion replays synchronous and asynchronous failures. whenTerminal means cleanup has settled, not that it succeeded.

remove, replace, and register's returned disposer perform separate per-entry cleanup. Async rejection is reported but does not enter a later whole-owner disposeAsync wait ledger. To await a removed object's actual asynchronous release, retain its owner's completion protocol rather than treating Registry completion as a barrier for every historical cleanup.

Await resource.promise before reading. useResourceValue takes one required Resource without taking over disposal. Both renderToString calls share it; the owner finally calls resource.dispose.

This module connects existing state models to React. It does not implement a Store, Atom, Resource, or global-state framework. store-light owns Stores and their async fields, store-keyed owns Atom definitions and AtomStore, resource owns standalone Resource values, and reactive owns the dependency graph. lifecycle and utils supply shared cleanup and utilities. Ordinary shared variables do not become reactive without reading reactive nodes.

The ESM module exposes only `@migaia/store-react`, with no subpaths. Both react and react-dom are peers requiring `>=19`; async Stores use React 19's use. Explicitly install store-light, store-keyed, reactive, or resource when importing them directly. SSR examples use real ReactDOM server rendering and prove server reads/rendering, not client subscriptions or effect cleanup.

A Runtime contains one reactive dependency graph. A shared ownership protocol identifies the Runtime of a node, Store, or Atom; subscriptions cannot connect different graphs. A Provider Registry/AtomStore belongs to a Runtime without owning that Runtime's lifetime.

store-light turns ordinary fields, get accessors, and methods into Signals, Computeds, and Actions. This binding uses $runtime, the async Store $async/storeReady protocol, and resource protocols. Ordinary-field export/hydration still belong to Store APIs such as $plain/$hydrate. $snapshot() provides a Store snapshot, and $batch(recipe) groups synchronous writes for notification; recipe receives `IStoreShape<S>`. useStore/useSignal can read module singletons without a Provider, but adding a Provider does not make an already-shared singleton request-local.

Atom definitions are frozen descriptions without runtime state. The same atomDef/derivedDef/writableDef/familyDef description is instantiated independently in different AtomStores. Each Registry owns an atomStore; multiple Registries can therefore share one Runtime while retaining separate Atom state. Create a request/application Registry first, create injected Stores/Resources with its runtime, register them before rendering, and release them through an explicit owner.
IStoreProviderProps requires children:ReactNode. registry, runtime, disposeOnUnmount, and config are optional.

blocks.text: The Provider never destroys a Runtime. disposeOnUnmount controls Registry cleanup, including its atomStore and owned registrations. Explicit disposeOnUnmount:true can transfer an external Registry's unmount cleanup. Changing an internally managed runtime prop selects a new candidate Registry and switches after commit; the old committed instance follows effect cleanup rather than mixing its reads into the new graph.

On the client, RegistryBoundary retains in an effect and releases in cleanup. The last release defers to setTimeout(0), then rechecks reference count and generation, protecting immediate StrictMode remount. Explicitly owned external Registries use the same path. SSR runs none of these effects, so there is no automatic unmount cleanup: a request owner must await disposeAsync in finally. React supplies no reliable permanently-abandoned-render callback for uncommitted candidates. Timers do not guess that state; use an externally observable owner for deterministic release. useMemo stabilizes identity without owning cleanup.

blocks.text: An IStoreReadyBarrier factory is `()=>Promise<unknown> or unknown`. Normalization invokes it synchronously and admits its result with Promise.resolve. All barriers must fulfill before children render. Rejection is thrown during render for an outer Error Boundary; the Provider supplies no error UI. An Error reason retains its identity, including frozen Errors. A non-Error reason becomes READY_REJECTED with the original cause, without string coercion. Any equivalent initialization barrier can satisfy features.wasm; store-wasm's ensureWasm is an optional composition.

Within one Provider/barrierScope, the same ready array identity reuses its list Promise. A new array creates another readiness generation and ReadyBoundary even with the same entries; old completion cannot unlock it. Factory results have a separate scope+factory cache: pending/successful results can be shared by different lists, while failure removes that factory's cache entry. Reusing the old array still reuses its cached rejected list Promise. A new array alone does not necessarily rerun a successful factory. Different Providers/request scopes remain isolated. Factory execution is not guaranteed exactly once across abandoned renders; an application owner should supply a stable Promise for non-idempotent initialization.

Even an already-settled Promise updates tracked status in a then microtask, so the first synchronous render can remain pending. A client effect rechecks; SSR renderToString does not run that effect. Keep ready arrays, Stores/Signals/Resources, and selector/equality identities stable. Configuration is readonly input: supply a new object for changes, do not write state during render, and do not create resource-owning business instances on each render.

Normalized features.wasm is boolean, features.experimental is a shallow-frozen null-prototype allowlist, defaults contains warnAsyncActions, and ready is null or an object with promise/status()/error(). Its states are pending/ready/error. Only the experimental allowlist is frozen; the outer features/defaults/ready containers are not guaranteed frozen. StoreProviderState/IStoreProviderState exports those three values; states are not error codes. Sorted experimental-key encoding makes input key order irrelevant. Accessors are ignored as enabling data without invoking their getters; `__proto__` remains an ordinary key.

blocks.text: useStore first calls use(storeReady(store)) when store.$async is true, suspending beneath an outer Suspense until ready. The selector receives `IStoreShape<S>`. useTracked captures reads during render and publishes the selector/snapshot and dependencies at commit. The public `IStableNode<T>` shape is readonly value:T and peek():T, but the node must also satisfy reactive's actual ownership protocol. useNodeValue checks node/runtime during render. enabled=false disables only subscription, not ownership checks or reading. The initial subscription run records dependencies without notifying; snapshots read node.peek directly without another old-value cache. useSignal uses this fixed-node path instead of dynamic dependency capture. This is a mechanism distinction, not a speed claim.

Nonobject options, failed reads, or a nonboolean flag produce INVALID_CONFIG; owned is captured once. register/replace use ownerOf to check declared ownership. A different Runtime produces CROSS_RUNTIME; plain values without a declared owner are accepted. get/require/has are queries, but still check active state. Whole-owner disposal seals admission and clears entries before invoking owned callbacks, preventing reentrant registration.

Owned cleanup prefers $dispose(), then dispose(), and otherwise does nothing. Borrowed values are merely detached. Whole cleanup starts owned callbacks in reverse current-entry order, then atomStore cleanup, without serially awaiting each. lifecycle reads a thenable's then once and invokes it with its original receiver. Synchronous dispose does not await Promises; late failure is observed and reported in the Runtime's lifecycle-hook phase. disposeAsync after synchronous dispose waits for the same pending plan. Its completion Promise is published before callbacks, so reentrant cleanup can share it.

One synchronous failure can retain its native Error with REGISTRY_DISPOSAL_FAILED attached; multiple failures use AggregateError. Frozen/non-Error reasons remain reachable through cause/errors, and foreign identity is preserved. The stable completion replays synchronous and asynchronous failures. whenTerminal means cleanup has settled, not that it succeeded.

remove, replace, and register's returned disposer perform separate per-entry cleanup. Async rejection is reported but does not enter a later whole-owner disposeAsync wait ledger. To await a removed object's actual asynchronous release, retain its owner's completion protocol rather than treating Registry completion as a barrier for every historical cleanup.

blocks.text: 本包只有根入口，导出两类、两工厂和错误身份工具，不提供 Store、Worker、消息协议或对象序列化实现。它依赖 `@migaia/reactive`、`@migaia/lifecycle`、`@migaia/utils`；运行时无 DOM、Node 或 Worker 绑定。调用方先创建 `IRuntime`，再创建共享包装实例。
`sharedInt32` 等价于调用 `new SharedInt32Signal`，`sharedInt32Array` 等价于调用 `new SharedInt32Array`。类也公开，供类型标注或 `instanceof` 使用。`SharedWaitMode` / `ISharedWaitMode` 已移除，没有兼容别名；旧导入需要迁移，`watch()` 不再接受模式选择参数。
共享的是 `SharedArrayBuffer`，每个 Runtime 各自创建包装对象。同一 JS 对象只能归属一个 Runtime；归属由 reactive 的所有权系统维护，不能把一个对象登记到另一个 Runtime。跨线程传 `.buffer`，不传包装对象；接收方使用相同长度和 buffer 附着。附着不会重新初始化数据，释放一个包装对象也不释放其他包装对象。

浏览器使用共享内存通常需要跨源隔离和相应的 COOP/COEP 响应头；宿主必须提供 `SharedArrayBuffer`、`Atomics` 和所需的整数类型数组。`watch()` 还要求原生 `Atomics.waitAsync`。只需同线程状态时可用普通响应式信号；偶尔传少量跨线程消息时，`postMessage` 仍是更简单的接入方式。字符串、对象、嵌套结构、浮点数和超出 int32 的整数不在本包存储范围内。

当前 ABI 的 header revision 为 1：包含 magic、revision、kind、ready 等字段。附着时校验这些字段，数组还校验长度；旧布局、错误类型或未完成初始化的布局不会自动兼容。信号总计 32 字节，值为 int32，seq 为对齐的 int64。数组头部和 64 位 generation 占 32 字节，后接 `length` 个 int32 值，按 8 字节对齐后接 `length` 个 int64 seq；布局大小为 `align8(32 + length * 4) + length * 8`。

blocks.text: `get`、`set`、`update`、`sync(index)` 先校验 active，再要求下标为 `[0, length)` 内整数，否则抛 `RangeError`（`INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE`）。未在 Effect/Computed 等追踪上下文中调用的 `get()` 不物化 cell，不推进数组观察游标；追踪读取才按需建立并复用 cell。最后一个观察者退订会立即回收 cell；尚未提交订阅的投机读取由所属 Runtime 的 idle 清理阶段回收，默认使用微任务。
`update()` 在锁外调用 updater，校验返回 int32，再按读到的当前值进行 CAS；竞争失败会重新读取并重新调用，最多尝试 65536 次。updater 应为可安全重试的纯函数，不应夹带不可逆副作用。它抛错不会把锁留在奇数状态；错误身份规则见下表。
`snapshot()` 的副本可独立修改；它只承诺每格的一致读，不承诺所有格来自同一原子事务。释放后高层 `get/set/update/sync/watch/snapshot/assertActive` 抛 `ARRAY_DISPOSED`。

高层本地写入通过 canonical `createSourceBinding` 的 `source.notify()` 发布已物化的图源，并更新共享版本、唤醒远端。另一 Runtime 的 Effect 不会仅因共享内存变化就自行重跑：接收方须 `sync()` 或 `watch()` 发布变化。信号 `value` 和数组追踪读取可顺带拉取所读位置；`peek()` 和非追踪的 `get()` 只读字节。

每个数组实例拥有独立的 generation 和逐格版本游标。`sync()` 未见 generation 变化直接返回 `0`；变化后完整扫描 `length` 个 seqlock，在一次 `runtime.batch()` 内发布本地变化，统计所有变化下标，包括没有观察者的格。扫描为 O(length)，`sync(index)` 只检查一格；没有被一个读者清除、供其他读者共享的 dirty bitmap。本地发布不会提前把整代标为已扫描，避免掩盖其他下标的远端写入。
`watch(scheduler?)` 固定使用原生 `Atomics.waitAsync`，不提供轮询模式；缺少它时同步抛 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`，由调用方从自己的消息循环或定时器 pump `sync()`。同步 `Atomics.wait` 会阻塞，不能代替主线程的异步 watch。

首个活动 watch 捕获 scheduler，省略时使用 `systemScheduler`；活动期间重复调用返回同一停止函数并保留首次 scheduler。停止幂等，停止后可以启动新的 watch。scheduler 负责唤醒之间的零延迟让出和取消，不替代原生等待；传入自定义调度器时可从 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 导入 `IScheduler` 或 `systemScheduler`，直接导入该包时须直接安装 `@migaia/utils`。

watch 开始时就可能同步发布已有变化。每轮先捕获等待版本，再 `sync()` 对账窗口内写入；期间再次写入会使等待返回 `not-equal`，不会被当作新基线吞掉。停止或 dispose 会取消已排任务并 notify 挂起的等待，使其尽快 settle，停止后的回调不会重启循环。watch 失败只经所属 Runtime 的 `reportError` 报告，宿主诊断由该 Runtime 的 adapter 负责。
以下接口为已有底层组合保留，不是业务代码的首选入口：

rows: `readCell(index): { readonly value: number; readonly version: bigint }`
原始 seqlock 一致读，不追踪
`expected?: number` 是期望当前值；省略为无条件写，提交返回新版本，同值或 CAS 不符返回 `undefined`
推进头部 generation 并唤醒数组 watcher
只复制数组级观察游标，不发布已有 cell

blocks.text: 这些低层方法不提供 active、下标或 int32 校验，调用方自行保证前提。成功 `writeCell()` 后应先 `notifyWaiters()`，再 `sync(index)`，复用正常发布路径；不要先调用 `recordObservedVersion()` 跳过游标差异，否则已有本地 cell 可能漏掉通知。
每格对齐的 int64 seq 同时表示版本和锁：偶数为稳定值，奇数表示写者持锁。读取按“读偶数 before → 读 value → 读 after”的顺序，只有 before 与 after 相等才接受这组值与版本。写入先用 CAS 把偶数变成奇数；校验 expected、跳过同值或写值后，把锁释放为相应偶数。成功改变值时版本推进两步；持锁期间不执行用户回调。

每轮最多自旋 65536 次；用完后可阻塞的线程通过 `Atomics.wait` 至多等待 1 ms，不允许阻塞的线程继续下一轮。约 1 秒持续无法一致读或取得写锁会抛 `CONTENTION_LIMIT`；`update()` 的 CAS 重试也有 65536 次上限。该错误可来自持续活跃竞争、延迟的写者或遗留的奇数锁，错误本身不证明写者已经崩溃。先检查写入方和争用；若确认写者终止并遗弃了锁，本包不会自动修复，应协调各端放弃旧 buffer 后重建。
高层初始化和写入只接受 `[-2147483648, 2147483647]` 范围内整数，不使用 `value | 0` 静默截断。例如浮点数或 `2 ** 31` 会被拒绝，已提交的共享值不会因此被替换。
`STORE_SHARED_SOURCE` 是字符串常量 `'@migaia/store-shared'`。`StoreSharedErrorCode` 是下表常量对象，`IStoreSharedErrorCode` 为其值的联合类型。

rows: 信号高层读写已释放；重新附着一个新实例
数组高层读写已释放；创建新包装对象
构造期 buffer 太小；改用正确容量
下标越界或非整数；修正下标
一致读、占锁或 CAS 持续争用到限；检查竞争，确认遗弃锁后才重建
watch 缺少原生 waitAsync；调用方改用手动 sync
updater 抛出未编码错误；修正回调，锁外失败不妨碍后续写入
非法 options/buffer/长度/布局、初值物化失败、int32 越界或 updater 非函数；修正输入

blocks.text: 本包校验通常保留 `RangeError`，释放、争用和缺少 waitAsync 使用 `Error`。未编码、可附码的 native updater Error 原位得到 `UPDATE_FAILED`，不替换原对象或 stack；冻结错误和非 Error 抛出值保留在包装错误的 `cause` 上。已有完整 foreign `source/code` 的错误保留其原 owner 和身份，因此不能假设每个 updater 失败都带本包 source。

`createStoreSharedError(code, message, options?)` 与 `createStoreSharedRangeError(code, message, options?)` 分别构造带身份的 Error、RangeError，供上层组合复用。两者 `code: IStoreSharedErrorCode` 和 `message: string` 必填，无默认；`options?: { readonly cause?: unknown }` 可选，无默认。仅当 cause 不为 undefined 时传入原 cause，再通过 `attachErrorIdentity` 附加 source/code，不重写 stack。
主线程创建 Runtime 与包装对象，通过自己的消息协议把 buffer 和数组长度交给 Worker；Worker 创建独立 Runtime 并附着。需要响应式绘制的一方对相应位置建立 Effect，并选择 watch 或在已有循环里 sync。SAB 共享内存本身不会被结构化克隆为另一份数据；包装对象、渲染函数和 Runtime 不应作为共享实例传递。
关闭时由宿主停止 Effect、watch 和自己的 timer，dispose 本地包装对象，再终止实际 Worker；Worker 内自建的资源也由该宿主负责。定时 sync 属于调用方的调度决策，不是本包的隐式降级。
已读到新字节但界面没重跑时，检查是否只用了 peek 或非追踪 get，以及接收方是否发布了 sync。waitAsync 不可用时分支处理 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`。值域错误检查整数与范围；完整 sync 的工作量过大时，可在已知下标的路径使用 sync(index)。包装对象释放后需要新实例，不应复用已释放实例。
`fmt`、`lint`、`typecheck`、`typecheck:test`、`test` 是已有脚本。已有测试覆盖 seqlock、跨 Runtime 同步、watch 生命周期、独立游标与错误身份；命令结果应以实际执行为准。

blocks.code:
pnpm run fmt
pnpm run lint
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run typecheck:test
pnpm run test

按需要确认的行为选择完整场景；下面的代码与网站 API 示例保持一致。

blocks.text: 运行任一场景前直接安装两个入口包；示例都在同一进程创建 Runtime，不需要 Worker、定时器或渲染框架。

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/store-shared @migaia/reactive

sections.id: 附着读者而不覆盖共享值
sections.heading: 附着读者而不覆盖共享值

blocks.text: 另一个线程更新整数后，本地运行时仍须把变化发布给自己的依赖图；直接读到共享字节，不等于已经确认通知。
复制数值会产生第二个计数器，克隆 JavaScript 包装也不能重建订阅；把 `peek()` 当成同步还会让本地版本游标保持不变。
直接安装 `@migaia/store-shared` 和 `@migaia/reactive`；`sharedInt32` 通过 `buffer` 附着并忽略所传初值，各读者用 `sync()` 推进自己的游标。
参数：`runtime` 必填，各自调用 `createRuntime()`；`initialValue` 默认 `0`，本例写者为 `7`，读者的 `999` 因传入 `buffer` 而被忽略。`buffer` 可选，省略则分配新信号布局；本例传写者的同一共享内存。

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { sharedInt32 } from '@migaia/store-shared'

const writer = sharedInt32(createRuntime(), 7)
const reader = sharedInt32(createRuntime(), 999, writer.buffer)
console.log(reader.peek())
writer.value = 9
console.log(reader.peek(), reader.isStale())
console.log(reader.sync(), reader.sync())
writer.dispose()
console.log(reader.peek())
reader.dispose()

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
7
9 true
true false
9

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `7`、`9 true`、`true false`、`9`；附着保留原值，`peek()` 读到新值时游标仍过期，仅首次 `sync()` 确认变化。
每个包装独立拥有本地图与生命周期，销毁写者不影响附着读者；`peek()` 不追踪、不发布，未启用 `watch()` 时由读者安排同步，本例在同一进程创建两个运行时。

sections.id: 跳过同值写入并拒绝非法整数
sections.heading: 跳过同值写入并拒绝非法整数

blocks.text: 计数器观察者应在整数变化时重新执行，而重复赋相同值不应产生额外更新；非法输入也不应悄悄变成另一个共享值。
无条件通知会为未变状态重复工作，位运算强制转换则会截断小数、回绕大整数，掩盖调用者提供了不支持的值。
`sharedInt32` 校验 `int32` 写入并跳过同值；本例用响应包 `createRuntime` 的 `schedulerStrategy` 同步执行效果以固定输出，共享包不拥有或修改运行时调度。
参数：`runtime` 必填；`createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })` 的字段属于 reactive，使本例效果同步执行，不是信号选项。`initialValue` 默认 `0`，本例为 `5`；未传 `buffer`，新建内存。`value` 写入只接受 int32。
输出：

blocks.code:
1 5
true INVALID_OPTION
5
2 6

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `1 5`、`true INVALID_OPTION`、`5`、`2 6`；同值赋值及被拒绝的小数写入都未改变存储值或效果执行次数。
合法写入为 `[-2147483648, 2147483647]` 内的整数，变化提交会本地发布，同值写入不推进共享版本，收到通知后的效果执行时机由传入的运行时控制。

sections.id: 只通知读取对应下标的观察者
sections.heading: 只通知读取对应下标的观察者

blocks.text: 共享数组存放多个独立坐标，更新其中一项应刷新对应观察者，同时保留其他下标读者的状态。
只观察整数组版本会让任意坐标变化都使全部订阅者失效，另建依赖表又会重复运行时已有的归属与清理职责。
`sharedInt32Array` 在效果内按 `get(index)` 追踪下标；本例直接安装响应包，用其运行时 `schedulerStrategy` 同步展示，该选项不是共享数组构造字段。
参数：`runtime` 和 `length` 必填，本例长度 `2`；`options` 默认 `{}`，`initialValues` 可选、无默认，本例初始化为 `[10, 20]`。`get/set/update` 的 `index` 必填；`update` 的纯 updater 必填。`schedulerStrategy` 是 reactive 的运行时调度选项。

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { sharedInt32Array } from '@migaia/store-shared'

const runtime = createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })
const coordinates = sharedInt32Array(runtime, 2, { initialValues: [10, 20] })
let firstRuns = 0
let secondRuns = 0
const first = runtime.effect(() => {
  firstRuns++
  void coordinates.get(0)
})
const second = runtime.effect(() => {
  secondRuns++
  void coordinates.get(1)
})
coordinates.set(1, 22)
console.log(firstRuns, secondRuns)
coordinates.set(1, 22)
console.log(firstRuns, secondRuns)
coordinates.update(0, (current) => current + 1)
console.log(firstRuns, secondRuns)
first.dispose()
second.dispose()
coordinates.dispose()

blocks.text: 输出：
逐行输出 `1 2`、`1 2`、`2 2`；下标 `1` 只唤醒自己的读者，再写 `22` 不唤醒任何读者，更新下标 `0` 只唤醒第一个读者。
追踪只为被读下标物化图源，追踪外的 `get()` 直接读共享内存；销毁效果释放订阅，销毁数组释放其余本地图源。
两个消费者读取同一共享数组，即使第一个消费者已经完成同步，第二个也仍须检测到写者的更新。
由首个读者清除的共享脏标志会消费其他人的通知，仅读取当前字节也无法记录各消费者已经确认哪些格版本。
`sharedInt32Array` 为各附着包装保留自己的代次与格游标，共享 `buffer` 并保持相同固定长度，各读者分别调用 `sync()`，响应包须直接安装。
参数：`runtime` 和固定 `length` 必填，三实例均为 `3`；`options.buffer` 可选，本例两个读者传入同一写者 buffer。`sync(index?)` 的下标可选，省略表示完整同步；`snapshot()` 无参数。

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { sharedInt32Array } from '@migaia/store-shared'

const writer = sharedInt32Array(createRuntime(), 3)
const first = sharedInt32Array(createRuntime(), 3, { buffer: writer.buffer })
const second = sharedInt32Array(createRuntime(), 3, { buffer: writer.buffer })
writer.set(0, 7)
writer.set(2, 9)
console.log(first.sync(), second.sync())
console.log(first.sync(), second.sync())
console.log(JSON.stringify(Array.from(second.snapshot())))
first.dispose()
second.dispose()
writer.dispose()

blocks.text: 输出：
逐行输出 `2 2`、`0 0`、`[7,0,9]`；每个读者独立计入两个变化格，没有新写入时再次完整同步均返回零。
完整 `sync()` 也计入没有观察者的变化下标，代次未变时直接返回，否则扫描 `length` 个格并批处理本地通知；`sync(index)` 只比较指定格，返回 `0` 或 `1`。

sections.id: 更新回调失败后仍可使用共享格
sections.heading: 更新回调失败后仍可使用共享格

blocks.text: 更新回调计算新整数时可能拒绝应用数据，调用者既需要原始失败，也需要随后继续更新同一个共享格。
在持有序列锁时执行应用回调，会让抛错留下奇数锁版本；每次失败都重新包装错误还会丢失原生错误身份。
`SharedInt32Array.update` 在锁外计算再尝试期望值提交，本例提交前抛出预建的本地 `TypeError`，随后用纯函数递增，并直接安装响应包以取得 `createRuntime`。
参数：类构造的 `runtime` 和 `length` 必填，`options` 默认 `{}`；本例 `initialValues: [7]` 只在新内存生效。`update(index, updater)` 两参数均必填，回调输入为当前值，返回 int32；竞争时回调可重试，失败时保留原错。
输出：

blocks.code:
true true UPDATE_FAILED
7
8

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true true UPDATE_FAILED`、`7`、`8`；抛出对象就是原始 `TypeError`，失败回调没有提交，随后同格更新仍能完成。
未编码且可扩展的原生错误原位附码，冻结或非错误值保留在 `cause`，完整外包身份保留原归属；争用可能重调更新回调，成功回调须纯净且可重复。

sections.id: 复制数值而不暴露共享存储
sections.heading: 复制数值而不暴露共享存储

blocks.text: 导出流程需要一份可编辑且不影响实时共享状态的本地数组，随后共享写入也不应改变此前副本。
在共享底层上另建类型数组视图仍会引用同一字节，把多格读取当事务还会暗示独立写者并不提供的跨格一致性。
`SharedInt32Array.snapshot` 分配独立的非共享 `Int32Array` 并逐格一致读入，先用直接安装的响应包运行时构造数组，再保留或修改返回副本。
参数：类构造的 `runtime` 和 `length` 必填，本例为 `2`；`options.initialValues` 可选，本例为 `[4, 5]`。`snapshot()` 不接收参数；`set(index, value)` 两项均必填，校验下标和 int32 值。

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { SharedInt32Array } from '@migaia/store-shared'

const values = new SharedInt32Array(createRuntime(), 2, { initialValues: [4, 5] })
const copy = values.snapshot()
console.log(JSON.stringify(Array.from(copy)))
copy[0] = 99
values.set(1, 8)
console.log(JSON.stringify(Array.from(copy)), JSON.stringify(Array.from(values.snapshot())))
console.log(copy.buffer instanceof SharedArrayBuffer)
values.dispose()

blocks.text: 输出：
逐行输出 `[4,5]`、`[99,5] [4,8]`、`false`；修改副本未改变共享下标 `0`，写入共享下标 `1` 也未改变此前副本。
返回结果是调用者拥有的普通内存，各格分别一致读取，但不同格的读取之间可能发生并发写入，`snapshot()` 不承诺整数组原子事务。
本包只有根入口，导出两类、两工厂和错误身份工具，不提供 Store、Worker、消息协议或对象序列化实现。它依赖 `@migaia/reactive`、`@migaia/lifecycle`、`@migaia/utils`；运行时无 DOM、Node 或 Worker 绑定。调用方先创建 `IRuntime`，再创建共享包装实例。
`sharedInt32` 等价于调用 `new SharedInt32Signal`，`sharedInt32Array` 等价于调用 `new SharedInt32Array`。类也公开，供类型标注或 `instanceof` 使用。`SharedWaitMode` / `ISharedWaitMode` 已移除，没有兼容别名；旧导入需要迁移，`watch()` 不再接受模式选择参数。
共享的是 `SharedArrayBuffer`，每个 Runtime 各自创建包装对象。同一 JS 对象只能归属一个 Runtime；归属由 reactive 的所有权系统维护，不能把一个对象登记到另一个 Runtime。跨线程传 `.buffer`，不传包装对象；接收方使用相同长度和 buffer 附着。附着不会重新初始化数据，释放一个包装对象也不释放其他包装对象。

浏览器使用共享内存通常需要跨源隔离和相应的 COOP/COEP 响应头；宿主必须提供 `SharedArrayBuffer`、`Atomics` 和所需的整数类型数组。`watch()` 还要求原生 `Atomics.waitAsync`。只需同线程状态时可用普通响应式信号；偶尔传少量跨线程消息时，`postMessage` 仍是更简单的接入方式。字符串、对象、嵌套结构、浮点数和超出 int32 的整数不在本包存储范围内。

`update()` 在锁外调用 updater，校验返回 int32，再按读到的当前值进行 CAS；竞争失败会重新读取并重新调用，最多尝试 65536 次。updater 应为可安全重试的纯函数，不应夹带不可逆副作用。它抛错不会把锁留在奇数状态；错误身份规则见下表。
`snapshot()` 的副本可独立修改；它只承诺每格的一致读，不承诺所有格来自同一原子事务。释放后高层 `get/set/update/sync/watch/snapshot/assertActive` 抛 `ARRAY_DISPOSED`。

高层本地写入通过 canonical `createSourceBinding` 的 `source.notify()` 发布已物化的图源，并更新共享版本、唤醒远端。另一 Runtime 的 Effect 不会仅因共享内存变化就自行重跑：接收方须 `sync()` 或 `watch()` 发布变化。信号 `value` 和数组追踪读取可顺带拉取所读位置；`peek()` 和非追踪的 `get()` 只读字节。

每个数组实例拥有独立的 generation 和逐格版本游标。`sync()` 未见 generation 变化直接返回 `0`；变化后完整扫描 `length` 个 seqlock，在一次 `runtime.batch()` 内发布本地变化，统计所有变化下标，包括没有观察者的格。扫描为 O(length)，`sync(index)` 只检查一格；没有被一个读者清除、供其他读者共享的 dirty bitmap。本地发布不会提前把整代标为已扫描，避免掩盖其他下标的远端写入。
`watch(scheduler?)` 固定使用原生 `Atomics.waitAsync`，不提供轮询模式；缺少它时同步抛 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`，由调用方从自己的消息循环或定时器 pump `sync()`。同步 `Atomics.wait` 会阻塞，不能代替主线程的异步 watch。

首个活动 watch 捕获 scheduler，省略时使用 `systemScheduler`；活动期间重复调用返回同一停止函数并保留首次 scheduler。停止幂等，停止后可以启动新的 watch。scheduler 负责唤醒之间的零延迟让出和取消，不替代原生等待；传入自定义调度器时可从 `@migaia/utils/scheduler` 导入 `IScheduler` 或 `systemScheduler`，直接导入该包时须直接安装 `@migaia/utils`。

watch 开始时就可能同步发布已有变化。每轮先捕获等待版本，再 `sync()` 对账窗口内写入；期间再次写入会使等待返回 `not-equal`，不会被当作新基线吞掉。停止或 dispose 会取消已排任务并 notify 挂起的等待，使其尽快 settle，停止后的回调不会重启循环。watch 失败只经所属 Runtime 的 `reportError` 报告，宿主诊断由该 Runtime 的 adapter 负责。

每格对齐的 int64 seq 同时表示版本和锁：偶数为稳定值，奇数表示写者持锁。读取按“读偶数 before → 读 value → 读 after”的顺序，只有 before 与 after 相等才接受这组值与版本。写入先用 CAS 把偶数变成奇数；校验 expected、跳过同值或写值后，把锁释放为相应偶数。成功改变值时版本推进两步；持锁期间不执行用户回调。

每轮最多自旋 65536 次；用完后可阻塞的线程通过 `Atomics.wait` 至多等待 1 ms，不允许阻塞的线程继续下一轮。约 1 秒持续无法一致读或取得写锁会抛 `CONTENTION_LIMIT`；`update()` 的 CAS 重试也有 65536 次上限。该错误可来自持续活跃竞争、延迟的写者或遗留的奇数锁，错误本身不证明写者已经崩溃。先检查写入方和争用；若确认写者终止并遗弃了锁，本包不会自动修复，应协调各端放弃旧 buffer 后重建。
高层初始化和写入只接受 `[-2147483648, 2147483647]` 范围内整数，不使用 `value | 0` 静默截断。例如浮点数或 `2 ** 31` 会被拒绝，已提交的共享值不会因此被替换。

`createStoreSharedError(code, message, options?)` 与 `createStoreSharedRangeError(code, message, options?)` 分别构造带身份的 Error、RangeError，供上层组合复用。两者 `code: IStoreSharedErrorCode` 和 `message: string` 必填，无默认；`options?: { readonly cause?: unknown }` 可选，无默认。仅当 cause 不为 undefined 时传入原 cause，再通过 `attachErrorIdentity` 附加 source/code，不重写 stack。
主线程创建 Runtime 与包装对象，通过自己的消息协议把 buffer 和数组长度交给 Worker；Worker 创建独立 Runtime 并附着。需要响应式绘制的一方对相应位置建立 Effect，并选择 watch 或在已有循环里 sync。SAB 共享内存本身不会被结构化克隆为另一份数据；包装对象、渲染函数和 Runtime 不应作为共享实例传递。

blocks.text: 简体中文
Share fixed-size int32 state through SharedArrayBuffer and Atomics, then track and publish changes at the locations each Runtime reads.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: A different Runtime writes successfully but the view does not rerun because shared bytes were never published to the receiving graph.
One coordinate change reruns every observer because dependencies follow the whole array rather than the indices read.
Later consumers miss updates because a shared dirty flag is used in place of a cursor for each reader.
Concurrent increments lose values, or a callback failure blocks later writes, because read-modify-write is split or user code runs under a lock.
A supposed export copy changes later because another typed-array view still points at the same shared memory.

Separate shared values from notification cursors. Copying a counter forks its state; treating peek as synchronization misses publication. A signal attaches to an existing buffer, while peek leaves the cursor untouched and sync acknowledges changes. Runnable proof.
Track the indices actually read. One whole-array dependency invalidates unrelated coordinates. A tracked get(index) materializes that cell, and equal writes remain silent. Runnable proof.
One reader cannot consume another reader’s changes. A cleared shared dirty flag can hide updates from later readers. Each wrapper keeps its own generation and cell cursors for sync. Runnable proof.

A failed callback does not leave a user-held lock behind. Computing under a lock lets a throw block future writes. update computes outside the lock, attempts CAS, and preserves the original error identity or cause. Runnable proof.

Export a copy that does not alias live storage. Another view over the same buffer still shares bytes. snapshot allocates an ordinary Int32Array and reads each cell consistently, separating edits on either side. Runnable proof.

blocks.text: Attach to the same integer from two independent Runtimes, then distinguish reading bytes from synchronizing a cursor:

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { sharedInt32 } from '@migaia/store-shared'

const writer = sharedInt32(createRuntime(), 7)
const reader = sharedInt32(createRuntime(), 999, writer.buffer)
console.log(reader.peek())
writer.value = 9
console.log(reader.peek(), reader.isStale())
console.log(reader.sync(), reader.sync())
writer.dispose()
console.log(reader.peek())
reader.dispose()

array.update computes outside the lock before CAS, snapshot allocates independent memory, and sync publishes remote changes to the local graph. Occasional cross-thread messages can remain ordinary messages.

sections.heading: Ownership, entry point, and host requirements

blocks.text: The module has one root entry. It exports two classes, two factories, and error identity helpers; it does not provide a Store, Worker, message protocol, or object serializer. Its dependencies are `@migaia/reactive`, `@migaia/lifecycle`, and `@migaia/utils`. It has no DOM, Node, or Worker binding. Create an `IRuntime` before creating a shared wrapper.

`sharedInt32` delegates to `new SharedInt32Signal`; `sharedInt32Array` delegates to `new SharedInt32Array`. Both classes remain public for type annotations and `instanceof` checks. `SharedWaitMode` and `ISharedWaitMode` were removed without compatibility aliases. Migrate old imports; `watch()` has no wait-mode argument.

Share the `SharedArrayBuffer`, and create a separate wrapper in each Runtime. The reactive ownership system gives each JS object one Runtime owner; an existing object cannot be registered with another Runtime. Send `.buffer` across a thread boundary and attach with the same array length. Attachment preserves existing data. Disposing one wrapper does not dispose another wrapper.

In browsers, shared memory generally requires cross-origin isolation and suitable COOP/COEP response headers. The host must provide `SharedArrayBuffer`, `Atomics`, and the required integer typed arrays. `watch()` additionally requires native `Atomics.waitAsync`. Ordinary reactive signals suffice for state within one thread; `postMessage` can be simpler for occasional small messages. Strings, objects, nested structures, floating-point values, and integers outside int32 are outside this module's storage contract.

blocks.text: Initialization consumes at most `length` values. Reaching that limit closes the original iterator through native IteratorClose. A zero-length array never pulls a value. Iteration or value-validation failure becomes a `RangeError` with `INVALID_OPTION` and the original `cause`. When attaching, initialization contents are ignored, but the constructor still reads both options fields.

The current header revision is 1. It includes magic, revision, kind, and ready fields. Attachment validates them and, for arrays, the declared length. Older, mismatched, or incomplete layouts are rejected without automatic compatibility. A signal occupies 32 bytes, including an int32 value and aligned int64 seq. An array uses a 32-byte header and 64-bit generation, then `length` int32 values, padding to an 8-byte boundary, and `length` int64 seq values. Its layout size is `align8(32 + length * 4) + length * 8`.

A nonshared buffer, invalid length, capacity overflow, or invalid header produces `RangeError` with `INVALID_OPTION`. An undersized buffer produces `RangeError` with `BUFFER_TOO_SMALL`. Array capacity checks include safe-integer arithmetic and the Int32Array slot limit. Construction does not scan all array seqlocks; a cell establishes its reactive baseline when first read in a tracking context.
`SharedInt32Signal` implements `IObservable` and `IDisposable`.

blocks.text: Publishing from the `value` getter can synchronously trigger another writer, so the getter rereads when necessary before returning. After a committed write, the setter wakes remote waiters before notifying the local graph source. Writing the same value advances no version and sends no notification. `peek()` can return a remote value while `isStale()` remains `true`: reading shared bytes and publishing them to the graph are separate operations.

After disposal, `value`, `peek()`, `sync()`, and `watch()` throw `SIGNAL_DISPOSED`. `isStale()` does not check active state, and metadata remains accessible. Its consistent read can still reach the contention limit; the absence of an active-state check is not a promise that it cannot throw.
`SharedInt32Array` implements `IDisposable`, not a whole-array `IObservable`, and has no whole-array `isStale()`. Each observed index has its own private graph source.

blocks.text: `get`, `set`, `update`, and `sync(index)` check active state, then require an integer in `[0, length)`. Invalid indices throw `RangeError` with `INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE`. Outside an Effect/Computed tracking context, `get()` creates no cell and does not advance the array's observed cursor. Tracking reads create and reuse cells on demand. A cell is reclaimed immediately when its final observer unsubscribes. Speculative reads that never commit a subscription are reclaimed through the owning Runtime's idle cleanup, which uses microtasks by default.

`update()` invokes the updater outside the lock, validates its int32 result, then attempts CAS against the current value it read. A conflict causes another read and another updater call, with a limit of 65536 attempts. The updater should be a pure function that is safe to retry, without irreversible side effects. An updater failure cannot leave a lock in the odd state; error identity rules appear below.

The `snapshot()` result can be modified independently. The operation guarantees consistency per cell, not a transaction spanning all cells. After disposal, the high-level `get/set/update/sync/watch/snapshot/assertActive` methods throw `ARRAY_DISPOSED`.

High-level local writes publish materialized graph sources through canonical `createSourceBinding` and `source.notify()`, update shared versions, and wake remote waiters. Another Runtime's Effect does not rerun merely because shared bytes changed. The receiving wrapper must publish through `sync()` or `watch()`. Signal `value` and tracked array reads also pull their own locations; `peek()` and untracked `get()` only read bytes.

Each array instance owns its own generation and per-cell version cursors. With unchanged generation, `sync()` returns `0`. Otherwise it scans all `length` seqlocks and publishes local changes inside one `runtime.batch()`. The count includes changed indices without observers. This is an O(length) scan; `sync(index)` checks one cell. There is no shared dirty bitmap for one reader to clear on behalf of others. Local publication does not prematurely mark the whole generation as scanned, which would hide remote writes at other indices.

`watch(scheduler?)` always uses native `Atomics.waitAsync`; it has no polling mode. Without that API it synchronously throws `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`. blocks.text: These low-level methods do not validate active state, indices, or int32 values. The caller owns those preconditions. After a successful `writeCell()`, call `notifyWaiters()` and then `sync(index)` to reuse normal publication. Do not copy the version with `recordObservedVersion()` first: hiding the cursor difference can suppress notification to an existing local cell.

Each aligned int64 seq is both a version and a lock. An even seq means a stable value; an odd seq means a writer holds the lock. Reading follows “read even before → read value → read after,” accepting the value/version pair only when before equals after. Writing first uses CAS to change even to odd, checks an optional expected value, skips an unchanged value or commits the new value, and releases to the corresponding even seq. A successful value change advances the version by two. No user callback runs while the lock is held.

Each spin round allows 65536 attempts. Threads allowed to block then use `Atomics.wait` for at most 1 ms; threads that cannot block continue another round. Choose a complete scenario by the behavior you need to confirm. Its code matches the website API examples.

blocks.text: Directly install both imported module before running a scenario. These examples create Runtimes in one process and need no Worker, timer, or rendering framework.

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/store-shared @migaia/reactive

sections.heading: Attach a reader without overwriting shared state

blocks.text: A worker updates an integer, but another Runtime still needs to publish that change to its own graph. A direct read of shared bytes is different from acknowledging a notification.
Copying a value creates a second counter, while cloning the JavaScript wrapper cannot recreate its subscriptions. Treating peek() as synchronization also leaves the local version cursor unchanged.
Install @migaia/store-shared and @migaia/reactive directly. sharedInt32 attaches through buffer, ignores the supplied initial value, and lets each reader explicitly sync its own cursor.

Parameters: `runtime` is required; each wrapper receives its own `createRuntime()`. `initialValue` defaults to `0`; the writer uses `7`, while the reader’s `999` is ignored because `buffer` is present. Omitting the optional buffer allocates a new signal layout; here the reader receives the writer’s shared memory.

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { sharedInt32 } from '@migaia/store-shared'

const writer = sharedInt32(createRuntime(), 7)
const reader = sharedInt32(createRuntime(), 999, writer.buffer)
console.log(reader.peek())
writer.value = 9
console.log(reader.peek(), reader.isStale())
console.log(reader.sync(), reader.sync())
writer.dispose()
console.log(reader.peek())
reader.dispose()

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
7
9 true
true false
9

blocks.text: Prints four lines: `7`, `9 true`, `true false`, then `9`. The attachment preserves 7; peek sees 9 while the cursor is stale; only the first sync acknowledges it.

Each wrapper owns its local graph and lifetime; disposing the writer leaves the attached reader usable. peek() does not track or publish. Without watch(), readers choose when to sync; this example uses two Runtimes in one process.

sections.heading: Skip unchanged writes and reject invalid integers

blocks.text: A counter observer should rerun for a changed integer, while a repeated assignment should not produce another update. Invalid input must not silently become a different shared value.

Unconditional notifications repeat work for unchanged state. Coercing with bitwise operators truncates fractions and wraps large numbers, hiding the fact that the caller supplied an unsupported value.

sharedInt32 validates int32 writes and skips equal values. The createRuntime schedulerStrategy option runs effects synchronously here for deterministic output; it belongs to reactive, and store-shared does not change Runtime scheduling.

Parameters: `runtime` is required. `schedulerStrategy` in `createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })` belongs to reactive and makes effects synchronous here; it is not a signal option. `initialValue` defaults to `0` and is `5` here. No buffer is supplied, so memory is allocated. Writes to `value` must be int32.
Output:

blocks.code:
1 5
true INVALID_OPTION
5
2 6

blocks.text: Prints `1 5`, `true INVALID_OPTION`, `5`, and `2 6` on separate lines. The same-value assignment and rejected fractional write leave both the stored value and effect count unchanged.

Valid writes are integers from -2147483648 through 2147483647. A changed commit publishes locally; equal writes do not advance the shared version. The supplied Runtime controls when notified effects execute.

sections.heading: Notify only the index an observer reads

blocks.text: A shared array holds several independent coordinates. Updating one coordinate should refresh its observer while leaving a reader of another index alone.
Observing one whole-array revision makes every coordinate change invalidate every subscriber. Adding a separate dependency table duplicates ownership and cleanup that the Runtime already manages.

sharedInt32Array tracks get(index) per index inside effects. This example installs reactive directly and uses its Runtime schedulerStrategy option for synchronous presentation; that option is not a shared-array constructor field.

Parameters: `runtime` and `length` are required; length is `2` here. `options` defaults to `{}`. Optional `initialValues` has no default and is `[10, 20]` here. The index in get/set/update is required, as is the pure updater passed to update. `schedulerStrategy` is a reactive Runtime option.

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { sharedInt32Array } from '@migaia/store-shared'

const runtime = createRuntime({ schedulerStrategy: (run) => run() })
const coordinates = sharedInt32Array(runtime, 2, { initialValues: [10, 20] })
let firstRuns = 0
let secondRuns = 0
const first = runtime.effect(() => {
  firstRuns++
  void coordinates.get(0)
})
const second = runtime.effect(() => {
  secondRuns++
  void coordinates.get(1)
})
coordinates.set(1, 22)
console.log(firstRuns, secondRuns)
coordinates.set(1, 22)
console.log(firstRuns, secondRuns)
coordinates.update(0, (current) => current + 1)
console.log(firstRuns, secondRuns)
first.dispose()
second.dispose()
coordinates.dispose()

blocks.text: Output:
Prints `1 2`, `1 2`, then `2 2`. Index 1 wakes only its reader, writing 22 again wakes neither reader, and updating index 0 wakes only the first.

Tracking materializes a source only for the read index; untracked get() reads shared memory directly. Disposing the effects releases their subscriptions, and array disposal releases the remaining local sources.
Two consumers read the same shared array. Both need to detect a writer update, even if the first consumer has already completed its synchronization pass.
A shared dirty flag that the first reader clears consumes the notification for everyone else. Reading current bytes alone does not establish which cell versions each consumer has acknowledged.

sharedInt32Array gives every attached wrapper its own generation and cell cursors. Share only buffer, preserve the same fixed length, and call sync() separately for each reader; reactive is a direct installation requirement.

Parameters: `runtime` and fixed `length` are required; all three instances use `3`. Optional `options.buffer` attaches both readers to the writer’s memory. The index in `sync(index?)` is optional; omission performs a full pass. `snapshot()` takes no arguments.

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { sharedInt32Array } from '@migaia/store-shared'

const writer = sharedInt32Array(createRuntime(), 3)
const first = sharedInt32Array(createRuntime(), 3, { buffer: writer.buffer })
const second = sharedInt32Array(createRuntime(), 3, { buffer: writer.buffer })
writer.set(0, 7)
writer.set(2, 9)
console.log(first.sync(), second.sync())
console.log(first.sync(), second.sync())
console.log(JSON.stringify(Array.from(second.snapshot())))
first.dispose()
second.dispose()
writer.dispose()

blocks.text: Output:
Prints `2 2`, `0 0`, and `[7,0,9]` on separate lines. Each reader counts both changed cells independently; repeating a full sync without another write reports zero.

Full sync counts changed indices even without observers. It returns immediately when its generation is unchanged; otherwise it scans length cells and batches local notifications. sync(index) limits the comparison to one index and returns 0 or 1.

sections.heading: Keep the cell usable after an updater fails

blocks.text: An updater can reject application data while computing a new integer. The caller needs the original failure and must still be able to update the same shared cell afterward.
Executing application callbacks while a seqlock is held lets a throw abandon an odd locked version. Wrapping every failure in a fresh error also loses the original native error identity.

SharedInt32Array.update computes outside the lock and then attempts an expected-value commit. The example throws a prebuilt local TypeError before committing, then performs a pure increment; install reactive directly for createRuntime.

Parameters: the constructor requires `runtime` and `length`; `options` defaults to `{}`. Here `initialValues: [7]` initializes new memory only. Both arguments to `update(index, updater)` are required. The callback receives the current value and returns int32; it can be retried under contention, and failure preserves the original error.
Output:

blocks.code:
true true UPDATE_FAILED
7
8

blocks.text: Prints `true true UPDATE_FAILED`, `7`, and `8` on separate lines. The thrown object is the original TypeError; the failed callback commits nothing, and the next update completes on the same cell.

Unclassified extensible native errors are tagged in place; frozen or non-Error failures remain on cause, and complete foreign identities keep their owner. A contending update may retry its callback, so successful callbacks must be pure and repeatable.

sections.heading: Copy values without exposing shared storage

blocks.text: An exporter needs a local array it can edit without changing the live shared state. Later shared writes should also leave that earlier copy unchanged.

Creating another typed-array view over shared backing still aliases the same bytes. Treating a multi-cell read as a transaction can also imply consistency across cells that independent writers do not provide.

SharedInt32Array.snapshot allocates a separate nonshared Int32Array and consistently reads each cell into it. Construct the array with a reactive Runtime from the directly installed reactive module, then keep or modify the returned copy.

Parameters: the constructor requires `runtime` and `length`; length is `2` here. Optional `options.initialValues` is `[4, 5]`. `snapshot()` takes no arguments. Both arguments to `set(index, value)` are required and validated as an index and int32 value.

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { SharedInt32Array } from '@migaia/store-shared'

const values = new SharedInt32Array(createRuntime(), 2, { initialValues: [4, 5] })
const copy = values.snapshot()
console.log(JSON.stringify(Array.from(copy)))
copy[0] = 99
values.set(1, 8)
console.log(JSON.stringify(Array.from(copy)), JSON.stringify(Array.from(values.snapshot())))
console.log(copy.buffer instanceof SharedArrayBuffer)
values.dispose()

blocks.text: Output:
Prints `[4,5]`, `[99,5] [4,8]`, and `false` on separate lines. Editing the copy does not change shared index 0, and writing shared index 1 does not change the earlier copy.

The result is caller-owned ordinary memory. Each cell is read consistently, but concurrent writes can occur between different cell reads; snapshot() does not promise an atomic whole-array transaction.

sections.heading: Ownership, entry point, and host requirements

blocks.text: The module has one root entry. It exports two classes, two factories, and error identity helpers; it does not provide a Store, Worker, message protocol, or object serializer. Its dependencies are `@migaia/reactive`, `@migaia/lifecycle`, and `@migaia/utils`. It has no DOM, Node, or Worker binding. Create an `IRuntime` before creating a shared wrapper.

`sharedInt32` delegates to `new SharedInt32Signal`; `sharedInt32Array` delegates to `new SharedInt32Array`. Both classes remain public for type annotations and `instanceof` checks. `SharedWaitMode` and `ISharedWaitMode` were removed without compatibility aliases. Migrate old imports; `watch()` has no wait-mode argument.

Share the `SharedArrayBuffer`, and create a separate wrapper in each Runtime. The reactive ownership system gives each JS object one Runtime owner; an existing object cannot be registered with another Runtime. Send `.buffer` across a thread boundary and attach with the same array length. Attachment preserves existing data. Disposing one wrapper does not dispose another wrapper.

In browsers, shared memory generally requires cross-origin isolation and suitable COOP/COEP response headers. The host must provide `SharedArrayBuffer`, `Atomics`, and the required integer typed arrays. `watch()` additionally requires native `Atomics.waitAsync`. Ordinary reactive signals suffice for state within one thread; `postMessage` can be simpler for occasional small messages. Strings, objects, nested structures, floating-point values, and integers outside int32 are outside this module's storage contract.

libraries.description: Request-scoped Store SSR dehydration and hydration.

blocks.text: 为每次服务端渲染登记 Store 与 Resource，捕获可复水的状态，并在请求结束时清理所拥有的对象。

items: 并发请求登记相同状态键，却读到了别人的值：模块级 Runtime 和共享登记表让请求数据归到了同一个所有者。
页面渲染时计数是 2，发送响应时却变成 3：响应仍指向活对象，没有捕获独立的数据副本。
一个请求还没完成，整份缓存就被当成超时：只给 Promise.all 加期限，无法区分已就绪与仍在途的资源。
JSON 能解析，内联页面却被截断：JSON 字符串中的关闭脚本标签仍会被 HTML 解析器当作标记。

固定渲染时捕获的值，并收拢请求清理。 安全脱水校验、复制和冻结数据，默认拥有的 Store 随请求关闭释放，见捕获请求快照并释放所拥有的状态。
分别识别就绪缓存与在途超时。 等待按 Promise 结算情况分类，零预算也识别已完成结果，见保留就绪数据并报告仍在途的资源。
把 HTML 中的 JSON 正文转义集中到一个入口。 序列化转义五类敏感字符并保留 JSON 读回值，见内联 JSON 时避免数据提前关闭脚本元素。
用经过校验的标识生成一致的状态元素。 标签生成器固定 JSON MIME 类型并拒绝突破属性边界的标识，见拒绝会破坏状态元素属性的标识符。

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/store-ssr @migaia/store-light

import { createSSRRequestScope } from '@migaia/store-ssr'
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'

const scope = createSSRRequestScope()
const cart = createStore({ count: 2 }, { runtime: scope.runtime })
scope.register('cart', cart)
const snapshot = scope.dehydrate()
cart.count = 3
console.log(snapshot.stores.cart?.count, cart.count)
console.log(Object.isFrozen(snapshot.stores.cart))
await scope.disposeAsync()
console.log(cart.$disposed)

blocks.text: 本包只有根入口 `@migaia/store-ssr`。它连接 reactive 驱动的 Store/Resource 与 SSR 快照，管理请求内登记、预取等待、脱水、复水和已接纳对象的清理；依赖 reactive、resource、serialize、utils，不绑定渲染框架，也不读 globalThis.document。

每个请求默认创建新的 SSRRequestScope 和 Runtime。register 检查 store.$runtime，registerResource 检查 resource.runtime，必须等于 scope.runtime；不匹配抛 CROSS_RUNTIME。claimOwnership 登记 scope 对象的归属，不独占 Runtime：调用方显式传同一个 Runtime 给两个 scope 是允许的，库无法据此自动隔离请求。正确的接入是每请求创建独立 scope，用 scope.runtime 创建该请求状态，并在 finally 中 await disposeAsync。
createStore 返回值和 Resource 类分别满足下文的 Store/Resource 接口，不需要另造适配层。纯客户端应用不需要这座 SSR 桥；它也不是通用的任意对象 JSON 转换器。客户端是否重发数据请求还取决于 Resource 的缓存、TTL 和启动策略，复水不保证所有业务都不再请求。
createSSRRequestScope(options?) 等价于 new SSRRequestScope(options?)，options 默认空对象：

rows: 未提供时内部 createRuntime() 新建；显式提供时复用
undefined；转给内部 createRuntime，与 runtime 互斥

blocks.text: runtimeOptions 是 reactive 的选项，包含 onError、onTrace、maxFlushPasses、scheduleIdle 等，由 reactive 定义具体语义；本包没有另建运行时选项。两项同时提供以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。scope.runtime 只读，scope.disposed 表示已开始同步关闭。
Resource 没有可脱水缓存时可返回 undefined。Store 使用 $ 前缀、Resource 不使用，是各自原接口的约定。异步 Store cleanup 由 scope 观察；Resource port 的 dispose 是同步接口。结构适配器必须按自身缓存策略提供 dehydrate，不能假设失败记录会替它决定是否输出缓存。

rows: key/store 必填，options 默认 {}，owned 默认 true；返回 void
key 必填，disposeOwned 默认 true；返回是否找到登记
返回原 Store 或 undefined，只移除不销毁
Resource 版本，同样默认 owned true
Resource 版本，返回是否找到登记

blocks.text: key 必须非空且不能为 `__proto__`。Store 与 Resource 各自的重复 key 以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝，不静默覆盖。登记对象必须属于当前 Runtime。owned true 在 scope 退出时负责清理；owned false 只参与脱水/复水，资源仍归调用方。
hydrate 先于登记到达时，register 会在提交登记前应用同 key 待处理快照。回调失败且 scope 仍活跃时，key 仍空闲，待处理快照保留以便重试，候选仍归调用方；若回调关闭了 scope，关闭会清空待处理表，提交前再次拒绝 SCOPE_DISPOSED，候选可能已被水合但未被接纳。
Store 注销先摘登记再启动 $dispose，thenable 由 scope 追踪；Resource 注销先调用 dispose，若同步失败，登记仍在，可由调用方 detach 或处理后重试。detach 从不销毁，成功后生命周期责任转给调用方。
hydrate(state) 只有必填 state 参数，无额外选项。先 assertSSRState 校验全部结构，再对已登记对象调用 $hydrate/hydrate，未知 key 放入待处理表，之后同 key 登记时应用。每次 hydrate 整体替换待处理表，新状态未包含的旧待处理项不保留。
这是尽力而为的操作，不是原子事务。一个回调失败不阻止其他条目尝试，已经应用的状态不回滚。单个失败原样抛出；多个失败通过 HYDRATE_FAILED 的 AggregateError.errors 保留原对象和顺序。key 拼写、快照是否含该 key 及服务端脱水时对象是否已销毁，都影响客户端恢复结果。

dehydrate() 无参数，按 key 字典序遍历未销毁的已登记对象。Store 的 $plain() 经 JSON 校验、深拷贝和冻结；Resource 的 dehydrate() 返回 undefined 时跳过，有值时只对 data 深拷贝校验，保留 version、ageMs、remainingTtlMs。外层 state、stores、resources 都冻结，脱水后源对象变化不改变这份安全快照。
dehydrateTrusted() 无参数，但它不是快照。它保留 $plain()/dehydrate() 的活引用，不做 JSON 校验、深拷贝或深冻结；只有外层包装不等于整棵数据不可变。ITrustedSSRState 有不可外部构造的类型品牌，serializeTrustedSSRState 只接受这条路径产出的类型，不是对不可信数据的安全证明。
选择 trusted 路径必须已知所有值合法且不会在序列化前改变，随后立即 serializeTrustedSSRState，中间不要 await 或 mutation。默认使用 dehydrate，不能因为有品牌就把请求输入当作已验证数据。dehydrate/dehydrateAsync 只产出数据，不负责 HTML 字符转义。

awaitResources(options?) 返回 readonly ISSRResourceFailure[]；每项包含 key 和原始 error。options 默认 {}，timeoutMs 默认 undefined，不设期限；提供时须为 [0, 2147483647] 内的有限非负数，可为小数，非法值让返回 Promise 以 RangeError / INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。
timeoutMs 是整个等待的总预算，不是每个 Resource 各得一份。逐轮按 Promise 身份去重，新 retry/refetch Promise 仍会被等待；瀑布式完成后登记的新 Resource 也会进入后续轮次。超过 64 轮以 RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT 拒绝。
读取 promise getter 的失败按 key 只记一次；原 Promise 拒绝保留其原因；预算耗尽只把仍 pending 的 Promise 记为 RESOURCE_TIMEOUT，已成功的不误报。timeoutMs 0 不等在途任务，但仍识别已完成 Promise。scope 关闭会让等待尽快返回已收集失败，不把剩余项统一报超时，也不取消这些 Resource 的底层工作。

dehydrateAsync(options?) 先等待再安全脱水，字段 timeoutMs 同上；onResourceError(failure) 可选，无默认用户回调。未传时每项失败交 runtime.reportError(error, { phase: 'ssr-resource' })，传入后替代默认报告。失败清单不按 key 另行删除 state.resources，是否输出由 Resource.dehydrate() 决定。没有期限的永不 settle 工作可一直等待，调用方应按请求预算显式选择 timeoutMs。
Resource v2 hydration 恢复捕获时的剩余 TTL。已知传输或存储耗时应由调用方计入 ageMs，并从有限 remainingTtlMs 扣除、最低为 0；外层 ISSRState.version 仍是 1。
dispose() 无参数，同步关闭入口并启动清理；disposeAsync() 无参数，返回稳定的 Promise<void>。首次关闭先标记 disposed、清空登记与待水合表并发布完成 Promise，再执行回调。因此清理中的同步重入也取得同一个完成 Promise；重复调用、完成后与失败后均稳定复用，不再释放一次。

释放顺序是注册逆序的 owned Resource，再注册逆序的 owned Store，已销毁项跳过。每项失败不阻断其余项。同步 dispose 可抛同步失败，但不等待异步 Store thenable；disposeAsync 等全部已追踪清理完成，单错保留原对象，多错以 SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED 的 AggregateError.errors 汇总。它也等待由此前 unregister 启动、仍在追踪的 Store cleanup。
scope 不销毁 Runtime 本体。关闭后除 runtime/disposed 观察和幂等关闭外，登记、注销、detach、hydrate、脱水与资源等待以 SCOPE_DISPOSED 失败；同步方法抛错，异步等待方法拒绝。scope 一次性使用，不支持复活。

ISSRState 要求 version: 1、stores 普通对象；resources 可选。每个 Store 值必须是 JSON 对象，key 非空且不为 `__proto__`。Resource 快照要求 version: 2、data、有限非负 ageMs，以及 null 或有限非负 remainingTtlMs。assertSSRState(value) 只有必填 value，无选项，校验通过后收窄类型，不是创建一份深拷贝。

JSON 域是 null、字符串、布尔、有限数、普通对象与数组。拒绝 Date/Map/Set/类实例、非有限数、undefined/函数/symbol/bigint 等非 JSON 类型、祖先循环、深度超过 256、节点超过 1000000；路径指向 stores.app.count 或 resources.user.data[2].name 等位置。相同无环对象的重复引用不等于祖先循环。拷贝与纯校验共享同一判定顺序。
INVALID_SNAPSHOT 用于 stores/resources 结构与资源快照错误；外层版本错误为 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT。读取未知快照属性失败保留 native 原对象或 cause，不用新字符串替换失败。序列化不支持的 JSON 值为 TypeError / SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED。

sections.heading: JSON 文本、HTML 嵌入与显式 document

blocks.text: serializeSSRState(state) 先校验、JSON.stringify，再对 &、<、>、U+2028、U+2029 做 JSON 兼容转义，返回文本，不包标签。serializeTrustedSSRState(state) 跳过校验但仍执行这些转义。两者各只有一个必填参数，不是任意 HTML 上下文的通用转义器。

转义结果分别含字面反斜杠序列 \u0026、\u003c、\u003e、\u2028、\u2029，防止 payload 的 `</script>` 提前结束对应 script；JSON.parse 仍读回原字符。deserializeSSRState(text) 执行 JSON.parse 和 assertSSRState，SyntaxError 原位附 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT，保留原生类型与 stack。
createSSRStateScript(state, elementId?) 把安全文本放入完整 application/json script 标签。state 必填；elementId 默认 `__STORE_STATE__`，须匹配 `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/`，允许首个下划线并排除空白和引号，非法时 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT。

readSSRStateFromDocument(elementId?, document?) 默认同一 id；document 默认 undefined，未传不读全局 DOM。document.getElementById(id) 返回含 textContent 与 getAttribute(name) 的元素或 null；没有元素或空内容返回 undefined。真实浏览器 document 满足此最小接口，非浏览器宿主也可显式实现它。返回数据仍须通过 SSR 校验。

sections.heading: 多 codec script 与读回

blocks.text: createSSRStateScriptWith(state, options) 和 readSSRStateFromDocumentWith(options) 是异步 API，options 必填：

rows: 必填，无默认；primaryType 选写入格式
默认 `__STORE_STATE__`；写入端校验上述正则，读取端按 id 原样查找
默认 undefined，透传给 registry encode/decode
仅读取，可选；省略返回 undefined

blocks.text: 如果 encode 返回 value chunk，以 TypeError / CODEC_CONTRACT 拒绝：SSR 需要线上文本或字节。primaryType 为 json 且 chunk 为 text 时使用 JSON 字符转义，属性为 data-codec="json" data-wire="text"。其他情况，包括 JSON 的 bytes，使用 base64，data-wire="b64"、type="text/plain"；不能把 JSON 转义套到 YAML 或二进制语法上。base64 字母表避免相关 HTML 分隔字符，编码体积约增加三分之一，这是编码规则而非速度测量。

多 codec 标签的 id 及 codec 属性按 HTML 属性规则转义 &、双引号、单引号、<、>。这不替代 id 的准入规则。读者取 data-codec（默认 json）与 data-wire（默认 text）决定还原方式；未注册写入类型以 CODEC_CONTRACT 拒绝，解码后的结果仍经过 assertSSRState。写入和读取必须有兼容 registry，registry.encode 本身不代替 SSR helper 的嵌入策略。

SsrWireType 是 { json: 'json', text: 'text', bytes: 'bytes' }，ISsrWireType 为值联合。json 比较 codec type，text/bytes 比较 chunk kind，不能把这三个词混为同一层。内部等待标签 SsrWorkOutcome/ISsrWorkOutcome 已从根入口收回，不增加 wrapper 或兼容 alias；awaitResources 仍直接返回失败数组。

JSON 值域、循环或深度/节点预算不符
timeout、互斥 Runtime 选项、owned 或重复键非法
登记对象不属于当前 Runtime

blocks.text: createStoreSsrError(code, message, options?) 构造 Error，options 可含 cause；createStoreSsrRangeError(code, message) 与 createStoreSsrTypeError(code, message) 仅两个参数，没有 cause 选项。code 和 message 必填，无默认。createStoreSsrAggregateError(code, errors, message) 构造 AggregateError，三参数必填，errors[] 保留原对象与顺序。工厂借 utils 的 attachErrorIdentity 附身份，不重写 stack。已有 native SyntaxError/TypeError 的准入失败在可附码时原位保留类型、实例和 stack，不可写或非 Error 原因通过 cause 保留。

服务端每请求创建 scope，用 scope.runtime 创建真实 Store/Resource 并按 key 登记；有预取时 dehydrateAsync，随后用对应 serialize/script helper 输出，finally 中 await disposeAsync。浏览器创建自己的 Runtime 和状态对象，显式读取同 id，按同 key hydrate；Resource 的 autoStart、缓存和 TTL 由 resource 包及应用决定。注入 snapshot、发送响应和页面渲染都是宿主职责，本包不替应用创建请求上下文。
遇到 CROSS_RUNTIME 检查对象创建时是否传入 scope.runtime。水合没变化检查 key、服务端是否含该条目和对象是否已销毁。资源缺 key 应查看 dehydrate() 的返回值，而不是把 failure 名单当 payload 过滤器。脚本读回失败检查 id 和 codec 配置；等待不结束区分无期限的在途 Resource 与清理边界。

sections.id: 捕获请求快照并释放所拥有的状态
sections.heading: 捕获请求快照并释放所拥有的状态

blocks.text: 页面完成渲染后，状态容器在序列化前又发生变化，导出状态应保留该次渲染捕获的值，请求清理也须释放其拥有的容器。
把嵌套活对象直接当响应载荷，会让后续修改改写此前结果；请求处理器若漏掉容器销毁，还会留下订阅与清理作业。
直接安装 `store-ssr` 与 `store-light`，以 `scope.runtime` 创建容器并登记，再用 `dehydrate()` 取得经校验的冻结快照，请求结束时等待 `disposeAsync()`。
createSSRRequestScope() 不传选项，内部新建 Runtime；register 的 key 与 Store 必填，owned 默认 true，Store 以 scope.runtime 创建。

blocks.code:
import { createSSRRequestScope } from '@migaia/store-ssr'
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'

const scope = createSSRRequestScope()
const cart = createStore({ count: 2 }, { runtime: scope.runtime })
scope.register('cart', cart)
const snapshot = scope.dehydrate()
cart.count = 3
console.log(snapshot.stores.cart?.count, cart.count)
console.log(Object.isFrozen(snapshot.stores.cart))
await scope.disposeAsync()
console.log(cart.$disposed)

2 3
true
true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `2 3`、`true`、`true`，活容器变为 `3` 后脱水值仍为 `2`，快照已冻结，请求完成时所拥有容器也已销毁。
登记默认拥有容器，`dehydrate()` 校验、复制并冻结 JSON 数据，`dehydrateTrusted()` 则保留活引用；作用域清理不销毁运行时本体，由调用者为每请求创建独立作用域。

sections.id: 让两个请求使用各自的运行时
sections.heading: 让两个请求使用各自的运行时

blocks.text: 并发请求为不同用户登记相同的个人资料键，需要隔离状态，也须拒绝误传另一个请求所创建的容器。
模块级运行时或共享登记表会让请求状态归同一所有者，仅给作用域不同名字，无法纠正使用错误运行时构造的容器。
`createSSRRequestScope` 默认创建新运行时，各真实 `store-light` 容器使用自身的 `scope.runtime`，`register()` 接纳前检查精确运行时身份。
两个 createSSRRequestScope() 都使用默认新 Runtime；相同 key 分别属于各自登记表，register 在接纳前检查 Store.$runtime。

blocks.code:
false
Alice Bob
CROSS_RUNTIME

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `false`、`Alice Bob`、`CROSS_RUNTIME`，默认作用域的运行时不同，相同键保存各自用户值，跨运行时登记被拒绝。
向多个作用域显式传同一个 `runtime` 会复用它，不能获得请求隔离；`runtime` 与 `runtimeOptions` 互斥，登记失败后候选仍归调用者，关闭一个作用域不释放另一个拥有的对象。

sections.id: 保留就绪数据并报告仍在途的资源
sections.heading: 保留就绪数据并报告仍在途的资源

blocks.text: 渲染已有一项就绪缓存，等待预算结束时另一项请求仍在途中，已完成条目应继续可用，不应被误标为超时。
对整个 `Promise.all` 统一报超时，会丢失各资源实际结算情况，全部重试又会丢弃可用缓存并重复已成功的工作。
直接安装资源包，`dehydrateAsync({ timeoutMs: 0 })` 识别已结算结果而不等待在途工作，通过 `onResourceError` 收集失败，就绪资源使用 `60000` 毫秒缓存有效期。
Resource 使用 scope.runtime；ttl 默认 Infinity，本例把 ready 的 ttl 覆盖为 60000 毫秒；timeoutMs: 0 是整个等待的零预算，onResourceError 替代默认报告。

blocks.code:
pending RESOURCE_TIMEOUT
7

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `pending RESOURCE_TIMEOUT`、`7`，仅未完成资源收到报告，成功缓存值仍在脱水资源状态中，随后示例完成在途加载并关闭作用域。
`timeoutMs` 默认无截止期限，预算覆盖整个等待，超时不会中止底层工作；是否纳入由资源自身脱水决定，不会额外按失败键过滤，旧缓存仍可能符合纳入条件。

sections.id: 内联-json-时避免数据提前关闭脚本元素
sections.heading: 内联 JSON 时避免数据提前关闭脚本元素

blocks.text: 用户文本包含 `</script>`、与号或 Unicode 行分隔符，把普通 JSON 内联进 HTML 脚本元素，可能让解析器把数据解释成标记。
`JSON.stringify` 转义 JSON 语法，却不会去掉字符串中的字面关闭脚本标签，之后再转义整份页面又可能损坏 JSON 表示。
`serializeSSRState` 先校验版本 `1` 状态，再用 JSON 兼容序列转义 `&`、`<`、`>`、U+2028 与 U+2029，用 `deserializeSSRState` 读回并核对同值。
state 必须是 version: 1 的合法 SSR 状态，serializeSSRState 与 deserializeSSRState 各接受一个必填参数，无额外选项。

blocks.code:
import { serializeSSRState, deserializeSSRState } from '@migaia/store-ssr'

const value = '</script>&\u2028\u2029'
const state = { version: 1 as const, stores: { page: { text: value } } }
const text = serializeSSRState(state)
console.log(
  text.includes('<'),
  text.includes('&'),
  text.includes('\u2028'),
  text.includes('\u2029')
)
console.log(deserializeSSRState(text).stores.page?.text === value)

false false false false
true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `false false false false`、`true`，序列化文本不含所检查的原始 HTML 敏感字符或行分隔符，JSON 解析仍精确恢复原字符串。
返回文本用于 JSON 脚本正文，函数不添加脚本元素，状态版本须为 `1`，值须符合支持的 JSON 值域；非法 JSON 解析保留 `SyntaxError` 并附 `INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT`。

sections.id: 生成完整的不可执行状态元素
sections.heading: 生成完整的不可执行状态元素

blocks.text: 渲染器已有合法状态外层，还需要为浏览器复水生成名称一致的元素，响应应包含数据，而不把 JSON 变成可执行 JavaScript。
手写标签模板容易在元素标识或 MIME 类型上不一致，没有配套转义便直接内联 JSON，还会让各渲染器重复处理关闭标签。
`createSSRStateScript` 校验状态与元素标识，按 HTML 上下文转义 JSON，再包装为 `application/json` 脚本，省略 `elementId` 时使用 `__STORE_STATE__`。
state 必填，elementId 省略时为 `__STORE_STATE__`；该函数返回标签文本，不插入 DOM。

blocks.code: <script type="application/json" id="__STORE_STATE__">{"version":1,"stores":{"app":{"count":2}}}</script>

blocks.text: 输出 `<script type="application/json" id="__STORE_STATE__">{"version":1,"stores":{"app":{"count":2}}}</script>`，完整标签包含默认标识与不可执行 JSON MIME 类型。
此函数生成 HTML 文本，不插入 DOM 节点或复水容器，浏览器可用同一标识和显式文档调用 `readSSRStateFromDocument`，读取器不会自动取得全局文档。

sections.id: 拒绝会破坏状态元素属性的标识符
sections.heading: 拒绝会破坏状态元素属性的标识符

blocks.text: 渲染器从配置中选择元素标识，若接纳引号或空白，该值便可能逃出 `id` 属性并改变生成标记。
把任意配置字符串插入标签，会把该值当成 HTML 语法，仅让服务端与浏览器约定同一标识，不能校验属性边界。
`createSSRStateScript` 要求标识以字母或下划线开头，后续仅含字母、数字、下划线、冒号、点或连字符；先展示合法自定义标识，再拒绝带引号及空白的值。
elementId 为第二个参数，默认 `__STORE_STATE__`，须匹配 /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/；非法值以 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT 拒绝。

blocks.code:
true
Error INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true`、`Error INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT`，合法的 `page-state` 被写入，尝试突破属性边界的标识在返回标签前被拒绝。
默认标识为 `__STORE_STATE__`，空或不匹配的标识会拒绝，状态数据另行校验并转义 JSON，此标识规则不替其他页面标记提供通用 HTML 清洗策略。
本包只有根入口 `@migaia/store-ssr`。它连接 reactive 驱动的 Store/Resource 与 SSR 快照，管理请求内登记、预取等待、脱水、复水和已接纳对象的清理；依赖 reactive、resource、serialize、utils，不绑定渲染框架，也不读 globalThis.document。

每个请求默认创建新的 SSRRequestScope 和 Runtime。register 检查 store.$runtime，registerResource 检查 resource.runtime，必须等于 scope.runtime；不匹配抛 CROSS_RUNTIME。claimOwnership 登记 scope 对象的归属，不独占 Runtime：调用方显式传同一个 Runtime 给两个 scope 是允许的，库无法据此自动隔离请求。正确的接入是每请求创建独立 scope，用 scope.runtime 创建该请求状态，并在 finally 中 await disposeAsync。
createStore 返回值和 Resource 类分别满足下文的 Store/Resource 接口，不需要另造适配层。纯客户端应用不需要这座 SSR 桥；它也不是通用的任意对象 JSON 转换器。客户端是否重发数据请求还取决于 Resource 的缓存、TTL 和启动策略，复水不保证所有业务都不再请求。
createSSRRequestScope(options?) 等价于 new SSRRequestScope(options?)，options 默认空对象：

rows: 未提供时内部 createRuntime() 新建；显式提供时复用
undefined；转给内部 createRuntime，与 runtime 互斥

blocks.text: runtimeOptions 是 reactive 的选项，包含 onError、onTrace、maxFlushPasses、scheduleIdle 等，由 reactive 定义具体语义；本包没有另建运行时选项。两项同时提供以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。scope.runtime 只读，scope.disposed 表示已开始同步关闭。
Resource 没有可脱水缓存时可返回 undefined。Store 使用 $ 前缀、Resource 不使用，是各自原接口的约定。异步 Store cleanup 由 scope 观察；Resource port 的 dispose 是同步接口。结构适配器必须按自身缓存策略提供 dehydrate，不能假设失败记录会替它决定是否输出缓存。

rows: key/store 必填，options 默认 {}，owned 默认 true；返回 void
key 必填，disposeOwned 默认 true；返回是否找到登记
返回原 Store 或 undefined，只移除不销毁
Resource 版本，同样默认 owned true
Resource 版本，返回是否找到登记
返回原 Resource 或 undefined，只移除不销毁

blocks.text: key 必须非空且不能为 `__proto__`。Store 与 Resource 各自的重复 key 以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝，不静默覆盖。登记对象必须属于当前 Runtime。owned true 在 scope 退出时负责清理；owned false 只参与脱水/复水，资源仍归调用方。
hydrate 先于登记到达时，register 会在提交登记前应用同 key 待处理快照。回调失败且 scope 仍活跃时，key 仍空闲，待处理快照保留以便重试，候选仍归调用方；若回调关闭了 scope，关闭会清空待处理表，提交前再次拒绝 SCOPE_DISPOSED，候选可能已被水合但未被接纳。
Store 注销先摘登记再启动 $dispose，thenable 由 scope 追踪；Resource 注销先调用 dispose，若同步失败，登记仍在，可由调用方 detach 或处理后重试。detach 从不销毁，成功后生命周期责任转给调用方。
hydrate(state) 只有必填 state 参数，无额外选项。先 assertSSRState 校验全部结构，再对已登记对象调用 $hydrate/hydrate，未知 key 放入待处理表，之后同 key 登记时应用。每次 hydrate 整体替换待处理表，新状态未包含的旧待处理项不保留。
这是尽力而为的操作，不是原子事务。一个回调失败不阻止其他条目尝试，已经应用的状态不回滚。单个失败原样抛出；多个失败通过 HYDRATE_FAILED 的 AggregateError.errors 保留原对象和顺序。key 拼写、快照是否含该 key 及服务端脱水时对象是否已销毁，都影响客户端恢复结果。

dehydrate() 无参数，按 key 字典序遍历未销毁的已登记对象。Store 的 $plain() 经 JSON 校验、深拷贝和冻结；Resource 的 dehydrate() 返回 undefined 时跳过，有值时只对 data 深拷贝校验，保留 version、ageMs、remainingTtlMs。外层 state、stores、resources 都冻结，脱水后源对象变化不改变这份安全快照。
dehydrateTrusted() 无参数，但它不是快照。它保留 $plain()/dehydrate() 的活引用，不做 JSON 校验、深拷贝或深冻结；只有外层包装不等于整棵数据不可变。ITrustedSSRState 有不可外部构造的类型品牌，serializeTrustedSSRState 只接受这条路径产出的类型，不是对不可信数据的安全证明。
选择 trusted 路径必须已知所有值合法且不会在序列化前改变，随后立即 serializeTrustedSSRState，中间不要 await 或 mutation。默认使用 dehydrate，不能因为有品牌就把请求输入当作已验证数据。dehydrate/dehydrateAsync 只产出数据，不负责 HTML 字符转义。

awaitResources(options?) 返回 readonly ISSRResourceFailure[]；每项包含 key 和原始 error。options 默认 {}，timeoutMs 默认 undefined，不设期限；提供时须为 [0, 2147483647] 内的有限非负数，可为小数，非法值让返回 Promise 以 RangeError / INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。
timeoutMs 是整个等待的总预算，不是每个 Resource 各得一份。逐轮按 Promise 身份去重，新 retry/refetch Promise 仍会被等待；瀑布式完成后登记的新 Resource 也会进入后续轮次。超过 64 轮以 RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT 拒绝。
读取 promise getter 的失败按 key 只记一次；原 Promise 拒绝保留其原因；预算耗尽只把仍 pending 的 Promise 记为 RESOURCE_TIMEOUT，已成功的不误报。timeoutMs 0 不等在途任务，但仍识别已完成 Promise。scope 关闭会让等待尽快返回已收集失败，不把剩余项统一报超时，也不取消这些 Resource 的底层工作。

dehydrateAsync(options?) 先等待再安全脱水，字段 timeoutMs 同上；onResourceError(failure) 可选，无默认用户回调。未传时每项失败交 runtime.reportError(error, { phase: 'ssr-resource' })，传入后替代默认报告。失败清单不按 key 另行删除 state.resources，是否输出由 Resource.dehydrate() 决定。没有期限的永不 settle 工作可一直等待，调用方应按请求预算显式选择 timeoutMs。
Resource v2 hydration 恢复捕获时的剩余 TTL。已知传输或存储耗时应由调用方计入 ageMs，并从有限 remainingTtlMs 扣除、最低为 0；外层 ISSRState.version 仍是 1。
dispose() 无参数，同步关闭入口并启动清理；disposeAsync() 无参数，返回稳定的 Promise<void>。首次关闭先标记 disposed、清空登记与待水合表并发布完成 Promise，再执行回调。因此清理中的同步重入也取得同一个完成 Promise；重复调用、完成后与失败后均稳定复用，不再释放一次。

释放顺序是注册逆序的 owned Resource，再注册逆序的 owned Store，已销毁项跳过。每项失败不阻断其余项。同步 dispose 可抛同步失败，但不等待异步 Store thenable；disposeAsync 等全部已追踪清理完成，单错保留原对象，多错以 SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED 的 AggregateError.errors 汇总。它也等待由此前 unregister 启动、仍在追踪的 Store cleanup。
scope 不销毁 Runtime 本体。关闭后除 runtime/disposed 观察和幂等关闭外，登记、注销、detach、hydrate、脱水与资源等待以 SCOPE_DISPOSED 失败；同步方法抛错，异步等待方法拒绝。scope 一次性使用，不支持复活。

ISSRState 要求 version: 1、stores 普通对象；resources 可选。每个 Store 值必须是 JSON 对象，key 非空且不为 `__proto__`。Resource 快照要求 version: 2、data、有限非负 ageMs，以及 null 或有限非负 remainingTtlMs。assertSSRState(value) 只有必填 value，无选项，校验通过后收窄类型，不是创建一份深拷贝。

JSON 域是 null、字符串、布尔、有限数、普通对象与数组。拒绝 Date/Map/Set/类实例、非有限数、undefined/函数/symbol/bigint 等非 JSON 类型、祖先循环、深度超过 256、节点超过 1000000；路径指向 stores.app.count 或 resources.user.data[2].name 等位置。相同无环对象的重复引用不等于祖先循环。拷贝与纯校验共享同一判定顺序。
INVALID_SNAPSHOT 用于 stores/resources 结构与资源快照错误；外层版本错误为 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT。读取未知快照属性失败保留 native 原对象或 cause，不用新字符串替换失败。序列化不支持的 JSON 值为 TypeError / SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED。

sections.heading: JSON 文本、HTML 嵌入与显式 document

blocks.text: serializeSSRState(state) 先校验、JSON.stringify，再对 &、<、>、U+2028、U+2029 做 JSON 兼容转义，返回文本，不包标签。serializeTrustedSSRState(state) 跳过校验但仍执行这些转义。两者各只有一个必填参数，不是任意 HTML 上下文的通用转义器。

转义结果分别含字面反斜杠序列 \u0026、\u003c、\u003e、\u2028、\u2029，防止 payload 的 `</script>` 提前结束对应 script；JSON.parse 仍读回原字符。deserializeSSRState(text) 执行 JSON.parse 和 assertSSRState，SyntaxError 原位附 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT，保留原生类型与 stack。
createSSRStateScript(state, elementId?) 把安全文本放入完整 application/json script 标签。state 必填；elementId 默认 `__STORE_STATE__`，须匹配 `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/`，允许首个下划线并排除空白和引号，非法时 INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT。

readSSRStateFromDocument(elementId?, document?) 默认同一 id；document 默认 undefined，未传不读全局 DOM。document.getElementById(id) 返回含 textContent 与 getAttribute(name) 的元素或 null；没有元素或空内容返回 undefined。真实浏览器 document 满足此最小接口，非浏览器宿主也可显式实现它。返回数据仍须通过 SSR 校验。

sections.heading: 多 codec script 与读回

blocks.text: createSSRStateScriptWith(state, options) 和 readSSRStateFromDocumentWith(options) 是异步 API，options 必填：

rows: 必填，无默认；primaryType 选写入格式
默认 `__STORE_STATE__`；写入端校验上述正则，读取端按 id 原样查找
默认 undefined，透传给 registry encode/decode
仅读取，可选；省略返回 undefined

blocks.text: 如果 encode 返回 value chunk，以 TypeError / CODEC_CONTRACT 拒绝：SSR 需要线上文本或字节。primaryType 为 json 且 chunk 为 text 时使用 JSON 字符转义，属性为 data-codec="json" data-wire="text"。其他情况，包括 JSON 的 bytes，使用 base64，data-wire="b64"、type="text/plain"；不能把 JSON 转义套到 YAML 或二进制语法上。base64 字母表避免相关 HTML 分隔字符，编码体积约增加三分之一，这是编码规则而非速度测量。

多 codec 标签的 id 及 codec 属性按 HTML 属性规则转义 &、双引号、单引号、<、>。这不替代 id 的准入规则。读者取 data-codec（默认 json）与 data-wire（默认 text）决定还原方式；未注册写入类型以 CODEC_CONTRACT 拒绝，解码后的结果仍经过 assertSSRState。写入和读取必须有兼容 registry，registry.encode 本身不代替 SSR helper 的嵌入策略。

SsrWireType 是 { json: 'json', text: 'text', bytes: 'bytes' }，ISsrWireType 为值联合。json 比较 codec type，text/bytes 比较 chunk kind，不能把这三个词混为同一层。内部等待标签 SsrWorkOutcome/ISsrWorkOutcome 已从根入口收回，不增加 wrapper 或兼容 alias；awaitResources 仍直接返回失败数组。
本包构造错误的 source 为 STORE_SSR_SOURCE，即 @migaia/store-ssr；完整外包 source/code 保留原 owner。StoreSsrErrorCode 的 12 项如下：

rows: scope 已关闭后继续使用
多个 owned 清理失败，AggregateError 保留 errors
多条水合失败，非原子、其他成功不撤销
stores/resources、Resource 快照或其属性读取非法
外层版本、script id 或 JSON 解析非法
JSON 值域、循环或深度/节点预算不符
timeout、互斥 Runtime 选项、owned 或重复键非法
登记对象不属于当前 Runtime
value chunk 或读者未注册对应 codec
资源注册瀑布超过 64 轮
某 pending Resource 到达总期限，记入失败数组

sections.heading: Ownership, entry point, and request isolation

blocks.text: The only entry is `@migaia/store-ssr`. It connects reactive-driven Stores/Resources to SSR snapshots, owning registration, prefetch waits, dehydration, hydration, and cleanup of accepted objects. Dependencies are reactive, resource, serialize, and utils. It has no rendering-framework binding and never reads globalThis.document.

A new SSRRequestScope creates a new Runtime by default. Store registration checks $runtime, and Resource registration checks runtime, against scope.runtime. Mismatches fail with CROSS_RUNTIME. claimOwnership records the scope object's owner; it does not exclusively reserve a Runtime. Two scopes may explicitly receive the same Runtime, so the application still owns request isolation. Create one independent scope per request, create its state with scope.runtime, and await disposeAsync in finally.

createStore and the Resource class already satisfy the respective interfaces below. A purely client-side application does not need this bridge, and this is not an arbitrary-object JSON converter. Whether the client refetches depends on Resource cache, TTL, and startup policy; hydration does not guarantee that every application request is eliminated.
createSSRRequestScope(options?) is equivalent to new SSRRequestScope(options?). Options default to an empty object.

rows: Create a Runtime when omitted; otherwise reuse the supplied one
undefined; forwarded to createRuntime, mutually exclusive with runtime

blocks.text: runtimeOptions belongs to reactive, including onError, onTrace, maxFlushPasses, and scheduleIdle. This module does not define another Runtime configuration model. Supplying both fields produces INVALID_OPTION. scope.runtime is readonly; scope.disposed becomes true when synchronous closure starts.

A Resource without a dehydrated cache can return undefined. The $-prefixed Store names and unprefixed Resource names follow their existing contracts. The scope observes asynchronous Store cleanup; the Resource port has synchronous disposal. Structural adapters must define their own dehydrate/cache policy rather than expect the failure list to choose cached output for them.
