blocks.text: Keys must be nonempty and cannot be `__proto__`. Duplicate Store or Resource keys fail with INVALID_OPTION rather than replacing registrations. Objects must belong to the scope Runtime. Owned entries are cleaned up on exit; owned false leaves lifecycle responsibility with the caller while participating in dehydration/hydration.

When hydration arrived before registration, the pending matching snapshot is applied before registration commits. If the callback fails while the scope remains active, the key stays free, the pending snapshot remains available for retry, and the candidate stays caller-owned. If the callback closes the scope, closure clears pending state and a post-hydration SCOPE_DISPOSED check rejects admission, even if the candidate has already received values.

Store unregistration removes the entry before invoking $dispose and tracks returned thenables. Resource unregistration calls dispose first; synchronous failure leaves the registration present for caller handling or detach. Detach never disposes and transfers lifecycle responsibility back to the caller.

hydrate(state) requires one state argument without options. It first validates the whole structure with assertSSRState, then applies $hydrate/hydrate to registered objects and stores unknown keys for later registration. Each call replaces the pending tables; absent keys from older pending state are not retained.

This is best-effort application rather than an atomic transaction. One callback failure does not prevent the other entries being attempted, and successful updates are not rolled back. One failure is thrown unchanged; multiple failures use HYDRATE_FAILED with AggregateError.errors retaining original objects and order. Matching keys, presence in the server payload, and whether an object was disposed before dehydration all affect restoration.

sections.heading: Safe dehydration and the trusted path

blocks.text: dehydrate() takes no arguments. It visits active registrations in sorted key order. Store $plain results are JSON-validated, deeply copied, and frozen. A Resource returning undefined is omitted. Otherwise its data receives the same validation/copying, while version, ageMs, and remainingTtlMs are preserved. The outer state, stores, and resources are frozen. Later source changes do not change this safe snapshot.

dehydrateTrusted() also takes no arguments, but it is not a snapshot. It retains live $plain()/dehydrate() references without JSON validation, deep copies, or deep freezing. An outer wrapper does not make all descendants immutable. The ITrustedSSRState brand prevents accidental typed input to serializeTrustedSSRState; it is not proof that untrusted application data is safe.

Use this path only when every value is already valid and cannot change before immediate serializeTrustedSSRState, with no intervening await or mutation. Prefer dehydrate by default. A brand is not validation of request input. dehydrate and dehydrateAsync produce data only; they do not perform HTML character escaping.

awaitResources(options?) returns readonly ISSRResourceFailure[], whose entries contain key and original error. Options default to {} and timeoutMs to undefined, meaning no deadline. A supplied timeout must be finite within [0, 2147483647], including fractional values. Invalid values reject the returned promise with RangeError / INVALID_OPTION.

The budget covers the whole wait, not a new allocation for every Resource. Successive rounds deduplicate by Promise identity. A retry/refetch promise or a Resource registered after another completes is still awaited. More than 64 rounds rejects with RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT.

A throwing promise getter is recorded once per key. A rejected promise retains its original reason. Deadline exhaustion marks only still-pending promises with RESOURCE_TIMEOUT, without misclassifying existing successes. Zero waits for no in-flight work but still recognizes settled promises. Scope closure promptly returns already collected failures without marking every remaining resource as timed out or cancelling its underlying work.

dehydrateAsync(options?) waits before safe dehydration. timeoutMs has the same contract. Optional onResourceError(failure) replaces default reporting; without it, each failure goes to runtime.reportError(error, { phase: 'ssr-resource' }). Failure keys are not a second payload filter: Resource.dehydrate decides whether cached data is included. An unbounded wait for a never-settled promise can remain pending; choose timeoutMs to match the request budget.

Resource v2 hydration restores captured remaining TTL. The caller accounts for known transport/storage delay by increasing ageMs and subtracting from finite remainingTtlMs, floored at zero. The outer ISSRState version remains 1.

sections.heading: Closing a scope and stable completion

blocks.text: dispose() takes no arguments, closes synchronously, and starts cleanup. disposeAsync() takes no arguments and returns a stable Promise<void>. First closure marks disposed, clears registrations/pending hydration, and publishes completion before invoking cleanup. Synchronous reentry sees the same promise. Concurrent, completed, and failed repeated calls reuse it without another cleanup pass.

Owned Resources release in reverse registration order, then owned Stores in reverse order; already disposed objects are skipped. Failure never prevents later entries being attempted. Synchronous dispose can throw synchronous failures without waiting for Store thenables. disposeAsync waits for tracked jobs, preserves a single failure, and aggregates multiple failures under SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED. It also waits for still-tracked Store cleanup started by earlier unregister calls.

The scope does not dispose the Runtime itself. After closure, registration, removal, detach, hydrate, dehydration, and resource waits fail with SCOPE_DISPOSED. Synchronous methods throw; asynchronous wait methods reject. Reading runtime/disposed and repeated closure remain available. A scope cannot be revived.

ISSRState requires version 1 and a plain stores record; resources is optional. Each Store value must be a JSON object, with a nonempty key other than `__proto__`. Resource snapshots require version 2, data, finite non-negative ageMs, and remainingTtlMs that is null or finite/non-negative. assertSSRState(value) takes one required value without options and narrows its type; it does not create a deep copy.

The JSON domain is null, strings, booleans, finite numbers, ordinary records, and arrays. It rejects Date/Map/Set/class instances, nonfinite numbers, undefined/functions/symbols/bigint, ancestor cycles, depth above 256, and node counts above 1000000. Paths identify locations such as stores.app.count or resources.user.data[2].name. Acyclic repeated references are not ancestor cycles. Copying and validation share rejection order.

INVALID_SNAPSHOT covers store/resource structure and Resource snapshots. Invalid outer versions use INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT. Unreadable unknown snapshot properties preserve the native object or cause rather than replacing the failure with text. Unsupported JSON values produce TypeError / SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED.

sections.heading: JSON text, HTML embedding, and explicit documents

blocks.text: serializeSSRState(state) validates, JSON-stringifies, and escapes &, <, >, U+2028, and U+2029 using JSON-compatible escapes. It returns text without a tag. serializeTrustedSSRState(state) skips validation but still escapes these characters. Both require one argument and are not general-purpose escaping for arbitrary HTML contexts.

The output contains literal escape sequences \u0026, \u003c, \u003e, \u2028, and \u2029, preventing a payload's `</script>` from ending its enclosing element while JSON.parse restores the original characters. deserializeSSRState(text) parses and validates; malformed JSON keeps native SyntaxError and its stack while receiving INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT.

createSSRStateScript(state, elementId?) wraps safe text in a complete application/json script element. State is required. The id defaults to `__STORE_STATE__` and must match `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/`, allowing the leading underscore but excluding whitespace/quotes. Invalid ids produce INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT.

readSSRStateFromDocument(elementId?, document?) uses the same default id. Document defaults to undefined; the module never discovers a global DOM. getElementById(id) returns an element with textContent/getAttribute(name), or null. Missing elements or empty content return undefined. A browser document satisfies the minimal interface, and another host can explicitly provide it. Returned state still passes SSR validation.
createSSRStateScriptWith(state, options) and readSSRStateFromDocumentWith(options) are asynchronous and require options.

blocks.text: A value chunk fails with TypeError / CODEC_CONTRACT because SSR needs wire text or bytes. Json primaryType plus a text chunk uses JSON escaping and data-codec="json" data-wire="text". Every other case, including JSON bytes, uses base64 with data-wire="b64" and type="text/plain". Applying JSON escapes to YAML or binary would corrupt their syntax. The base64 alphabet avoids the relevant HTML delimiters and increases encoded size by roughly one third; this is an encoding property rather than a speed measurement.

Codec script id and codec attributes escape &, double/single quotes, <, and > as HTML attributes, in addition to id admission. Reading uses data-codec, default json, and data-wire, default text. An unregistered writer type fails with CODEC_CONTRACT; decoded output still passes assertSSRState. Writer and reader registries must be compatible. registry.encode alone does not provide the SSR helper's embedding policy.

SsrWireType is { json: 'json', text: 'text', bytes: 'bytes' }, and ISsrWireType is its value union. Json is a codec-type comparison, while text/bytes identify chunk kinds. Internal wait outcomes SsrWorkOutcome/ISsrWorkOutcome were removed from the root without a compatibility alias. awaitResources still returns its failure array directly.
module-created errors use STORE_SSR_SOURCE, @migaia/store-ssr. Complete foreign source/code identities retain their original owner. StoreSsrErrorCode contains these 12 values.

Existing mutable native SyntaxError/TypeError failures retain instance/class/stack when tagged; immutable or non-Error causes remain reachable.

On the server, create a scope per request and real Stores/Resources using its Runtime. Register keys, dehydrateAsync when prefetching, emit through the corresponding serialize/script helper, then await disposeAsync in finally. In the browser, create independent state/Runtime, explicitly read the same id, and hydrate matching keys. Resource startup, caching, and TTL belong to resource and the application. Supplying initial snapshots, sending responses, and rendering are host responsibilities.

For CROSS_RUNTIME, check the Runtime supplied at object creation. For missing hydration, check keys, server entries, and disposal. For absent resource output, inspect dehydrate rather than interpreting failure keys as filtering. Script read failures call for matching ids/codecs. A stalled wait requires distinguishing unbounded Resource work from cleanup completion.

sections.heading: Capture a request snapshot and release its owned store

blocks.text: A page finishes rendering, but the live store changes before its state is serialized. The exported state should retain the values captured for that render, and request cleanup must release its owned store.
Keeping a live nested object as the response payload lets later mutations rewrite the earlier result. A request handler that forgets store disposal also leaves subscriptions and cleanup jobs behind.
Install store-ssr and store-light directly. Create the Store with scope.runtime, register it, then call dehydrate() for a checked frozen snapshot and await disposeAsync() when the request ends.
createSSRRequestScope() uses no options and creates a Runtime; register requires the key and Store, defaults owned to true, and receives a Store created with scope.runtime.

blocks.code:
import { createSSRRequestScope } from '@migaia/store-ssr'
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'

const scope = createSSRRequestScope()
const cart = createStore({ count: 2 }, { runtime: scope.runtime })
scope.register('cart', cart)
const snapshot = scope.dehydrate()
cart.count = 3

await scope.disposeAsync()

true
true

blocks.text: Prints `2 3`, `true`, then `true`. The dehydrated count stays 2 after the live Store reaches 3; its snapshot is frozen, and the owned Store is disposed at request completion.

Registration owns the Store by default. dehydrate() validates, copies and freezes JSON data; dehydrateTrusted() retains live references instead. Scope cleanup does not dispose the Runtime itself, and the caller chooses one scope per request.

sections.heading: Keep two requests in separate runtimes

blocks.text: Concurrent requests register the same profile key for different users. They need separate state and must reject a Store accidentally created for the other request.
A module-level Runtime or shared registry lets request-specific state share one owner. Giving scopes different names cannot correct a Store that was constructed with the wrong Runtime.
createSSRRequestScope creates a new Runtime by default. Build each real store-light Store with its own scope.runtime; register() checks exact Runtime identity before accepting the foreign candidate.
Both scopes use their default fresh Runtime; identical keys belong to separate registries, and register checks Store.$runtime before admission.

blocks.code:
false
Alice Bob
CROSS_RUNTIME

blocks.text: Prints `false`, `Alice Bob`, and `CROSS_RUNTIME`. The default scopes have different Runtimes, identical keys hold separate user values, and the foreign registration is refused.

Passing the same explicit runtime to multiple scopes reuses it and does not create request isolation. runtime and runtimeOptions are mutually exclusive. Failed registration retains caller ownership; closing one scope does not release objects owned by the other.

sections.heading: Keep ready data when another resource exceeds the wait budget

blocks.text: A render has one ready cache entry and one request still pending when its waiting budget ends. The completed entry should remain usable without being mislabeled as a timeout.
Timing out an entire Promise.all call loses which resources actually settled. Retrying every resource discards available cache data and repeats work that already succeeded.

Install resource directly. dehydrateAsync({ timeoutMs: 0 }) classifies already-settled promises without waiting for pending work; onResourceError collects failures, and the ready Resource uses a 60000 ms cache TTL.
Resources use scope.runtime; ttl defaults to Infinity, and this example overrides ready to 60000 ms; timeoutMs: 0 is a zero budget for the whole wait, and onResourceError replaces default reporting.

blocks.code:
pending RESOURCE_TIMEOUT
7

blocks.text: Prints `pending RESOURCE_TIMEOUT` and `7`. Only the unresolved resource is reported; the successfully cached value remains in the dehydrated resource state. The example then resolves the pending loader and closes the scope.

timeoutMs defaults to no deadline and applies to the whole wait. A timeout does not abort underlying work. Resource inclusion follows resource.dehydrate(), without independently filtering failure keys; a stale cache can remain eligible.

sections.heading: Embed JSON without letting data close its script element

blocks.text: A user-supplied text contains `</script>`, an ampersand or Unicode line separators. Inlining ordinary JSON into an HTML script element can make the HTML parser treat data as markup.
JSON.stringify escapes JSON syntax but does not remove a literal closing script tag from string contents. Escaping the whole document afterward can instead corrupt the JSON representation.

serializeSSRState first validates the version-1 state and then escapes &, <, >, U+2028 and U+2029 with JSON-compatible sequences. deserializeSSRState reads the escaped text back and verifies the same value.
state must be a valid version-1 SSR envelope; serializeSSRState and deserializeSSRState each take one required argument without options.

blocks.code:
import { serializeSSRState, deserializeSSRState } from '@migaia/store-ssr'

const value = '</script>&\u2028\u2029'
const state = { version: 1 as const, stores: { page: { text: value } } }
const text = serializeSSRState(state)
console.log(
  text.includes('<'),
  text.includes('&'),
  text.includes('\u2028'),
  text.includes('\u2029')
)
console.log(deserializeSSRState(text).stores.page?.text === value)

false false false false
true

blocks.text: Prints `false false false false` and `true`. The serialized text contains none of the checked raw HTML-sensitive characters or line separators, while JSON parsing recovers the original string exactly.

Use the returned text as JSON script content; the function does not add a script element. State version must be 1 and values must meet the supported JSON domain. Invalid parsed JSON retains SyntaxError with INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT.

sections.heading: Create the complete non-executable state element

blocks.text: A renderer has a validated state envelope but still needs a consistently named element for browser hydration. The response should include data without turning that JSON into executable JavaScript.
Hand-written tag templates can disagree about the element id or MIME type. Inlining the JSON without its matching escaping also reintroduces closing-tag handling into every renderer.
createSSRStateScript validates the state and element id, serializes with HTML-compatible JSON escapes, and wraps the result in an application/json script. Omit elementId to use `__STORE_STATE__`.
state is required, elementId defaults to `__STORE_STATE__`, and the result is tag text rather than a DOM insertion.

blocks.code: <script type="application/json" id="__STORE_STATE__">{"version":1,"stores":{"app":{"count":2}}}</script>

blocks.text: Prints `<script type="application/json" id="__STORE_STATE__">{"version":1,"stores":{"app":{"count":2}}}</script>`. The default id and non-executable JSON MIME type appear in the complete tag.

This function builds HTML text and does not insert DOM nodes or hydrate Stores. A browser reader can use readSSRStateFromDocument with the same id and an explicitly supplied document; that reader does not obtain a global document automatically.

sections.heading: Reject identifiers that can break the state element attribute

blocks.text: A renderer selects an element id from configuration. If quotes or whitespace are accepted, the value can escape its id attribute and change the generated markup.
Interpolating an arbitrary configuration string into a tag treats that value as HTML syntax. Merely agreeing on an id between server and browser does not validate the attribute boundary.

createSSRStateScript requires an id beginning with a letter or underscore, followed by letters, digits, underscores, colons, dots or hyphens. Show a valid custom id, then reject one containing a quote and spaces.
elementId is the second argument and defaults to `__STORE_STATE__`; it must match /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/, otherwise INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT is thrown.

blocks.code:
true
Error INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT

blocks.text: Prints `true` and `Error INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT`. The valid page-state id is rendered; the attempted attribute-breaking id is rejected before a tag is returned.

The default id is `__STORE_STATE__`, and empty or nonmatching ids reject. State data is separately validated and JSON-escaped; this identifier rule does not provide a general HTML sanitization policy for other markup.

blocks.text: Keys must be nonempty and cannot be `__proto__`. Duplicate Store or Resource keys fail with INVALID_OPTION rather than replacing registrations. Objects must belong to the scope Runtime. Owned entries are cleaned up on exit; owned false leaves lifecycle responsibility with the caller while participating in dehydration/hydration.

When hydration arrived before registration, the pending matching snapshot is applied before registration commits. If the callback fails while the scope remains active, the key stays free, the pending snapshot remains available for retry, and the candidate stays caller-owned. If the callback closes the scope, closure clears pending state and a post-hydration SCOPE_DISPOSED check rejects admission, even if the candidate has already received values.

Store unregistration removes the entry before invoking $dispose and tracks returned thenables. Resource unregistration calls dispose first; synchronous failure leaves the registration present for caller handling or detach. Detach never disposes and transfers lifecycle responsibility back to the caller.

hydrate(state) requires one state argument without options. It first validates the whole structure with assertSSRState, then applies $hydrate/hydrate to registered objects and stores unknown keys for later registration. Each call replaces the pending tables; absent keys from older pending state are not retained.

This is best-effort application rather than an atomic transaction. One callback failure does not prevent the other entries being attempted, and successful updates are not rolled back. One failure is thrown unchanged; multiple failures use HYDRATE_FAILED with AggregateError.errors retaining original objects and order. Matching keys, presence in the server payload, and whether an object was disposed before dehydration all affect restoration.

sections.heading: Safe dehydration and the trusted path

blocks.text: dehydrate() takes no arguments. It visits active registrations in sorted key order. Store $plain results are JSON-validated, deeply copied, and frozen. A Resource returning undefined is omitted. Otherwise its data receives the same validation/copying, while version, ageMs, and remainingTtlMs are preserved. The outer state, stores, and resources are frozen. Later source changes do not change this safe snapshot.

dehydrateTrusted() also takes no arguments, but it is not a snapshot. It retains live $plain()/dehydrate() references without JSON validation, deep copies, or deep freezing. An outer wrapper does not make all descendants immutable. The ITrustedSSRState brand prevents accidental typed input to serializeTrustedSSRState; it is not proof that untrusted application data is safe.

Use this path only when every value is already valid and cannot change before immediate serializeTrustedSSRState, with no intervening await or mutation. Prefer dehydrate by default. A brand is not validation of request input. dehydrate and dehydrateAsync produce data only; they do not perform HTML character escaping.

awaitResources(options?) returns readonly ISSRResourceFailure[], whose entries contain key and original error. Options default to {} and timeoutMs to undefined, meaning no deadline. A supplied timeout must be finite within [0, 2147483647], including fractional values. Invalid values reject the returned promise with RangeError / INVALID_OPTION.

The budget covers the whole wait, not a new allocation for every Resource. Successive rounds deduplicate by Promise identity. A retry/refetch promise or a Resource registered after another completes is still awaited. More than 64 rounds rejects with RESOURCE_ROUND_LIMIT.

A throwing promise getter is recorded once per key. A rejected promise retains its original reason. Deadline exhaustion marks only still-pending promises with RESOURCE_TIMEOUT, without misclassifying existing successes. Zero waits for no in-flight work but still recognizes settled promises. Scope closure promptly returns already collected failures without marking every remaining resource as timed out or cancelling its underlying work.

dehydrateAsync(options?) waits before safe dehydration. timeoutMs has the same contract. Optional onResourceError(failure) replaces default reporting; without it, each failure goes to runtime.reportError(error, { phase: 'ssr-resource' }). Failure keys are not a second payload filter: Resource.dehydrate decides whether cached data is included. An unbounded wait for a never-settled promise can remain pending; choose timeoutMs to match the request budget.

Resource v2 hydration restores captured remaining TTL. The caller accounts for known transport/storage delay by increasing ageMs and subtracting from finite remainingTtlMs, floored at zero. The outer ISSRState version remains 1.

sections.heading: Closing a scope and stable completion

blocks.text: dispose() takes no arguments, closes synchronously, and starts cleanup. disposeAsync() takes no arguments and returns a stable Promise<void>. First closure marks disposed, clears registrations/pending hydration, and publishes completion before invoking cleanup. Synchronous reentry sees the same promise. Concurrent, completed, and failed repeated calls reuse it without another cleanup pass.

Owned Resources release in reverse registration order, then owned Stores in reverse order; already disposed objects are skipped. Failure never prevents later entries being attempted. Synchronous dispose can throw synchronous failures without waiting for Store thenables. disposeAsync waits for tracked jobs, preserves a single failure, and aggregates multiple failures under SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED. It also waits for still-tracked Store cleanup started by earlier unregister calls.

The scope does not dispose the Runtime itself. After closure, registration, removal, detach, hydrate, dehydration, and resource waits fail with SCOPE_DISPOSED. Synchronous methods throw; asynchronous wait methods reject. Reading runtime/disposed and repeated closure remain available. A scope cannot be revived.

ISSRState requires version 1 and a plain stores record; resources is optional. Each Store value must be a JSON object, with a nonempty key other than `__proto__`. Resource snapshots require version 2, data, finite non-negative ageMs, and remainingTtlMs that is null or finite/non-negative. assertSSRState(value) takes one required value without options and narrows its type; it does not create a deep copy.

The JSON domain is null, strings, booleans, finite numbers, ordinary records, and arrays. It rejects Date/Map/Set/class instances, nonfinite numbers, undefined/functions/symbols/bigint, ancestor cycles, depth above 256, and node counts above 1000000. Paths identify locations such as stores.app.count or resources.user.data[2].name. Acyclic repeated references are not ancestor cycles. Copying and validation share rejection order.

INVALID_SNAPSHOT covers store/resource structure and Resource snapshots. Invalid outer versions use INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT. Unreadable unknown snapshot properties preserve the native object or cause rather than replacing the failure with text. Unsupported JSON values produce TypeError / SERIALIZE_UNSUPPORTED.

sections.heading: JSON text, HTML embedding, and explicit documents

blocks.text: serializeSSRState(state) validates, JSON-stringifies, and escapes &, <, >, U+2028, and U+2029 using JSON-compatible escapes. It returns text without a tag. serializeTrustedSSRState(state) skips validation but still escapes these characters. Both require one argument and are not general-purpose escaping for arbitrary HTML contexts.

The output contains literal escape sequences \u0026, \u003c, \u003e, \u2028, and \u2029, preventing a payload's `</script>` from ending its enclosing element while JSON.parse restores the original characters. deserializeSSRState(text) parses and validates; malformed JSON keeps native SyntaxError and its stack while receiving INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT.

createSSRStateScript(state, elementId?) wraps safe text in a complete application/json script element. State is required. The id defaults to `__STORE_STATE__` and must match `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_:.-]*$/`, allowing the leading underscore but excluding whitespace/quotes. Invalid ids produce INVALID_STATE_SCRIPT.

readSSRStateFromDocument(elementId?, document?) uses the same default id. Document defaults to undefined; the module never discovers a global DOM. getElementById(id) returns an element with textContent/getAttribute(name), or null. Missing elements or empty content return undefined. A browser document satisfies the minimal interface, and another host can explicitly provide it. Returned state still passes SSR validation.
createSSRStateScriptWith(state, options) and readSSRStateFromDocumentWith(options) are asynchronous and require options.

rows: Required without a default; primaryType chooses the written format
`__STORE_STATE__`; writers validate the grammar above, readers look up the id as supplied
Read only, optional; omission returns undefined

blocks.text: A value chunk fails with TypeError / CODEC_CONTRACT because SSR needs wire text or bytes. Json primaryType plus a text chunk uses JSON escaping and data-codec="json" data-wire="text". Every other case, including JSON bytes, uses base64 with data-wire="b64" and type="text/plain". Applying JSON escapes to YAML or binary would corrupt their syntax. The base64 alphabet avoids the relevant HTML delimiters and increases encoded size by roughly one third; this is an encoding property rather than a speed measurement.

Codec script id and codec attributes escape &, double/single quotes, <, and > as HTML attributes, in addition to id admission. Reading uses data-codec, default json, and data-wire, default text. An unregistered writer type fails with CODEC_CONTRACT; decoded output still passes assertSSRState. Writer and reader registries must be compatible. registry.encode alone does not provide the SSR helper's embedding policy.

SsrWireType is { json: 'json', text: 'text', bytes: 'bytes' }, and ISsrWireType is its value union. Json is a codec-type comparison, while text/bytes identify chunk kinds. Internal wait outcomes SsrWorkOutcome/ISsrWorkOutcome were removed from the root without a compatibility alias. awaitResources still returns its failure array directly.
module-created errors use STORE_SSR_SOURCE, @migaia/store-ssr. Complete foreign source/code identities retain their original owner. StoreSsrErrorCode contains these 12 values.

blocks.text: createStoreSsrError(code, message, options?) creates Error and accepts an optional cause. createStoreSsrRangeError(code, message) and createStoreSsrTypeError(code, message) have only two arguments and no cause option. Code/message are required without defaults. createStoreSsrAggregateError(code, errors, message) requires all three arguments and retains error objects/order. Factories attach identity through utils without rewriting stacks. Existing mutable native SyntaxError/TypeError failures retain instance/class/stack when tagged; immutable or non-Error causes remain reachable.

On the server, create a scope per request and real Stores/Resources using its Runtime. Register keys, dehydrateAsync when prefetching, emit through the corresponding serialize/script helper, then await disposeAsync in finally. In the browser, create independent state/Runtime, explicitly read the same id, and hydrate matching keys. Resource startup, caching, and TTL belong to resource and the application. Supplying initial snapshots, sending responses, and rendering are host responsibilities.

For CROSS_RUNTIME, check the Runtime supplied at object creation. For missing hydration, check keys, server entries, and disposal. For absent resource output, inspect dehydrate rather than interpreting failure keys as filtering. Script read failures call for matching ids/codecs. A stalled wait requires distinguishing unbounded Resource work from cleanup completion.

blocks.text: 本包只有根入口，导出 ensureWasm、number/boolean/string/array/record 五个 builder、八个错误码与四个错误工厂，以及 WasmReservedKey/IWasmReservedKey。字段的具体类型通过 builder 返回值公开使用，但 IWasmNumberField 等不是根入口的具名 reexport。建议 `import * as wasm from '@migaia/store-wasm'`，避免 number/string 等通用名称冲突。

依赖 reactive、store-light、wasm、utils。字段 payload 位于 WebAssembly.Memory，响应式 Source、描述符、解码后的字符串等仍使用 JS 对象；不是把整个应用状态或整个 Store 搬离 JS 堆。适合固定长度数值布局和明确容量的数据；普通小状态、类实例、函数和循环 JS 对象不需要强行使用这些字段。没有测量证据时只讨论布局与通知机制，不作速度承诺。
arena/field/number 等内部实现文件不是子路径导出。内部统一以 Wasm32 字节长度分配，并记录 memory、allocation id、ptr 与释放登记；同步分配要求已就绪，内部异步分配先等 ensureWasm。新增字段应由本包正式发布，不通过深层导入或自己复制分配器接入。

sections.heading: 初始化与真实 Node 加载

blocks.text: `ensureWasm():Promise<WebAssembly.Memory>` 无参数，只保证底层模块内存就绪，不分配字段。模块内 pending 和成功后的 Promise 身份都稳定，返回同一个 memory；加载失败清除对应缓存，后续可重新尝试。创建 builder 本身不分配内存；Store 调用其同步 create(context) 前必须等待就绪，否则 NOT_INITIALIZED，而不是自动等待或切换到 JS 字段。

Node 的默认 file URL 不能直接交给 fetch。示例先从 `@migaia/wasm` 发布的 sibling WASM 文件读取字节，调用其默认 initWasm({module_or_path:bytes})，再 ensureWasm。module_or_path 是底层加载参数，不是 store-wasm 的字段选项；本例值为 readFile 的字节，省略会获取包内 sibling WASM URL，也可接收 Promise。文件由 node:fs/promises 读取，所有过程使用真实 WASM 实例。

浏览器等有合适 fetch 入口的宿主可直接 await ensureWasm。store-react 的 StoreProvider 可用 features.wasm:true 与稳定 ready:[ensureWasm] 阻挡子树，但不会替已在 render 外提前创建的 Store 延后分配。推荐先在应用/请求 owner 中初始化并创建 Store，再注册到对应 Runtime 的 Registry；WASM 包不反向依赖 React。外部 Registry 默认由应用释放，SSR 没有 effect 自动清理。wasm 开启却没有 ready 会生成拒绝的配置屏障，随后从 render 抛出，开发/生产都如此，不是仅开发环境的同步检查。
全部 builder 使用 store-light 的 StoreFieldMode.sync，实现 `IFieldBuilder` 的同步分支，直接放进 createStore(shape)，无需专用异步 Store 工厂。初始 WASM 加载与同步字段创建是两件事。

rows: 直接 field.x 读写命名数值属性，无 .value

blocks.text: Store 拥有其 builder 创建的字段，store.$dispose() 调用各字段清理；不要在仍存活 Store 中随意手动释放单字段。只有明确接管 IFieldContext 的扩展才直接 builder.create(context)：runtime、signal、createSource 属于 store-light 协议，必须使用真实 owner，自己负责返回字段的生命周期。signal 用于构造时的取消检查，不是字段运行中自动停止的开关。

真实分配器以零填充内存：number 初始 0，boolean 初始 false，string 初始空串，array 与 record 数值初始 0。字段不接受初值参数；创建后用相应写入口设置。number/boolean/string 公开只读 observed（其 Source 是否被观察）与 disposed；array 公开只读 length/disposed，record 公开只读 disposed。payload 访问在释放后拒绝，disposed 及 array.length 等元信息仍可读取。

rows: value:number，Object.is 相等不提交；JavaScript 传入非 number 为 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION
value:boolean，true/false 写为 1/0，读取非零为 true；非 boolean 为 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION

blocks.text: number 接受 JS number，包括 NaN、Infinity 与负零，按 f64 储存；不是整数专用字段。读取 value 会追踪对应 Source，写入通过 Source.commit。标量写入在 commit 回调中重新取得当前 DataView，避免 owner 在提交边界增长内存后仍写入旧 buffer。无参 dispose 同步、幂等，关闭后 value 读写为 FIELD_DISPOSED。
maxBytes 默认 256，必须是 0..0xffff_ffff-4 的安全整数，否则 builder 创建时 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION。分配请求为 4+maxBytes 字节，前四字节是小端 Uint32 UTF-8 长度，后面是固定容量字节区；底层分配容量可按对齐舍入，不在字符串变长时重新分配。

value 必须为 string，否则 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION。TextEncoder 编码后的字节数超过容量时 INVALID_OPTION，保留旧值、不截断；中文和 emoji 按 UTF-8 字节数而非字符数计。写前读取当前字符串做 === 比较，相同跳过提交；这一步仍需解码。getter 每次从当前 memory.buffer 按长度前缀解码，不缓存“只由本地 setter 版本决定”的字符串。存储长度超过 maxBytes 为 ALLOCATION_FAILED，表示数据损坏，不是正常截断。只读 observed/disposed 与 dispose 同标量字段。

rows: 64，必须是正安全整数；1 表示每个位置单独一桶

blocks.text: 无效参数在 builder 创建时 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION。布局为 length*8 字节连续 f64，非空分配要求 ptr 按 8 字节对齐，否则 ALLOCATION_FAILED；空数组使用独立零长视图，不依赖分配器零字节哨兵对齐。长度固定，没有 push/splice/resize。

同样索引检查，非 number 值 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION；Object.is 相等不提交

blocks.text: 连续 granularity 个位置共享一个 Source，触碰桶时按需创建；at 追踪该桶，setAt/setRange 的实际变化可让同桶其他读取者也收到通知。最多有 ceil(length/granularity) 个桶，不等于每次创建全部桶；更细的粒度增加 Source 数量，不构成已测速度结论。

setRange 先捕获 length 和全部输入项，再写任何字段字节；非法形状、长度、数值或尚未分类的 getter 失败为 INVALID_OPTION，原错误按身份或 cause 保留；已有完整外包身份的错误保留原 source/code。只把实际 Object.is 改变的值按桶分组，同批每桶一次 commit，跨桶放在一次 runtime.batch。提交失败尝试逆序恢复涉及的字段字节，但不承诺撤销 Source/通知或外部回调副作用。初始化/回滚自己的资源错误仍保持可追溯。
内部 typed view 与 DataView 按 memory.buffer 身份刷新，memory.grow 后用当前 buffer，setAt 和每桶 commit 内也重新取得当前视图。之前 view() 的快照独立，不因新增长失效；外部直接写 memory 不走 Source，因此不等于响应式写入。

shape 必填，类型为 `Record<string,ReturnType<typeof number>>`。这是固定命名 f64 结构，不是可装任意 JS 值的通用对象。只支持 number builder，不支持嵌套 record/array；不要通过类型断言把 boolean/string builder 传入。运行时接纳检查对象/键和 FIELD_BUILDER 品牌，不额外证明品牌来自 number，不能把这个检查当成支持其它字段类型的契约。

Object.keys(shape) 的顺序决定 keys.length*8 字节分配里的偏移，每个键 8 字节、小端 f64。每个业务键是可枚举 getter/setter，直接 field.x 访问并独立追踪/提交；写入非 number 为 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION，Object.is 相等跳过。dispose/disposed 为不可枚举生命周期属性，Object.keys/JSON.stringify 只看到业务键。

WasmReservedKey/IWasmReservedKey 包含 dispose/disposed。record(shape) 先创建描述，保留键在字段 create(context) 阶段以 RESERVED_FIELD_NAME TypeError 拒绝，通常表现为 createStore 时失败。非法 shape、键读取或 builder 品牌读取失败为 INVALID_OPTION，原错经 cause 可达。

创建字段时已分配的 block 与已建 Source 都由同一个 owner 管理。若 signal 已 aborted，五类 builder 使用同一原因边界：可附码原生 reason 保留类型/message/stack/身份并附 INIT_ABORTED，外包完整身份不改，不可附码原因经 cause/errors 保留。失败时尝试释放已经创建的 Sources 与 block，不把一半字段交给 Store。

正常 dispose 先把字段标为终态并注销 GC 登记，再尝试所有 Source 清理，最后释放 block；Source 失败也继续 block 清理。重复/重入 dispose 不重新清理，首次可能抛清理错误。单个清理失败保留原错；多个为 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError，errors 按执行顺序保留全部原对象。构造主错与回滚同时失败时，能附 secondary errors 则保留主错本身并追加非枚举 errors，否则用 [primary,cleanup] 聚合；不覆盖 primary 的 cause/stack。
FinalizationRegistry 存在时登记已创建字段，显式释放会 unregister；不支持该 API 时不报错。GC 兜底释放的时机不确定，不能替代 store.$dispose()/field.dispose()。内部 deallocation 对未知/已释放 id 无操作，分配在 WASM32 范围校验；这些 arena 原语不是根 API。

原生 WebAssembly.CompileError/LinkError/RuntimeError 保持原样穿过支持的 WASM 边界。arena export 首次 RuntimeError trap 也原样抛；arena 记录后续不可用状态，新分配以 INSTANCE_POISONED 拒绝，cause 为最初 trap，释放降为无操作以免二次 trap。不是宣称任意已有字段 getter 都会重新调用 export 或必然再 trap。共享 wasm-bindgen 实例不能在当前模块内重建，需重新加载页面或重启进程；不应重试分配并假装恢复。毒化后不承诺实际回收全部原生内存。

sections.heading: 错误码、构造工厂与稳定诊断

blocks.text: STORE_WASM_SOURCE 为 `'@migaia/store-wasm'`，只标识本包创建的错误；已有外包身份保持原 owner。可附码 native 输入读取失败原位附 INVALID_OPTION，不可附码时用 cause/errors；不要把声明的原生 WASM pass-through 错误强制重包为普通 Error。

四个公开错误工厂 code:IStoreWasmErrorCode 与 message:string 必填。`createStoreWasmError(code,message,options?)` 返回 Error，`createStoreWasmTypeError(...)` 返回 TypeError，options 默认 undefined，仅 cause，值非 undefined 时转发；`createStoreWasmRangeError(code,message)` 无第三参；`createStoreWasmAggregateError(code,errors:readonly unknown[],message)` 保留每个原错。它们构造不自动 throw，附不可写 source/code，不改 stack。

未就绪时先修初始化顺序；字符串容量按 UTF-8 字节检查；想逐 index 通知用 granularity=1；view 副本改动不会提交，写入必须 setAt/setRange。固定记录不支持任意嵌套类型。构造器只声明布局，不把分配副作用放进 React render；请求/应用 owner 初始化、创建并负责释放。

每个示例单独加载真实发布的 WASM，并使用 createStore 提供的字段 owner。先按场景查找，再看完整的容量、通知、释放与原生错误边界。

blocks.text: 示例是 Node 独立 TypeScript 文件，直接导入列出的包。readFile 读取相对于 @migaia/wasm 主入口的 sibling wasm_provider_bg.wasm，initWasm 的 module_or_path 传这份字节；省略会走默认资源 URL，Node 的 file URL fetch 不适合该默认路径，Promise 输入也可由底层 loader 接收。ensureWasm 自身无参数。所有创建的 Store/观察者显式释放，不使用假的 WASM 或字段 context。

sections.id: 创建字段前复用同一个就绪-promise
sections.heading: 创建字段前复用同一个就绪 Promise

blocks.text: 多个启动入口都要创建 WASM 字段，可能同时询问模块是否已经就绪。
每次查询都临时包装初始化 Promise，会让调用方拿到不同的就绪凭据，即使模块早已加载成功。
Node 中先从发布的文件初始化原生模块，再调用无参数的 `ensureWasm()`；等待中及成功后，它都会复用同一个 Promise。

blocks.code:
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import initWasm from '@migaia/wasm'
import { ensureWasm } from '@migaia/store-wasm'

const url = new URL('./wasm_provider_bg.wasm', import.meta.resolve('@migaia/wasm'))
await initWasm({ module_or_path: await readFile(url) })
const first = ensureWasm()
const second = ensureWasm()
console.log(first === second)
const memory = await first
console.log(memory instanceof WebAssembly.Memory)
console.log(first === ensureWasm())

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
true
true
true

blocks.text: 输出三行 `true`：两次等待中的调用相同，结果是原生内存，成功后的调用仍返回原 Promise。
它只建立就绪条件，不分配字段，也不移交共享内存的所有权；初始化失败会清空尝试缓存，同步创建字段仍须等待一次成功的调用。
ensureWasm 无参数、不分配字段，返回共享 `Promise<WebAssembly.Memory>`；相同 Promise 包括 pending 与成功后。url 是发布文件相对包入口的位置，initWasm.module_or_path 为 readFile 返回的 Uint8Array 字节。WebAssembly.Memory 检查确认真实内存对象，不移交其整个生命周期。

sections.id: 原生内存增长后继续读写数值字段
sections.heading: 原生内存增长后继续读写数值字段

blocks.text: 其他 WASM 分配可能在数值字段仍被使用时增长线性内存。
如果手写读写逻辑一直保存旧缓冲区上的 DataView，内存增长后视图会失效，原本正常的字段也就无法继续访问。
就绪后把无参数的 `number()` 交给 `createStore`；字段会读取当前内存视图，清理由 Store 统一负责。
输出：

blocks.code:
0
true 12.5
19
true
FIELD_DISPOSED

blocks.text: 依次输出 `0`、`true 12.5`、`19`、`true`、`FIELD_DISPOSED`：缓冲区已更换，原值仍在，新值可写，Store 释放后保留的字段引用也已关闭。
数值初始值为 `0`，按 f64 存储。这里证明正常内存增长后的读写，不代表能从原生陷阱恢复；共享实例中毒后需要重启其拥有者。
number 无参数，初值 0，字段通过 .value 读写 f64。createStore 的 score 是 builder 声明，字段由 Store 拥有。memory.grow(1) 增长一个 WASM 页；字段使用新 buffer，但原分配偏移保持。最后保留字段引用检查 disposed 与访问错误，$dispose 是 Store 的释放入口。

sections.id: 按-utf-8-容量拒绝超长写入并保留原值
sections.heading: 按 UTF-8 容量拒绝超长写入并保留原值

blocks.text: 标签没有超过字符数限制，编码后却放不进 WASM 字段预留的字节空间。
只数字符会低估多字节文本的容量，直接截取编码字节又可能切断一个字符，悄悄破坏原本有效的内容。
用 `string(6)` 把默认 `256` 字节改为六字节容量；超容量赋值会在提交新值之前失败。
输出：

blocks.code:
你好 6
INVALID_OPTION
你好

blocks.text: 输出依次为 `你好 6`、`INVALID_OPTION`、`你好`：两个汉字占六字节，更长的赋值失败后仍读到旧值。
容量按 `TextEncoder` 编码后的 UTF-8 字节数计算且不会自动增长；超容量既不截断也不扩容，业务允许更长内容时应选更大的容量。
string 的 maxBytes 默认 256，本例覆盖为 6；容量必须为范围内安全整数。value 赋值按 TextEncoder UTF-8 字节计，而非字符数。readFile/initWasm 初始化同运行准备，Store 关闭会释放该字段；超容量不改变它的旧内容。

sections.id: 独立追踪数组下标并隔离拷贝视图
sections.heading: 独立追踪数组下标并隔离拷贝视图

blocks.text: 界面只读取一个采样点，数组其他位置的变化却不断让这个读取者重新运行。
多个下标共用一个通知桶时，同桶的无关读取者也会失效；若直接暴露可写原生内存，又会绕过响应式写入。
用 `array(3, 1)` 把默认每桶 `64` 个下标改为逐下标追踪；通过 `setAt` 写入，`view()` 只用于取得独立拷贝。
输出：
输出为 `0`、`0,5`、`99 5`：改下标 `1` 不重跑只读下标 `0` 的观察者，改下标 `0` 才重跑；把副本改成 `99`，字段仍为 `5`。
下标须为 `[0, length)` 内的安全整数，不支持 `Array.at` 的负数索引。`view()` 不追踪读取，也不回写；更粗的桶会使邻近下标的读取者一起失效。
array 的 length 必填，本例 3；granularity 默认 64，本例设为 1。createStore options.runtime 显式使用创建的 Runtime。effect 的回调首次执行计入 seen，runtime.flush 明确完成调度；setAt 需有效非负安全整数下标与 number 值，view 无参数且不追踪。

sections.id: 范围输入无法读取时保持数组原值
sections.heading: 范围输入无法读取时保持数组原值

blocks.text: 批量更新从类数组对象读取数值，其中某个访问器可能在读取到一半时抛错。
边读边写会把前面的新值留在字段里，后面的访问器一失败，数组就停在只更新了一部分的状态。
`setRange` 会在写入左闭右开区间 `[lo, hi)` 前读完全部输入；读取失败时附加错误身份，现有字段字节保持不变。
输出：

blocks.code:
true INVALID_OPTION
1,2,3
4,5,3

blocks.text: 输出为 `true INVALID_OPTION`、`1,2,3`、`4,5,3`：原 TypeError 身份保留，失败输入没有改动字段，随后仍可正常写入有效范围。
`values.length` 必须等于 `hi - lo`，所有输入值都须为数字。这里证明先读后写，不承诺撤销访问器自身的外部副作用，也不泛化为通知回滚。

array(3) 使用默认 granularity=64。setRange 的 lo/hi 为左闭右开范围，values.length 必须等于 hi-lo，元素均为 number；input 本例是有一个抛错 getter 的真实 ArrayLike。先写入 [1,2,3] 后再拒绝 input，原 TypeError 保持身份和 INVALID_OPTION，之后 [0,2) 可写入 [4,5]。

sections.id: 只观察一个坐标字段而不订阅其同级字段
sections.heading: 只观察一个坐标字段而不订阅其同级字段

blocks.text: 组件只读取横坐标，纵坐标变化时却也跟着重新计算。
如果把整个位置对象当作一个依赖，任何属性变化都会让读取者重跑，即使它真正使用的输入并未改变。
用 `number()` 描述固定记录的字段；每个命名数字属性都有独立响应源，直接读写 `position.x`，无需再经过 `.value`。
输出：
依次输出 `0`、`0,3`、`x,y`、`3 9`：改 `y` 不影响只读 `x` 的观察者，改 `x` 才重跑，枚举时只看见业务字段。
记录值初始为 `0`；结构固定且只支持 `number()` 构造器，不支持嵌套字段和动态增键，`dispose`、`disposed` 保留给生命周期使用。
record 的 shape 只支持 number() builder，本例 x/y 都从 0 开始；实际属性直接读写，不用 .value。Store options.runtime 与 effect 同一实例，flush 明确结束通知调度；Object.keys 只包含业务键，dispose/disposed 不可枚举，观察者先于 Store 释放。

本包只有根入口，导出 ensureWasm、number/boolean/string/array/record 五个 builder、八个错误码与四个错误工厂，以及 WasmReservedKey/IWasmReservedKey。字段的具体类型通过 builder 返回值公开使用，但 IWasmNumberField 等不是根入口的具名 reexport。建议 `import * as wasm from '@migaia/store-wasm'`，避免 number/string 等通用名称冲突。

依赖 reactive、store-light、wasm、utils。字段 payload 位于 WebAssembly.Memory，响应式 Source、描述符、解码后的字符串等仍使用 JS 对象；不是把整个应用状态或整个 Store 搬离 JS 堆。适合固定长度数值布局和明确容量的数据；普通小状态、类实例、函数和循环 JS 对象不需要强行使用这些字段。没有测量证据时只讨论布局与通知机制，不作速度承诺。
arena/field/number 等内部实现文件不是子路径导出。内部统一以 Wasm32 字节长度分配，并记录 memory、allocation id、ptr 与释放登记；同步分配要求已就绪，内部异步分配先等 ensureWasm。新增字段应由本包正式发布，不通过深层导入或自己复制分配器接入。

sections.heading: 初始化与真实 Node 加载

blocks.text: `ensureWasm():Promise<WebAssembly.Memory>` 无参数，只保证底层模块内存就绪，不分配字段。模块内 pending 和成功后的 Promise 身份都稳定，返回同一个 memory；加载失败清除对应缓存，后续可重新尝试。创建 builder 本身不分配内存；Store 调用其同步 create(context) 前必须等待就绪，否则 NOT_INITIALIZED，而不是自动等待或切换到 JS 字段。

Node 的默认 file URL 不能直接交给 fetch。示例先从 `@migaia/wasm` 发布的 sibling WASM 文件读取字节，调用其默认 initWasm({module_or_path:bytes})，再 ensureWasm。module_or_path 是底层加载参数，不是 store-wasm 的字段选项；本例值为 readFile 的字节，省略会获取包内 sibling WASM URL，也可接收 Promise。文件由 node:fs/promises 读取，所有过程使用真实 WASM 实例。

浏览器等有合适 fetch 入口的宿主可直接 await ensureWasm。store-react 的 StoreProvider 可用 features.wasm:true 与稳定 ready:[ensureWasm] 阻挡子树，但不会替已在 render 外提前创建的 Store 延后分配。推荐先在应用/请求 owner 中初始化并创建 Store，再注册到对应 Runtime 的 Registry；WASM 包不反向依赖 React。外部 Registry 默认由应用释放，SSR 没有 effect 自动清理。wasm 开启却没有 ready 会生成拒绝的配置屏障，随后从 render 抛出，开发/生产都如此，不是仅开发环境的同步检查。
全部 builder 使用 store-light 的 StoreFieldMode.sync，实现 `IFieldBuilder` 的同步分支，直接放进 createStore(shape)，无需专用异步 Store 工厂。初始 WASM 加载与同步字段创建是两件事。

rows: 直接 field.x 读写命名数值属性，无 .value

blocks.text: Store 拥有其 builder 创建的字段，store.$dispose() 调用各字段清理；不要在仍存活 Store 中随意手动释放单字段。只有明确接管 IFieldContext 的扩展才直接 builder.create(context)：runtime、signal、createSource 属于 store-light 协议，必须使用真实 owner，自己负责返回字段的生命周期。signal 用于构造时的取消检查，不是字段运行中自动停止的开关。

真实分配器以零填充内存：number 初始 0，boolean 初始 false，string 初始空串，array 与 record 数值初始 0。字段不接受初值参数；创建后用相应写入口设置。number/boolean/string 公开只读 observed（其 Source 是否被观察）与 disposed；array 公开只读 length/disposed，record 公开只读 disposed。payload 访问在释放后拒绝，disposed 及 array.length 等元信息仍可读取。

rows: value:number，Object.is 相等不提交；JavaScript 传入非 number 为 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION
value:boolean，true/false 写为 1/0，读取非零为 true；非 boolean 为 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION

blocks.text: number 接受 JS number，包括 NaN、Infinity 与负零，按 f64 储存；不是整数专用字段。读取 value 会追踪对应 Source，写入通过 Source.commit。标量写入在 commit 回调中重新取得当前 DataView，避免 owner 在提交边界增长内存后仍写入旧 buffer。无参 dispose 同步、幂等，关闭后 value 读写为 FIELD_DISPOSED。
maxBytes 默认 256，必须是 0..0xffff_ffff-4 的安全整数，否则 builder 创建时 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION。分配请求为 4+maxBytes 字节，前四字节是小端 Uint32 UTF-8 长度，后面是固定容量字节区；底层分配容量可按对齐舍入，不在字符串变长时重新分配。

value 必须为 string，否则 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION。TextEncoder 编码后的字节数超过容量时 INVALID_OPTION，保留旧值、不截断；中文和 emoji 按 UTF-8 字节数而非字符数计。写前读取当前字符串做 === 比较，相同跳过提交；这一步仍需解码。getter 每次从当前 memory.buffer 按长度前缀解码，不缓存“只由本地 setter 版本决定”的字符串。存储长度超过 maxBytes 为 ALLOCATION_FAILED，表示数据损坏，不是正常截断。只读 observed/disposed 与 dispose 同标量字段。

rows: 64，必须是正安全整数；1 表示每个位置单独一桶

blocks.text: 无效参数在 builder 创建时 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION。布局为 length*8 字节连续 f64，非空分配要求 ptr 按 8 字节对齐，否则 ALLOCATION_FAILED；空数组使用独立零长视图，不依赖分配器零字节哨兵对齐。长度固定，没有 push/splice/resize。

rows: index 必须是 [0,length) 的非负安全整数；越界/非整数 RangeError/INVALID_OPTION，不支持负索引

blocks.text: 连续 granularity 个位置共享一个 Source，触碰桶时按需创建；at 追踪该桶，setAt/setRange 的实际变化可让同桶其他读取者也收到通知。最多有 ceil(length/granularity) 个桶，不等于每次创建全部桶；更细的粒度增加 Source 数量，不构成已测速度结论。

setRange 先捕获 length 和全部输入项，再写任何字段字节；非法形状、长度、数值或尚未分类的 getter 失败为 INVALID_OPTION，原错误按身份或 cause 保留；已有完整外包身份的错误保留原 source/code。只把实际 Object.is 改变的值按桶分组，同批每桶一次 commit，跨桶放在一次 runtime.batch。提交失败尝试逆序恢复涉及的字段字节，但不承诺撤销 Source/通知或外部回调副作用。初始化/回滚自己的资源错误仍保持可追溯。
内部 typed view 与 DataView 按 memory.buffer 身份刷新，memory.grow 后用当前 buffer，setAt 和每桶 commit 内也重新取得当前视图。之前 view() 的快照独立，不因新增长失效；外部直接写 memory 不走 Source，因此不等于响应式写入。

shape 必填，类型为 `Record<string,ReturnType<typeof number>>`。这是固定命名 f64 结构，不是可装任意 JS 值的通用对象。只支持 number builder，不支持嵌套 record/array；不要通过类型断言把 boolean/string builder 传入。运行时接纳检查对象/键和 FIELD_BUILDER 品牌，不额外证明品牌来自 number，不能把这个检查当成支持其它字段类型的契约。

Object.keys(shape) 的顺序决定 keys.length*8 字节分配里的偏移，每个键 8 字节、小端 f64。每个业务键是可枚举 getter/setter，直接 field.x 访问并独立追踪/提交；写入非 number 为 TypeError/INVALID_OPTION，Object.is 相等跳过。dispose/disposed 为不可枚举生命周期属性，Object.keys/JSON.stringify 只看到业务键。

WasmReservedKey/IWasmReservedKey 包含 dispose/disposed。record(shape) 先创建描述，保留键在字段 create(context) 阶段以 RESERVED_FIELD_NAME TypeError 拒绝，通常表现为 createStore 时失败。非法 shape、键读取或 builder 品牌读取失败为 INVALID_OPTION，原错经 cause 可达。

创建字段时已分配的 block 与已建 Source 都由同一个 owner 管理。若 signal 已 aborted，五类 builder 使用同一原因边界：可附码原生 reason 保留类型/message/stack/身份并附 INIT_ABORTED，外包完整身份不改，不可附码原因经 cause/errors 保留。失败时尝试释放已经创建的 Sources 与 block，不把一半字段交给 Store。

正常 dispose 先把字段标为终态并注销 GC 登记，再尝试所有 Source 清理，最后释放 block；Source 失败也继续 block 清理。重复/重入 dispose 不重新清理，首次可能抛清理错误。单个清理失败保留原错；多个为 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError，errors 按执行顺序保留全部原对象。构造主错与回滚同时失败时，能附 secondary errors 则保留主错本身并追加非枚举 errors，否则用 [primary,cleanup] 聚合；不覆盖 primary 的 cause/stack。
FinalizationRegistry 存在时登记已创建字段，显式释放会 unregister；不支持该 API 时不报错。GC 兜底释放的时机不确定，不能替代 store.$dispose()/field.dispose()。内部 deallocation 对未知/已释放 id 无操作，分配在 WASM32 范围校验；这些 arena 原语不是根 API。

原生 WebAssembly.CompileError/LinkError/RuntimeError 保持原样穿过支持的 WASM 边界。arena export 首次 RuntimeError trap 也原样抛；arena 记录后续不可用状态，新分配以 INSTANCE_POISONED 拒绝，cause 为最初 trap，释放降为无操作以免二次 trap。不是宣称任意已有字段 getter 都会重新调用 export 或必然再 trap。共享 wasm-bindgen 实例不能在当前模块内重建，需重新加载页面或重启进程；不应重试分配并假装恢复。毒化后不承诺实际回收全部原生内存。

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: Startup paths each wait on a new initialization Promise because readiness identity is not retained centrally.
A short-looking label is truncated incorrectly because UTF-8 capacity was estimated by character count.
Reading one sample reruns after a neighboring write because several positions share a notification bucket.
A batch source fails halfway after half its values were written because input reading and memory commits were interleaved.
A horizontal-coordinate reader reruns on vertical edits because the whole position object is one dependency.

Reuse one readiness token while pending and after success. ensureWasm caches the actual Promise instead of wrapping its result on every call as shown in Share one readiness Promise before creating fields.

Reject UTF-8 overflow while retaining the old string. The fixed-capacity field encodes and validates before committing, without truncation as shown in Reject a UTF-8 overflow without truncating the old value.

Choose array notification granularity and isolate exported copies. granularity=1 separates indices and view returns an independent copy without write-back as shown in Track one array index and keep copied views isolated.

Read batch input completely before changing field bytes. setRange materializes every number first and preserves the original failure and old contents as shown in Reject unreadable range input before changing array bytes.

Observe each numeric property of a fixed record independently. record gives each key its own Source, so editing y leaves an x-only observer alone as shown in Observe one named coordinate without tracking its siblings.

sections.heading: Ownership, entry point, and intended use

blocks.text: The module has one root entry: ensureWasm, the number/boolean/string/array/record builders, eight error codes, four error factories, and WasmReservedKey/IWasmReservedKey. Concrete field types are exposed through builder return types, but names such as IWasmNumberField are not named root reexports. Namespace imports such as `import * as wasm from '@migaia/store-wasm'` avoid common-name collisions.

Dependencies are reactive, store-light, wasm, and utils. Field payloads live in WebAssembly.Memory; reactive Sources, descriptors, and decoded strings still use JavaScript objects. The entire Store or application state is not moved off the JS heap. Use fixed numeric layouts or explicitly bounded data where useful; ordinary small state, class instances, functions, and cyclic JS objects need not become WASM fields. Without measurements, layout and notification mechanisms are not speed claims.

Internal arena/field/number implementation files are not subpath exports. One internal allocator validates Wasm32 byte lengths and tracks memory, allocation id, pointer, and release registration. Synchronous allocation requires readiness; internal async allocation waits for ensureWasm first. New field types should be published by this module rather than relying on deep imports or another allocator implementation.

`ensureWasm():Promise<WebAssembly.Memory>` takes no arguments. It makes the underlying module memory ready without allocating fields. Pending and successful calls preserve the same Promise identity and memory. Failure clears the corresponding cache so a later call can retry. A builder itself allocates nothing; await readiness before the Store calls its synchronous create(context), otherwise NOT_INITIALIZED is thrown rather than waiting or substituting a JS field.

Node fetch cannot directly load the default file URL. The examples first read bytes from the published sibling WASM file in `@migaia/wasm`, invoke its default initWasm({module_or_path:bytes}), then call ensureWasm. module_or_path belongs to the underlying loader, not a field option. Here it contains readFile bytes; omission fetches the module's sibling WASM URL, and Promise input is also accepted. node:fs/promises reads the real file, and the examples use a real WASM instance.

Hosts with a suitable fetch path, such as browsers, can await ensureWasm directly. store-react StoreProvider can gate children with features.wasm:true and a stable ready:[ensureWasm], but cannot postpone a Store already constructed outside render. Prefer initialization and Store creation in an application/request owner, then register it with the matching Runtime Registry. This module has no reverse React dependency. The application owns an external Registry by default, and SSR has no effect cleanup. Enabling wasm without ready creates a rejected configuration barrier subsequently thrown during render, in production as well as development.

Every builder uses store-light's StoreFieldMode.sync and the synchronous `IFieldBuilder` branch. Put it directly in createStore(shape); no special async Store factory is required. Async module loading and synchronous field construction are separate operations.

rows: Read/write numeric properties such as field.x, without .value

blocks.text: The Store owns fields created by its builders and invokes their cleanup from store.$dispose(). Do not dispose individual fields while their Store remains in use. Extensions that explicitly own an IFieldContext may call builder.create(context) directly: runtime, signal, and createSource belong to store-light's protocol, must use a real owner, and leave field lifetime to the caller. signal is checked during construction, not a continuous automatic stop switch.

The real allocator zero-fills memory: number starts at 0, boolean at false, string at an empty string, and array/record numeric values at 0. Builders take no initial-value argument; set values through their write methods after creation. number/boolean/string expose readonly observed and disposed. array has readonly length/disposed; record has readonly disposed. Disposed payload access rejects, while metadata such as disposed and array.length remains readable.

rows: value:number; Object.is-equal writes do not commit; a nonnumber JavaScript value is TypeError/INVALID_OPTION
value:boolean; true/false write 1/0 and nonzero reads as true; nonboolean writes are TypeError/INVALID_OPTION

blocks.text: number accepts JS numbers, including NaN, Infinity, and negative zero, using f64 storage rather than integer-only semantics. Reading value tracks its Source; writing uses Source.commit. Scalar writes obtain the current DataView inside the commit callback so an owner growing memory at that boundary does not leave a write on the old buffer. No-argument dispose is synchronous and idempotent. Later value reads/writes produce FIELD_DISPOSED.

maxBytes defaults to 256 and must be a safe integer in 0..0xffff_ffff-4. Invalid capacity produces RangeError/INVALID_OPTION when creating the builder. The allocation request is 4+maxBytes bytes: a little-endian Uint32 UTF-8 length followed by a fixed-capacity byte region. Underlying allocation capacity can round for alignment; a longer string does not resize the field.

value must be string, otherwise TypeError/INVALID_OPTION. TextEncoder output exceeding maxBytes produces INVALID_OPTION, retains the old value, and never truncates. Chinese characters and emoji count by UTF-8 bytes rather than character count. A write decodes the current value for === comparison and skips an equal commit; that comparison still costs a decode. Every getter decodes current memory.buffer bytes according to the prefix rather than caching a value solely by local setter revision. A stored length exceeding maxBytes is ALLOCATION_FAILED, indicating corrupted data rather than normal truncation. observed/disposed/dispose follow scalar semantics.

rows: 64; a positive safe integer; 1 gives one bucket per position

blocks.text: Invalid arguments produce RangeError/INVALID_OPTION at builder creation. Layout is length*8 contiguous f64 bytes. Nonempty allocation requires an eight-byte-aligned pointer, otherwise ALLOCATION_FAILED. Empty arrays use an independent zero-length view without depending on zero-byte sentinel alignment. Length is fixed; there is no push/splice/resize.

rows: Requires a nonnegative safe integer in [0,length); invalid/out-of-range reads are RangeError/INVALID_OPTION, without negative-index support
Same index checks; nonnumber values are TypeError/INVALID_OPTION; Object.is-equal writes do not commit
Half-open [lo,hi), safe integer endpoints with 0≤lo≤hi≤length; values.length must equal hi-lo and every value must be number
No arguments; a new writable independent copy, without tracking, exposing linear memory, or writing back

blocks.text: Each contiguous granularity-sized bucket shares a Source, created on demand when touched. at tracks that bucket; an actual setAt/setRange change may notify other readers in the same bucket. There are at most ceil(length/granularity) buckets, not necessarily all created immediately. Finer granularity increases Source count and does not imply a measured speed advantage.

setRange captures length and every input item before writing field bytes. Invalid shape, length, numeric type, or an unclassified getter failure becomes INVALID_OPTION with original identity/cause retained; an error with complete foreign ownership keeps its source/code. Only Object.is-changed values are grouped by bucket; each affected bucket commits once and cross-bucket changes share one runtime.batch. Commit failure attempts reverse restoration of affected field bytes, without undoing Source/notification or external callback effects. Owned initialization/rollback failures remain traceable.

Private typed views and DataViews refresh when memory.buffer identity changes. memory.grow uses the current buffer; setAt and each bucket commit obtain it again inside the callback. Existing view() snapshots stay independent of that growth. Direct external memory writes bypass Source and therefore are not reactive writes.

shape is required and typed as `Record<string,ReturnType<typeof number>>`. This is a fixed named f64 structure, not an arbitrary JS record. Only number builders are supported, without nested record/array fields; casting a boolean/string builder does not create a supported combination. Runtime admission checks object/keys and the FIELD_BUILDER brand, without separately proving that the brand came from number.

Object.keys(shape) order determines offsets in a keys.length*8 allocation. Each key occupies eight little-endian f64 bytes. Business properties are enumerable getters/setters: field.x tracks/commits its own Source. Nonnumber writes are TypeError/INVALID_OPTION and Object.is-equal writes are skipped. Lifecycle dispose/disposed properties are nonenumerable, so Object.keys/JSON.stringify expose only business keys.

WasmReservedKey/IWasmReservedKey contains dispose/disposed. record(shape) creates a description first; reserved names are rejected with RESERVED_FIELD_NAME TypeError during field create(context), usually called by createStore. Invalid shapes, failed key reads, or failed builder-brand reads produce INVALID_OPTION with the original cause.

One owner manages a field's allocation and created Sources. If signal is already aborted, every builder uses the same reason boundary. An extensible native reason keeps its type/message/stack/identity with INIT_ABORTED attached; foreign identity remains intact, and other reasons stay reachable through cause/errors. Failed construction attempts to release created Sources and the allocation rather than publishing a half-built field.

Normal disposal marks the field terminal and unregisters its GC entry, then attempts every Source cleanup before releasing the block. A Source failure does not prevent block cleanup. Repeated/reentrant dispose does not run cleanup again; the first call can throw cleanup errors. One error retains the original; multiple errors produce CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError with originals in execution order. If construction and rollback both fail, a primary that can accept secondary errors is retained with nonenumerable errors appended. Otherwise [primary,cleanup] is aggregated, without replacing the primary's cause or stack.

When available, FinalizationRegistry registers created fields and explicit release unregisters them. Its absence is tolerated. GC fallback timing is unpredictable and cannot replace store.$dispose()/field.dispose(). Internal deallocation ignores unknown/released ids, and allocation validates the WASM32 byte range; arena primitives are not root API.

Native WebAssembly.CompileError/LinkError/RuntimeError pass unchanged through supported WASM boundaries. The first RuntimeError trap from an arena export also passes unchanged. The arena then marks itself unusable: later allocation rejects INSTANCE_POISONED with that original trap as cause, while release becomes a no-op to avoid another trap. This does not claim that every existing field getter calls an export or necessarily traps again. The shared wasm-bindgen instance cannot be rebuilt in the same module; reload the page or restart the process rather than retrying allocation as recovery. Poisoning does not promise reclamation of all earlier native memory.

blocks.text: STORE_WASM_SOURCE is `'@migaia/store-wasm'`, identifying errors created here rather than rewriting foreign owners. A native input-read failure that can accept identity receives INVALID_OPTION in place; otherwise cause/errors retain it. Do not forcibly replace declared native WASM pass-through errors with ordinary Error wrappers.

All four public factories require code:IStoreWasmErrorCode and message:string. `createStoreWasmError(code,message,options?)` returns Error and `createStoreWasmTypeError(...)` returns TypeError. options defaults to undefined, contains only optional cause, and forwards it when not undefined. `createStoreWasmRangeError(code,message)` has no third argument. `createStoreWasmAggregateError(code,errors:readonly unknown[],message)` retains each original error. They construct without automatically throwing, attach nonwritable source/code, and leave stack intact.

sections.heading: Share one readiness Promise before creating fields

blocks.text: Several startup paths need WASM fields and may ask for readiness at the same time.
Starting a new initialization Promise on every read can give each caller a different readiness token, even after loading succeeds.
Initialize the native module from its published file in Node, then call ensureWasm() without arguments; it keeps one Promise while pending and after success.

blocks.code:
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import initWasm from '@migaia/wasm'
import { ensureWasm } from '@migaia/store-wasm'

const url = new URL('./wasm_provider_bg.wasm', import.meta.resolve('@migaia/wasm'))
await initWasm({ module_or_path: await readFile(url) })
const first = ensureWasm()
const second = ensureWasm()
console.log(first === second)
const memory = await first
console.log(memory instanceof WebAssembly.Memory)
console.log(first === ensureWasm())
