blocks.text: The output is true, true, true on separate lines: both pending calls match, the resolved value is native memory, and the settled call still matches.
The Promise establishes readiness and does not allocate fields or transfer memory ownership. Failure clears its attempt cache; synchronous field creation must still wait for a successful call.

ensureWasm takes no arguments, allocates no fields, and returns the shared `Promise<WebAssembly.Memory>` while pending and after success. url selects the published file relative to its entry; initWasm.module_or_path receives readFile's Uint8Array bytes. The WebAssembly.Memory check verifies native memory without transferring its entire lifetime.

sections.heading: Keep a numeric field usable after native memory grows

blocks.text: Other WASM allocations can grow linear memory while an existing numeric field remains in use.
A DataView kept against the old buffer becomes detached, so hand-written readers and writers can fail after growth.
Put number() in createStore after readiness; the field refreshes its view of current memory and the Store owns its cleanup.
Output:

blocks.code:
0
true 12.5
19
true
FIELD_DISPOSED

blocks.text: The lines are 0, true 12.5, 19, true, FIELD_DISPOSED: the buffer changes while the stored value survives, later writes work, and Store disposal closes the retained field.
A numeric field starts at 0 and uses f64 storage. This demonstrates ordinary memory growth, not recovery from a native trap; a poisoned shared instance requires restarting its owner.

number takes no arguments and starts at zero, with f64 reads/writes through .value. createStore's score is a builder declaration owned by that Store. memory.grow(1) grows one WASM page; the field uses the new buffer at its original allocation offset. The retained field then demonstrates disposed state and access failure after Store.$dispose.

sections.heading: Reject a UTF-8 overflow without truncating the old value

blocks.text: A label fits a character limit but exceeds its fixed byte budget once encoded for WASM storage.
Counting characters underestimates multibyte text, while truncating encoded bytes can split a character and silently replace valid data.
Use string(6) for a six-byte capacity, overriding the default 256; an oversized assignment fails before the field commits any replacement.
Output:

blocks.code:
ééé 6
INVALID_OPTION
ééé

blocks.text: The output is ééé 6, INVALID_OPTION, then ééé: three accented characters consume six bytes and the longer assignment leaves that value intact.
Capacity counts TextEncoder UTF-8 bytes and stays fixed. Overflow neither truncates nor grows the field; choose a larger capacity when longer values are part of the input contract.

string maxBytes defaults to 256 and is overridden with 6, a safe integer within the supported range. TextEncoder measures assignment by UTF-8 bytes rather than characters. readFile/initWasm follows the preparation above. Store cleanup releases the field, and overflow preserves its prior contents.

sections.heading: Track one array index and keep copied views isolated

blocks.text: A view reads only one sample, but updates elsewhere in a large numeric array keep invalidating that reader.
Sharing one notification bucket across many indices makes unrelated readers rerun, and exposing writable native memory would bypass tracked writes.
Use array(3, 1) to give each index its own bucket instead of the default 64; write through setAt and use view only for an independent copy.
Output:
The output is 0, then 0,5, then 99 5: changing index 1 does not rerun the index-0 reader, changing index 0 does, and modifying the copy leaves the field at 5.
Indices must be safe integers in [0, length); negative Array.at-style indices are unsupported. view() does not track reads or write back, and coarser buckets can invalidate neighboring readers.

array requires length, here 3, and defaults granularity to 64, overridden here with 1. createStore options.runtime receives the explicit Runtime. seen includes the initial effect run, and runtime.flush completes scheduling. setAt requires a valid nonnegative safe index and numeric value; view takes no arguments and does not track.

sections.heading: Reject unreadable range input before changing array bytes

blocks.text: A batch update reads numbers from an ArrayLike object whose accessor can fail midway through the input.
Writing each number immediately after reading it leaves a partially updated field when a later accessor throws.
setRange reads the complete input before writing its half-open [lo, hi) range, so an input failure is classified without changing the existing bytes.
Output:

blocks.code:
true INVALID_OPTION
1,2,3
4,5,3

blocks.text: The output is true INVALID_OPTION, then 1,2,3, then 4,5,3: the exact TypeError is retained, the rejected input changes nothing, and a later valid range can still be applied.

values.length must equal hi - lo and every value must be a number. This proves admission before writes; it does not promise rollback of external accessor side effects or earlier observer notifications.

array(3) uses default granularity 64. setRange uses half-open lo/hi endpoints, values.length equal to hi-lo, and number items. input is a real ArrayLike with a throwing getter. After [1,2,3] is stored, rejecting input retains the exact TypeError with INVALID_OPTION; a later [0,2) update accepts [4,5].

sections.heading: Observe one named coordinate without tracking its siblings

blocks.text: A component reads the horizontal coordinate while only the vertical coordinate changes.
Tracking the entire position object would rerun that reader for any property change, even when its own input stays the same.
Build a fixed record from number() descriptors; each named numeric property has its own source and is read directly as position.x rather than through .value.
Output:
The output is 0, then 0,3, then x,y, then 3 9: updating y leaves the x reader alone, updating x reruns it, and enumeration exposes only business keys.
Record values begin at 0. The shape is fixed and supports number() builders only; nested fields and dynamic keys are unsupported, while dispose and disposed remain reserved lifecycle names.

record shape supports number() builders only, with x/y initially zero. Properties are read/written directly without .value. Store options.runtime matches the observing effect, and flush completes scheduling. Object.keys lists only business keys; dispose/disposed are nonenumerable. Release the observer before its Store.

sections.heading: Ownership, entry point, and intended use

blocks.text: The module has one root entry: ensureWasm, the number/boolean/string/array/record builders, eight error codes, four error factories, and WasmReservedKey/IWasmReservedKey. Concrete field types are exposed through builder return types, but names such as IWasmNumberField are not named root reexports. Namespace imports such as `import * as wasm from '@migaia/store-wasm'` avoid common-name collisions.

Dependencies are reactive, store-light, wasm, and utils. Field payloads live in WebAssembly.Memory; reactive Sources, descriptors, and decoded strings still use JavaScript objects. The entire Store or application state is not moved off the JS heap. Use fixed numeric layouts or explicitly bounded data where useful; ordinary small state, class instances, functions, and cyclic JS objects need not become WASM fields. Without measurements, layout and notification mechanisms are not speed claims.

Internal arena/field/number implementation files are not subpath exports. One internal allocator validates Wasm32 byte lengths and tracks memory, allocation id, pointer, and release registration. Synchronous allocation requires readiness; internal async allocation waits for ensureWasm first. New field types should be published by this module rather than relying on deep imports or another allocator implementation.

`ensureWasm():Promise<WebAssembly.Memory>` takes no arguments. It makes the underlying module memory ready without allocating fields. Pending and successful calls preserve the same Promise identity and memory. Failure clears the corresponding cache so a later call can retry. A builder itself allocates nothing; await readiness before the Store calls its synchronous create(context), otherwise NOT_INITIALIZED is thrown rather than waiting or substituting a JS field.

Node fetch cannot directly load the default file URL. The examples first read bytes from the published sibling WASM file in `@migaia/wasm`, invoke its default initWasm({module_or_path:bytes}), then call ensureWasm. module_or_path belongs to the underlying loader, not a field option. Here it contains readFile bytes; omission fetches the module's sibling WASM URL, and Promise input is also accepted. node:fs/promises reads the real file, and the examples use a real WASM instance.

Hosts with a suitable fetch path, such as browsers, can await ensureWasm directly. store-react StoreProvider can gate children with features.wasm:true and a stable ready:[ensureWasm], but cannot postpone a Store already constructed outside render. Prefer initialization and Store creation in an application/request owner, then register it with the matching Runtime Registry. This module has no reverse React dependency. The application owns an external Registry by default, and SSR has no effect cleanup. Enabling wasm without ready creates a rejected configuration barrier subsequently thrown during render, in production as well as development.

Every builder uses store-light's StoreFieldMode.sync and the synchronous `IFieldBuilder` branch. Put it directly in createStore(shape); no special async Store factory is required. Async module loading and synchronous field construction are separate operations.

rows: Read/write numeric properties such as field.x, without .value

blocks.text: The Store owns fields created by its builders and invokes their cleanup from store.$dispose(). Do not dispose individual fields while their Store remains in use. Extensions that explicitly own an IFieldContext may call builder.create(context) directly: runtime, signal, and createSource belong to store-light's protocol, must use a real owner, and leave field lifetime to the caller. signal is checked during construction, not a continuous automatic stop switch.

The real allocator zero-fills memory: number starts at 0, boolean at false, string at an empty string, and array/record numeric values at 0. Builders take no initial-value argument; set values through their write methods after creation. number/boolean/string expose readonly observed and disposed. array has readonly length/disposed; record has readonly disposed. Disposed payload access rejects, while metadata such as disposed and array.length remains readable.

rows: value:number; Object.is-equal writes do not commit; a nonnumber JavaScript value is TypeError/INVALID_OPTION
value:boolean; true/false write 1/0 and nonzero reads as true; nonboolean writes are TypeError/INVALID_OPTION

blocks.text: number accepts JS numbers, including NaN, Infinity, and negative zero, using f64 storage rather than integer-only semantics. Reading value tracks its Source; writing uses Source.commit. Scalar writes obtain the current DataView inside the commit callback so an owner growing memory at that boundary does not leave a write on the old buffer. No-argument dispose is synchronous and idempotent. Later value reads/writes produce FIELD_DISPOSED.

maxBytes defaults to 256 and must be a safe integer in 0..0xffff_ffff-4. Invalid capacity produces RangeError/INVALID_OPTION when creating the builder. The allocation request is 4+maxBytes bytes: a little-endian Uint32 UTF-8 length followed by a fixed-capacity byte region. Underlying allocation capacity can round for alignment; a longer string does not resize the field.

value must be string, otherwise TypeError/INVALID_OPTION. TextEncoder output exceeding maxBytes produces INVALID_OPTION, retains the old value, and never truncates. Chinese characters and emoji count by UTF-8 bytes rather than character count. A write decodes the current value for === comparison and skips an equal commit; that comparison still costs a decode. Every getter decodes current memory.buffer bytes according to the prefix rather than caching a value solely by local setter revision. A stored length exceeding maxBytes is ALLOCATION_FAILED, indicating corrupted data rather than normal truncation. observed/disposed/dispose follow scalar semantics.

rows: 64; a positive safe integer; 1 gives one bucket per position

blocks.text: Invalid arguments produce RangeError/INVALID_OPTION at builder creation. Layout is length*8 contiguous f64 bytes. Nonempty allocation requires an eight-byte-aligned pointer, otherwise ALLOCATION_FAILED. Empty arrays use an independent zero-length view without depending on zero-byte sentinel alignment. Length is fixed; there is no push/splice/resize.

rows: Requires a nonnegative safe integer in [0,length); invalid/out-of-range reads are RangeError/INVALID_OPTION, without negative-index support
Same index checks; nonnumber values are TypeError/INVALID_OPTION; Object.is-equal writes do not commit
Half-open [lo,hi), safe integer endpoints with 0≤lo≤hi≤length; values.length must equal hi-lo and every value must be number
No arguments; a new writable independent copy, without tracking, exposing linear memory, or writing back

blocks.text: Each contiguous granularity-sized bucket shares a Source, created on demand when touched. at tracks that bucket; an actual setAt/setRange change may notify other readers in the same bucket. There are at most ceil(length/granularity) buckets, not necessarily all created immediately. Finer granularity increases Source count and does not imply a measured speed advantage.

setRange captures length and every input item before writing field bytes. Invalid shape, length, numeric type, or an unclassified getter failure becomes INVALID_OPTION with original identity/cause retained; an error with complete foreign ownership keeps its source/code. Only Object.is-changed values are grouped by bucket; each affected bucket commits once and cross-bucket changes share one runtime.batch. Commit failure attempts reverse restoration of affected field bytes, without undoing Source/notification or external callback effects. Owned initialization/rollback failures remain traceable.

Private typed views and DataViews refresh when memory.buffer identity changes. memory.grow uses the current buffer; setAt and each bucket commit obtain it again inside the callback. Existing view() snapshots stay independent of that growth. Direct external memory writes bypass Source and therefore are not reactive writes.

shape is required and typed as `Record<string,ReturnType<typeof number>>`. This is a fixed named f64 structure, not an arbitrary JS record. Only number builders are supported, without nested record/array fields; casting a boolean/string builder does not create a supported combination. Runtime admission checks object/keys and the FIELD_BUILDER brand, without separately proving that the brand came from number.

Object.keys(shape) order determines offsets in a keys.length*8 allocation. Each key occupies eight little-endian f64 bytes. Business properties are enumerable getters/setters: field.x tracks/commits its own Source. Nonnumber writes are TypeError/INVALID_OPTION and Object.is-equal writes are skipped. Lifecycle dispose/disposed properties are nonenumerable, so Object.keys/JSON.stringify expose only business keys.

WasmReservedKey/IWasmReservedKey contains dispose/disposed. record(shape) creates a description first; reserved names are rejected with RESERVED_FIELD_NAME TypeError during field create(context), usually called by createStore. Invalid shapes, failed key reads, or failed builder-brand reads produce INVALID_OPTION with the original cause.

One owner manages a field's allocation and created Sources. If signal is already aborted, every builder uses the same reason boundary. An extensible native reason keeps its type/message/stack/identity with INIT_ABORTED attached; foreign identity remains intact, and other reasons stay reachable through cause/errors. Failed construction attempts to release created Sources and the allocation rather than publishing a half-built field.

Normal disposal marks the field terminal and unregisters its GC entry, then attempts every Source cleanup before releasing the block. A Source failure does not prevent block cleanup. Repeated/reentrant dispose does not run cleanup again; the first call can throw cleanup errors. One error retains the original; multiple errors produce CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError with originals in execution order. If construction and rollback both fail, a primary that can accept secondary errors is retained with nonenumerable errors appended. Otherwise [primary,cleanup] is aggregated, without replacing the primary's cause or stack.

When available, FinalizationRegistry registers created fields and explicit release unregisters them. Its absence is tolerated. GC fallback timing is unpredictable and cannot replace store.$dispose()/field.dispose(). Internal deallocation ignores unknown/released ids, and allocation validates the WASM32 byte range; arena primitives are not root API.

Native WebAssembly.CompileError/LinkError/RuntimeError pass unchanged through supported WASM boundaries. The first RuntimeError trap from an arena export also passes unchanged. The arena then marks itself unusable: later allocation rejects INSTANCE_POISONED with that original trap as cause, while release becomes a no-op to avoid another trap. This does not claim that every existing field getter calls an export or necessarily traps again. The shared wasm-bindgen instance cannot be rebuilt in the same module; reload the page or restart the process rather than retrying allocation as recovery. Poisoning does not promise reclamation of all earlier native memory.

blocks.text: STORE_WASM_SOURCE is `'@migaia/store-wasm'`, identifying errors created here rather than rewriting foreign owners. A native input-read failure that can accept identity receives INVALID_OPTION in place; otherwise cause/errors retain it. Do not forcibly replace declared native WASM pass-through errors with ordinary Error wrappers.

All four public factories require code:IStoreWasmErrorCode and message:string. `createStoreWasmError(code,message,options?)` returns Error and `createStoreWasmTypeError(...)` returns TypeError. options defaults to undefined, contains only optional cause, and forwards it when not undefined. `createStoreWasmRangeError(code,message)` has no third argument. `createStoreWasmAggregateError(code,errors:readonly unknown[],message)` retains each original error. They construct without automatically throwing, attach nonwritable source/code, and leave stack intact.

blocks.text: Replace the old array(number(),n,g) with array(n,g). The unused item argument was removed, encoding remains f64, and no compatibility entry remains. WasmFieldMode/IWasmFieldMode were withdrawn in favor of store-light StoreFieldMode.sync. Use typeof StoreFieldMode.sync for a sync-only type; the full IStoreFieldMode union includes async and is not an equivalent alias.

Fix initialization order after NOT_INITIALIZED. Size strings by UTF-8 bytes. Choose granularity=1 for separate index notifications. view returns a copy, so writes must use setAt/setRange. Fixed records do not support arbitrary nested field types. Builders describe layout; keep allocation outside React render under an application/request owner that initializes, constructs, and releases it.

该桥固定使用 exclusive 拓扑：一个逻辑连接对应一对端口，默认本端 main、对端 worker，经 connect 做 Core 的一致性检查和目录接线，不使用自定义 identifier。这不赋予任意共享 Worker 对象多客户端复用保证。一个 MessagePort 可以满足端口形状，但创建者仍须安排独立的物理连接和资源归属。

IWorkerPort 是 Core IWebWorkerLikePort 的别名，要求 postMessage、addEventListener、removeEventListener，消息事件为 message / error / messageerror。浏览器 Worker / MessagePort / 单条 SharedWorker.port 可提供这种面；Node 示例使用真实 Worker 内运行的 handler 与原生 MessagePort，不伪造端口。IWorkerLike 额外允许可选 terminate()；结构可传入不等于本包获得原生 Worker 的创建或退出所有权。

无参数，同步幂等标记不可用；新 request 拒绝 ADAPTER_DISPOSED，不释放 Endpoint。
无参数，唯一异步释放入口；先 close，等初始化，再关闭 Endpoint，重复调用返回同一个 Promise。

blocks.text: Adapter.dispose 不 terminate 借用的 Worker / port。清理失败以 rejected Promise 暴露，不吞掉；close-before-ready 也不能在稍后初始化完成后继续派发已退休请求。物理 Worker 由创建者按应用顺序终止；端点完成清理不等于得到了原生线程退出回执。

sections.heading: Worker 侧 handler 与输入载荷

blocks.text: `createWorkerHandler<Input, Output>(compute, postMessage, options?)` 验证两个必填函数，再建立消息处理器。compute(payload, { signal }) 可同步返回或返回 Promise；signal 是原生取消信号，长任务应配合检查或监听，框架不强制中断正在执行的同步代码。postMessage(message) 把 Core 消息交给真实父端口。options.timeoutMs 缺省 undefined，只影响该端点发起的 request，不为本端 compute 设置运行期限；请求期限通常由主端 Adapter 配置。

返回 IManagedRpcHandler 后，调用方要把真实 message.data 交给 handler。它不是自己安装全局 onmessage 的 Worker 创建器；浏览器可在监听器中交付数据，Node 使用 MessagePort 监听。handler 返回 Promise，初始化或交付路径失败仍应由宿主观察；普通 provider compute 抛错由 Core 转为失败响应，不能据此泛称所有宿主回调都永远不 reject。

桥会把业务输入转换为 portable 数据：支持普通记录 / 数组、有限基础值、undefined，以及 ArrayBuffer / Uint8Array 的显式字节表示。它不是任意原型、函数、Map / Set 或循环对象图的无损 structured clone；业务需要这些形状时先定义可传输表示或使用合适 parser。内部 $worker 标签为保留表示，不能把相同标记形状当成普通业务对象，也不能用来宣称信任。

rows: 接收已解析的原始消息值；关闭后 resolve 并忽略，不处理晚到队列残留。
已接纳、正在等待 Endpoint 初始化或交付消息的数量，不代表 provider compute 已完成。
`handler.disposed` 在 `handler.close()` 或 `handler.dispose()` 开始时同步变为 `true`，表示该处理器不再接收消息。
同步幂等停止接纳，不执行 Endpoint 或用户清理。
先 close，等待初始化，再执行 Endpoint 清理；同一个 Promise，失败保持拒绝。

blocks.text: 初始化期间已经接纳的消息在 close 后也不再交付，pendingCount 最终回到 0。不要把该计数当成安全 terminate 的静默门禁；端点 provider drain 和清理由 Core 契约负责，应等待 dispose 并按物理资源 owner 规则处理 Worker。此接口没有 disposeAsync。序列化 handler 也只释放自己的 Endpoint / provider 注册，不自动调用借入 parser.dispose，parser 生命周期仍归创建者。

`workerComputed(adapter, selectInput, options?)` 返回标准 `Resource<Output>`。每次 Resource fetcher 同步调用 selectInput 一次，再以该输入请求 Adapter，并转发 Resource signal 和可选 transfer(input)。同步读取的 signal / computed 依赖由 Resource 追踪；await 后才读取的值不自动归入这次同步依赖。它不提供跨 Resource 或跨 Worker 的全局缓存 / 请求去重。

rows: 必填的 WorkerAdapter 实例；Resource 借用，不负责 dispose。
必填同步函数，返回当前计算输入。
undefined；若提供必须是函数，返回此次输入的转移列表。
true；false 只跳过构造时主动启动，读取 state / promise 仍可触发按需取值。
0；也可按 (failureCount, error) 返回是否重试。
0；也可按 (failureCount, error) 返回等待毫秒数。

blocks.text: 这些 Resource 字段原样交给 Resource，不在 Worker 层重新实现规则。读取已知 options 各一次，不通过对象 rest 枚举未知 getter；非法 adapter、selectInput、transfer 或配置 getter 在 Resource 接管 / 自动启动前以 INVALID_OPTION 同步拒绝，原错为 cause。Resource 的 refetch、load、state 和 dispose 继续遵循 resource 包。
结束时先释放 Resource，再 await adapter.dispose，最后由创建者终止原生 Worker / 端口，避免销毁 Resource 仍在使用的连接。传 transfer 时必须由应用决定输入以后是否还会读取；Resource 重试不使已经 detach 的 backing 自动恢复。

sections.heading: 序列化 parser 与插件

blocks.text: workerParser(options) 是主端 ISerializeParser；workerPlugin(options) 只是把它的 name / parser 组合成标准 ISerializePlugin，供 createSerializeRegistry 使用。两者仅从 /serialize/worker 导入。

rows: worker，格式标签，必须与真实 Worker parser 的编码含义相符；读存档时用正确标签。
copy；另一个值为 transfer，见字节规则。
false，借用 Worker 由调用方拥有。

blocks.text: options 的这五个字段在入口各读一次；非对象、反射或读取失败、非法字段值以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。parser 无 timeoutMs 选项，不能建议配置不存在的 parser.timeoutMs；取消使用 SerializeContext.signal，注册表另有自己的生命周期预算。

encode(value, context) 将 Uint8Array 输入分类为 bytes，其他为 value，返回按块消费的异步序列；不是同步返回一份合并好的 chunk。decode(chunk, context) 请求 Worker 解码，返回结果段的 payload，不再给调用方多包一层 chunk。context 提供 signal 和用于诊断的 context 名称；注册表会传入其真实上下文。

workerParser.dispose 异步退休活跃输出并关闭 Endpoint，默认不终止原生 Worker；terminateOnDispose 为 true 时，即便端点清理失败也继续尝试调用可选 terminate。只有同步 terminate 调用抛错才由这段捕获，不宣称等待原生异步退出。端点单独失败保留 RpcLifecycleError 清理信息，terminate 单独抛错保留原错，两者均失败才生成 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError，errors 按端点、terminate 顺序保留。重复 parser.dispose 返回同一个 Promise。Registry.dispose 需要 await 才能观察其异步清理结果。

sections.heading: Worker 侧序列化与分段流

blocks.text: createSerializeWorkerHandler(parser, post) 的两个参数必填：真实 parser 必须提供 encode / decode，post(message, transfer?) 委托真实 Worker 端口。非对象 / 非函数在 Endpoint 创建前同步拒绝。parser 成员 getter 抛错时，可注记未归属原生 Error 保留同一对象、类型和 stack 并附 INVALID_OPTION；完整外包 source/code 保留，不可注记值通过 cause 或聚合链保留。

handler 传 parser.encode 输入段的 payload；输出可为一个合法 ISerializeChunk，或同步 / 异步 chunk iterable。主端以 open / chunk / end 帧增量接收，初始两个 credit、按顺序 ACK，消费后补 credit；不调用 collectStream 或先把所有结果拼为一份。credit 限制单流发送进度，不是全 Worker 的总字节上限，producer 可先取得下一块再等待发送 credit。

返回的合法 text / bytes / value 段保持顺序，可有空流和混合段；删掉的 CHUNK_MERGE_FAILED 不再承担这种路径。parser.decode 接收原 chunk，解码结果是 Uint8Array 则分类为 bytes，否则为 value。Worker 侧向外发送的完整 bytes backing 可按其发送规则转移，不由主端输入 ownership 自动赋予输出重用保证。

消费者提前结束或取消会通知对应 stream，唤醒等待 credit 的 producer，并尝试 iterator.return；清理又失败时用既有 secondary-error 附加保留主错与次错。终结错误通过 Core RPC rejection 传 source/code/name/message/stack/cause/errors 链，不另造普通 error 应用帧。实际不可合作的业务代码仍须由应用负责，不把流取消宣称为强制停止 Worker。

sections.id: 字节复制-转移与实际载荷
sections.heading: 字节复制、转移与实际载荷

blocks.text: WorkerByteOwnership 是公开词表 copy / transfer，IByteOwnership 是其值联合；WorkerDiagnosticType 只有 worker，IWorkerDiagnosticType 是该值类型。它们不接收参数。默认 copy 保留调用方输入；transfer 是显式放弃独占输入存储的策略。

序列化输入只有 bytes 段、真实 Uint8Array、且视图覆盖整个普通 ArrayBuffer（offset 为 0、length 等于 backing 长度）才进入 transfer list。局部 subarray、SharedArrayBuffer backing 等不满足条件时回退复制；普通 ArrayBuffer 的其他别名不会被检测并排除转移，整块转移可能同时使它们失效。共享 backing 不因此变成一个支持的共享内存计算协议。顶层非 bytes 的 text / value 不因 ownership 自动转移内部对象。
实际原生 post 提交后，转移可能让整个 backing 及所有别名 view detach；预取消尚未发送时输入仍可用，不能看到 transfer 选项或取消码就断言数据已丢失。重试前检查实际 buffer 状态，或选择 copy / 保留应用副本。transferablesOf / exclusiveBuffer 是内部工具，不作为公开 API 调用。
当前 portable 桥先把 bytes 转成 base64url 载荷，再独立传 native transfer list，因此 detach 不证明载荷零拷贝。小计算与复杂对象图还要承担编码和往返成本；旧实现耗时与倍率不代表当前实现，没有本轮性能数字或速度保证。应用应按真实工作量判断是否值得卸载，而不是从“用了 Worker”推导提速。

通用 Adapter request 保留 canonical Core 取消、超时、transport 与远程错误。compute 异常通常在 RpcRemoteError / INTERNAL 外层之下恢复原生 TypeError / RangeError 等 cause、message 和 stack；不要要求接收对象与 Worker 原对象 identity 相同，也不要把所有顶层异常当成业务原生类型。未配置期限且 provider 一直不结算时，请求仍可能等待；不能承诺任何坏 Worker 都必然及时 settle。

序列化 decode / request 与预取消 encode 使用 SerializeCodecError / REQUEST_ABORTED，包含 type（默认 worker）、phase（encode / decode）、context、chunkIndex 0 和 bytesConsumed（输入 bytes 长度，否则 0），原 signal.reason 保留在 cause。活动 encode 流可以由原始 RPC / 取消失败终结，不保证每个失败都有全部 codec 字段。credit 等待和显式流停止创建原生 DOMException / AbortError，message 为 serialize stream cancelled，附 REQUEST_ABORTED；其原生类型、message 和 stack 由错误链保留。

rows: 非法或不可读取的 Worker / parser / Resource 配置。
已 close / dispose 的通用 Adapter 继续 request。
序列化请求或流协作取消，检查 reason 与真实 buffer 状态。
Worker 请求的 chunk 形状非法。
返回 chunk 或帧序列不合法。
parser 端点与可选 terminate 同时清理失败。

blocks.text: STORE_WORKER_SOURCE 为 @migaia/store-worker。createStoreWorkerError(code, message, options?) 接收必填码和消息，可选 options.cause，返回带身份的 Error；createStoreWorkerAggregateError(code, errors, message) 返回 AggregateError，保留 errors 顺序和原值。code 类型为 IStoreWorkerErrorCode，工厂不覆盖 stack。外包完整身份继续由原 owner 负责。

请求一直等待时先检查真实 message.data 是否交给正确 handler，再看 WorkerAdapter.timeoutMs / 调用 signal；workerParser 只能用已有 context.signal，没有 parser.timeoutMs。Chunk 多段问题应按增量迭代处理，不套用旧“Worker 内先合并单段”的做法。释放端点后 Worker 仍存活通常是借用所有权：通用路径由创建者 terminate，序列化可选择 terminateOnDispose，但仍不等于确认原生退出。
包已有 fmt / lint / typecheck / typecheck:test / test / build，以及 typecheck:e2e / test:e2e。浏览器 e2e 需要已安装 Playwright 浏览器；本轮 Node 场景不冒充浏览器授权或多宿主证据。实际报告说明哪些命令运行与通过，不把命令列表或旧性能记录当成当前验证结论。
按任务选择下面的完整示例，再查后面的参数与生命周期约定。所有运行示例使用 Node 24 的真实 Worker 与 MessagePort；它们证明线程接线、计算、缓存或清理，不代表浏览器权限或跨进程隔离。

blocks.text: 安装本包；Resource 示例直接导入 reactive，序列化示例直接导入 serialize，因此也要直接安装这两个包。

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/store-worker @migaia/reactive @migaia/serialize

blocks.text: 把每个示例分别保存为一个独立的 ESM TypeScript 文件，再用 Node 24 执行该文件；不要在交互式标准输入中运行，因为 Worker 会通过 import.meta.url 重新加载同一文件。子线程只接收转移给它的原生端口；父线程负责 finally 中的关闭与终止。无需浏览器端口替身或额外 Worker 包装层。
一项计算需要离开界面线程，调用方又不想自己维护消息标识与响应匹配。
只发送业务数据，还需要手写请求匹配、启动就绪和失败处理；主线程的等待也容易与 Worker 初始化错开。
创建真实 Node Worker，把 `MessagePort` 转交给它，再配对 `WorkerAdapter` 与 `createWorkerHandler`；`request` 自动等待端点初始化，返回的进程与线程标识可核对计算位置。

`new Worker(new URL(import.meta.url), { workerData: port2, transferList: [port2] })` 在另一个线程执行当前文件；`isMainThread` 区分两条分支，`workerData` 是交给子线程的端口，`transferList` 转移的是端口而非业务输入。`port1.start()` 启用原生端口的事件分发。`request` 的两个泛型只声明输入与返回值类型；本例载荷为 `[20, 22]`，未设置 `signal` 或业务转移列表。适配器的 `clientId` 默认 `'main'`，`timeoutMs` 默认 `undefined`，不设期限。
输出：

blocks.code: 结果： 42 true true

blocks.text: 输出 `结果： 42 true true`：结果是 `42`，Worker 与父线程位于同一进程，却使用不同线程。
这里验证的是 Node 24 原生 Worker，不是浏览器环境或进程隔离；`clientId` 默认 `'main'`，`timeoutMs` 默认 `undefined`。端口由适配器借用，调用方仍需关闭端口并终止自己创建的 Worker。

sections.id: 停止请求并保留借用的-worker
sections.heading: 停止请求并保留借用的 Worker

blocks.text: 页面关闭了请求客户端，应用却仍持有 Worker 和端口。
在客户端清理时直接终止 Worker，会释放不属于它的资源；只标记关闭，又会留下端点订阅。
用 `close` 立即拒绝新请求，再等待 `dispose` 释放端点；重复销毁复用同一个 Promise，最后用原生消息确认借用的 Worker 端口仍能通信。
`close()` 与 `dispose()` 都无参数；前者同步退休请求入口，后者异步释放端点，重复调用复用 Promise。示例最后通过 `port1.once` 与原生 `'ping'` / `'pong'` 验证借用端口仍可用；它们不是本包业务协议。`Worker` 与端口由本例创建，因此仍由 `finally` 关闭和终止。
输出：

blocks.code:
关闭前： 42
已关闭： true ADAPTER_DISPOSED
同一清理： true
借用端口： pong

blocks.text: 依次输出 `关闭前： 42`、`已关闭： true ADAPTER_DISPOSED`、`同一清理： true`、`借用端口： pong`。
`close` 只停止接收新请求，`dispose` 才执行可能失败的异步端点清理；两者都不关闭原生端口或终止 Worker。最后的探测是独立宿主消息，不是 RPC 请求。

sections.id: 保留-worker-计算失败的原因链
sections.heading: 保留 Worker 计算失败的原因链

blocks.text: Worker 中的计算因输入问题抛出 `TypeError`，其原因又是一个 `RangeError`，调用方需要同时看到两层失败。
只回传错误消息，会在线程边界丢失原生类型、嵌套原因和原始堆栈信息。
用 `createWorkerHandler` 包装真实计算，并向它转交收到的消息；RPC 返回远端失败，其原因链保留原生 `TypeError` 与内部 `RangeError`，无需另建错误消息协议。
`createWorkerHandler(compute, postMessage)` 的两个函数均必填；本例 `compute` 抛出含 `cause` 的原生 `TypeError`，`postMessage` 委托原生端口。主端没有设置超时，默认不设期限；错误由跨线程 RPC 原因链读取，不要求接收对象与子线程原对象相同。消息监听器观察 handler 返回 Promise 的投递失败。
输出：

blocks.code:
远端错误： RpcRemoteError INTERNAL
原始错误： true 无法计算总数
原因： true 行数据无效
堆栈： true true

blocks.text: 依次输出 `远端错误： RpcRemoteError INTERNAL`、`原始错误： true 无法计算总数`、`原因： true 行数据无效`、`堆栈： true true`。
外层错误属于 RPC Core，原生错误保留在 `cause` 链中，不会把最外层变成 `TypeError`。消息处理器的 Promise 只等待投递，不代表计算完成；操作结果由主端请求等待。

sections.heading: 用 Resource 管理 Worker 结果与缓存

blocks.text: 界面需要展示加载与成功状态，也需要缓存 Worker 结果，输入之后还可能继续变化。
在请求旁再维护结果变量和缓存，会重复实现 `Resource` 的行为，也容易把旧输入的结果留在界面上。
用 `workerComputed` 同步选择输入，并传入信号所属的运行时；`autoStart: false` 跳过构造时主动启动，读取 `state` 仍可按需取值，再等待 `refetch`、读取缓存并在输入改变后刷新。

`runtime` 显式使用输入信号所属的运行时；省略时为 `defaultRuntime`。`selectInput` 同步返回 `values.value`；`autoStart: false` 覆盖默认 `true`，只跳过构造时主动启动，首个 `state` 读取仍会触发请求。`ttl` 默认 `Infinity`，本例不覆盖；`refetch()` 强制取值，`promise` 被动读取可复用新鲜缓存。`Resource` 借用适配器，须先释放资源，再清理端点与原生 Worker。
输出：

blocks.code:
取值前： pending
首次： 6 success
缓存： true 6
更新： 9 success

blocks.text: 依次输出 `取值前： pending`、`首次： 6 success`、`缓存： true 6`、`更新： 9 success`。
`autoStart` 默认 `true`，设为 `false` 只跳过构造时主动启动；首次读取 `state` 会按需取值并显示 `pending`。`ttl` 默认 `Infinity`，被动读取 `promise` 复用新鲜缓存，`refetch` 则强制刷新；先释放资源，再清理借用的适配器与 Worker。

sections.id: 把现有-json-解析器接入-worker-注册表插件
sections.heading: 把现有 JSON 解析器接入 Worker 注册表插件

blocks.text: 应用已经使用序列化注册表，现在需要把某个解析器放到 Worker 执行。
把注册表调用改成临时消息，会重复实现格式选择与清理；主线程再运行一份解析器，又没有建立预期的执行边界。
在真实 Worker 中用 `createSerializeWorkerHandler` 接入 `jsonParser`，主线程注册 `workerPlugin`；继续调用注册表的编码与解码接口，由格式标签选择此插件。

`workerPlugin` 的 `worker` 必填，本例为原生端口；`type: 'json'` 覆盖默认 `'worker'`，只作为本地注册表格式标签，不改变 Worker 中 `jsonParser()` 的算法。`ownership` 默认 `'copy'`，`clientId` 默认 `'main'`，`terminateOnDispose` 默认 `false`。注册表借助插件进行 `encode` / `decode`，`registry.dispose()` 清理插件端点；本例仍负责原生端口和 Worker。
输出：

blocks.code:
数据块： text
恢复： report 2

blocks.text: 依次输出 `数据块： text`、`恢复： report 2`：工作端 JSON 解析器返回文本块，并恢复了原有字段。

blocks.text: 输入字节可能还要留给下一次重试，当前解码却可能在发送前就不再需要。
转移共用的底层缓冲区可能让所有视图失效；把取消一律当成已经分离，也会丢弃根本没有发送的输入。
为真实 Worker JSON 解析器使用 `workerParser` 的默认复制策略，先完成一次解码，再传入预先中止的信号，检查失败原因和原字节后决定是否重试。

`workerParser({ worker: port1 })` 使用默认 `type: 'worker'`、`ownership: 'copy'`、`clientId: 'main'` 和 `terminateOnDispose: false`。`decode` 接收 `['bytes', bytes]` 与上下文；`signal` 控制此次调用，`context: 'settings'` 为诊断名称。第二次调用前已取消，原始 `DOMException` 保留在 `cause`，输入未被发送或分离；这不证明在途计算能够被强制中断。
输出：
依次输出 `解码： 2 11`、`已取消： REQUEST_ABORTED true`、`输入： {"count":2}`。
默认所有权策略为 `'copy'`；本次预取消保留调用方的原始原因且不发送工作，不证明已经运行的计算会被抢占中断。显式转移和字节分离同样不代表载荷实现了零拷贝。

本包提供两条 Worker 接线：WorkerAdapter / createWorkerHandler 执行通用计算，workerComputed 把该请求接入 Resource；序列化子入口则把普通 parser 接入 Worker 和 SerializeRegistry。请求关联、provider、取消、deadline、来源与错误传输归 rpc-core，Resource 的缓存、重试和响应式生命周期归 resource，格式解析与注册表归 serialize。本包只拥有应用载荷转换、分段 credit / ACK 和这些 API 的接线，不创建另一套 RPC 引擎。

rows: WorkerAdapter、createWorkerHandler、workerComputed、IManagedRpcHandler、端口 / Resource 配置类型、所有权 / 诊断常量与错误。

blocks.text: reactive、resource、serialize、rpc-core、rpc-contract、utils 是运行时依赖。直接导入它们时，应用也应直接安装需要的包。根入口不导出序列化 factory，没有 serialize/* 通配入口；旧根 aliases 需迁移到精确子路径，没有兼容 shim。encodeWorkerValue / decodeWorkerValue 与 transferablesOf 是内部工具，不作为业务导出。无抛点的旧 CHUNK_MERGE_FAILED 已移除，当前保留六码。
该桥固定使用 exclusive 拓扑：一个逻辑连接对应一对端口，默认本端 main、对端 worker，经 connect 做 Core 的一致性检查和目录接线，不使用自定义 identifier。这不赋予任意共享 Worker 对象多客户端复用保证。一个 MessagePort 可以满足端口形状，但创建者仍须安排独立的物理连接和资源归属。

IWorkerPort 是 Core IWebWorkerLikePort 的别名，要求 postMessage、addEventListener、removeEventListener，消息事件为 message / error / messageerror。浏览器 Worker / MessagePort / 单条 SharedWorker.port 可提供这种面；Node 示例使用真实 Worker 内运行的 handler 与原生 MessagePort，不伪造端口。IWorkerLike 额外允许可选 terminate()；结构可传入不等于本包获得原生 Worker 的创建或退出所有权。
`new WorkerAdapter(port, options?)` 同步返回对象，内部 Endpoint 异步初始化；request 自动等初始化，不需要额外 ready API。

sections.heading: Worker 侧 handler 与输入载荷

blocks.text: `createWorkerHandler<Input, Output>(compute, postMessage, options?)` 验证两个必填函数，再建立消息处理器。compute(payload, { signal }) 可同步返回或返回 Promise；signal 是原生取消信号，长任务应配合检查或监听，框架不强制中断正在执行的同步代码。postMessage(message) 把 Core 消息交给真实父端口。options.timeoutMs 缺省 undefined，只影响该端点发起的 request，不为本端 compute 设置运行期限；请求期限通常由主端 Adapter 配置。

返回 IManagedRpcHandler 后，调用方要把真实 message.data 交给 handler。它不是自己安装全局 onmessage 的 Worker 创建器；浏览器可在监听器中交付数据，Node 使用 MessagePort 监听。handler 返回 Promise，初始化或交付路径失败仍应由宿主观察；普通 provider compute 抛错由 Core 转为失败响应，不能据此泛称所有宿主回调都永远不 reject。

桥会把业务输入转换为 portable 数据：支持普通记录 / 数组、有限基础值、undefined，以及 ArrayBuffer / Uint8Array 的显式字节表示。它不是任意原型、函数、Map / Set 或循环对象图的无损 structured clone；业务需要这些形状时先定义可传输表示或使用合适 parser。内部 $worker 标签为保留表示，不能把相同标记形状当成普通业务对象，也不能用来宣称信任。

`workerComputed(adapter, selectInput, options?)` 返回标准 `Resource<Output>`。每次 Resource fetcher 同步调用 selectInput 一次，再以该输入请求 Adapter，并转发 Resource signal 和可选 transfer(input)。同步读取的 signal / computed 依赖由 Resource 追踪；await 后才读取的值不自动归入这次同步依赖。它不提供跨 Resource 或跨 Worker 的全局缓存 / 请求去重。

sections.heading: 序列化 parser 与插件

blocks.text: workerParser(options) 是主端 ISerializeParser；workerPlugin(options) 只是把它的 name / parser 组合成标准 ISerializePlugin，供 createSerializeRegistry 使用。两者仅从 /serialize/worker 导入。

rows: worker，格式标签，必须与真实 Worker parser 的编码含义相符；读存档时用正确标签。
copy；另一个值为 transfer，见字节规则。
false，借用 Worker 由调用方拥有。

blocks.text: options 的这五个字段在入口各读一次；非对象、反射或读取失败、非法字段值以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝。parser 无 timeoutMs 选项，不能建议配置不存在的 parser.timeoutMs；取消使用 SerializeContext.signal，注册表另有自己的生命周期预算。

encode(value, context) 将 Uint8Array 输入分类为 bytes，其他为 value，返回按块消费的异步序列；不是同步返回一份合并好的 chunk。decode(chunk, context) 请求 Worker 解码，返回结果段的 payload，不再给调用方多包一层 chunk。context 提供 signal 和用于诊断的 context 名称；注册表会传入其真实上下文。

workerParser.dispose 异步退休活跃输出并关闭 Endpoint，默认不终止原生 Worker；terminateOnDispose 为 true 时，即便端点清理失败也继续尝试调用可选 terminate。只有同步 terminate 调用抛错才由这段捕获，不宣称等待原生异步退出。端点单独失败保留 RpcLifecycleError 清理信息，terminate 单独抛错保留原错，两者均失败才生成 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError，errors 按端点、terminate 顺序保留。重复 parser.dispose 返回同一个 Promise。Registry.dispose 需要 await 才能观察其异步清理结果。

sections.heading: Worker 侧序列化与分段流

blocks.text: createSerializeWorkerHandler(parser, post) 的两个参数必填：真实 parser 必须提供 encode / decode，post(message, transfer?) 委托真实 Worker 端口。非对象 / 非函数在 Endpoint 创建前同步拒绝。parser 成员 getter 抛错时，可注记未归属原生 Error 保留同一对象、类型和 stack 并附 INVALID_OPTION；完整外包 source/code 保留，不可注记值通过 cause 或聚合链保留。

handler 传 parser.encode 输入段的 payload；输出可为一个合法 ISerializeChunk，或同步 / 异步 chunk iterable。主端以 open / chunk / end 帧增量接收，初始两个 credit、按顺序 ACK，消费后补 credit；不调用 collectStream 或先把所有结果拼为一份。credit 限制单流发送进度，不是全 Worker 的总字节上限，producer 可先取得下一块再等待发送 credit。

返回的合法 text / bytes / value 段保持顺序，可有空流和混合段；删掉的 CHUNK_MERGE_FAILED 不再承担这种路径。parser.decode 接收原 chunk，解码结果是 Uint8Array 则分类为 bytes，否则为 value。Worker 侧向外发送的完整 bytes backing 可按其发送规则转移，不由主端输入 ownership 自动赋予输出重用保证。

消费者提前结束或取消会通知对应 stream，唤醒等待 credit 的 producer，并尝试 iterator.return；清理又失败时用既有 secondary-error 附加保留主错与次错。终结错误通过 Core RPC rejection 传 source/code/name/message/stack/cause/errors 链，不另造普通 error 应用帧。实际不可合作的业务代码仍须由应用负责，不把流取消宣称为强制停止 Worker。

sections.id: 字节复制-转移与实际载荷
sections.heading: 字节复制、转移与实际载荷

blocks.text: WorkerByteOwnership 是公开词表 copy / transfer，IByteOwnership 是其值联合；WorkerDiagnosticType 只有 worker，IWorkerDiagnosticType 是该值类型。它们不接收参数。默认 copy 保留调用方输入；transfer 是显式放弃独占输入存储的策略。

序列化输入只有 bytes 段、真实 Uint8Array、且视图覆盖整个普通 ArrayBuffer（offset 为 0、length 等于 backing 长度）才进入 transfer list。局部 subarray、SharedArrayBuffer backing 等不满足条件时回退复制；普通 ArrayBuffer 的其他别名不会被检测并排除转移，整块转移可能同时使它们失效。共享 backing 不因此变成一个支持的共享内存计算协议。顶层非 bytes 的 text / value 不因 ownership 自动转移内部对象。
实际原生 post 提交后，转移可能让整个 backing 及所有别名 view detach；预取消尚未发送时输入仍可用，不能看到 transfer 选项或取消码就断言数据已丢失。重试前检查实际 buffer 状态，或选择 copy / 保留应用副本。transferablesOf / exclusiveBuffer 是内部工具，不作为公开 API 调用。
当前 portable 桥先把 bytes 转成 base64url 载荷，再独立传 native transfer list，因此 detach 不证明载荷零拷贝。小计算与复杂对象图还要承担编码和往返成本；旧实现耗时与倍率不代表当前实现，没有本轮性能数字或速度保证。应用应按真实工作量判断是否值得卸载，而不是从“用了 Worker”推导提速。

通用 Adapter request 保留 canonical Core 取消、超时、transport 与远程错误。compute 异常通常在 RpcRemoteError / INTERNAL 外层之下恢复原生 TypeError / RangeError 等 cause、message 和 stack；不要要求接收对象与 Worker 原对象 identity 相同，也不要把所有顶层异常当成业务原生类型。未配置期限且 provider 一直不结算时，请求仍可能等待；不能承诺任何坏 Worker 都必然及时 settle。

序列化 decode / request 与预取消 encode 使用 SerializeCodecError / REQUEST_ABORTED，包含 type（默认 worker）、phase（encode / decode）、context、chunkIndex 0 和 bytesConsumed（输入 bytes 长度，否则 0），原 signal.reason 保留在 cause。活动 encode 流可以由原始 RPC / 取消失败终结，不保证每个失败都有全部 codec 字段。credit 等待和显式流停止创建原生 DOMException / AbortError，message 为 serialize stream cancelled，附 REQUEST_ABORTED；其原生类型、message 和 stack 由错误链保留。

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: Two calculations finish and the wrong caller receives a result because raw messages do not associate requests with responses.
Closing a screen terminates a borrowed Worker because client subscriptions and physical thread ownership were combined.
A Worker sends only an error message, losing native error types, causes and stacks across the thread boundary.
Inputs change while a view keeps the old result because loading state and caching were maintained separately beside each request.
Moving an existing parser to a Worker duplicates format selection and cleanup in ad hoc messages.

Use one request interface across a real thread boundary. WorkerAdapter waits for endpoint initialization and delegates result matching to Core, while Run a calculation in a real Worker checks the returned process and thread identifiers.

Release the request client separately from its physical Worker. close retires admission and dispose shares one cleanup Promise, and Stop requests without terminating a borrowed Worker receives a native message after endpoint cleanup.
Keep cross-thread failures traceable through their causes. createWorkerHandler uses RPC error transfer, and Keep a Worker computation failure traceable checks native types, nested causes and stacks.

Use an existing state and cache model for results. workerComputed connects input selection and requests to Resource, and Use Resource state and cache for Worker results demonstrates lazy work, fresh-cache reuse and explicit refresh.

Keep the application's existing registry calls. workerPlugin registers the remote parser as a standard plugin, and Run an existing JSON parser through a Worker registry plugin round-trips data with the same encode/decode interface.

blocks.text: This module connects two Worker use cases. WorkerAdapter / createWorkerHandler execute general computation, and workerComputed connects those requests to Resource. The serialization subentry connects an ordinary parser to a Worker and SerializeRegistry. rpc-core owns request correlation, providers, cancellation, deadlines, source handling, and error transport. resource owns caching, retry, and reactive lifetime; serialize owns formats and registry behavior. This module owns payload conversion, chunk credit / ACK, and the integration rather than another RPC engine.

blocks.text: reactive, resource, serialize, rpc-core, rpc-contract, and utils are runtime dependencies. Install module directly when your application imports them. Serialization factories no longer have root aliases, and there is no serialize/* wildcard entry; migrate imports to the exact subentry without a compatibility shim. encodeWorkerValue / decodeWorkerValue and transferablesOf are internal. CHUNK_MERGE_FAILED was removed because its former merge path no longer exists; six local codes remain.

The bridge uses exclusive topology: one logical connection has one port pair, with main and worker as default identities. connect performs Core consistency checks and directory wiring without a custom identifier. This is not a guarantee of arbitrary multi-client sharing on one Worker object. A MessagePort can satisfy the port surface while its creator still owns physical connection setup and resources.

blocks.text: Install this module. The Resource example directly imports reactive, and serialization examples directly import serialize, so install those module directly too.

sections.heading: Run a calculation in a real Worker

blocks.text: A large calculation needs to leave the UI thread without making callers manage message identifiers and response matching.
Posting application data alone leaves request matching, startup readiness and failure settlement to handwritten listeners.

Create a real Node Worker, transfer a MessagePort to it, and pair WorkerAdapter with createWorkerHandler. request waits for endpoint initialization; the returned PID and thread id show where the calculation ran.

`new Worker(new URL(import.meta.url), { workerData: port2, transferList: [port2] })` executes this file in another thread. `isMainThread` selects the branch, `workerData` carries the child port, and `transferList` transfers that port rather than application input. `port1.start()` enables native port event delivery. The two request type arguments describe input and output statically; the payload is `[20, 22]`, with no signal or application transfer list. Adapter defaults are `clientId: 'main'` and `timeoutMs: undefined`, meaning no deadline.
Output:

blocks.code: result: 42 true true

blocks.text: The output is `result: 42 true true`: the result is 42, the Worker shares the parent's process, and it runs on a different thread.

This is Node 24 native Worker execution, not a browser or process-isolation test. clientId defaults to 'main' and timeoutMs to undefined; the caller must close its borrowed port and terminate its own Worker.

sections.heading: Stop requests without terminating a borrowed Worker

blocks.text: A screen closes its RPC client while the application still owns the Worker and its port.
Terminating the Worker inside client cleanup destroys a resource owned elsewhere; only marking the client closed leaves its endpoint subscriptions installed.

Use close to reject new requests immediately, then await dispose to release the endpoint. Repeated dispose calls share one Promise; a native ping afterward checks that the borrowed Worker port still works.

`close()` and `dispose()` take no arguments. The former retires request admission synchronously; the latter releases the endpoint asynchronously and shares one Promise across calls. The native `'ping'` / `'pong'` exchange checks that the borrowed port still works; it is separate from this module's request protocol. This example created the port and Worker, so its `finally` block closes and terminates them.
Output:

blocks.code:
before close: 42
closed: true ADAPTER_DISPOSED
same cleanup: true
borrowed port: pong

blocks.text: The output is `before close: 42`, `closed: true ADAPTER_DISPOSED`, `same cleanup: true`, then `borrowed port: pong`.

close only changes admission; dispose performs asynchronous endpoint cleanup and can reject. Neither closes the native port nor terminates the Worker. The final ping is a separate native host message, not an RPC request.

sections.heading: Keep a Worker computation failure traceable

blocks.text: A Worker calculation throws a TypeError caused by an earlier RangeError, but the caller needs both failures to diagnose the input.
Sending only an error message loses native types, the nested cause and the original stack information across the thread boundary.

Wrap the real computation with createWorkerHandler and forward incoming messages to it. RPC returns a remote failure whose cause retains the native TypeError and its RangeError cause; no custom error-message protocol is needed.

Both functions passed to `createWorkerHandler(compute, postMessage)` are required. Here, compute throws a native `TypeError` with a cause, while postMessage delegates to the native port. No timeout is configured, so requests have no default deadline. Read the transferred cause chain rather than expecting object identity with the child-side error. The message listener observes delivery failures from the handler's Promise.
Output:

blocks.code:
remote: RpcRemoteError INTERNAL
primary: true cannot compute total
cause: true invalid row
stacks: true true

blocks.text: The output is `remote: RpcRemoteError INTERNAL`, `primary: true cannot compute total`, `cause: true invalid row`, then `stacks: true true`.

The outer error belongs to RPC Core; the native errors remain below cause rather than becoming the top-level TypeError. The message handler's Promise covers delivery, not compute completion; await the main-side request for the operation result.

sections.heading: Use Resource state and cache for Worker results

blocks.text: A view needs loading and successful states plus a cached Worker result, and its inputs can change later.
Keeping a separate result variable and cache beside Worker requests duplicates Resource behavior and makes it easy to show a result for outdated inputs.

Use workerComputed with a synchronous selector and the signal's Runtime. autoStart false skips eager construction work; reading state can still start lazy work. Await refetch, read the cached promise, then explicitly refresh after input changes.

`runtime` is explicitly the input signal's runtime; omission uses `defaultRuntime`. The selector synchronously returns `values.value`. `autoStart: false` overrides the default `true` only for eager construction; the first `state` read can still start work. `ttl` defaults to `Infinity` and is unchanged here. `refetch()` forces work, while passive `promise` reads can reuse fresh cache. Dispose the Resource before its borrowed adapter and native Worker.
Output:

blocks.code:
before: pending
first: 6 success
cache: true 6
next: 9 success

blocks.text: The output is `before: pending`, `first: 6 success`, `cache: true 6`, then `next: 9 success`.

autoStart defaults to true; false skips eager construction, not lazy state reads. The first state read starts work and reports pending. ttl defaults to Infinity; passive promise reads reuse fresh cache, while refetch forces work. Dispose Resource before its borrowed adapter and Worker.

sections.heading: Run an existing JSON parser through a Worker registry plugin

blocks.text: An application already uses a serialization registry, but one parser should execute inside a Worker.
Replacing registry calls with ad hoc messages duplicates format routing and cleanup, while running another parser on the main thread defeats the intended execution boundary.

Install jsonParser with createSerializeWorkerHandler inside a real Worker, then register workerPlugin on the main side. Keep the existing registry encode and decode calls; the type label selects this plugin.

`worker` is required and receives a native port. `type: 'json'` overrides the default `'worker'` label for local registry routing; it does not change the Worker-side `jsonParser()` algorithm. Defaults are `ownership: 'copy'`, `clientId: 'main'`, and `terminateOnDispose: false`. Registry encode/decode calls use the plugin; registry disposal releases its endpoint, while the example still owns the native port and Worker.
Output:

blocks.code:
chunk: text
restored: report 2

blocks.text: The output is `chunk: text`, then `restored: report 2`: the Worker-side JSON parser produces a text chunk and restores the original fields.

The explicit type 'json' replaces the default 'worker'; ownership defaults to 'copy' and terminateOnDispose to false. Registry disposal releases its parser endpoint, while the caller closes the native port and Worker. This is wiring evidence, not a speed measurement.

sections.heading: Keep input bytes available when a decode is cancelled

blocks.text: A byte buffer may be needed for a later retry, while the current decode can become unnecessary before it is sent.
Transferring a shared backing buffer can invalidate all its views; treating every cancellation as proof of detachment also discards input that was never sent.

Use workerParser's default copy policy for the real Worker JSON parser. Decode once, then pass a pre-aborted signal and inspect its failure cause and the original bytes before deciding whether to retry.

`workerParser({ worker: port1 })` uses `type: 'worker'`, `ownership: 'copy'`, `clientId: 'main'`, and `terminateOnDispose: false`. Decode receives `['bytes', bytes]` plus context: `signal` controls this call, and `'settings'` names its diagnostic context. The second call is cancelled before sending, preserving the original `DOMException` as cause and keeping the bytes attached; this does not prove forced interruption of work already running.
Output:
The output is `decoded: 2 11`, `cancelled: REQUEST_ABORTED true`, then `input: {"count":2}`.

Copy is the default ownership policy. This pre-cancelled decode preserves the caller's reason as cause and does not send work; it does not prove interruption of an already-running calculation. Transfer and byte detachment also do not establish zero-copy payload delivery.

This module connects two Worker use cases. WorkerAdapter / createWorkerHandler execute general computation, and workerComputed connects those requests to Resource. The serialization subentry connects an ordinary parser to a Worker and SerializeRegistry. rpc-core owns request correlation, providers, cancellation, deadlines, source handling, and error transport. resource owns caching, retry, and reactive lifetime; serialize owns formats and registry behavior. This module owns payload conversion, chunk credit / ACK, and the integration rather than another RPC engine.

Do not expect sender-side object identity or require the top-level error itself to be the original native class. Without a deadline, a provider that never settles can leave a request pending; every broken Worker is not guaranteed to settle promptly.

Serialization decode / request and pre-cancelled encode use SerializeCodecError / REQUEST_ABORTED with type (default worker), phase encode / decode, context, chunkIndex 0, and bytesConsumed (input byte length or zero). The caller's signal.reason remains on cause. Active encode streams can end with the original RPC / cancellation error rather than every codec diagnostic field. Credit waits and explicit stream stop create native DOMException / AbortError with message serialize stream cancelled and REQUEST_ABORTED, preserving native type, message, and stack through the error chain.

A general Adapter request after close / dispose.
Cooperative serialization or stream cancellation; inspect reason and actual buffer state.
Invalid response chunk or frame sequence.
Both parser Endpoint cleanup and optional termination failed.

blocks.text: STORE_WORKER_SOURCE is @migaia/store-worker. createStoreWorkerError(code, message, options?) requires code / message and accepts options.cause, returning an identified Error. createStoreWorkerAggregateError(code, errors, message) returns AggregateError retaining all values and ordering. code has type IStoreWorkerErrorCode, and factories do not overwrite stack. Complete foreign identities retain their owner.

For a pending request, check actual message.data delivery to the correct handler, then WorkerAdapter.timeoutMs / caller signal. workerParser uses context.signal and has no timeoutMs. Handle multi-chunk output incrementally rather than following the old local-merge model. A Worker still alive after Endpoint disposal usually reflects borrowed ownership: its creator terminates the general path, while serialization can opt into terminateOnDispose without claiming confirmed native exit.

The module has fmt / lint / typecheck / typecheck:test / test / build and typecheck:e2e / test:e2e. Browser e2e requires installed Playwright browsers. Node scenarios do not establish browser authorization or every host's behavior. Actual reports identify commands and results; a command list or old benchmark does not establish current verification.

libraries.description: Runtime-neutral supervision for execution units and coroutines.

blocks.text: English
后台任务、子进程和工作线程迟早会出问题：启动就崩溃、跑着跑着卡死、停止时迟迟不退出。`@migaia/supervision` 替你看管它们：限制同时运行的数量，确认它真正准备好才交给你，失败后按递增的间隔重启，失败太多就停下并告诉你原因；停止时分段限时，旧实例真正退出后才释放它占用的名额。

items: 崩溃风暴：子进程因为配置错误一启动就退出，`on('exit')` 里的重启逻辑每秒执行上百次，CPU 和日志被打满。根因是重启没有间隔，也没有“失败多少次就放弃”的上限。
卡死却显示“运行中”：进程还活着，但已经不处理任何请求。只监听退出事件发现不了，需要定期检查它是否还在干活。
发布时新旧版本同时干活，或者中间断档：先停旧再起新，中间有一段没人处理请求；先起新再停旧，又可能两个版本同时消费同一条任务。
关闭卡住，或者留下孤儿进程：子进程不理会退出信号，发布脚本一直等；父进程被强制结束后，子进程继续占着内存。

blocks.text: 下面的格式化服务前两次启动都会失败。监督器在每次失败后等待一段时间再重启，直到服务真正可用，`start()` 才返回 `ready`。
输出：

blocks.code: hello world | 启动次数: 3

blocks.text: 很多项目用几行代码自己“守护”子进程：
用监督器时，重启间隔、重启上限、停止限时和“停止后不再重启”都由同一个对象负责，不需要在每个项目里重新写一遍。

items: 即使服务一启动就崩溃，也不会无限重启。 默认第一次等 250 毫秒，之后每次翻倍，最长 30 秒；60 秒内最多自动重启 5 次，之后再失败就进入 `terminal` 状态，并通过 `report` 交出一个 `SUPERVISION_EXHAUSTED` 错误。你的原始错误一直保留在它的 `cause` 链上。
即使任务不理会停止信号，`stop()` 也会按时返回。 停止分三段：等应用收尾、等正常退出、强制结束后等回收，每段默认 5 秒。但这个任务占用的名额要等它真正退出才归还，所以新任务不会和没停干净的旧任务挤在一起。
替换时可以先起新、再停旧。 `replace({ strategy: 'start-then-switch' })` 等新实例准备好后才切换，旧实例在切换之后才收到停止信号。
旧实例不会冒充新实例。 每次成功启动都有新的 `generation` 编号，迟到的旧结果不会覆盖当前状态。
协程、线程、子进程用同一套规则。 平台差异只放在“启动器”里，重启、健康检查和停止策略写一次就能用于三种执行方式。
保证不了的事情会直接告诉你。 启动器必须如实声明自己能做到什么（例如能否结束整个进程树）。默认要求所有保证都成立，否则创建时就报错；你可以显式选择 `best-effort` 接受降级，降级项会出现在 `inspect().degraded` 里。

blocks.text: 一个被监督的执行单元（unit，一次启动出来的协程、线程或子进程）会经历这些阶段：

1. 申请名额：向预算（budget）申请一个位置。满了就排队，或者直接被拒绝。 2. 启动：启动器（launcher）按规格（spec）创建这个单元。 3. 确认就绪：如果提供了 `ready`，等它通过；超过启动时限（默认 10 秒）算启动失败。 4. 运行：`start()` 返回 `ready`。如果配置了健康检查，监督器会定期检查它。 5. 出问题：崩溃、健康检查连续失败或超出资源限制，都会结束这个单元，然后按重启策略退避重启，或者进入 `terminal`。 6. 停止：`stop()`、`replace()` 或 `dispose()` 按三段限时结束它。 7. 归还名额：只有单元真正退出后，名额才回到预算里。

rows: 创建一组单元共享的名额。
监督在当前事件循环里运行、能响应取消的任务。
监督由启动器创建的子进程。
监督由启动器创建的工作线程。

blocks.text: 完整用法见 USEGUIDE.md。
根入口负责预算、启动尝试、运行中单元的生命周期、限时停止、重启策略、健康检查、能力准入和状态观察。`./coroutine` 增加协作式任务；`./process` 和 `./threads` 使用同一套根契约。
创建预算 `createUnitBudget({ kind, maxUnits })`，再把预算、匹配的 profile、启动器、规格和 `report` 回调交给 `createSupervisor`。调用 `start()`，只有结果是 `ready` 时才使用单元；用完调用 `dispose()`。

启动器必须在单元停止、并且自己持有的资源都关闭之后，才让 `handle.exited` 完成；`exited` 永远不会以错误结束。profile 负责校验规格、声明需要的能力、幂等地结束单元，并给已完成的退出状态分类。`report` 接收终态、清理失败、迟到的失败和能力降级诊断。健康检查在响应取消时如果以自己的错误失败，即使监控已经关闭，这个错误也会被报告；如果它只是以取消原因结束，就不会再报告一次。`inspect()` 和 `subscribe()` 只观察状态，不会启动单元。
预算返回 `{ kind: 'granted', lease }` 或 `{ kind: 'rejected', reason }`。每个获得的名额只释放一次，`release()` 可以重复调用。关闭预算会拒绝排队中和之后的申请，已经发出的名额继续有效，直到对应单元真正退出。嵌套预算的单元类型必须相同，释放时先还父预算、再还子预算。

默认值：启动时限 10 秒；启动超时与其他启动失败使用同一套重启和终态策略；`acquireUnit` 抛出的错误以 `LAUNCH_FAILED` 报告，原始错误在 `cause` 上。停止的三段（应用收尾、正常退出、强制回收）各 5 秒。重启默认 `on-failure`，初始间隔 250 毫秒，倍数 2，最长 30 秒，60 秒内最多 5 次。默认终态策略是停在 `terminal`，直到显式调用 `restart()`；配置 `cooldown` 后会安排一次不阻止进程退出的重试。健康检查默认每 5 秒一次，单次限时 2 秒，连续 3 次失败判定为不健康。预算默认排队，排队最多等 30 秒，每秒最多发出 8 个名额。需要确定的时间行为时，传入自己的 scheduler。

核心只依赖 `@migaia/lifecycle` 和 `@migaia/utils`。profile 可以用 `hooks.acquireUnit` 接收预先启动好的单元，用 `hooks.afterLaunch` 挂接附属资源，用 `hooks.onReady` 挂接监控或让单元失败，用 `hooks.inspectUnit` 提供只读快照。登记在 `unit.scope` 里的附属资源在 `exited` 之后释放；登记在 `unit.monitors` 里的监控在结束单元之前释放。
监督器产生的错误带有 `source: '@migaia/supervision'` 和一个 `SupervisionErrorCode`；被包装的原始错误保留在 `cause` 上，清理失败可以通过 `errors` 找到。交给 `report` 的被动观察失败和迟到的检查失败保持原对象。状态和预算结果是返回值，不会作为错误抛出。

启动器明确声明 `exit-observation: 'unsupported'` 时，强制终止后立即报告 `EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE` 并将该代记为 abandoned，不等待 `reapTimeoutMs`。诊断详情包含 kind、generation 和 capability。名额仍保留到真实退出，不能把无法观察当作已经退出；可观察退出但超时的路径仍报告 `REAP_TIMEOUT`，启动阶段的回收超时也保持原行为。
`./process` 提供不经过 shell 的进程规格、能力检查、资源用量监控、有上限的输出尾部、持久的进程记录与回收、父进程断开保护，以及可选的有上限预热池。它只定义启动器接口，自己不创建操作系统进程。
`./threads` 用同样的预算、重启、健康检查、替换和限时释放策略监督由启动器创建的线程。启动器把 `heap-limit` 和 `exit-observation` 声明为 `enforced` 或 `unsupported`；不能可靠观察退出的启动器必须配置健康检查。线程既不能隔离崩溃，也不能限制 CPU；需要这两项保证时选择进程。

选项校验：`health.intervalMs` 必须是大于零的有限数；`startupTimeoutMs` 可以为零，表示立即到期；`restart.mode`、`terminalPolicy.mode`、`isolation` 只接受列出的取值；`stop` 三段时限都可以为零。未知的替换策略会在排队或停止当前单元之前抛出带 `INVALID_OPTION` 的错误。预热池和监督器用同样的方式接收注入的 scheduler。
English
包的定位、亮点和心智模型见 README。本指南先按场景给出可以直接运行的示例，再说明协程、进程和线程三种执行方式的详细契约。

sections.id: 监督一个真实的子进程
sections.heading: 监督一个真实的子进程

blocks.text: 本包只定义“启动器”接口，不直接调用操作系统 API，这样同一套策略可以用在 Node、Bun、Deno 和 Electron 上。`@migaia/rpc-process` 提供了现成的启动器，Node 用 `createNodeProcessLauncher()`。
下面的子进程每次启动 200 毫秒后都以退出码 3 崩溃，模拟一个读错配置的索引服务。监督器每次崩溃后间隔一段时间重启，重启 2 次后仍然失败，就进入 `terminal` 并停止尝试。
输出：
第一行 `CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED` 是降级提示：Node 启动器声明自己不能保证结束整个进程树，选择 `best-effort` 后监督器照常工作，但会把这一项报告一次，并记在 `inspect().degraded` 里。不写 `isolation: 'best-effort'` 时，创建监督器会直接抛出这个错误。
“重启成功”指新进程启动成功，不代表它之后不会再崩溃。这里没有提供 `ready`，所以进程一启动就算可用；真实服务应该提供 `ready`，例如等它在标准输出里打印“已就绪”，或者等一次连接成功。
默认规则：第一次重启前等 250 毫秒，之后每次翻倍，最长 30 秒；60 秒内最多自动重启 5 次，之后再失败，监督器进入 `terminal`。进入 `terminal` 时，`report` 会收到 `SUPERVISION_EXHAUSTED`，你的原始错误在它的 `cause` 链上。
输出：

blocks.code:
SUPERVISION_EXHAUSTED <- LAUNCH_FAILED <- EXIT_UNEXPECTED <- 配置文件缺失
start(): terminal | 启动次数: 4 | 占用名额: 0

blocks.text: 启动 4 次 = 第一次启动 + 3 次重启。`start()` 不会因为单元失败而抛错，它返回 `terminal`；失败细节交给 `report`，也可以从 `inspect().lastExit` 和 `inspect().terminalError` 读取。
进入 `terminal` 后，监督器不会自己恢复，除非你调用 `restart()`，或者配置 `terminalPolicy: { mode: 'cooldown', afterMs }` 让它冷却一段时间后再试一次。`restart: { mode: 'never' }` 表示任何失败都直接进入 `terminal`。

sections.id: 用心跳发现卡住的任务
sections.heading: 用心跳发现卡住的任务

blocks.text: 只监听“退出”发现不了卡住的任务。协程监督器可以要求任务定期调用 `heartbeat()`；超过 `heartbeat.timeoutMs` 没有心跳，就判定为不健康，结束这次运行并按重启规则重新开始。
下面的扫描任务每处理完一页报告一次心跳。第一次运行在第 3 页卡在一个不会返回的请求上。
输出：

blocks.code:
第 1 次运行：完成第 1 页
第 1 次运行：完成第 2 页
exit: unhealthy
第 2 次运行：完成第 1 页
第 2 次运行：完成第 2 页
第 2 次运行：完成第 3 页
exit: exited

blocks.text: 注意：协程和你的其他代码共用同一个事件循环，监督器只能“请求”它停下。卡在同步死循环里、或者完全不理会取消信号的任务，监督器无法强行结束，它占用的名额也不会归还（见限时停止与名额归还）。需要强制结束时，用子进程。
子进程和线程没有 `heartbeat` 选项，用通用的 `health: { check, intervalMs, timeoutMs, failureThreshold }`：默认每 5 秒检查一次，单次限时 2 秒，连续 3 次失败就判定为不健康。`heartbeat` 和 `health` 不能同时使用。
预算（budget）是一组监督器共享的名额。名额用完后，新的启动请求默认排队，最多等 30 秒；设置 `overflow: 'reject'` 时直接返回 `full`。预算还默认限制每秒最多启动 8 个，避免瞬间起一大批。
输出：

blocks.code:
开始导出 a.csv，同时运行: 1
开始导出 b.csv，同时运行: 2
开始导出 c.csv，同时运行: 2

blocks.text: `c.csv` 等到 `a.csv` 结束、名额空出来之后才开始。预算只能被同一类单元共用：协程、线程、进程各自使用自己的预算，`kind` 不一致时创建监督器会报 `INVALID_OPTION`。
`replace()` 用新的实例替换正在服务的实例，可以同时换一份新的规格（例如新版本的命令参数）。默认策略 `stop-then-start` 先停旧再起新；`start-then-switch` 先起新，新实例准备好后才切换，旧实例在切换之后才收到停止信号。后者需要预算里能同时容纳两个单元。
输出：

blocks.code:
v1 开始消费
v2 开始消费
切换: generation 1 -> 2
v1 停止消费
replace(): replaced
v2 停止消费

blocks.text: 新实例启动失败时，`replace()` 返回 `{ kind: 'failed', error }`，旧实例继续服务。新规格在停止旧实例之前就会被校验；未知的策略名会直接抛出 `INVALID_OPTION`。
`stop()` 分三段，每段默认 5 秒：

1. 应用收尾：如果提供了 `stop.beforeTerminate`，先让它完成手头的工作（`drainTimeoutMs`）。 2. 正常退出：请求单元退出，等待它真正退出（`exitTimeoutMs`）。 3. 强制回收：强制结束后等待实际退出（`reapTimeoutMs`），超时报告 `REAP_TIMEOUT`。如果启动器已明确声明 `exit-observation: 'unsupported'`，则立即报告 `EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE` 并按 abandoned 处理，不等待该回收窗口；诊断详情为 kind、generation 和 capability: `'exit-observation'`。重复释放不会重复报告。
`stop()` 一定会在这些时限内返回。但如果单元还没有真正退出，它占用的名额会一直保留，直到它真正退出为止。这样新任务就不会和一个没停干净的旧任务同时运行。
`EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE` 是能力边界，不表示线程卡死，也不表示退出已获确认。调用方应按 source/code 区分它与 `REAP_TIMEOUT`；需要真实退出保证时更换启动器。best-effort 准入时的 `CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`、required 模式的准入拒绝以及 launch 阶段超时均不改变。
输出：

blocks.code:
report: REAP_TIMEOUT
stop() 已返回，占用名额: 1
这时再申请名额: full
任务真正结束
任务结束后，占用名额: 0

blocks.text: `stop({ graceMs })` 只缩短这一次的“应用收尾”时间。`kill()` 跳过前两段，直接强制结束。`stop()` 之后可以再次 `start()`；`dispose()` 之后监督器永久关闭，再调用 `start()` 会被拒绝。

sections.id: 父进程退出与遗留进程
sections.heading: 父进程退出与遗留进程

blocks.text: 父进程被强制结束时，子进程收不到正常的停止请求。有两件事要做：

items: 子进程这一侧：用 `createParentLossGuard` 在父连接断开时开始收尾，并保证在 `graceMs`（默认 5 秒）内退出。收尾完成时退出码为 0；超时或收尾失败时为 1。
父进程这一侧：用持久的进程记录（registry）登记每个启动的子进程。下次启动时，先调用 `reclaimOrphanProcesses` 清理上次遗留的进程。它只结束“指纹”仍然匹配的进程；如果原来的 pid 已经被别的程序复用，只删除记录，不会误杀。

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
进度已保存
退出码: 0
结束遗留进程 4101
已结束: [ 'a' ] | 已删除记录: [ 'a', 'b' ]

blocks.text: 给 `createProcessSupervisor` 传入 `registry: { port, namespace }` 后，监督器会在启动时登记记录、在进程真正退出后删除记录。使用 registry 时，启动器必须实现 `probe` 和 `terminateRecord`。某条记录回收失败时，它会保留下来供下次再试，失败以 `ORPHAN_RECLAIM_FAILED` 报告。
`createPrewarmPool` 提前启动若干空闲进程。监督器 `start()` 时直接取用一个，省掉创建进程的时间；取用后监督器仍然会执行 `ready` 检查。预热池必须和监督器使用同一个预算、启动器和规格对象，预热进程同样占用预算名额。
输出：

blocks.code:
空闲进程: 1
start(): ready | 剩余空闲进程: 0

blocks.text: 空闲进程默认 60 秒没有被取用就会被结束。`restart()` 和 `replace()` 会绕过可能已经过时的空闲进程，重新启动。

sections.id: 协作式任务-协程-的完整契约
sections.heading: 协作式任务（协程）的完整契约

blocks.text: `expose(port)` 只能调用一次，第二次调用会在任务内部抛出带错误码的 `TypeError`。如果任务在 `expose` 之前就结束，`exposed` 会一直等待，`ready` 检查会等到启动时限。任务收到的 `signal` 在停止、替换和 `dispose()` 时触发；异步生成器还会收到一次 `return()` 请求。`exited` 总是以 `{ outcome: 'fulfilled' }` 或 `{ outcome: 'rejected', error }` 完成，不会以错误结束。自定义 AsyncIterable 的 `return()` 失败会立即报告，但 `exited` 要等进行中的 `next()` 结束才完成，名额也保留到那时。
协作式结束依赖任务自己结束。不理会取消的任务可能超过 5 秒的回收时限：监督器报告 `REAP_TIMEOUT`，把它记为 `abandoned`，并在它真正退出前一直保留预算名额。监督器不能打断同步循环，也不能把崩溃隔离在事件循环之外。因此 `fault-isolation` 能力是 `unsupported`；在默认的 `isolation: 'required'` 下请求这项能力会被拒绝。
`replace({ strategy: 'start-then-switch' })` 要求预算能同时容纳两个单元。新实例准备好、`switched` 事件发出之前，旧实例一直可用；之后旧任务才收到取消信号。`replace({ spec })` 在动当前单元之前先校验新规格。默认策略先停旧实例，再启动新实例。
任务调用 `heartbeat()`，或者从异步生成器中产出值时，可以使用 `heartbeat: { timeoutMs, intervalMs?, failureThreshold? }`。错过心跳会变成 `UNHEALTHY`，`cause` 链上有 `HEARTBEAT_MISSED`。`heartbeat` 和通用的 `health` 选项不能同时使用。

`@migaia/supervision/process` 是与平台无关的契约。你提供的启动器的 `launch(spec, context)` 必须不经过 shell 启动进程，只传递 `env.inherit` 里列出的环境变量和 `env.set`，从启动开始就通过 `context.output` 读取每个设为 `drain` 的输出流，并且只在进程和启动器自己持有的资源都关闭后，才让 `handle.exited` 完成。启动器必须生成一个在 pid 被复用时会变化的指纹，幂等地结束声明的进程树，并如实报告各项能力的强度。profile 本身从不调用平台的进程创建 API。

默认隔离要求是 `required`：缺少 `termination` 或 `fault-isolation` 保证时，创建监督器会抛出 `CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED`。调用方可以显式选择 `best-effort` 并查看 `degraded`，但这不会让启动器真正获得那些保证。要监控内存或 CPU 上限，启动器需要实现 `sampleUsage`；默认每 1 秒采样一次。`sampleUsage` 连续 3 次失败会把进程判定为不健康；一次成功的采样超过上限，进程会被立即结束。监督器和预热池都要求 `usage.intervalMs` 是大于零的有限数，`failureThreshold` 是正整数。每个输出流保留最近 65,536 字节。父进程断开保护默认给收尾 5 秒；预热的空闲进程默认保留 60 秒。

启动密钥（bootstrap）只能通过标准输入的前缀或专用的文件描述符传递，绝不能放在参数、环境变量、错误、快照或日志里。无法证明某种传递方式安全时，启动器必须把 `bootstrap-stdin` 或 `bootstrap-fd` 声明为 `unsupported`。Electron 的 `utilityProcess` 目前两种方式都不支持。Windows 上只有在启动器证明进程是在 Job Object 中创建的（或者先挂起创建、加入 Job Object 后再恢复，并处理好失败清理）之后，才能把进程树结束声明为 `enforced`。本包的内存测试不能证明这些平台保证。

持久回收：注入 registry，并在创建监督器或预热池之前调用 `reclaimOrphanProcesses`。回收只结束指纹仍然匹配的记录；pid 已被复用的记录只删除、不结束。失败的记录会保留，供下次再试。预热池使用和监督器相同的预算、启动器和规格对象；它启动空闲进程，但监督器取用后仍会执行就绪检查。`restart()` 和 `replace()` 会绕过过时的空闲进程。预热池和监督器使用相同的 id、registry 和 namespace 时，取用会沿用预热进程已有的持久记录及其退出清理；不同的拥有者各自登记记录。在补发缓冲输出或实时转发时，输出回调抛出的异常会被报告，但不会中断输出。registry 的 `list` 失败会以 `ORPHAN_RECLAIM_FAILED` 收集并报告，`detail.step` 为 `list`，此时不会动任何记录。

`@migaia/supervision/threads` 提供与运行时无关的线程契约。你提供的启动器的 `launch(spec, context)` 创建一个线程，返回可以幂等结束的句柄。它的 `exited` 只能在线程代码停止执行后完成，而且不能以错误结束。如果一个 Web 风格的线程在 error 事件之后仍在运行，启动器必须结束它，并以 `{ code: null, error }` 完成 `exited`。仅仅发出结束请求，或者收到运行时的关闭标记，都不能作为线程已经退出的证据。如果 `context.signal` 已经被取消，启动器必须拒绝，而不是创建线程。

启动器必须如实声明 `termination: 'enforced' | 'monitored' | 'unsupported'` 和 `fault-isolation: 'unsupported'`。在 `required` 隔离要求下，`enforced` 或 `monitored` 的结束能力可以通过，`unsupported` 会被拒绝；`monitored` 不代表运行时会强制执行。启动器还要如实声明 `heap-limit: 'enforced' | 'unsupported'` 和 `exit-observation: 'enforced' | 'unsupported'`。只有 `heap-limit` 为 `enforced` 时才接受 `heapBytes`；`callWallTimeMs` 原样交给启动器，用于它面向调用方的操作。不能可靠观察退出的启动器必须配置 `health` 检查，这样无声退出或停滞的线程才能被发现并结束。监督器不采样堆内存，线程也没有单独的“正常退出”阶段：先执行可选的 `beforeTerminate`，然后调用一次 `terminate()`；退出可观察时在回收时限内等待，明确不支持退出观察时立即报告 `EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE`。这两种 abandoned 结果都不会释放尚未确认实际退出的预算名额。
需要隔离崩溃、限制 CPU、持久回收遗留单元或读取输出时，选择 `@migaia/supervision/process`。线程代码和宿主共用同一个进程，无法提供这些保证。各平台的适配器及其验证属于对应的适配包；本包的内存测试不代表 Bun、Deno、浏览器或 Electron 的线程结束行为已经被验证。

items: `health.intervalMs` 必须是大于零的有限数，周期检查不能以零间隔运行。
`startupTimeoutMs` 可以为零，表示启动立即到期。
`restart.mode` 只接受 `never`、`on-failure`、`always`；未知取值在创建时被拒绝。
`terminalPolicy.mode` 只接受 `stay` 或 `cooldown`。
`isolation` 只接受 `required` 或 `best-effort`。
`stop` 的三段时限都可以为零，表示立即到期。
未知的替换策略会在排队或停止当前单元之前抛出 `INVALID_OPTION`。预热池和监督器用同样的方式接收注入的 scheduler。

blocks.text: 中文

Background tasks, child processes and worker threads fail sooner or later: they crash on startup, hang while still "running", or refuse to exit when you stop them. `@migaia/supervision` looks after them for you. It caps how many run at once, hands a unit to you only after it is actually ready, restarts it with a growing delay after a failure, and gives up with a clear error when failures pile up. Stopping is bounded in time, and a unit's slot is released only after the unit has really exited.

items: Crash loops. A child process exits right after start because of a bad config, and the restart in your `on('exit')` handler fires hundreds of times a second, flooding CPU and logs. The restart has no delay and no "give up after N failures" limit.
Hung but "running". The process is alive but no longer handles anything. Listening for exit cannot catch this; something has to check periodically that it still makes progress.
Overlap or a gap during deploys. Stop-then-start leaves a window where nobody serves requests; start-then-stop can let two versions consume the same job.
Shutdowns that hang, or orphans left behind. A child ignores the exit signal and your deploy script waits forever; after the parent is killed, children keep holding memory.

blocks.text: The formatter service below fails on its first two starts. The supervisor waits a little after each failure and tries again; `start()` returns `ready` only once the service is actually usable.

blocks.code: hello world | launches: 3

blocks.text: Next steps:

items: To supervise a real child process, read USEGUIDE: Supervise a real child process.
To see what happens when failures pile up, read USEGUIDE: Stop after too many crashes.
To swap versions without downtime, read USEGUIDE: Replace a unit without downtime.

blocks.text: Many projects "babysit" a child process with a few lines like these:
With a supervisor, restart delay, restart limit, stop deadlines and "do not restart after stop" belong to one object, instead of being rewritten in every project.

items: A unit that crashes on start is never restarted forever. The first retry waits 250 ms and each later one doubles, up to 30 s. At most 5 automatic restarts happen within 60 s; the next failure moves the supervisor to `terminal` and sends a `SUPERVISION_EXHAUSTED` error to `report`. Your original error stays on its `cause` chain.

`stop()` returns on time even if the task ignores the stop signal. Stopping has three phases: let the application drain, wait for a normal exit, then force and wait to reap. Each defaults to 5 s. The unit's slot, however, is released only when it really exits, so new work never piles onto a unit that has not finished stopping.

Replacement can start the new unit before stopping the old one. `replace({ strategy: 'start-then-switch' })` switches only after the new unit is ready; the old unit receives its stop signal after the switch.
An old unit cannot pass itself off as the new one. Every successful start gets a new `generation` number, so late results from an old unit never overwrite current state.
One set of rules for coroutines, threads and processes. Platform differences live only in the launcher; restart, health and stop policies are written once and apply to all three.

Guarantees it cannot keep are reported up front. A launcher must declare honestly what it can do, for example whether it can end a whole process tree. By default every guarantee is required and construction fails otherwise; you may opt into `best-effort`, and the missing guarantees appear in `inspect().degraded`.

blocks.text: A supervised unit (one started coroutine, thread or child process) goes through these stages:

1. Get a slot. It asks a budget for a place. When the budget is full it queues or is rejected. 2. Launch. The launcher creates the unit from its spec. 3. Confirm readiness. If you supply `ready`, the supervisor waits for it. Missing the startup deadline (10 s by default) counts as a failed start. 4. Run. `start()` returns `ready`. With health checks configured, the supervisor checks the unit periodically. 5. Fail. A crash, repeated failed health checks or a resource limit ends the unit; the restart policy then backs off and retries, or moves to `terminal`. 6. Stop. `stop()`, `replace()` and `dispose()` end the unit within the three stop phases. 7. Release the slot. The slot returns to the budget only after the unit has really exited.

What a unit needs to start, such as a coroutine's task function or a process's command and arguments.

blocks.text: See USEGUIDE.en.md for complete usage.

Runtime-neutral supervision for execution units. The root entry owns unit budgets, attempts, active-unit lifecycle, bounded teardown, restart policy, health checks, capability admission, and observation. The `./coroutine` entry adds cooperative tasks; other unit profiles use the same root contracts.

Create a budget with `createUnitBudget({ kind, maxUnits })`, then pass that budget, a matching profile, a launcher, a specification, and a `report` callback to `createSupervisor`. Call `start()` and use the unit only when its result is `ready`. Call `dispose()` when finished. The complete coroutine example is in USEGUIDE.en.md.

The launcher must fulfill `handle.exited` only after its unit has stopped and its own resources are closed. `exited` never rejects. The profile validates specifications, declares required capabilities, terminates idempotently, and classifies fulfilled exit statuses. `report` receives terminal, cleanup, late rejection, and degraded-capability diagnostics. A health check that rejects its own failure while responding to cancellation is still reported after monitor closure; the exact cancellation reason need not be reported again. `inspect()` and `subscribe()` expose state without creating a unit.

Budgets return `{ kind: 'granted', lease }` or `{ kind: 'rejected', reason }`. Release each granted lease once; `release()` is idempotent. Closing a budget rejects pending and future admissions while existing leases remain held until their units actually exit. Nested budgets share the unit kind and release parent before child.

The default startup timeout is 10 seconds. A startup timeout follows the same restart/terminal policy as other startup failures and publishes a stable readiness result; acquireUnit failures are LAUNCH_FAILED with the original cause, even before a lease exists. Stop uses 5 seconds each for drain, graceful exit, and force reap. Restart defaults to `on-failure`, with 250 ms initial delay, factor 2, 30 seconds maximum delay, five restarts in 60 seconds. The default terminal policy stays terminal until explicit restart; a configured cooldown schedules one unref'd retry. Health checks default to a 5 second interval, 2 second check timeout, and three consecutive failures. Budget defaults are queue overflow, 30 second queue timeout, and eight grants per second. Supply a scheduler for deterministic timing.

The core depends only on `@migaia/lifecycle` and `@migaia/utils`. A profile may use `hooks.acquireUnit` for a preacquired unit, `hooks.afterLaunch` to own attachments, `hooks.onReady` to own monitors or fail the unit, and `hooks.inspectUnit` for a read-only snapshot. Attachments registered in `unit.scope` release after `exited`; monitors registered in `unit.monitors` release before termination. Unit-specific entry points belong beside, never inside, the root implementation.

Supervisor-created failures carry `source: '@migaia/supervision'` and one semantic `SupervisionErrorCode`; wrapped original failures remain on `cause`, and cleanup failures remain reachable through `errors`. Passive observer and late-check failures sent to `report` retain their original objects. States and budget outcomes are values, not thrown codes.

When a launcher explicitly declares `exit-observation: 'unsupported'`, forced termination immediately reports `EXIT_UNOBSERVABLE` and marks the generation abandoned without waiting for `reapTimeoutMs`. Details include kind, generation and capability. Its lease remains held until actual exit: an unavailable observation is not an exit receipt. Observable exit that misses its deadline still reports `REAP_TIMEOUT`; launch-phase recovery timeouts also retain their existing behavior.

The `./process` entry adds a shell-free specification, capability checks, usage monitoring, bounded output tails, durable orphan records and recovery, a parent-loss guard, and an optional bounded prewarm pool. It defines a launcher port and does not start an operating-system process itself. See USEGUIDE.en.md for the process contract, defaults and cleanup.

The `./threads` entry supervises a launcher-owned thread with the same core budget, restart, health, replacement, and bounded release policy. The launcher declares `heap-limit` and `exit-observation` as `enforced` or `unsupported`; a launcher without enforced exit observation requires a health check. A thread is not a fault-isolation or CPU-limit boundary. Choose the process profile when either guarantee is required. See USEGUIDE.en.md for the thread launcher contract and example.
`health.intervalMs` must be finite and greater than zero, so recurring health checks cannot run at a zero interval.
`startupTimeoutMs` may be zero for an immediate one-shot startup deadline.
`restart` selects a supported mode and bounded exponential backoff; unknown modes fail option admission.
`terminalPolicy` selects stay or cooldown; unknown modes fail option admission.
`isolation` accepts required or best-effort; unknown modes fail option admission.
`stop` defines drain, exit and reap phases. Their one-shot budgets may be zero for an immediate deadline.

An unknown replacement strategy throws coded `INVALID_OPTION` before enqueuing or retiring the serving unit. The prewarm pool snapshots its injected scheduler through the same lifecycle admission as the supervisor.
